翻译: ...

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决在联邦学习环境下训练图像生成模型时，全局模型被恶意参与者泄露后无法验证版权归属且无法追踪具体泄露源的问题。同时，它克服了传统水印技术容易被替换组件攻击轻易移除的缺陷。该问题在现实中至关重要，因为模型非法流转不仅侵犯知识产权，还可能被用于生成有害内容或泄露隐私，而现有方法难以满足生成模型在隐私保护与版权溯源之间的平衡需求。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有方法无法追踪具体泄露客户端且水印易被替换移除的缺陷，设计了分块水印机制，将水印分为验证所有权和追踪客户端两部分。为防御替换攻击，作者基于潜在扩散模型中网络模块相互适应的训练特性，提出潜在向量变换技术，通过修改变分自编码器的数据分布，强制生成网络适应新分布，从而实现模块间的强绑定。该方法在核心算法上借鉴了Stable Signature等现有水印技术，并结合联邦学习场景进行了针对性改进。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用分块水印技术区分所有权验证与客户端溯源，并通过修改变分自编码器的潜在空间分布，使其与扩散模型的核心网络深度绑定，从而防止恶意客户端通过简单替换组件来去除水印。整体实现流程为：服务器首先对全局模型的变分自编码器进行潜在空间变换训练，接着为每个客户端生成并嵌入专属的分块水印模型副本。客户端在本地仅更新核心网络参数进行联邦训练并上传结果。一旦发生模型泄露，服务器即可从生成图像中提取水印，先验证模型归属，再精准定位泄露源。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于提出了首个支持所有权验证与泄露溯源的联邦潜在扩散模型水印框架。具体包括设计分块水印机制，将水印分为共享的前缀用于验证模型来源以及唯一的后缀用于精准定位泄露客户端；同时引入潜在向量变换技术，通过修改变分自编码器的潜在分布来紧密绑定模型组件，有效防止恶意替换解码器去除水印。相比以往仅能验证所有权且易被替换攻击破解的工作，该方法首次实现了生成模型在联邦环境下的安全溯源，并大幅提升了水印的抗攻击能力。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了首个面向联邦潜在扩散模型的框架，通过分块水印机制与潜在向量变换技术，实现了模型所有权验证与泄露溯源，并有效防止了恶意客户端通过替换组件移除水印的攻击。

Abstract

Training Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) within Federated Learning (FL) has attracted increasing attention due to its ability to combine the powerful generative capacity of LDMs with the privacy-preserving properties of FL. However, FL requires sharing the global model with multiple participants, which risks unauthorized model distribution or resale by malicious clients. While an intuitive approach is to adopt existing VAE-based watermarking techniques for LDMs in FL, this strategy falls short in addressing such threats due to two fundamental challenges: (1) Existing methods support ownership verification but lack the ability to trace model leakage to a specific malicious client; (2) VAE-based watermarks are vulnerable, as they can be removed simply by replacing the decoder with a clean counterpart. In this paper, we propose FedOT, the first framework for ownership verification and leakage tracing in federated LDMs. Specifically, to address the first challenge, we design a chunked watermark, where the first part is for ownership verification, and the second part is used for client identification. Furthermore, to overcome the second challenge and secure the model against VAE replacement attack, we introduce Latent Vector Transformation (LVT), which strengthens the connection between the VAE and U-Net latent spaces by modifying the original latent distribution of the VAE. Consequently, any attempt to replace the VAE for watermark removal leads to significant image quality degradation, making the LDM model unusable. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FedOT achieves superior performance in both ownership verification and traceability. Project page: this https URL .

item.title: EEG Benchmarking Needs a Task Specification Layer: NeuroDoc for Rulebook-Guided, Executable Benchmark Construction
item.author: Chengxuan Qin, Zhige Chen, Shu Peng, Rui Yang, Jiping Cui, Yikai Dong, Jun Li, Liu Peng, Zhida Shang, Mingze Tang, Kay Chen Tan, Jibin Wu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本研究针对公开脑电图数据集缺乏统一任务规范的问题，提出结合结构化任务语言与共享规则书的标准化框架。通过同步任务文档与可执行内核，发布了含二百四十五个任务定义的基准语料库及配套工具，并在多个基础模型中验证了其可复用性与可执行性，为脑电图基准测试的标准化与自动化奠定基础。

背景: 脑电图基础模型日益依赖多数据集训练与评估，但公开数据集缺乏共享的任务规范层，无法将异构记录转化为可复用基准单元。现有标准仅组织文件与元数据，未用统一语言规定任务，导致任务语义分散。

目的: 探究是否可通过结构化任务规范语言与共享规则书对异构公开脑电图数据集进行标准化。

方法: 将基准条目构建为与可执行任务内核同步的任务文档，规则书明确任务字段、证据要求、文档内核对齐、审查状态及机器可查约束。发布社区审查的基准语料库，并开发辅助工具支持任务起草、审查与管理。在四个脑电图基础模型骨干网络中实例化基准单元进行验证。

主要发现: 成功构建包含五十三个审查通过条目与二百四十五个任务定义的基准语料库，覆盖多种范式。基准单元能在共享下游环境中成功实例化于四个基础模型中，证实了该基础设施具备可复用、可审计与可执行特性。

结论: 结构化任务规范语言结合共享规则书能有效实现异构脑电图数据集的标准化，为构建可复用、可审计且可执行的脑电图基准测试基础设施提供了可靠路径。

翻译: 脑电图基础模型日益依赖多数据集训练与评估，但公开的脑电图数据集仍缺乏共享的任务规范层，无法将异构记录转化为可复用的基准单元。现有标准主要组织文件、元数据和溯源信息，但未在统一语言和规则框架下规定脑电图任务，导致关键任务语义分散于论文、代码和人工解读之中。本研究探讨了是否可通过结合结构化任务规范语言与共享规则书来实现异构公开脑电图数据集的标准化。我们的方法将每个基准条目表示为与可执行任务内核同步的任务文档，规则书定义了任务字段、证据要求、文档与内核的对齐方式、审查状态及机器可检查的约束。基于该方法，我们发布了一个经社区审查的脑电图基准语料库，包含五十三个已完成并审查通过的条目，涵盖二百四十五个任务定义，涉及多种范式。同时，我们引入了NeuroDoc和NeuroAudit作为操作支持层，用于指导规则书驱动的起草、升级、审查、修订和发布管理。我们进一步检验了生成的基准单元是否能在共享的下游环境中实例化于四个脑电图基础模型骨干网络中，从而为可复用、可审计且可执行的脑电图基准测试基础设施提供了基于执行的证据。

Abstract

Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models increasingly rely on multi-dataset training and evaluation, yet public EEG datasets still lack a shared task specification layer that can turn heterogeneous recordings into reusable benchmark units. Existing standards organize files, metadata, and provenance, but they do not specify EEG tasks under a common language and rulebook, leaving critical task semantics scattered across papers, code, and manual interpretation. We investigate whether heterogeneous public EEG datasets can be standardized through a structured task specification language paired with a shared rulebook. Our methodology represents each benchmark entry as a task document synchronized with an executable task kernel, with the rulebook defining task fields, evidence requirements, document-kernel alignment, review states, and machine-checkable constraints. Using this methodology, we release a community-reviewed EEG benchmark corpus centered on 53 completed and reviewed entries with 245 task definitions spanning diverse paradigms, and we introduce NeuroDoc and NeuroAudit as the operational support layer for rulebook-guided drafting, upgrading, review, amendment, and release management. We further examine whether the resulting benchmark units can be instantiated in a shared downstream setting across four EEG foundation model backbones, providing execution-based evidence for reusable, auditable, and executable EEG benchmarking infrastructure.

item.title: Evaluating self-supervised echocardiographic representations across downstream extraction strategies for left-ventricular segmentation and ejection fraction estimation
item.author: Sylwia Majchrowska, Philip Teare
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ...

背景: ...

目的: ...

方法: ...

主要发现: ...

结论: ...

翻译: ...

Abstract

Self-supervised learning (SSL) is increasingly used in medical imaging to reduce annotation requirements, but representation quality is often judged using a single downstream evaluation setting. For dense clinical tasks, this can confound representation quality with the capacity of the downstream model used to recover task-relevant information. We present a systematic evaluation of self-supervised representations for left-ventricular segmentation and ejection fraction (EF) estimation from apical four-chamber echocardiography on EchoNet-Dynamic. Rather than relying on a single downstream probe, we compare a hierarchy of extraction strategies with increasing expressivity: heuristic extraction without mask-supervised training, frozen linear probes, frozen lightweight decoder probes, and partial fine-tuning. We apply this framework to two complementary representation families: generic frozen self-DIstillation with NO labels (DINOv3) features and a task-adapted dense self-supervised representation, Bootstrap Your Own Segmentation (BYOS). In both families, heuristic extraction substantially understated what was recoverable from the frozen representation. For DINOv3, performance improved from Dice 0.684 and EF mean absolute error (MAE) 13.01 under heuristic extraction to Dice 0.906 and EF MAE 9.65 with a frozen lightweight decoder, approaching a supervised U-Net baseline (Dice 0.915, EF MAE 9.72). For BYOS, performance improved from Dice 0.687 and EF MAE 17.83 under heuristic extraction to Dice 0.902 and EF MAE 8.74 with a frozen lightweight decoder. These results show that conclusions about self-supervised representation quality in dense echocardiographic analysis depend strongly on the downstream extraction strategy used for evaluation. We therefore argue that multi-strategy evaluation is an important methodological consideration for SSL in dense medical image analysis.

item.title: Unlimited OCR Works
item.author: Yin, Youyang, Liu, Huanhuan, YY, Xie, Qunyi, Liu, Chaorun, Yang, Shiqi, Wang, Shaohua, Liu, Zhanlong, Zou, Hao, Chen, Jinyue, Wei, Shu, Wu, Jingjing, Huang, Mingxin, Wu, Zhen, Wang, Guibin, Du, Tengyu, Jia, Lei
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为无限光学字符识别的新模型，通过替换解码器注意力机制，解决了长文本生成时的内存与速度瓶颈，实现了单次前向传播即可转录数十页文档的高效能力。

背景: 基于大语言模型解码器的端到端光学字符识别模型虽能提升性能，但输出序列变长时会导致键值缓存累积，从而大幅增加内存消耗并显著降低生成速度，这与人类在长程抄写任务中保持高效的特点形成鲜明对比。

目的: 设计一种能够模拟人类解析工作记忆的模型，以克服长序列生成过程中的效率下降问题。

方法: 以现有模型为基线，将解码器中的所有注意力层替换为参考滑动窗口注意力机制，该机制在降低注意力计算成本的同时，在整个解码过程中保持键值缓存恒定，并结合编码器的高压缩率特性。

主要发现: 该模型在标准最大长度限制下，单次前向传播即可转录数十页文档；所提出的注意力机制具有通用性，不仅适用于光学字符识别，同样适用于语音识别、机器翻译等任务。

结论: 该设计有效解决了长文本转录的内存与速度瓶颈，验证了恒定键值缓存设计的有效性，且相关代码与模型权重已公开。

翻译: 近期，以深度光学字符识别为代表的端到端光学字符识别模型再次引发关注。一种普遍观点认为，采用大语言模型作为解码器能够利用语言先验分布，从而提升光学字符识别性能。然而，其缺点同样明显：随着输出序列变长，累积的键值缓存会推高内存消耗并逐渐降低生成速度。这与人类在长程抄写任务中效率不降反升的特点形成鲜明对比。在本技术报告中，我们提出了无限光学字符识别模型，旨在模拟人类的解析工作记忆。我们以深度光学字符识别为基线，将解码器中的所有注意力层替换为提出的参考滑动窗口注意力机制，该机制在降低注意力计算成本的同时，在整个解码过程中保持键值缓存恒定。结合深度光学字符识别编码器的高压缩率与我们的恒定键值缓存设计，无限光学字符识别模型在标准最大长度限制下，单次前向传播即可转录数十页文档。更重要的是，参考滑动窗口注意力机制是一种通用解析注意力机制，除光学字符识别外，同样适用于语音识别、翻译等任务。代码与模型权重已公开。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有端到端光学字符识别模型在处理长文档时，因注意力机制累积缓存导致的内存消耗激增和生成速度下降的问题。该问题在研究和现实中非常重要，因为实现单次连续解析数十页文档的能力是迈向通用人工智能的关键一步，同时也能大幅提升实际办公、文献数字化和长文本翻译等场景的工作效率。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者受人类在长文本处理时仅关注原文、近期输出与下一字符且记忆会自然淡化的认知机制启发，设计了参考滑动窗口注意力机制。该设计让模型在生成过程中始终关注全部参考信息，同时仅保留固定长度的历史输出缓存，从而避免显存随长度无限增长。在实现上，作者直接以DeepSeek OCR为基线，保留其高压缩率的图像编码器，并将解码器的注意力模块替换为该方法，整体思路借鉴了现有端到端OCR架构与高效注意力计算的技术路线。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是模拟人类长文本抄写时的认知习惯，即不无限累积已生成的历史文本，而是仅关注完整的参考图像与固定长度的最近输出片段，从而将内存占用和计算成本控制在恒定水平。整体实现流程以现有端到端模型为基线，保留其高压缩率的图像编码器，并将解码器中的所有注意力层替换为参考滑动窗口注意力机制。在生成过程中，模型始终访问全部视觉参考信息，同时通过固定容量的队列管理输出缓存，旧缓存生成后即被自动替换，最终实现单次运行即可连续解析数十页文档。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点是提出了参考滑动窗口注意力机制，使模型在生成文本时同时关注完整的参考信息（如图像特征）和固定长度的历史输出。相比以往模型随着生成变长而无限膨胀的缓存以及逐页循环处理的模式，该设计将输出缓存大小固定为常数，大幅降低了内存占用与计算成本。这使得模型能够在单次运行中连续解析数十页文档，实现了类似人类工作记忆的长序列高效解析。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种参考滑动窗口注意力机制，通过在整个解码过程中保持缓存大小恒定，大幅降低了长文本处理的计算成本与内存占用，并基于此构建了新型光学字符识别模型，实现了单次处理即可转录数十页文档的长程解析能力，同时提升了整体识别精度。

Abstract

Recently, end-to-end OCR models, exemplified by DeepSeek OCR, have once again thrust OCR into the spotlight. A widely held view is that employing a large language model (LLM) as the decoder allows the model to leverage the prior distribution of language, leading to improved OCR performance. However, the downside is equally evident: as the output sequence lengthens, the accumulated KV cache drives up memory consumption and progressively slows down generation. This stands in stark contrast to humans, who exhibit no such decline in efficiency during long-horizon copying tasks. In this technical report, we propose Unlimited OCR, a model designed to emulate human parsing working memory. Taking DeepSeek OCR as the baseline, we replace all attention layers in the decoder with our proposed Reference Sliding Window Attention (R-SWA), which reduces attention computation costs while maintaining a constant KV cache throughout the entire decoding process. By combining the high compression rate of DeepSeek OCR's encoder with our constant KV cache design, Unlimited OCR can transcribe dozens of pages of documents in a single forward pass under a standard maximum length of 32K. More importantly, R-SWA is a general-purpose parsing attention mechanism - beyond OCR, it is equally applicable to tasks such as ASR, translation, etc. Codes and model weights are publicly available at this http URL .

item.title: Technical Report for the ICRA 2026 GOOSE 2D Fine-Grained Semantic Segmentation Challenge: Pretraining-Diverse Ensemble of Foundation Vision Encoders for Robust Outdoor Scene Understanding
item.author: Boyan Wang, Yongxi Huang, Wenjing Li, Tianrui Hui, Shaofei Huang, Nan Pu, Zhun Zhong
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ...

背景: ...

目的: ...

方法: ...

主要发现: ...

结论: ...

翻译: ...

Abstract

This report presents our solution for the ICRA 2026 GOOSE 2D Fine-Grained Semantic Segmentation Challenge, which requires parsing unstructured outdoor scenes from four camera platforms into 56 fine-grained categories. Our approach pairs foundation vision encoders (including DINOv3, SigLIP2, and InternImage) with a Mask2Former decoder, and trains them with a strong recipe including long training schedules, exponential moving average, a larger crop size, and multi-scale plus flip test-time augmentation. The three encoders, chosen for their complementary pretraining objectives, are combined into a pretraining-diverse ensemble through per-class validation-IoU weighting. Evaluated on the official GOOSE test set, our submission achieves 75.40% composite mIoU and wins the second place of the challenge. Our study further shows that the encoder's pretraining recipe, rather than its parameter count or the decoder design, is the dominant factor for accuracy on this benchmark.

item.title: Tmax: A simple recipe for terminal agents
item.author: Ivison, Hamish, Yin, Junjie Oscar, Shao, Rulin, Xiao, Teng, Lambert, Nathan, Hajishirzi, Hannaneh
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ...

背景: ...

目的: ...

方法: ...

主要发现: ...

结论: ...

翻译: ...

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决终端智能体在强化学习训练方面缺乏高质量数据、简单有效的训练方法以及针对复杂长程任务的研究空白。该问题之所以重要，是因为终端智能体已成为大语言模型最热门的实际应用场景之一，能够有效训练此类模型不仅有助于推动开源人工智能技术的发展，还能为学术界提供可靠的基础参考，从而加速更复杂自动化任务的实现。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有终端智能体数据生成流程复杂、任务覆盖单一且缺乏难度控制的问题，设计了一套基于结构化分类轴的合成数据流水线。该方法明确借鉴了Endless Terminals等前期工作利用强外部模型生成任务的思路，但通过引入显式难度校准、角色多样化和多模态附件等机制，大幅提升了数据规模与任务复杂度。同时，作者参考了角色条件数据合成与强化学习软过滤的相关研究，去除了昂贵的验证步骤，使整个数据生成与训练流程更加轻量且易于复现。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是通过结构化采样与显式难度控制，低成本构建大规模多样化的终端训练数据，并配合简单的强化学习配方进行模型训练。整体流程首先基于多个正交维度分层生成任务描述，随后为每个任务快速构建可执行的容器环境。接着利用训练过程中的通过率自动过滤无效样本，最后使用稳定的强化学习算法对模型进行优化，从而在保持流程简洁的同时显著提升终端任务处理能力。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一套简单高效的终端智能体数据生成与强化学习训练方案。相比以往工作，它通过分层采样和显式难度控制生成了规模更大、领域分布更均衡且整体难度更高的合成数据集，并省去了昂贵的数据验证步骤。在模型训练上，论文采用更稳定的强化学习算法替代了传统的监督微调，不仅性能显著超越同类开源模型，还证明了所学能力能够泛化到不同测试环境和任务中，而非仅仅适应特定的训练框架。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一套简单高效的终端智能体强化学习训练方案，并开源了规模更大、难度可控且覆盖广泛的终端任务数据集与完整代码，使开源模型在终端任务基准上取得了领先性能并展现出良好的跨任务泛化能力。

Abstract

Terminal-using agents have quickly become the most popular downstream application of language models (LMs). Despite their prevalence, relatively little academic work has examined RL-based training of these models, likely due to difficult benchmarks, a lack of data, and a lack of simple baseline recipes. We present Tmax, the strongest open RL recipe for terminal agents to date, bringing open data recipes closer to the frontier. While simple, our recipe achieves 27\% on Terminal-Bench 2.0 with only 9B parameters, outperforming much larger models from prior work. Concretely, we generate data using a novel taxonomy, combining difficulty control, personas, and verifier diversification, which allows us to cheaply generate large amounts of terminal environments for RL and SFT training. We open-source our terminal dataset, which is over 2.5x larger than previously released terminal-agent datasets. We then train open-weight models using RL with our data, using a simple, outcome-only recipe. We release our data, models, and code as a strong baseline for future open academic work on terminal agents at this https URL .

item.title: Tapered Language Models
item.author: Bayat, Reza, Behrouz, Ali, Courville, Aaron
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出锥形语言模型架构原则，通过在固定参数预算下沿网络深度单调调整多层感知机宽度，实现模型性能提升。

背景: 现代语言模型通常采用由相同层堆叠的架构，参数在深度方向上均匀分配。但研究表明各层对输出的贡献存在非对称性，后期层主要用于细化信息。

目的: 探讨参数容量分配是否应当反映层级贡献的非对称性，即验证将更多容量分配给早期层是否优于均匀分配。

方法: 在固定参数预算下进行对照实验，提出沿深度单调收缩参数组件的架构设计。具体采用平滑余弦调度策略调整多层感知机宽度，并在三种模型规模及四种不同架构上进行广泛测试。

主要发现: 在固定预算下，将更多参数容量分配给早期层而减少后期层容量，相比均匀宽度基线能显著改善困惑度并提升下游基准测试表现，且无需增加额外参数或计算成本。反向分配则会损害性能。

结论: 基于深度的容量分配是一种简单且与具体架构无关的语言模型设计维度，为模型优化提供了一个无需额外开销的有效改进方向。

翻译: 现代语言模型，包括变压器、循环和基于记忆的变体，共享一个共同的架构基础：由相同层堆叠而成，参数在深度上均匀分配。这是从原始变压器继承的默认设置，且长期未变。然而，越来越多的证据表明，各层对最终输出的贡献并不均匀，后期层主要用于细化残差流而非进行转换。我们探讨参数容量是否应反映这种不对称性。受控实验表明，在固定预算下，将更多容量分配给早期层而减少后期层容量，相比均匀宽度基线能改善困惑度表现，而反向分配则会损害性能。基于此，我们提出锥形语言模型，这是一种在固定总预算下沿深度单调收缩参数组件的架构原则。多层感知机是实施该原则的理想位置，因其占据现代语言模型参数主体且宽度是单一清晰的变量轴。在三种模型规模和四种架构上，通过平滑余弦调度策略收缩多层感知机宽度，一致地改善了困惑度和下游基准测试性能，且未增加额外参数或计算成本。这些发现确立了深度感知容量分配作为一种简单、与架构无关的语言模型设计维度，为模型优化提供了一个无需额外开销的有效杠杆。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现代语言模型在各层之间平均分配参数容量的问题，探索将更多计算资源集中在靠前的层、减少靠后层的容量是否能提升模型效果。该问题之所以重要，是因为现有研究表明不同深度的层对最终输出的实际贡献并不均匀，早期层负责核心特征提取而后期层多用于微调。通过这种非均匀的容量分配，可以在不增加总参数量和计算成本的前提下，显著提升模型的预测精度与下游任务表现，为语言模型架构设计提供了一个简单且普适的优化方向。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者基于现有研究中网络各层贡献不均的共识进行思考，发现传统模型在各层均匀分配参数与实际情况不符，从而提出将参数容量按深度递减的设计。该方法借鉴了早期退出、层跳过、结构冗余分析及可解释性研究等多项现有工作，这些研究均表明浅层负责核心特征提取而深层仅做微调。作者据此选择多层感知机宽度作为调整对象，采用平滑衰减曲线在固定总参数量下实现容量前重后轻的重新分配。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是在总参数量和计算成本固定的前提下，打破传统模型各层参数均匀分配的模式，将更多的网络容量集中在靠前的层，并随层数加深逐渐减少靠后层的参数规模。整体实现流程是将模型中负责主要参数存储的前馈网络中间维度，按照线性、余弦或平滑下降的曲线规则，从第一层到最后一层进行单调递减的平滑调整。调整过程中会确保各层宽度的平均值与原始均匀模型一致，并将每层宽度取整以适配硬件，其余网络结构保持不变。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出一种深度感知容量分配原则，即在固定总参数量下，让网络中负责核心计算的多层感知机宽度随层数加深而平滑递减。与以往默认各层参数均匀分配或依赖后期剪枝压缩的工作不同，该方法在架构设计初期就将更多计算资源前置于早期层。实验证明，这种策略能在不增加任何参数和计算成本的前提下，显著提升模型性能，且该原则具有架构无关性，可广泛适用于多种主流语言模型结构。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了锥形语言模型架构原则，通过在固定参数总量下沿网络深度平滑递减多层感知机宽度，在不增加额外计算成本的前提下统一提升了多种架构与规模模型的困惑度及下游任务表现，并从机制上证实了将参数能力前置分配至浅层更为有效。

Abstract

Modern language models, including transformer, recurrent, and memory-based variants, share a common chassis: a stack of identical layers in which parameters are allocated uniformly across depth. This is a default inherited from the original transformer and largely unchanged since, yet a growing body of evidence suggests that layers contribute non-uniformly to the final output, with later layers refining the residual stream rather than transforming it. We ask whether parameter capacity should reflect this asymmetry. Our controlled experiment shows that, under a fixed budget, allocating more capacity to earlier layers and less to later layers improves perplexity over a uniform-width baseline, while the reverse allocation hurts. Building on this result, we introduce Tapered Language Models (TLMs), an architectural principle in which a parameter-bearing component is monotonically tapered across depth under a fixed total budget. MLPs are the natural site for this instantiation: they dominate parameter count across all modern LM families and expose width as a single, clean axis of variation. Across three model scales and four architectures (Transformer, Gated Attention, Hope-attention, and Titans), tapering MLP width via a smooth cosine schedule consistently improves perplexity and downstream benchmark performance over uniform baselines, at no additional parameter or compute cost. These findings establish depth-aware capacity allocation as a simple, architecture-agnostic axis of language model design, a free lever hidden in plain sight.

item.title: Efficient implementation of graph autoencoders for model-order reduction of systems with sharp gradients
item.author: Liam K Magargal, Parisa Khodabakhshi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本研究提出了一种基于图自编码器的模型降阶框架，用于处理具有尖锐梯度特征的高维动力系统，在计算效率与预测精度之间取得了良好平衡。

背景: 传统线性近似方法在处理具有尖锐梯度特征的高维动力系统时往往表现不足。

目的: 高效部署图自编码器以实现高维动力系统的模型降阶，以克服传统方法的局限性。

方法: 提出图神经网络潜在空间动力学识别方法，采用算子学习框架直接近似图自编码器潜在表示的时间演化过程，并与几何深度最小二乘伽辽金方法及基于本征正交分解的方法进行对比，同时引入了一种针对尖锐梯度位置的新型点云误差度量指标。

主要发现: 在含尖锐梯度的数值实验中，该方法比几何深度最小二乘伽辽金方法计算成本显著更低，虽略高于基于本征正交分解的方法，但精度远高于后者，实现了精度与加速比的平衡。新型点云误差指标在评估尖锐梯度区域精度时比传统指标更直观有效。

结论: 该框架能有效解决具有尖锐梯度系统的降阶建模问题，兼顾计算效率与预测精度，且新型误差指标为相关区域模型评估提供了更优的参考。

翻译: 本研究探讨了将图自编码器高效部署于高维动力系统模型降阶中的应用。所提出的框架利用图自编码器进行非线性降维，从而为具有尖锐梯度特征的系统提供低维表示，而传统线性近似方法对此类系统往往力不从心。具体而言，本研究引入了图神经网络潜在空间动力学识别方法。该方法采用算子学习框架，直接近似图自编码器潜在表示的时间演化过程。研究将所提方法与几何深度最小二乘伽辽金方法及结合本征正交分解降维与算子学习的本征正交分解潜在空间动力学识别方法进行了性能对比。除标准误差指标外，本文还提出了一种新型点云误差指标，专门用于评估解中尖锐梯度位置的识别精度。通过两个包含尖锐梯度的数值实验，验证了该指标及所提降阶框架的有效性。在所研究的问题中，该方法比几何深度最小二乘伽辽金方法的计算成本显著更低，尽管其计算成本略高于本征正交分解潜在空间动力学识别方法。然而，该方法实现了远高于后者的精度，从而在预测精度与计算加速比之间取得了平衡。此外，结果表明，在尖锐梯度区域，所提出的点云误差指标比传统误差指标能提供更直观且信息更丰富的降阶模型精度度量。

Abstract

This study investigates the efficient deployment of graph autoencoders, a class of graph neural networks (GNNs), for model-order reduction (MOR) of high-dimensional dynamical systems. The proposed framework leverages graph autoencoders to perform nonlinear dimensionality reduction, enabling low-dimensional representations of systems characterized by sharp gradients for which conventional linear approximations, such as proper orthogonal decomposition (POD), are inadequate. Specifically, this study introduces graph neural network latent space dynamics identification (GNN-LaSDI). GNN-LaSDI employs an operator learning framework to directly approximate the temporal evolution of the graph autoencoder's latent representation. The performance of GNN-LaSDI is assessed against both geometric deep least-squares Petrov-Galerkin (GD-LSPG and POD latent space dynamics identification (POD-LaSDI), which combines POD-based dimensionality reduction with operator learning. In addition to standard error metrics, this work presents a novel point cloud error metric specifically tailored to evaluate the accuracy of the identified locations of sharp gradients within the solution. The effectiveness of the metric and the proposed MOR framework is demonstrated through two numerical experiments featuring sharp gradients. For the studied problems, GNN-LaSDI incurs a substantially lower computational cost than GD-LSPG, though it remains slightly more computationally expensive than POD-LaSDI. However, GNN-LaSDI achieves significantly greater accuracy than POD-LaSDI, thereby providing a balance between predictive accuracy and computational speedup. Additionally, the results indicate that the proposed point cloud error provides a more intuitive and informative measure of reduced-order model accuracy in regions with sharp gradients than conventional error metrics.

Abstract

This work investigates the implementation of artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) for real-time monitoring in laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) additive manufacturing. We developed a binary image classification framework for distinguishing normal and abnormal melt pool images using a balanced dataset of 1,200 images collected from Nickel superalloy 625 on the NIST AMMT platform. The study evaluates accuracy and inference time based on control requirements and hardware limitations of open-architecture LPBF machines. We benchmark three transfer learning architectures (ResNet50, EfficientNetB0, and MobileNetV2) against two Random Forest approaches: one trained on EfficientNetB0 feature embeddings (hybrid) and one trained on raw pixel features (baseline). Images are stratified into 80/20 train-test splits, with a further 90/10 validation split on the training set, and undergo standardized resizing, normalization, and label-preserving data augmentation to emulate realistic process variability. Each model is evaluated using accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), along with training time, inference latency, and CPU & GPU usage to capture deployability constraints relevant to factory-floor monitoring. The hybrid EfficientNetB0-plus-Random Forest approach achieves the best performance on the held-out test set, with an F1 score of 0.9451, accuracy of 0.9458, and AUC of 0.9904, while maintaining sub-millisecond per-image inference (1.15 ms). In contrast, purely deep learning models exhibit significantly higher inference times with lower accuracy. These results demonstrate that combining pre-trained convolutional features with classical ensemble methods provides a robust, computationally efficient route to real-time melt pool anomaly detection in data-limited additive manufacturing environments.

Abstract

Purpose: To evaluate the feasibility and challenges of heart chamber segmentation from non-contrast CT scans using contrastive unpaired image translation and deep learning-based segmentation. Approach: We developed ChameleonNet, a framework utilizing the Contrastive Unpaired Translation (CUT) network with decoupled contrastive learning (DCL) loss to synthesize non-contrast CT from contrast CT scans. Using annotations of four heart chambers (left atrium (LA), left ventricle (LV), right atrium (RA), and right ventricle (RV)) from contrast scans, we trained a Hausdorff distance loss-enhanced nnU-Net on synthesized non-contrast images. The translation model was trained with 35,538 contrast-enhanced and 37,197 non-contrast CT slices. The segmentation model was trained with 292 synthesized non-contrast scans. Performance was evaluated using Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) and 95th Hausdorff distance (HD95) on 36 synthesized non-contrast scans, and volume agreement on 36 real non-contrast CT scans was assessed using Pearson correlation, mean absolute percentage error (MAPE), and mean percentage error (MPE). Results: The segmentation model achieved DSC of 0.94 (0.01), 0.91 (0.04), 0.92 (0.03), 0.93 (0.02), and HD95 of 3.63 (1.49), 5.74 (4.08), 5.18 (1.77), 5.51 (3.21) mm on synthesized non-contrast images for LA, LV, RA, and RV, respectively. On real non-contrast CT scans, Pearson correlations were 0.93, 0.82, 0.87, and 0.89 (all p<0.001), with MAPE ranging from 9.22% to 20.79%, and MPE ranging from -12.52% to 4.67%. Conclusions: ChameleonNet demonstrated feasibility for heart chamber segmentation from non-contrast CT without manual non-contrast annotations. However, volume errors, particularly for LV and RV, indicate that further refinement and validation are needed before clinical use.

Abstract

Robust perception underpins autonomous driving, and most recent progress comes from scaling the model-larger backbones, foundation models, and cooperative multi-agent fusion. We pursue a complementary, upstream question: what should the camera itself measure? Using a differentiable RAW-to-task pipeline, we decompose which sensor degrees of freedom benefit dense prediction. Learning the spectral colour-filter-array (CFA) weights is the dominant lever, improving mIoU by +0.017 (KITTI-360) and +0.023 (ACDC) over a fixed camera. In contrast, point-spread-function (optics) co-design is net-negative (-0.020 mIoU on KITTI-360) - a consequence of the data-processing inequality, which also bounds the task information that any downstream model, however large or cooperative, can recover. Noise co-optimisation is marginal, and counter to intuition enlarging the CFA tile beyond 2x2 consistently hurts, as the filters are confined to the rank three sRGB input. Because the intervention is at the sensor, the gains are model-agnostic; we validate robustness on ACDC's fog, night, rain, and snow, and conclude with a simple recipe: learn the 2x2 CFA weights and keep an identity PSF.

Abstract

Most electronic health record (EHR) foundation models encode clinical events as discrete event tokens from a fixed vocabulary and therefore cannot directly represent events containing unseen concepts or new combinations of concepts and attributes such as numeric values. This limits transfer across institutions and even across deployment pipelines within the same institution. We introduce PORTER, a language-grounded structured EHR foundation model that decouples event representation from this fixed vocabulary. PORTER represents events through their descriptions using a frozen text encoder, integrates numeric values through a dedicated pathway, and learns clinical dynamics over patient timelines with an autoregressively pretrained temporal backbone. Across 74 clinical prediction tasks at a pediatric hospital, PORTER matched the mean AUROC of a fixed-vocabulary model with the same temporal backbone and pretraining objective. When the same patient timelines were rendered using event descriptions not seen during pretraining, PORTER transferred without retraining or vocabulary mapping, recovering 97.1% of the mean AUROC of a model trained directly on the target vocabulary. When transferred to MIMIC, PORTER outperformed the fixed-vocabulary model, which dropped 69% of events because their tokens were unseen. Mechanistic analyses showed cross-vocabulary transfer tracked preservation of patient-level representation geometry rather than the scale of the text encoder, and the numeric pathway improved sensitivity to magnitude without disrupting clinical concept identity. PORTER also achieved higher AUROC than a task-specific text serialization comparator, at 329-fold lower amortized compute. PORTER is a step toward vocabulary-independent EHR foundation models that reduce the need for vocabulary harmonization while preserving in-domain performance and enabling efficient cross-task reuse.

Abstract

Timely, high-resolution maps of flood extent around settlements are essential for emergency response and damage assessment. We consider airborne RGB imagery for flood mapping as it can be collected rapidly at low cost. To produce flood maps, deep learning models for water segmentation are often used. CNN based and small vision transformer models are used. However, they need much data for adaptation to a change of scenery, i.e., another flooding event. Vision foundation models or large vision transformers are known to generalize across domains. Recently, foundation models for Earth observation became available. They are pretrained on satellite data, whose spatial resolution, viewing geometry, and radiometry differ from nadir RGB imagery. Thus, adaptation is required. We investigate how a satellite-pretrained Earth observation foundation model can be adapted to centimeter-scale floodwater mapping from RGB imagery. Specifically, we fine-tune a model we call Prithvi-2.0-UPN consisting of the Prithvi-EO-2.0-600M Vision Transformer combined with a UPerNet decoder for binary water segmentation on two RGB datasets (BlessemFlood21, NeuenahrFlood). In a first experiment we observe that Prithvi-2.0-UPN reaches state-of-the-art results on BlessemFlood21 and NeuenahrFlood, when trained on their datasets. In a second experiment we show that Prithvi-2.0-UPN performs better than state-of-the-art baseline models for transfer to a new flood event (trained on BlessemFlood21, tested on NeuenahrFlood) in a zero-shot setting. However, the performance indicates room for improvement. In this respect, we investigate in a third experiment how performance improves when further fine-tuning the models with small shares of NeuenahrFlood training data: Prithvi-2.0-UPN improves the fastest and reaches almost the performance level when fully trained on NeuenahrFlood, indicating transfer capabilities.

item.title: Dual-Branch Cross-Projection Debiasing through Diffusion-based Disentanglement
item.author: Xiangqian Zhao, Xinyang Jiang, Zhipeng Xu, Lingfeng He, Zilong Wang, Dongsheng Li, De Cheng, Nannan Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 针对基础模型在偏见数据集上训练导致的少数群体泛化能力差的问题，本文提出了一种无需群体标签的偏见缓解框架，通过概念挖掘与双分支去偏机制有效识别并消除虚假关联，显著提升了模型在少数群体上的性能。

背景: 在偏见数据集上训练的基础模型常依赖目标标签与非因果属性间的虚假相关，导致对少数群体的泛化能力较差。现有偏见缓解方法面临两大挑战：一是群体标签缺失时难以从模型行为中隐式推断出与现实偏见语义对齐的虚假因素；二是现有方法多采用单分支共享特征空间设计，导致目标属性与虚假属性内在纠缠。

目的: 解决群体标签缺失时虚假属性识别困难以及单分支设计中目标与虚假属性纠缠的问题，以提升基础模型在少数群体上的泛化性能与偏见缓解效果。

方法: 提出置信度引导的偏见概念挖掘模块，利用扩散解耦且具备语义基础的概念表示在无属性标注情况下可靠识别虚假属性；提出双分支交叉投影去偏框架，将目标与虚假表示分离至两个分支，并通过交叉零空间投影显式去除虚假信息，同时保留与目标相关的语义。

主要发现: 在四个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，该方法在无需群体标签的去偏方法中达到了最差的群体准确率最高水平，且仅微调了模型参数的百分之零点二二。

结论: 所提方法能有效克服现有偏见缓解方法的局限性，在极低参数微调成本下显著提升模型对少数群体的泛化能力，为无监督偏见缓解提供了高效可行的解决方案。

翻译: 在偏见数据集上训练的基础模型通常依赖目标标签与非因果属性之间的虚假相关，导致在少数群体上的泛化能力较差。由于两个根本性问题，偏见缓解仍然具有挑战性。首先，当群体标签不可用时，现有的无群体监督方法通常从模型行为中隐式推断虚假属性，难以识别与现实偏见语义对齐的虚假因素。其次，即使有伪虚假监督，大多数现有去偏方法遵循单分支设计，在单一共享特征空间内运行，其中目标属性和虚假属性内在纠缠。为了解决第一个挑战，我们引入了置信度引导的偏见概念挖掘，它利用扩散解耦、具有语义基础的概念表示，在没有属性标注的情况下识别可靠的虚假属性。为了解决第二个挑战，我们提出了双分支交叉投影去偏，这是一种提示微调框架，将目标和虚假表示分离到两个分支中，并通过交叉零空间投影显式去除虚假信息，同时保留与目标相关的语义。在四个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法在无群体监督方法中实现了最差的群体准确率最高水平，同时仅微调了模型参数的百分之零点二二。源代码可在补充材料中找到。

Abstract

Foundation models trained on biased datasets often rely on spurious correlations between target labels and non-causal attributes, resulting in poor generalization on minority groups. Bias mitigation remains challenging due to two fundamental issues. First, when group labels are unavailable, existing group-unsupervised methods typically infer spurious attributes implicitly from model behavior, making it difficult to identify spurious factors that are semantically aligned with real-world biases. Second, even with pseudo spurious supervision, most existing debiasing methods follow a single-branch design that operates within a single shared feature space, where target and spurious attributes are intrinsically entangled. To address the first challenge, we introduce Confidence-guided Bias Concept Mining (CBCM), which leverages diffusion-disentangled, semantically grounded concept representations to identify reliable spurious attributes without attribute annotations. To address the second challenge, we propose Dual-branch Cross-projection Debiasing (DCD), a prompt-tuning framework that separates target and spurious representations into two branches and explicitly removes spurious information through cross null-space projection while preserving target-relevant semantics. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets show that our method achieves state-of-the-art worst group accuracy among group-unsupervised approaches, while tuning at most 0.22% of the model parameters. The source code is available in the supplementary materials.

item.title: BehaviorBench: Benchmarking Foundation Models for Behavioral Science Tasks
item.author: Jin Huang, Yutong Xie, Wanli Song, Xingjian Zhang, Walter Yuan, Matthew O. Jackson, Qiaozhu Mei
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了行为科学领域的综合基准测试行为基准，用于系统评估基础模型在多种任务、情境和人群中的表现，并开发了微调后的行为基础模型行为一点五，展示了行为适配在缩小模型性能差距方面的潜力。

背景: 基础模型正越来越多地应用于心理学、社会学和经济学等行为科学领域。尽管它们在预测问卷回答和模拟人类受试者实验等单一任务中展现出潜力，但目前仍缺乏对其在多样化行为科学任务、情境和人群中表现的系统性理解。

目的: 引入一个全面的基准测试，以系统评估基础模型在行为科学领域的表现，并开发专门针对行为数据微调的基础模型，以推动行为对齐人工智能系统的发展。

方法: 构建行为基准，从行为预测与模拟、战略决策、受试者特征推断和行为知识应用四个核心能力维度评估模型。评估涵盖个体水平和分布水平两个层面。基于该基准开发并微调了行为基础模型行为一点五。

主要发现: 专有通用模型在个体级预测和知识密集型任务上表现优异，而基于行为数据微调的行为基础模型在分布对齐上显著更强。行为一点五在分布指标上领先，同时在个体级指标上保持竞争力，表明恰当的行为适配能够有效缩小两者差距。

结论: 研究强调了分布评估的重要性，确立了行为基准作为开发和评估行为对齐人工智能系统的基础地位，并证明了行为一点五在广泛行为科学研究中的潜力。相关基准与模型已公开提供访问。

翻译: 基础模型正越来越多地应用于心理学、社会学和经济学等行为科学领域。尽管这些模型在预测问卷回答和模拟人类受试者实验等单一任务中展现出潜力，但目前仍缺乏对其在多样化行为科学任务、情境和人群中表现的系统性理解。我们引入了行为基准，这是一个全面的基准测试，从四个核心能力维度评估基础模型：行为预测与模拟、战略决策、受试者特征推断和行为知识应用。关键在于，行为基准在个体和分布两个层面评估模型输出，不仅捕捉每个受试者的准确性，还捕捉群体层面的对齐程度，这是行为有效性的基本要求。利用行为基准中的任务，我们进一步开发了行为一点五，扩展了基于行为数据微调的行为基础模型家族。我们的结果显示存在显著差距：专有通用模型在个体级预测和知识密集型任务上表现优异，而基于行为数据微调的行为基础模型在分布对齐上显著更强。值得注意的是，行为一点五在分布指标上领先，并在个体级指标上保持竞争力，表明恰当的行为适配能够缩小这一差距。我们的结果强调了分布评估的重要性，确立了行为基准作为开发和评估行为对齐人工智能系统的基础，并展示了行为一点五在广泛行为科学研究中的潜力。我们的行为基准和行为一点五模型可通过指定网址访问。

Abstract

Foundation models have been increasingly applied to behavioral science domains such as psychology, sociology, and economics. While these models show promise in individual tasks such as survey response prediction and human-subject experiment simulation, there remains no systematic understanding of how well they perform across diverse behavioral science tasks, contexts, and populations. We introduce BehaviorBench, a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates foundation models along four core capabilities: (1) behavior prediction and simulation, (2) strategic decision-making, (3) subject-trait inference, and (4) behavioral knowledge application. Crucially, BehaviorBench evaluates model outputs at both the individual and distributional levels, capturing not only per-subject accuracy but also population-level alignment, an essential requirement for behavioral validity. Leveraging the tasks in BehaviorBench, we further develop Be.FM-1.5, extending the Be.FM family of behavioral foundation models fine-tuned on behavioral data. Our results reveal a considerable gap: proprietary general-purpose models excel at individual-level prediction and knowledge-intensive tasks, whereas behavioral foundation models, fine-tuned on behavioral data, achieve substantially stronger distributional alignment. Notably, Be.FM-1.5 leads on distributional metrics and remains competitive on individual-level metrics, suggesting that proper behavioral adaptation can close the gap. Our results highlight the importance of distributional evaluation, establish BehaviorBench as a foundation for developing and assessing behaviorally aligned AI systems, and demonstrate Be.FM-1.5's potential for a broad range of behavioral science studies. Our BehaviorBench and Be.FM-1.5 models can be accessed via https://umich-foreseer.github.io/behaviorbench/.

item.title: TuringViT: Making SOTA Vision Transformers Accessible to All
item.author: Qiman Wu, Hanlin Chen, Lyujie Chen, Rui Xin, Jianlei Zheng, Mingyuan Wang, Jiahui Hu, Da Zhu, Yuecheng Ma, Yuhua Wei, Yizhao Wang, Hua Zhou, Yuheng Zhang, Anhua Liu, Shaman Tang, Yue He, Pengfei Diao, Shuang Su, Haotong Xin, Weichao Huang, Hang Zhang, Xianming Liu

Abstract

Modern VLMs and VLA systems commonly adopt off-the-shelf ViTs such as SigLIP2 as visual encoders, but diverse downstream requirements in latency, temporal modeling, and VLM integration often call for customized SOTA-level ViTs. Training such encoders remains beyond the reach of much of the community, as it requires massive image-text data, while standard softmax attention makes high-resolution or dynamic-resolution pretraining prohibitively costly and often forces low-resolution pretraining followed by post-hoc adaptation. TuringViT addresses these challenges with three key designs: Turing Linear Attention (TLA) for efficient sequence modeling, VISTA-Curation to construct supervision-rich image-video training data, and native dynamic-resolution pretraining that supports flexible inputs from the start and transfers seamlessly to downstream VLMs. As a result, TuringViT outperforms leading open-source ViT baselines with only 10% of the data, achieves stronger downstream VLM performance, and delivers substantially better latency scaling on high-resolution inputs. Our scaling-law analysis further shows that TuringViT continues to improve predictably with curated data scale, far from saturation. Its fast adaptation, hardware-friendly design, and efficient deployment have made it a unified visual foundation across XPeng's AI systems. More broadly, TuringViT provides a reproducible pipeline that dramatically lowers the cost for the community to train, customize, and deploy SOTA-level ViTs, moving toward making such Vision Transformers accessible to all.

Abstract

Multimodal Large Language Models have achieved remarkable progress in short-form audio-video understanding, yet long-form audio-video comprehension remains challenged by limited context windows and severe information redundancy. To address these bottlenecks, we propose AVOC, a framework for long-form audio-video understanding in Omni-modal Large Language Models. AVOC introduces a learnable token compression module between the modality encoders and the LLM backbone. We reframe multimodal token compression as a top-$K$ retrieval problem: given a fixed context budget, the module must retrieve a compact subset of tokens that best supports answering the user query. We draw inspiration from three classical Information Retrieval criteria for selecting informative units from a large candidate pool: relevance, importance, and diversity. AVOC instantiates each criterion as a tailored mechanism for audio-video understanding, and integrates them into a unified retrieval-style compression pipeline. Experiments show that AVOC achieves state-of-the-art performance on long-form audio-video benchmarks, surpassing the second-best model by 4.9 and 5.5 points in average accuracy on OmniVideoBench and LVOmniBench, respectively. Moreover, AVOC maintains robust performance on Audio-Video Needle-in-a-Haystack task at durations up to one hour.

Abstract

Cross-domain Few-shot Segmentation (CD-FSS) aims to transfer knowledge learned from source domain to distinct target domains, segmenting unseen target classes with only a few annotated samples. Although existing methods have made significant progress, they still rely on training or fine-tuning processes, which incur high computational costs and risk overfitting. We observe that when powerful and general-purpose vision foundation models are incorporated into these methods, their performance shows only marginal improvement or even degrades due to overfitting. To address this, we eliminate trainable parameters and propose a training-free framework to avoid both training overhead and overfitting. Built upon the self-supervised vision encoder DINOv3, our framework addresses cross-domain challenges through three core modules. First, the Semantic-aware Feature Re-fusion (SAFR) module identifies and re-fuses features that emphasize semantic patterns, generating representations with enhanced semantic discriminability. Additionally, the Adaptive Support Enhancement (ASE) module narrows semantic gaps between support and query through robust query information aggregation. Finally, the Hybrid Prototype Matching (HPM) module integrates matching results from diverse prototypes to adapt to varying semantic complexity across domains. Extensive experiments on four target domain datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in CD-FSS without any training.

item.title: Escaping the Self-Confirmation Trap: An Execute-Distill-Verify Paradigm for Agentic Experience Learning
item.author: Zhu, Shiding, Qi, Yudi, Wang, Yajie, Li, Jiaze, Song, Chao, Shi, Yaorui, Miao, Yibo, Gao, Hanqi, Zhang, Kai
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为EDV的执行-提炼-验证框架，旨在解决大语言模型智能体在经验驱动自我进化中因单智能体循环导致的自我确认陷阱问题，通过多智能体协作与严格验证机制提升经验学习的可靠性。

背景: 大语言模型智能体依赖经验驱动实现自我进化，但现有方法多采用单智能体循环模式，易陷入自我确认陷阱，将错误但自洽的轨迹误认为成功经验，导致检索与复用过程中累积错误。

目的: 克服单智能体经验学习的局限性，消除自我确认陷阱带来的累积误差，构建可靠且高质量的经验学习机制。

方法: 提出执行-提炼-验证框架。执行阶段由多个异构智能体并行探索任务空间生成多样化轨迹；提炼阶段由第三方智能体对比分析轨迹以生成候选经验，减少执行者总结偏差；验证阶段由执行组通过共识机制审核候选经验，仅将批准的经验写入共享或私有记忆。该框架解耦了三个阶段，将孤立自我反思转化为协作构建，并在经验入库前过滤错误与噪声。

主要发现: 在三个具有挑战性的长周期基准测试中，该框架 consistently 优于强基线模型，证明了可靠经验构建的有效性。

结论: 可靠的经验构建对于实现稳健的智能体自我进化至关重要。

翻译: 经验驱动的自进化对于大语言模型智能体通过开放世界交互进行改进至关重要。然而，现有的经验学习方法大多依赖单智能体循环，即同一智能体执行任务、总结结果并确定记忆内容。这种设置使智能体容易陷入自我确认陷阱：错误但自洽的轨迹被误识别为成功经验，导致在检索和复用过程中产生累积误差。为解决此问题，我们提出了EDV，一种用于可靠经验学习的执行-提炼-验证框架。在执行阶段，多个异构智能体并行探索同一任务空间，生成多样化的候选轨迹。在提炼阶段，专门的第三方智能体对这些轨迹进行对比分析，以生成候选经验，从而减少以执行者为中心的总结偏差。在验证阶段，执行组通过共识机制验证候选经验，仅将批准的经验写入共享或私有记忆。通过解耦这三个阶段，EDV将经验学习从孤立的自我反思转变为协作构建，在经验插入记忆之前过滤掉错误和噪声内容。我们在三个具有挑战性的长周期基准测试上对EDV进行了评估：tau2-bench、Mind2Web和MMTB。结果表明，EDV consistently 优于强基线，验证了可靠经验构建对于稳健智能体自我进化的重要性。我们的代码可在该网址获取。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决大语言模型智能体在经验学习中容易陷入的自我确认陷阱问题，即单一智能体在执行任务后自行总结并记录经验时，常将内部逻辑自洽但实际错误的过程误认为成功经验，导致错误不断累积。该问题在开放世界环境中尤为重要，因为缺乏明确的标准答案，若经验构建不可靠，智能体将难以实现稳定可靠的自我进化，反而会因错误记忆的反复调用而性能下降。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有单智能体经验学习存在自我确认陷阱，即执行与评估由同一模型完成，容易将内部连贯但实际错误的轨迹误认为成功经验并导致错误累积。为此，他们将经验构建过程解耦为并行探索、第三方对比提炼与共识验证三个阶段，通过多智能体协作过滤噪声与错误经验。该设计借鉴了早期经验记忆框架及多智能体协作提升任务表现的相关研究，但创新性地聚焦于利用多角色分工来保障经验写入记忆前的可靠性，而非仅用于单次任务求解。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是通过多智能体协作将任务执行、经验提炼与结果验证三个环节解耦，打破单一智能体自我确认的陷阱，在经验存入记忆前严格过滤错误和噪声内容。整体流程分为三步：首先由多个异构智能体并行执行任务生成多样化的候选轨迹；接着由独立的第三方智能体对比这些轨迹提炼出候选经验；最后由执行组共同进行共识验证，仅将严格通过验证的经验写入记忆库。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了执行、提炼与验证框架，通过多智能体协作重构经验学习流程。具体包括利用异构智能体并行探索生成多样化轨迹、引入第三方智能体进行跨轨迹对比提炼，以及采用基于共识的严格验证机制。与以往依赖单一智能体闭环自我总结的工作不同，该方法将执行、提炼与验证完全解耦，将孤立的自我反思转变为协作式经验过滤，从而有效防止错误轨迹被误存为记忆。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种执行-提炼-验证框架，通过多智能体协作将经验构建过程解耦，有效避免了单智能体经验学习中的自我确认陷阱，显著提升了智能体在开放环境中经验积累与自我进化的可靠性。

Abstract

Experience-driven self-evolution is critical for large language model (LLM) agents to improve through open-world interaction. However, existing experience learning methods mostly rely on single-agent loops, where the same agent executes tasks, summarizes outcomes, and determines memory content. This setup makes agents vulnerable to the Self-Confirmation Trap: wrong-but-self-consistent trajectories are misidentified as successful experience, leading to cumulative errors during retrieval and reuse. To address this issue, we propose EDV, an Execute-Distill-Verify framework for reliable experience learning. In the Execute stage, multiple heterogeneous agents explore the same task space in parallel to generate diverse candidate trajectories. In the Distill stage, a dedicated third-party agent comparatively analyzes these trajectories to produce candidate experiences, reducing executor-centric summarization bias. In the Verify stage, the execution group validates candidates via a consensus mechanism, and only approved experiences are written into shared or private memory. By decoupling the three stages, EDV transforms experience learning from isolated self-reflection into collaborative construction, filtering erroneous and noisy content before memory insertion. We evaluate EDV on three challenging long-horizon benchmarks: tau2-bench, Mind2Web and MMTB. Results show EDV consistently outperforms strong baselines, validating that reliable experience construction is essential for robust agent self-evolution. Our code is available at this https URL .

item.title: An LLM-based Two-Stage Transformer Framework for Cross-Domain Bearing Fault Diagnosis with Limited Data
item.author: Jinghan Wang, Feng Cheng, Wentao Wu, Hang Li, Gaoliang Peng, Tianchen Liu

总结: ...

主要发现: ...

结论: ...

翻译: ...

Abstract

Bearing fault diagnosis faces critical challenges when dataset heterogeneity, operating condition variations, and limited labeled data occur simultaneously in industrial environments. Existing approaches address these issues in isolation and rely on implicit feature alignment, limiting effectiveness under concurrent challenges. This paper proposes a knowledge-guided two-stage transfer learning framework that employs a lightweight GPT-2-style Transformer with causal self-attention for hierarchical feature extraction from vibration signals, establishing explicit pathways where pre-trained encoder weights and fault prototype embeddings serve as knowledge carriers from multi-source pre-training to target adaptation. The framework addresses the dual-shift challenge through multi-source learning for generalizable representations, prototype-based knowledge modulation for target adaptation, and taxonomy-adaptive classification for seamless transfer across heterogeneous fault categories. Experimental validation on four real-world datasets demonstrates 92.61% average accuracy with only 10% labeled target data, outperforming state-of-the-art methods by 17.24 percentage points, establishing a practical pathway toward cost-effective predictive maintenance in Industry 4.0 applications.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决现有评估基准无法准确衡量人工智能编程代理在真实科学问题上实现方法创新能力的缺陷。过去的基准多局限于代码复现或工程优化，且存在环境配置碎片化导致结果不可靠的问题。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为随着人工智能代理逐步应用于自主科学研究，必须建立严谨可靠的评估体系，以准确区分代理是真正推动了科学发现还是仅在做表面拟合，从而为人工智能赋能科学的发展提供可信依据。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有基准测试仅侧重代码复现或工程优化、且存在环境碎片化问题的不足，设计了该评估框架。该方法通过自动化流水线将科学论文转化为标准化的容器化任务包，并设置信息防火墙隐藏原始方法，迫使智能体进行自主发现而非简单复现。设计过程中充分借鉴并对比了PaperBench、PostTrainBench等现有工作，旨在同时突破从代码理解到科学发现、以及从工程优化到真实科学领域的双重局限。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是构建自动化流水线，将已发表的自然科学论文转化为标准化的容器化任务包，并通过信息防火墙隐藏原始方法，以测试人工智能编程代理能否在真实科学问题上实现方法创新。整体实现流程包含论文筛选、数据获取与验证、任务包构建三个主要阶段，各阶段均由大语言模型代理执行并配合人工审核，最终输出包含任务说明、数据集、测试集和自动评估器的完整环境。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于提出了NatureGym自动化流水线与NatureBench基准测试。NatureGym能将不同格式的自然科学论文自动转化为标准化的容器化任务环境，有效解决了以往基准测试中环境碎片化的问题。相比之前的工作，现有基准多侧重于代码复现或工程优化，而本基准通过隐藏原始方法并设置超越或匹配已有最高水平的评估标准，要求人工智能编程智能体在真实科学问题上进行方法创新，从而真正评估其从复现走向发现的能力。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了NatureBench基准测试与NatureGym自动化构建流水线，通过从《自然》系列期刊论文中提炼九十项跨学科科学任务，旨在评估人工智能编程代理能否在真实科学问题上实现超越简单复现的发现能力。

Abstract

We introduce NatureBench, a cross-discipline benchmark of 90 tasks distilled from peer-reviewed Nature-family publications, designed to evaluate whether AI coding agents can move beyond reproduction toward discovery on real scientific problems. NatureBench is built on NatureGym, an automated pipeline that constructs a standardized, per-task containerized environment from a source paper, addressing the environment-fragmentation problem that has limited the credibility of prior agent-on-research benchmarks. Evaluating ten frontier agent configurations under a strict web-search-disabled protocol, we find that the strongest model surpasses SOTA on only 17.8% of tasks under the g>0.1 criterion. Analysis of method pathways reveals that agents succeed primarily through methodological translation, converting scientific tasks into familiar supervised prediction problems, rather than through genuine scientific invention. Failures are dominated by wrong method choice and insufficient compute budget, not by task misunderstanding. We release the benchmark, the NatureGym pipeline, and a public leaderboard with maintainer-side reproduction. Code: this https URL

item.title: ASALT: Adaptive State Alignment for Lateral Transfer in Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
item.author: Anurag Akula, Satheesh K. Perepu, Abhishek Sarkar, Kaushik Dey
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出ASALT方法，用于解决多智能体强化学习中源域与目标域状态空间维度不匹配的迁移学习问题，通过观测级和状态级适配器将目标域数据映射到共享嵌入空间，实现跨异构域的高效策略迁移。

背景: 多智能体强化学习旨在训练追求协作、竞争或混合目标的多智能体。现有迁移学习方法通常要求源域和目标域的观测空间与全局状态空间维度必须完全一致。

目的: 显式处理源域与目标域之间状态空间维度不匹配的问题，实现跨异构域的有效知识迁移。

方法: 提出ASALT方法，引入观测级和状态级适配器，将目标域的观测和全局状态映射到共享嵌入空间，生成支持跨异构域高效策略迁移的嵌入表示，从而提升actor和critic的知识迁移效果。

主要发现: 在标准基准环境的多种配置下，ASALT在协作设置中的样本效率和全局回报方面优于现有基线方法；其有效性受源域与目标域不匹配程度的影响；同时能有效缓解跨不同观测和动作空间迁移策略时常见的负迁移问题。

结论: ASALT成功克服了维度不匹配带来的限制，通过适配器机制有效缓解负迁移，为多智能体强化学习中的跨域策略迁移提供了可靠解决方案。

翻译: 多智能体强化学习旨在解决训练追求协作、竞争或混合目标的多智能体的问题。先前的工作已研究了多智能体强化学习中源域与目标域之间的迁移学习；然而，大多数现有方法都施加了约束，即源域和目标域的观测空间与全局状态空间的维度必须相同。在本文中，我们引入了一种显式适应源域与目标域之间状态空间维度不匹配的方法。所提出的ASALT方法结合了观测级和状态级适配器，将目标域的观测和全局状态映射到共享嵌入空间中，从而在actor和critic之间实现更有效的知识迁移。这些适配器可以生成支持跨异构域高效策略迁移的嵌入表示。在标准基准环境的多种配置下的实验结果表明，ASALT在协作设置中的样本效率和全局回报方面超越了现有基线，但其有效性取决于源域与目标域之间的不匹配程度。此外，我们的研究结果表明，ASALT缓解了负迁移问题，而负迁移通常是在具有不同观测和动作空间的域之间迁移策略时的主要障碍。

Abstract

Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) addresses the problem of training multiple agents that pursue collaborative, competitive, or mixed objectives. Prior work has investigated transfer learning between source and target domains in MARL; however, the majority of existing approaches impose the constraint that the dimensionalities of the observation space and the global state space must be identical across domains. In this paper, we introduce a method that explicitly accommodates mismatched state-space dimensionalities between source and target domains. The proposed approach, ASALT, incorporates both observation-level and state-level adapters that map the target-domain observations and global states into a shared embedding space, thereby enabling more effective transfer of knowledge across both actors and critics. These adapters can generate embeddings that support efficient strategy transfer across heterogeneous domains. Experimental results on multiple configurations in standard benchmark environments demonstrate that ASALT surpasses existing baselines in terms of sample efficiency and global return in cooperative settings, but its effectiveness depends on the degree of mismatch between source and target domains. Furthermore, our findings indicate that ASALT mitigates negative transfer, which frequently constitutes a major obstacle when transferring policies between domains with differing observation and action spaces.
