方法: 构建CineCap框架，利用时空锚点将视觉证据转化为紧凑原子推理进行监督微调，并引入包含全面性、准确性及门控覆盖奖励的强化学习优化平衡；同时建立包含四百七十二对人工标注样本的CineCap Bench基准。

主要发现: 大量实验表明该框架稳定优于强大的专有与开源基线模型，确立了电影语言描述任务的新标杆。

结论: 所提方法有效提升了描述准确性与完整性，相关代码、模型权重及基准数据集已公开。

翻译: 电影语言描述旨在使用专业电影语言概念如摄像机运动镜头尺寸景深构图和拍摄角度来描述视频的拍摄方式。这种能力对于细粒度视频理解和可控的高质量电影级视频生成至关重要，但在现有的多模态大语言模型中仍未得到充分探索。与基于问答的电影理解评估不同，电影语言描述需要对多个电影语言维度进行统一的开放式描述。该任务具有两大挑战模型必须从细微的视觉线索中推断出专业的电影语言概念并且必须生成既全面又准确的描述。为此我们提出了CineCap框架该框架结合了带有时空锚点的结构化推理以及包含全面性准确性和门控覆盖奖励的强化学习。前者将专业的电影语言描述建立在明确的视觉证据上并将其组织为紧凑的原子推理以进行监督微调而后者则改善了描述完整性与事实准确性之间的平衡。此外我们构建了CineCap Bench基准包含四百七十二对人工标注的视频描述对用于系统评估。大量实验表明CineCap稳定优于强大的专有和开源基线确立了电影语言描述任务的新最先进水平。代码模型权重和基准已公开在指定链接。

Abstract

Cinematographic captioning aims to describe how a video is filmed using professional film-language concepts such as camera movement, shot size, depth of field, composition, and shooting angle. This capability is important for fine-grained video understanding and controllable movie-quality video generation, yet remains underexplored in existing multimodal large language models. Unlike question-answering-based evaluation of cinematic understanding, cinematographic captioning requires a unified open-form description over multiple cinematographic dimensions. This task is challenging for two main reasons: the model must infer professional cinematographic concepts from subtle visual evidence, and it must generate captions that are both comprehensive and accurate. Accordingly, we propose CineCap, a framework that combines structured reasoning with spatio-temporal anchors and reinforcement learning with comprehensiveness, accuracy, and gated coverage rewards. The former grounds professional cinematographic descriptions in explicit visual evidence and organizes them into compact atomic reasoning for supervised fine-tuning, while the latter improves the balance between descriptive completeness and factual correctness. In addition, we construct CineCap Bench, a benchmark of 472 manually annotated video-caption pairs for systematic evaluation. Extensive experiments show that CineCap consistently outperforms strong proprietary and open-source baselines, establishing a new state of the art for cinematographic captioning. The code, model checkpoint, and benchmark are publicly available in https://github.com/Hectormxy/CineCap.git.

item.title: World Value Models for Robotic Manipulation
item.author: Zhihao Wang, Jianxiong Li, Yu Cui, Yuan Gao, Xianyuan Zhan, Junzhi Yu, Xiao Ma
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ...

背景: ...

目的: ...

方法: ...

主要发现: ...

结论: ...

翻译: ...

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有机器人价值模型在评估任务进度时缺乏深层时间理解与未来规划能力的问题，导致其难以准确识别犹豫或重试等次优行为。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为准确的价值估计是筛选大规模混合质量数据、指导机器人策略学习的关键信号，直接决定了机器人在复杂现实任务中的学习效率与最终性能。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现传统方法依赖的视觉语言模型缺乏对时间动态和未来的理解能力，而世界模型天生擅长时空建模与未来预测。基于这一洞察，他们将世界模型的时空先验直接转化为价值评估的基础，设计了结合视频流与轻量级价值预测模块的混合架构，并采用分布式的流匹配目标进行训练。该方法在技术实现上借鉴了现有的视频生成模型、流匹配算法及数据增强策略，但核心思路是首次将世界模型全面引入机器人价值评估领域。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是借用世界模型固有的时空理解与未来推演能力，替代传统视觉语言模型，从而更准确地评估机器人操作的实时任务进度。整体实现流程为：模型并行处理视频流与价值流，通过注意力机制让价值预测模块充分吸收视频的时空特征；训练时采用流匹配算法对连续帧的价值分布进行联合优化，并配合前缀随机化与视频时间轴打乱等增强策略，使模型能有效识别犹豫、重试等非理想操作片段。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于首次将视频世界模型作为基础骨干用于机器人价值估计，并将价值函数建模为分布式的连续片段而非单一标量，结合流匹配技术进行训练。相比以往主要依赖视觉语言模型、缺乏时间动态理解能力且通常仅针对单一任务或专家数据的方法，该模型能够同时把握历史上下文与未来走向，有效识别犹豫和重试等次优行为，在混合质量数据的学习中展现出更强的泛化性与鲁棒性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种基于世界模型的通用机器人价值评估方法，通过将任务进度建模为分布序列并结合流匹配训练，显著提升了模型对专家与次优轨迹的进度估计能力，同时发布了包含八百条人工标注次优轨迹的新基准以全面评估价值模型性能。

Abstract

Generalist value models play a pivotal role in scaling robotic policy learning from large-scale, mixed-quality data. Mathematically, accurate value estimation demands deep temporal understanding, requiring models to both ground the current belief using historical context and plan over future outcomes. However, most existing robotic value models are built on Vision-Language Model (VLM) backbones that are pretrained primarily on static or temporally sparse visual observations, lacking the requisite temporal modeling capabilities for value estimation. Unlike VLMs, world models naturally excel at temporal modeling and future planning, making them ideal foundations for learning generalizable value functions. Driven by this insight, we marry world models with value estimation to construct a new generalist robotic value model, World Value Model (WVM), that offers accurate task progressions to assess data quality. On standard benchmarks, WVM delivers state-of-the-art (SOTA) Value-Order Correlation (VOC) results. Complementing standard evaluation suites that contains only expert data, we further introduce Suboptimal-Value-Bench, a multi-embodiment benchmark consisting of 800 suboptimal trajectories with high-fidelity, human-labeled frame annotations. Our evaluations show that WVM maintains its SOTA performance on Suboptimal-Value-Bench, establishing its robustness in handling both expert and suboptimal data. When deployed for policy learning, WVM improves manipulation performance across various policy extraction approaches in both simulated and real-world deployment, providing robust guidance for learning from mixed-quality data.

item.title: DailyReport: An Open-ended Benchmark for Evaluating Search Agents on Daily Search Tasks
item.author: Han, Jingxuan, Liu, Wei, Zhu, Mingyang, Wang, Youpeng, Wang, Ziwen, Qiu, Lin, Cao, Xuezhi, Cai, Xunliang, Fu, Zheren, Zhang, Licheng, Mao, Zhendong
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出DailyReport开放式基准测试，用于评估搜索智能体在日常搜索任务中的能力。该基准通过细粒度多维级联评分标准与用户中心聚合方法，揭示了当前智能体系统与实际用户期望之间的差距，并公开数据代码以促进后续研究。

背景: 搜索智能体通常利用大语言模型自主探索网络并综合信息以完成复杂检索任务。现有评估基准多聚焦于非真实场景的专业任务，且依赖粗糙的任务级评分标准，导致评估结果可解释性不足。

目的: 弥补现有评估方法的不足，构建面向真实用户日常搜索需求的开放式基准，以提升对搜索智能体能力的评估可解释性与实用性。

方法: 构建包含一百五十个开放式任务及三千五百四十六条关联评分标准的数据集，涵盖广泛且及时的真实用户需求。将任务分解为子任务，采用跨解耦维度的级联评分标准进行评估。通过级联性能归因与以用户为中心的聚合方法生成各维度可解释分数及用户偏好分数，并对十七个智能体系统进行了测试。

主要发现: 在十七个智能体系统上的测试结果表明，当前搜索智能体的表现仍未能达到用户的实际期望。

结论: 该基准测试为搜索智能体的评估提供了更具解释性和用户中心化的新视角，相关数据集与代码已公开以促进未来研究。

翻译: 搜索智能体通常利用大语言模型，通过自主探索网络来源并将信息综合为全面回答，来支持复杂的信息检索任务。在评估搜索智能体时，现有基准主要关注在真实用户场景中不太可能出现的专业任务。此外，它们对粗糙的任务级评分标准的依赖往往限制了评估的可解释性。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了DailyReport，这是一个用于评估搜索智能体在日常搜索任务中能力的开放式基准。它包含一百五十个开放式任务及三千五百四十六条相关评分标准，捕捉了真实用户广泛讨论且及时的信息需求。每个任务被分解为子任务，并通过跨解耦维度的级联评分标准进行评估。通过级联性能归因和以用户为中心的聚合方法，我们得出了每个维度高度可解释的分数以及用户偏好分数。我们在十七个智能体系统上的结果表明，当前系统仍未能达到用户的期望。为促进未来研究，我们的数据集和代码已公开在指定网址。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有搜索智能体评估基准过于专业化、静态化且缺乏用户视角解释性的问题。它通过构建贴近真实日常场景的开放型任务与分层评估标准，旨在更准确地衡量智能体满足普通用户实际信息需求的能力。该问题在研究中非常重要，因为随着智能体技术普及，传统基准无法反映真实用户的动态需求，而缺乏可解释且以用户为中心的评估会阻碍智能体在实际应用中的优化与落地。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有评测基准偏向专业领域、指标粗糙且缺乏可解释性的问题，设计了聚焦日常真实需求的开放型评测方法。他们从热门平台话题中构建任务，将任务拆解为子任务，并沿指令遵循、事实性和合理性三个独立维度设计级联评估流程，通过优先级依赖关系和用户中心聚合策略来量化实际偏好。该方法借鉴了前期在搜索智能体与评测基准方面的研究，但通过引入动态更新的话题、细粒度级联指标和用户视角的评估逻辑，弥补了以往工作在实际场景适配与评估透明度上的不足。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是构建以用户为中心的分层评估框架，强调回答的不同维度具有优先级，只有满足基础指令要求后，事实准确性与逻辑合理性才具有评估意义。整体流程首先从真实热点话题中提取开放型搜索任务并拆解为子任务，随后针对指令遵循、事实准确和逻辑合理三个独立维度生成级联评估标准。接着对每个子任务进行逐项打分，并通过级联性能归因机制，将前置维度的达标情况作为后续维度评分的前提，最终结合子任务重要性加权聚合，输出可解释的维度得分与用户偏好总分。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于提出了DailyReport基准，包含一百五十个源自真实热点话题的开放式日常搜索任务，并设计了用户中心级的级联评估流程。相比以往工作，该基准不再局限于专业或静态的特定领域任务，而是聚焦于反映真实用户需求的动态日常场景。此外，它摒弃了传统的粗粒度线性评分方式，采用解耦的级联评估维度与子任务重要性加权，从而能更直观地量化模型表现并明确反映用户偏好。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了DailyReport基准，通过构建贴近真实日常场景的开放式搜索任务与用户中心级联评估体系，实现了对当前搜索代理多维度性能的可解释评估及用户偏好量化。

Abstract

Search Agents (SAs) typically leverage large language models (LLMs) to support complex information-seeking tasks by autonomously exploring web sources and synthesizing information into comprehensive responses. For SAs evaluation, prior benchmarks mainly focus on specialized tasks that are unlikely to arise in real-world user scenarios. Moreover, their reliance on coarse task-level rubrics often limits evaluation interpretability. To bridge this gap, we introduce DailyReport, an open-ended benchmark to evaluate SA capabilities on daily search tasks. It contains 150 open-ended tasks with 3,546 associated rubrics, capturing widely discussed and timely information demands of real-world users. Each task is decomposed into subtasks and evaluated with cascade rubrics across disentangled dimensions. Through cascade performance attribution and user-centric aggregation, we derive highly interpretable scores for each dimension, along with a user preference score. Our results on 17 agentic systems show that current systems still fall short of users' expectations. To facilitate future research, our dataset and code are made publicly available at this https URL .

item.title: Thinking with Visual Grounding
item.author: Zhang, Junkai, Deng, Yihe, Chang, Kai-Wei, Wang, Wei
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ...

背景: ...

目的: ...

方法: ...

主要发现: ...

结论: ...

翻译: ...

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决视觉语言模型在推理过程中缺乏明确视觉证据关联的问题。传统模型生成的推理过程虽然语言连贯，但无法指明具体参考了图像的哪些区域，导致推理难以验证和监督。明确将推理步骤与图像区域绑定非常重要，因为这不仅能提高模型在计数和空间关系理解等任务上的准确性，还能让推理过程变得透明可查，符合人类解答视觉问题时的认知习惯。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者观察到纯文本推理难以验证，而人类解答视觉问题时习惯将思考与具体图像区域关联，因此提出让模型在语言推理中穿插明确的点或框坐标，实现思考与视觉证据的绑定。设计上，他们构建了基于图像分割工具的自动化数据合成流水线来生成带坐标标注的推理轨迹，并引入结合答案正确性与坐标匹配度的强化学习奖励机制进行训练。该方法确实借鉴了现有工作，沿袭了从区域定位到推理轨迹耦合，再到强化学习主动定位的研究脉络，并在此基础上创新性地加入了显式的坐标质量奖励。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是让视觉语言模型在生成自然语言推理步骤时，同步明确标注出支撑每一步的图像区域，使语言推理与视觉证据直接绑定以提升可验证性。整体实现流程首先利用大模型生成正确的推理轨迹并提取关键视觉对象，接着通过视觉定位智能体迭代生成点或框的坐标标注来构建训练数据，最后采用结合答案正确性与接地质量的强化学习进行模型训练。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了视觉定位思考模式，使模型在推理时自然语言与具体的点或框坐标交替输出，从而将每一步思考与图像证据明确绑定。相比以往仅用定位技术辅助区域选择或生成坐标的工作，本文通过自动化管线生成高质量训练数据，并设计了直接评估中间视觉引用是否匹配正确图像证据的强化学习奖励机制。这种将显式空间坐标深度融入推理链条并配合针对性奖励的方法，显著提升了模型在计数和空间关系理解任务上的表现。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种视觉定位思考方法，通过构建可扩展的数据合成流水线与显式定位奖励机制，引导模型在推理过程中将自然语言与图像区域精确对应，从而显著提升了视觉语言模型在计数和空间关系理解任务上的表现。

Abstract

Visual thinking should not only sound right; it should show its evidence. While recent vision-language models (VLMs) can produce natural-language reasoning traces, these traces often leave the supporting image regions implicit, making them hard to verify and difficult to supervise. We introduce visually grounded thinking, a reasoning process in which models interleave natural-language thoughts with explicit point or box groundings of the visual evidence used at each step. This lets the model express intermediate reasoning in language while grounding key objects in the image regions they refer to. To train this behavior, we construct a scalable synthesis pipeline that distills correct visual reasoning traces, extracts the visual objects required by the traces, grounds them with a SAM3-based agent, and derives aligned point and box supervision from the resulting masks. We further propose grounding-aware reinforcement learning, which combines answer correctness rewards with dense grounding rewards that score whether generated object references match the correct image evidence. Across two counting benchmarks and four spatial reasoning benchmarks, adding visually grounded thinking to Gemma3-4B-IT consistently improves performance over the original model and the non-grounded thinking baseline. On spatial reasoning, the visually grounded thinking 4B models match, and in some cases surpass, Gemma3-27B-IT from the same model family. Our analysis shows that point grounding is well suited to counting, while box grounding benefits most from explicit grounding rewards on spatial tasks. Overall, our results show that VLMs think better when their intermediate thoughts are tied to the image regions that make them true.

item.title: Context-Aware RL for Agentic and Multimodal LLMs
item.author: Xu, Peiyang, Li, Bangzheng, Liu, Sijia, Narasimhan, Karthik R., Viswanath, Pramod, Mittal, Prateek, Fu, Xingyu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为ContextRL的上下文感知强化学习方法，通过间接辅助目标提升大语言模型在长程推理和多模态任务中的表现。

背景: 大语言模型在处理需要长文本或复杂图像中微小关键证据的问答任务时常常失败。

目的: 提升模型的长程推理能力与多模态性能。

方法: 提出ContextRL方法，不直接监督最终答案，而是向模型提供查询、答案及两个高度相似的上下文，奖励模型选出支持查询与答案对的上下文，以鼓励细粒度定位。在代码代理和多模态推理两个领域构建对比上下文数据，分别通过条件过滤和生成编辑结合相似度搜索生成对比数据对。

主要发现: 该方法在五个长程基准测试上平均提升百分之二点二，在十二个视觉问答基准上平均提升百分之一点八。与仅利用相同对比数据的数据增强基线相比，基线方法几乎无提升，证明性能增益源于上下文选择目标而非对比数据本身。

结论: 上下文选择目标能有效改善模型在长程与多模态任务中的表现，且该改进主要归功于所提出的学习目标设计。

翻译: 大语言模型在回答需要长文本或复杂上下文中微小关键证据的问题时常常失败。我们提出ContextRL，一种上下文感知的强化学习方法，通过间接辅助目标提升长程推理和多模态性能。该方法不直接监督最终答案，而是向模型提供查询、答案及两个高度相似的上下文，并奖励其选出支持查询与答案对的上下文，从而鼓励细粒度定位。我们在两个领域构建了对比上下文数据：对于代码代理，轨迹作为上下文，通过条件过滤生成一千对数据；对于多模态推理，图像作为上下文，通过生成编辑和相似度搜索生成七千对数据。ContextRL在五个长程基准测试上平均比标准方法提升百分之二点二，在十二个视觉问答基准上平均提升百分之一点八。为分离所提目标与额外数据的影响，我们将其与重用相同对比上下文作为标准查询上下文答案示例的数据增强基线进行对比。这些基线几乎未带来提升，表明性能增益源于所提出的上下文选择目标而非对比数据本身。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决大语言模型在长文本或复杂多模态输入中难以准确识别并依赖关键隐蔽证据的上下文不敏感问题。该问题在研究和应用中至关重要，因为随着模型被用于智能体代码编辑和多模态推理等复杂任务，若无法将决策与上下文证据严格对齐，模型极易产生看似合理但实际错误的不一致输出，从而严重制约系统的可靠性与真实落地。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者观察到现有大模型在复杂任务中常因忽略关键上下文证据而犯错，即上下文无意识问题。为此，他们在标准强化学习框架基础上设计了辅助目标，通过构建高度相似的对比上下文对，专门训练模型识别并选择真正支持答案的上下文。该方法直接借鉴了现有的强化学习算法，将传统的结果奖励与新增的上下文选择损失结合进行联合训练，无需修改模型架构即可提升推理与多模态理解能力。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是解决大模型在复杂长上下文或图像中忽略关键证据的问题，通过引入辅助训练目标，不仅奖励模型给出正确答案，还专门奖励它精准选出能支撑该答案的正确上下文。整体实现流程首先构建包含查询、答案、支撑上下文和易混淆干扰上下文的对比数据对，随后在标准强化学习训练的基础上，联合优化一个上下文选择损失函数，强制模型在推理时依赖正确的上下文信息，从而有效提升长程推理与多模态理解能力。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种上下文感知的强化学习训练框架，通过引入辅助的上下文选择目标，要求模型在生成答案的同时，必须从高度相似的干扰上下文中准确识别出支持该答案的关键证据。与以往仅以最终答案正确性为奖励标准的强化学习或简单数据增强方法不同，该方法通过对比机制强制模型将输出结果与具体上下文证据严格对齐。实验表明，这种特定的训练目标而非单纯的数据增加，才是模型在长程推理和多模态任务中性能提升的根本原因。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种上下文感知强化学习方法，通过在训练过程中增加让模型选择支撑答案的正确上下文这一辅助目标，有效提升了大语言模型在长程推理和多模态任务中的上下文对齐与推理能力。

Abstract

Large language models (LLMs) often fail when answering requires identifying a small but decisive piece of evidence within a long or complex context, such as a single line in a tool trace or a subtle detail in an image. We propose ContextRL, a context-aware reinforcement learning (RL) method that improves long-horizon reasoning and multimodal performance through an \emph{indirect} auxiliary objective. Instead of supervising only the final answer, ContextRL presents the model with a query, an answer, and two highly similar contexts, and rewards it for selecting the context that supports the query--answer pair, thereby encouraging fine-grained grounding. We construct contrastive context data in two domains: for coding agents, trajectories serve as contexts, yielding 1k pairs built via condition filtering; for multimodal reasoning, images serve as contexts, yielding 7K pairs built via generative editing and similarity search. ContextRL achieves average gains of +2.2% over standard GRPO on 5 long-horizon benchmarks, and +1.8% across 12 diverse visual question answering benchmarks. To disentangle the effect of the proposed objective from that of additional data, we compare against data-augmentation baselines that repurpose the same contrastive contexts as standard query--context--answer examples. These baselines provide little to no improvement, showing that the gains arise from the proposed context-selection objective rather than from the contrastive data alone.

item.title: Do Time Series Foundation Model Benchmarks Hide Regime-Dependent Failures? Evidence from Traffic Speed Forecasting
item.author: Yingshuo Wang, Xian Sun, Lingdong Kong, Wei Gao, Yanhang Li, Zhichao Fan, Zexin Zhuang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ...

背景: ...

目的: ...

方法: ...

主要发现: ...

结论: ...

翻译: ...

Abstract

Standard benchmarks evaluate time series foundation models (TSFMs) using aggregate metrics, but these can mask severe failures in critical operating regimes. We introduce regime-stratified evaluation and apply it to three TSFMs on two standard traffic speed benchmarks. Traffic exhibits abrupt regime switching between free-flow and congested states, producing bimodal speed distributions during transitions. When we stratify by traffic regime, both accuracy and prediction-interval coverage degrade sharply during transitions: transition-regime MAE reaches 11 mph (versus 3 mph overall), and empirical coverage of 90% prediction intervals drops as low as 55%. These failures are invisible in aggregate metrics because free-flow observations dominate the sample. A simple historical conditional baseline (sampling from per-sensor training distributions) achieves better transition coverage than any TSFM, but has far worse overall accuracy. We propose bimodal mixture augmentation (BMA), a post-hoc method that combines TSFM forecasts with historical distributional knowledge, approaching the historical baseline's transition coverage while preserving the TSFM's accuracy. Our results suggest that TSFM benchmarks should incorporate regime-aware evaluation to surface failures that aggregate metrics hide.

item.title: Deep Research in Physical Sciences: A Multi-Agent Framework and Comprehensive Benchmark
item.author: Jiang, Yigeng, Yang, Tengchao, Cui, Taoyong, Wan, Jiaxing, Wang, Yuan, Wang, Weida, Liu, Zhiyu, Peng, Chuyi, Luo, Binzhao, Gao, Maoli, Huang, Huaihai, Zeng, Yuqianer, Zheng, Ziyang, Huang, Dongchen, Chen, Chao, Liu, Zichao, Shen, Weiping, Pu, Shuchen, Zhou, Siyu, Ma, Runmin, Hu, Yusong, Chao, Fei, Zhang, Bo, Zheng, Xiawu, Wang, Zifu, Bai, Lei, Cai, Yunqi, Zhang, Shufei
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了物理科学领域的深度研究基准测试 PhySciBench 及多智能体框架 DelveAgent，旨在评估并提升大型语言模型在物理与化学研究中的自主推理能力。

背景: 基于大型语言模型的深度研究代理在物理科学自主推理中潜力巨大，但缺乏全面深入的领域能力评估。

目的: 填补物理科学研究领域能力评估的空白，提供相关基准测试并开发改进的智能体框架。

方法: 构建包含两百道专家精选问题的 PhySciBench 基准测试，涵盖六个任务类别；评估现有模型并分析失败案例；开发具有自适应规划循环、双粒度记忆和分层物理基础反思机制的模块化多智能体框架 DelveAgent，并在多个基准上进行测试。

主要发现: 现有最强模型准确率仅约百分之三十三点五；失败案例暴露出长推理链脆弱、跨步骤知识迁移有限及缺乏物理基础自我验证三大缺陷；DelveAgent 将准确率提升最高达百分之七点五，并将推理成本降至最强基线的约三分之一。

结论: PhySciBench 是评估物理科学人工智能系统的关键基准，架构专业化能有效提升自主科学研究的可靠性，相关数据与代码已公开。

翻译: 深度研究代理是基于大型语言模型的系统，专为自主的多步科学推理而设计，在加速物理科学研究方面具有巨大潜力。然而，目前缺乏对其在该领域能力的全面深入评估。为弥补这一空白，我们推出了与物理科学研究高度相关的基准测试 PhySciBench，该基准包含两百道专家精心挑选的问题，在物理和化学之间保持平衡，涵盖六个反映现实科学工作流程的任务类别。对 PhySciBench 上最先进模型和代理系统的评估显示其性能有限；即使最强的基线模型 Gemini Deep Research 的准确率也仅为百分之三十三点五。对失败案例的分析确定了三个反复出现的缺陷：长推理链的脆弱性、跨步骤的知识迁移能力有限以及缺乏基于物理的自我验证。受此启发，我们开发了 DelveAgent，这是一个配备自适应规划循环、双粒度记忆和分层物理基础反思机制的模块化多智能体框架。在四个科学基准测试中，DelveAgent 将准确率提高了最高达百分之七点五，同时将推理成本降至最强基线的约三分之一。这些结果确立了 PhySciBench 作为评估物理科学人工智能系统的关键基准的重要性，并证明架构专业化可以有效提升自主科学研究的可靠性。数据和代码已在指定链接公开。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决物理科学领域缺乏针对人工智能智能体深度研究能力的综合评估基准，以及现有模型在复杂多步科学推理中表现不佳的问题。该问题在科研中至关重要，因为传统依赖人工整合海量实验数据与文献的模式已触及效率瓶颈，而自主多步推理技术有望大幅加速科学研究进程。然而当前通用模型在长链条推理、跨步骤知识迁移及物理规律验证方面存在明显缺陷，亟需专用架构与可靠评估体系来推动人工智能在物理科学中的实际应用。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者通过评估现有通用智能体在物理科学任务上的表现，深入分析了大量失败案例，总结出长链条推理不稳定、跨步骤知识复用不足以及缺乏物理约束验证三大核心缺陷。基于这些发现，作者针对性地设计了模块化多智能体框架，分别引入自适应规划循环、双粒度记忆机制和分层物理自反思模块来逐一弥补上述短板。该方法主要依托大型语言模型智能体工作流的通用范式，并直接针对现有基线模型的局限性进行了架构专业化改进，文中未明确提及借鉴其他特定外部架构。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是通过架构专业化设计而非单纯扩大模型规模，来克服长链条推理脆弱、知识迁移能力弱及缺乏物理自验证等缺陷。整体实现流程依托模块化多智能体架构，首先利用自适应规划循环在获取中间结果后动态调整策略并修正偏差；随后通过双粒度记忆模块持续积累并复用领域知识与成功经验；最后借助分层物理自验证机制对中间和最终输出进行科学一致性检查，从而形成多步工具调用与推理的闭环。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点在于提出了面向物理科学的综合评测基准与模块化多智能体框架。该评测基准涵盖信息提取、科学理解与应用创造三个阶段，包含两百道专家精心设计的题目，全面评估模型在多步工具调用与跨源推理方面的能力。相比以往仅关注单一任务或纯文本的评测标准，该基准更贴近真实科研流程并支持多模态解析与代码执行。配套的框架则通过自适应规划、双粒度记忆和基于物理规律的反思机制，针对性解决了现有模型在长链条推理、知识迁移和科学自验证方面的缺陷，在提升准确率的同时大幅降低了计算成本。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文构建了一个涵盖物理与化学多阶段科研流程的综合评测基准，揭示了现有人工智能系统在长程推理、知识迁移和物理自验证方面的不足，并据此设计了一种模块化多智能体框架，显著提升了自主科学研究的准确率并大幅降低了计算成本。

Abstract

Deep research agents are Large Language Model (LLM)-based systems designed for autonomous, multi-step scientific reasoning, and they hold immense potential for accelerating research in the physical sciences. However, comprehensive and in-depth evaluations of their capabilities within this domain remain lacking. To address this gap, we introduce PhySciBench, a benchmark highly relevant to physical science research, comprising 200 expert-curated questions, balanced between physics and chemistry, across six task categories that reflect real-world scientific workflows. Evaluations of state-of-the-art models and agent systems on PhySciBench reveal limited performance; even the strongest baseline, Gemini Deep Research, achieves an accuracy of only 33.5%. Analysis of failure cases identifies three recurrent deficiencies: fragility in extended reasoning chains, limited knowledge transfer across steps, and a lack of physics-grounded self-verification. Motivated by these findings, we develop DelveAgent, a modular multi-agent framework equipped with an adaptive planning loop, dual-granularity memory, and a hierarchical physics-grounded reflection mechanism. Across four scientific benchmarks, DelveAgent improves accuracy by up to 7.5 percentage points while reducing inference costs to approximately one-third of the strongest baseline. These results establish the significance of PhySciBench as a critical benchmark for evaluating AI systems in the physical sciences and demonstrate that architectural specialization can effectively enhance the reliability of autonomous scientific this http URL data andcode are publicly available athttps://github.com/yigengjiang/physci-deepresearch.

item.title: PEFT-MedSAM: Efficient Fine-Tuning of Medical Foundation Models for Explainable Skin Lesion Segmentation
item.author: Asad Channa, Abdullah Khan, Asghar Ali Chandio, Aamir Akbar, Shahzad Memon, Aqib Hussain, Ameer Hamza
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为PEFT-MedSAM的参数高效微调方法，用于自动分割皮肤镜图像中的皮肤病变，显著提升了分割精度与临床可信度。

背景: 利用深度学习模型自动分割皮肤镜图像中的皮肤病变有助于更早发现黑色素瘤，但现有大多数深度学习方法性能不佳。

目的: 提出PEFT-MedSAM方法，将医学分割一切模型适配于皮肤病变的自动分割任务。

方法: 仅使用轻量级掩码解码器进行模型训练，冻结预训练的图像编码器与提示编码器。在ISIC二零一八年基准数据集上进行实验，并在PH2数据集上进行外部验证。结合Grad-CAM可解释性技术与基于指认游戏的评价方法对模型进行评估。

主要发现: 在ISIC二零一八年数据集中，该方法Dice系数达到零点九四一一，交并比达到零点八九一八，优于全训练U-Net基线模型与零样本医学分割一切模型推理结果。PH2数据集外部验证Dice系数为零点九四六七，标准差为零点零三一零。统计检验显示差异显著，置信区间合理。可解释性评估在五百一十九张验证图像上准确率达到百分之九十八点二七，证实模型能正确识别病变区域。

结论: PEFT-MedSAM方法能有效适配医学分割一切模型，实现高精度的皮肤病变自动分割，并具备良好的临床可信度。

翻译: 利用深度学习模型对皮肤镜图像进行皮肤病变自动分割，有助于比常规检测更早地发现黑色素瘤。然而，目前大多数可用的深度学习方法性能并不理想。本文旨在提出一种名为PEFT-MedSAM的参数高效微调方法，以将医学分割一切模型适配于皮肤病变的自动分割任务。PEFT-MedSAM方法仅使用轻量级掩码解码器进行模型训练，同时冻结预训练的图像编码器和提示编码器。在ISIC二零一八年基准数据集上进行的实验表明，与全训练U-Net基线模型相比，PEFT-MedSAM获得了零点九四一一的Dice系数和零点八九一八的交并比。使用PH2数据集对模型进行外部验证显示，其Dice系数为零点九四六七，标准差为零点零三一零。支持这些主张的证据包括比较两个数据集的威尔科克森符号秩检验的P值小于零点零零零一，以及通过重复测试估计的平均Dice系数可能取值范围的百分之九十五置信区间为零点九三六四至零点九四四七。为提高临床可信度，我们结合Grad-CAM可解释性与基于指认游戏的评价方法，在验证集上对卷积神经网络基线模型进行了评估。结果表明，在五百一十九张图像的验证集上准确率达到百分之九十八点二七，并证实该模型能够正确分类包含皮肤病变的区域。

Abstract

Automated segmentation of skin lesions using deep learning models for dermoscopic images can be very helpful in finding melanomas earlier than they would normally be detected. However, most deep learning methods available do not perform well. The aim of this paper is to present a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method called PEFT-MedSAM for adapting the Medical Segment Anything Model (MedSAM) to automatically segment dermoscopic skin lesions. The PEFT-MedSAM method uses only the lightweight mask decoder for training the model while keeping the pre-trained image encoder and prompt encoder frozen. The experiments performed on the ISIC 2018 benchmark dataset shows that PEFT-MedSAM obtains a dice coefficient of .9411 and an intersection over union value of .8918 when compared to both a fully trained U-Net baseline (.8715 dice coefficient) and zero-shot MedSAM inference (.8997 dice coefficient). The external validation of the model using PH2 dataset shows .9467 dice coefficient with +/- .0310 standard deviation. Supportive evidence for these claims include a p-value less than .0001 for Wilcoxon signed rank tests comparing the two datasets and bootstrap-estimated 95% confidence intervals of [.9364,.9447] that represent the estimated range of possible values for the average dice coefficient obtained by repeating the test. To increase clinical trustworthiness, we used Grad-CAM explainability along with a pointing game based evaluation methodology to evaluate the CNN baseline model on the validation set. The results showed that we had an accuracy rate of 98.27% on the validation set of 519 images and confirmed that the model classified regions containing skin lesions.

item.title: Learning from Your Own Mistakes: Constructing Learnable Micro-Reflective Trajectories for Self-Distillation
item.author: Huang, Zhilin, Gao, Hang, Dong, Ziqiang, Chen, Yuan, Luo, Yifeng, Qin, Chujun, Wang, Jingyi, Yang, Yang, Jiang, Guanjun
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出轨迹增强策略优化方法，通过将自蒸馏从隐式分布对齐转变为显式轨迹构建，有效提升了大语言模型的推理能力与错误修正效果。

背景: 现有自蒸馏技术利用模型自身生成的轨迹作为训练信号，通常通过隐式对齐最小化分布差异。但由于监督信号来自无控采样，无法提供针对具体错误的诊断或修正指导，导致模型仅模仿目标分布而缺乏细粒度的纠错反馈。

目的: 旨在突破隐式分布对齐的局限，实现显式轨迹构建，为模型提供精准定位推理失败原因及位置的细粒度修正信号。

方法: 提出轨迹增强策略优化算法。在强化学习训练过程中，利用同一查询下的正确与错误轨迹构建对比结构，生成微反思修正轨迹。该轨迹保留模型出错前的推理过程，并插入基于同组正确参考的自然语言诊断与修正推理。同时，采用难度感知的候选者选择机制与解耦优势估计，以保留策略分布并防止梯度污染。

主要发现: 在多项数学推理基准测试中的实验表明，该方法在相同训练步数下持续优于现有基线方法。进一步分析证实，该方法显著增强了模型的首次推理准确率与错误修正能力。

结论: 轨迹增强策略优化成功将自蒸馏范式转向显式轨迹构建，在保持策略分布一致性的同时，有效提升了大语言模型的推理质量与纠错效能。

翻译: Self-distillation improves reasoning in large language models by using the model's own rollouts as training signal, typically through implicit logit-level alignment that minimizes KL divergence toward a privileged target distribution. However, because this supervision is generated via uncontrolled sampling, it provides no diagnostic insight into the model's specific errors or corrective guidance for its individual failure patterns. Consequently, the model learns to imitate a privileged distribution rather than receiving fine-grained corrections that pinpoint where and why its reasoning fails. In this paper, we propose Trajectory-Augmented Policy Optimization (TAPO), which advances self-distillation from implicit distributional alignment to explicit trajectory construction. During RL training, the model produces both correct and incorrect rollouts to the same query, and TAPO leverages this contrastive structure to construct micro-reflective corrections, new training trajectories that retain the model's erroneous reasoning up to the point of failure, then insert a natural-language diagnosis and corrected reasoning guided by a correct reference from the same sampling group. Since each trajectory is anchored in the learner's own prefix and solutions, the corrective signal preserves the model's on-policy distribution to a greater extent than the position-wise alignment imposed by KL-based methods. To integrate these trajectories, TAPO introduces difficulty-aware candidate selection at the model's capability boundary and decoupled advantage estimation to prevent gradient contamination. Experiments on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and HMMT 2025 show that TAPO achieves consistent improvements over GRPO under the same number of training steps. Further analysis demonstrates that TAPO strengthens both first-pass reasoning and error-correction effectiveness.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有大语言模型自训练方法中依赖隐式概率对齐的缺陷。传统方法通过强制模型模仿正确答案的分布来优化，不仅无法提供具体的错误诊断与修正指导，还会压制模型自身的错误推理路径，导致模型缺乏自主纠错能力。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为复杂推理任务要求模型能够识别并纠正自身思维过程中的错误，从而在不依赖外部干预或测试时多轮交互的情况下，实现更稳健、泛化性更强的自主推理能力。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有自蒸馏方法仅通过隐式的概率分布对齐进行指导，无法提供针对具体错误的诊断与纠正路径，且容易压制模型的纠错能力。受教育心理学最近发展区理论的启发，作者设计了一种显式构建训练轨迹的方法，利用强化学习采样中自然产生的正确与错误答案对比，让模型从自身错误起点出发，生成包含错误诊断与纠正步骤的新轨迹。该方法主要借鉴了组相对策略优化的对比采样框架以及自蒸馏和错误驱动学习的相关研究，并参考分布判别理论设计了稳定训练的机制。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是让模型从自身的错误中学习，通过保留模型推理至出错点的前缀，并插入自然语言错误诊断与正确修正步骤，构建出包含错误分析到纠正过程的显式训练轨迹，从而提供比传统隐式对齐更精准的纠错指导。整体实现流程是在训练时让模型对同一问题生成多组答案，从中筛选难度适中的题目，将错误答案与正确答案配对生成反思轨迹，随后通过独立分组计算优化信号并抑制异常词汇的干扰，将这些新轨迹与常规答案混合进行策略更新，最终在推理时直接输出标准答案而无需额外反思步骤。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的核心创新是提出了一种将自蒸馏从隐式概率分布对齐转变为显式轨迹构建的训练框架。相比以往方法仅通过数学约束压制错误答案，该框架利用模型自身正确与错误推理的对比，构造出包含错误诊断与修正步骤的微型反思轨迹。这种设计使模型在训练时直接学习如何从自身错误中恢复，而非盲目模仿标准答案，且该反思机制仅在训练阶段使用，推理时保持与基线相同的单步生成模式。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种新的自蒸馏框架，通过从模型自身错误中构建显式的“微反思”训练轨迹，将传统隐式的分布对齐升级为显式的轨迹构建，从而在保持训练稳定的同时显著提升大语言模型的推理与纠错能力。

Abstract

Self-distillation improves reasoning in large language models by using the model's own rollouts as training signal, typically through implicit logit-level alignment that minimizes KL divergence toward a privileged target distribution. However, because this supervision is generated via uncontrolled sampling, it provides no diagnostic insight into the model's specific errors or corrective guidance for its individual failure patterns. Consequently, the model learns to imitate a privileged distribution rather than receiving fine-grained corrections that pinpoint where and why its reasoning fails. In this paper, we propose Trajectory-Augmented Policy Optimization (TAPO), which advances self-distillation from implicit distributional alignment to explicit trajectory construction. During RL training, the model produces both correct and incorrect rollouts to the same query, and TAPO leverages this contrastive structure to construct micro-reflective corrections, new training trajectories that retain the model's erroneous reasoning up to the point of failure, then insert a natural-language diagnosis and corrected reasoning guided by a correct reference from the same sampling group. Since each trajectory is anchored in the learner's own prefix and solutions, the corrective signal preserves the model's on-policy distribution to a greater extent than the position-wise alignment imposed by KL-based methods. To integrate these trajectories, TAPO introduces difficulty-aware candidate selection at the model's capability boundary and decoupled advantage estimation to prevent gradient contamination. Experiments on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and HMMT 2025 show that TAPO achieves consistent improvements over GRPO under the same number of training steps. Further analysis demonstrates that TAPO strengthens both first-pass reasoning and error-correction effectiveness.

Abstract

Accurately estimating treatment effects in time series is essential for evaluating interventions in real-world applications, especially when treatment assignment is biased by unobserved factors. In many practical settings, interventions are adopted at different times across individuals, leading to staggered treatment exposure and heterogeneous pre-treatment histories. In such cases, aggregating outcome trajectories across treated units is ill-defined, making individual treatment effect (ITE) estimation a prerequisite for reliable causal inference. We therefore study the problem of estimating the average treatment effect for the treated (ATT) by first recovering individual-level counterfactuals. We introduce a neural framework that learns simultaneously low-dimensional latent representations of individual time series and propensity scores. These estimates are then used to approximate the individual treatment effects through a flexible matching procedure that avoids classical convexity constraints commonly used in synthetic control methods. By operating at the individual level, our approach naturally accommodates staggered interventions and improves counterfactual estimation under latent bias, without relying on explicit temporal modeling assumptions. We illustrate our approach on both real-world energy consumption data and clinical time series, including high-frequency electricity demand-response programs and semi-synthetic data for individuals in intensive care unit (ICU), where hidden confounding, staggered treatment adoption, and non-stationary dynamics are prevalent.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决多轮工具使用智能体在强化学习训练中，因依赖静态数据集而导致的“有效训练样本快速枯竭”问题。随着模型能力不断提升，原本用于训练的数据会逐渐变得过于简单或超出当前水平，导致模型无法继续获得有价值的学习信号。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为高质量的多轮交互数据收集成本极高，若无法动态生成贴合模型当前能力边界的训练数据，将严重限制智能体在复杂现实任务中的学习效率与泛化能力。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者的核心思路是利用强化学习训练时自然产生的奖励方差来定位模型的能力边界，因为该区域恰好是梯度信号最丰富的地方。基于此启发，他们构建了训练与数据生成的闭环，通过保留原始任务结构复杂度的流水线合成新样本，并配合动态缓冲区随模型能力共同进化。该方法借鉴了优先经验回放和困难样本挖掘等经典强化学习策略的思想，但将其从筛选现有数据转变为在边界处生成新数据，同时结合了前期关于进度奖励与课程学习的研究成果。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用强化学习训练中的奖励方差作为零成本的能力边界探测器，实时定位模型当前刚好能部分完成的任务，并据此动态生成结构相似的新数据，以维持训练信号的丰富性。整体流程包含三个环节：首先在滚动采样中筛选出奖励处于中等水平的边界样本；接着通过多智能体流水线生成保持原有工具调用结构和语义连贯性的新变体；最后将新数据按阶段注入动态训练池，并自动淘汰已掌握或过难的旧任务，实现数据生成与模型训练的持续协同进化。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种奖励驱动的在线数据合成框架，利用训练过程中的奖励方差自动识别模型能力边界，并实时生成结构复杂度匹配的新数据。与以往依赖静态数据集或盲目在线生成的方法不同，该方法将数据生成与强化学习训练闭环紧密耦合，通过技能对齐的采样管线保证多轮交互的语义连贯性，并动态维护训练数据池。这使得模型仅需极少量人工种子数据即可实现高效训练，显著克服了静态数据信号枯竭和在线生成逻辑断裂的缺陷。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种奖励驱动的在线数据合成方法，通过利用强化学习过程中的奖励波动动态定位模型能力边界，并实时生成结构连贯的新训练数据，从而在极少初始数据下显著提升了多轮工具使用智能体的训练效率与最终性能。

Abstract

Multi-turn tool-use RL is bottlenecked by the rapid depletion of informative samples in static datasets. We observe that the gradient signal in GRPO concentrates on tasks with the highest rollout reward variance, a consequence of the Popoviciu upper bound. Consequently, samples near the agent's capability boundary -- where successes and failures are roughly balanced -- contribute disproportionately large policy gradients. As training progresses, this boundary continuously shifts, which gradually depletes the pool of informative samples in a static dataset. We propose RODS (Reward-driven Online Data Synthesis) to resolve this depletion. RODS closes the loop between RL training and data generation by repurposing the progress reward variance as a practical, zero-cost boundary detector that requires no extra inference beyond the rollouts already computed for training. It continuously identifies such boundary samples, synthesizes new multi-turn variants matching their structural complexity (e.g., API topology and dependency depth) via a skill-aligned resampling pipeline, and manages a dynamic replay buffer that co-evolves with the policy. Starting from 400 human seeds and maintaining an active training pool of ~800 samples, RODS achieves comparable performance to a 17K-sample offline pipeline while requiring roughly 20x fewer trajectories, and improves over fixed-data RL and environment augmentation in our controlled setting.

item.title: ImageWAM: Do World Action Models Really Need Video Generation, or Just Image Editing?
item.author: Zhang, Yuyang, Zhang, Wenyao, Qi, Zekun, Zhang, He, Lin, Haitao, Zhang, Jingbo, Mu, Yao, Yang, Xiaokang, Zeng, Wenjun, Jin, Xin

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决传统世界动作模型过度依赖视频生成所导致的计算成本高昂、易浪费算力在无关细节上以及长程预测误差可能误导机器人决策的问题。该问题在研究和实际应用中非常重要，因为视频生成难以满足机器人实时控制的低延迟需求，而改用图像编辑不仅能大幅降低计算开销和运行延迟，还能更精准地聚焦任务相关的视觉变化，从而为机器人控制提供高效可靠的替代方案。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者通过反思传统视频生成世界动作模型在推理成本高、易受无关细节干扰以及长程预测误差误导动作决策等问题，提出机器人控制其实只需关注当前到目标状态的指令引导型视觉变化。基于这一洞察，他们设计了该框架，直接复用预训练图像编辑模型，不生成完整视频或编辑后图像，而是提取编辑去噪过程中的中间特征缓存作为紧凑的世界动作上下文，并以此驱动动作专家预测机器人操作。该方法借鉴了现有的图像编辑模型预训练成果与世界动作模型架构，将视频生成的先验转化为图像编辑的先验，实现了更高效的任务导向型策略学习。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是用图像编辑替代视频生成，利用预训练的图像编辑模型捕捉当前画面到目标画面的指令驱动变化，从而聚焦于与机器人动作相关的视觉差异，避免视频生成带来的高计算成本和长程预测误差。整体流程为输入当前观测图像与任务指令，通过图像编辑网络进行单次推理提取中间特征信息，随后将这些特征直接输入动作预测模块，结合当前状态直接生成机器人动作序列，全程无需解码完整图像或未来视频帧。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种新框架，将预训练的图片编辑模型直接作为机器人动作预测的骨干网络。与以往依赖视频生成来预测未来多帧画面的工作不同，该方法仅提取图片编辑过程中的中间特征缓存作为上下文信息，直接指导机器人动作生成，无需解码完整图像或未来视频。这种设计使模型更聚焦于任务相关的视觉变化，大幅降低了计算成本与推理延迟，且无需额外的机器人策略预训练即可取得更优性能。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种新的机器人动作预测框架，通过复用预训练图像编辑模型替代传统的视频生成技术来提取视觉特征，在无需额外策略预训练的情况下实现了更优的控制性能并大幅降低了计算与推理成本。

Abstract

World Action Models (WAMs) commonly rely on video generation to bridge visual world modeling and robot control. However, video-based WAMs face three coupled limitations: dense multi-frame future tokens make inference costly, full video prediction spends capacity on action-irrelevant temporal and appearance details, and long-horizon future imagination may introduce errors that mislead action prediction. These issues raise a simple question: Does world action model really need video generation? We propose ImageWAM, a simple WAM framework that repurposes pretrained image editing models for robot action prediction. In contrast to video generation, image editing provides a better-matched prior: it only needs to model a target-frame transformation, focuses on action-relevant current-to-target visual differences, and grounds task instructions to localized visual changes through edit pretraining. In practice, ImageWAM does not decode the target frame at inference time; instead, it conditions a flow-matching action expert on the KV caches produced by image-editing denoising, using them as a compact world-action context. ImageWAM outperforms standard VLA baselines and matching competitive WAMs without additional policy pretraining across different simulator and real-world experiments. It also reduces FLOPs to 1/6 and latency to 1/4 of video-based WAMs. Attention analysis further shows that editing caches focus on task-relevant change regions, supporting image editing as an effective alternative to video-based world-action modeling.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决大语言模型在处理长文本时，标准注意力机制计算复杂度太高导致效率低下，而现有混合注意力设计难以有效结合高精度检索与高效计算的问题。该问题在研究与现实中至关重要，因为扩展上下文窗口是模型实现复杂推理与长期规划的基础，但必须在保证推理精度的同时大幅降低计算与存储成本。通过细粒度的头级注意力混合，该方法为高效构建支持超长上下文的大模型提供了新的可行路径。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者通过可解释性分析发现同一层内的注意力头功能差异显著，而层间功能相似，因此决定以注意力头为粒度混合全注意力与线性注意力。设计上，他们利用可解释性技术筛选出对长文本检索关键的头保留全注意力，其余头使用线性注意力，并引入尺度归一化融合模块解决两者输出分布差异。该方法借鉴了机制可解释性分析工具与现有混合注意力架构的研究思路，并基于现有蒸馏流程进行了扩展以适应头级混合结构。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用注意力头级别的功能差异，通过可解释性分析精准识别出对长文本检索至关重要的注意力头并分配全注意力机制，其余头则采用高效的线性注意力机制，从而实现同一层内不同机制的混合。整体实现流程首先基于校准数据完成头级机制的轻量级分配，随后引入尺度归一化融合模块以调和不同机制输出的分布差异，最后通过参数继承、全局蒸馏与长上下文微调的三阶段训练流程完成模型优化。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新在于提出了一种基于注意力头级别的混合架构，利用可解释性分析精准筛选出对长文本检索至关重要的注意力头，并仅对这些关键头保留高精度全注意力机制，其余头则采用高效的线性注意力机制。同时，论文设计了尺度归一化融合模块，有效弥合了两种机制输出分布的差异。与以往工作相比，该方法突破了传统按层或按词元混合的粗粒度限制，克服了现有头级混合方法缺乏功能区分或融合策略单一的问题，实现了更细粒度且功能互补的注意力混合，在长上下文任务中显著提升了性能。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种基于注意力头级功能异质性的新型混合架构，通过可解释性分析精准筛选关键注意力头并仅对其保留全注意力机制，同时结合尺度归一化融合模块与轻量级训练流程，以极低的训练成本实现了卓越的长上下文处理能力与通用推理性能。

Abstract

The quadratic complexity of attention poses a critical bottleneck for long-context processing, spurring interest in hybrid attention designs. Most open-source hybrid models adopt a layer-wise strategy. Yet, prior work has noted the inherent difficulty of integrating Linear Attention (LA) with Full Attention (FA), suggesting that the design space of attention hybridization remains underexplored. To probe this space, we conduct interpretability analysis and observe that layers exhibit block-wise functional similarity, while individual heads within the same layer display distinct functional specialization despite sharing input features. This head-level heterogeneity suggests that the head dimension provides a natural and principled granularity for fusing heterogeneous attention signals. Building on this insight, we introduce HydraHead, a novel architecture that hybridizes FA and LA along the head axis. HydraHead features two key innovations: (1) an interpretability-driven selection strategy that identifies retrieval-critical heads and preserves FA only for them, and (2) a scale-normalized fusion module that reconciles the distributional gap between FA and LA head outputs. By leveraging a three-stage transfer pipeline with parameter reuse and distillation, we achieve high-performance hybrid models with minimal training overhead. Under a unified training setup, HydraHead outperforms other hybrid designs in long-context tasks while maintaining strong general reasoning. With interpretability-driven head selection, it matches a 3:1 layer-wise hybrid's long-context performance at a 7:1 LA-to-FA ratio. Crucially, trained on only 15B tokens, HydraHead achieves over 69% improvement over the baseline at 512K context length, approaching Qwen3.5, a leading model of comparable size with a native context length of 256K. This highlights the significant scaling potential of head-level hybridization.

item.title: Rethinking Shrinkage Bias in LLM FP4 Pretraining: Geometric Origin, Systemic Impact, and UFP4 Recipe
item.author: Zhao, Qian, Chen, Kunlong, Tian, Changxin, Jiang, Zhonghui, Zhang, Haitao, Yu, Chaofan, Jiang, Peijie, Gong, Mingliang, Liu, Jia, Liu, Ziqi, Zhang, Zhiqiang, Zhou, Jun

总结: ...

翻译: ...

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决大语言模型在采用四位浮点格式训练时，因非均匀数据网格固有的几何不对称性而引发的系统性信号衰减与训练不稳定问题。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为降低计算精度是大幅削减大模型预训练内存与算力成本的核心路径，若无法克服精度下降导致的收敛困难与性能退化，将严重阻碍低成本、超大规模语言模型的实际应用与迭代。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者通过理论分析发现，现有训练采用的非均匀数据格式存在固有的几何不对称性，会导致系统性的舍入偏差并随网络层数累积放大。基于这一发现，他们提出改用均匀网格格式，并据此设计了均匀训练方案，将数据分散变换应用于所有计算路径，同时仅对特定梯度使用随机舍入。该方法在现有低精度训练技术与舍入策略的基础上进行了重构，通过更换底层数据格式从根本上规避了原有偏差问题。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是放弃传统非均匀格式固有的几何不对称性，改用均匀分布的位宽网格，从而彻底消除系统性的量化收缩偏差，使随机哈达玛变换能真正提升精度而非导致信号衰减。整体实现流程为：在模型训练的前向计算与反向梯度更新中全面应用随机哈达玛变换以分散数据，同时仅对上游梯度量化时采用随机舍入策略，最终在大规模语言模型预训练中实现更稳定的收敛与更低的精度损失。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点在于首次揭示了非均匀格式固有的系统性舍入误差问题，并证明该误差会随网络层数累积并被随机哈达玛变换放大，从而统一解释了现有训练方案不稳定的原因。基于此，论文提出了一种基于均匀网格的4位训练方案，将随机哈达玛变换应用于所有训练计算路径，并严格限制随机舍入的使用范围。相比以往工作固守非均匀格式的做法，该方案通过消除几何不对称带来的偏差，显著提升了大规模预训练的稳定性并降低了精度损失。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文系统揭示了现有非均匀4位格式固有的几何舍入偏差及其在深层网络中累积导致训练不稳定的机制，并据此提出了一种基于均匀网格的4位训练方案，在大规模语言模型预训练中实现了更优的精度与稳定性。

Abstract

FP4 training promises substantial reductions in memory and computation cost for LLM pretraining, yet current FP4 hardware paths and recipes, including NVIDIA Blackwell/Rubin-class systems and AMD MI350-series GPUs, remain centered on E2M1 data elements. In this study, we identify a fundamental limitation of that choice: non-uniform formats such as E2M1 inherently suffer from Shrinkage Bias, a systematic negative rounding error caused by the geometric asymmetry of their representable bins. We show that this bias accumulates multiplicatively across layers and is amplified by the Random Hadamard Transform (RHT), providing a unified explanation for the training instability observed in existing E2M1-based FP4 recipes. In contrast, uniform grids (E1M2/INT4) bypass this grid-geometry error and better convert the improved bucket utilization from RHT into higher quantization quality. Based on this finding, we propose UFP4, a uniform 4-bit training recipe that applies RHT to all three training GEMMs while restricting stochastic rounding to dY alone. On Dense 1.5B, MoE 7.9B, and MoE 124B long-run pretraining, UFP4 consistently achieves lower BF16-relative loss degradation than strong E2M1-based baselines, supported by scaling-law analysis and ablation studies. Our results suggest that future accelerators should support E1M2/INT4-style uniform 4-bit grids as first-class training primitives alongside E2M1.

item.title: The FID Lottery: Quantifying Hidden Randomness in Generative-Model Evaluation
item.author: Dufour, Nicolas, Efros, Alexei A., Pérez, Patrick
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ...

背景: ...

目的: ...

方法: ...

主要发现: ...

结论: ...

翻译: ...

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决生成模型评估中因训练和采样随机性导致FID分数不可靠的问题。研究发现，更换训练随机种子带来的分数波动远大于固定模型多次采样带来的波动，且单纯增加算力或模型规模无法消除这种波动。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为FID是衡量图像生成质量的默认标准，若忽略训练随机性，会导致虚假的性能提升宣称、误导算力分配，并严重阻碍模型评估的公平性与可复现性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者基于对现有图像生成论文仅报告单一评估分数可复现性的质疑，将评估指标视为受训练与采样种子共同影响的随机变量，设计了覆盖数百个独立训练模型与多次采样评估的双轴实验面板，以直接量化并分解隐藏随机性的来源。该方法借鉴了机器学习领域关于模型可复现性与方差分解的统计思路，并参考了前人关于评估指标有限样本偏差、特征提取器不确定性以及生成模型种子差异的相关研究，在此基础上首次系统考察了训练阶段多重随机源对最终评估结果的综合影响。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将生成模型的评估指标视为受训练和采样过程随机性影响的随机变量，而非固定数值。整体实现流程是并行训练大量使用不同随机种子的模型，对每个模型用多种采样种子生成图像并计算评估分数，构建双轴评估面板。随后通过分解方差来源并测试不同计算规模与超参数的影响，量化隐藏随机性的波动范围。最后基于实测波动阈值提出新的评估规范，要求报告多次训练种子的误差范围而非单一分数。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于首次将图像生成评估指标视为同时受训练和采样过程影响的随机变量，通过大规模实验直接量化了隐藏的训练随机性。相比以往仅报告单一模型结果和采样误差的惯例，本文发现重新训练带来的分数波动远大于固定模型重采样带来的波动，并明确指出权重初始化、数据顺序和训练噪声是主要来源。基于这一发现，论文提出了一种新的评估规范，建议通过多次独立训练报告误差范围，并将微小分数差异视为无效结果。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文系统量化了生成模型评估中隐藏的训练与采样随机性，揭示重训练对评估分数的影响远超重采样，并据此提出应基于多个训练种子报告误差范围的新评估协议。

Abstract

The Frechet Inception Distance (FID) is the de facto arbiter of image generation, yet most papers report just a single number from a single trained model using a single sampling seed. How reproducible is that number if we retrain the model, or merely resample from it? In this paper, we treat FID as a random variable on a two-axis panel of training and generation seeds, and measure its variance directly on several hundred SiT networks trained on class-conditional ImageNet 256x256. We report surprising findings: (a) Retraining the model using the same recipe with a different seed moves FID 3.2x more (in Inception feature space) than redrawing samples from a fixed network. (b) That gap is driven by three factors: random initialisation, data ordering, and the per-step Gaussian noise of the flow-matching loss. (c) Increasing compute or model size barely tightens the spread, holding the FID coefficient of variation (CoV) inside a 1-2% band. (d) Per-cell classifier-free-guidance tuning halves the spread but reshuffles which seeds work best, and a lucky training seed reaches the same FID with up to 2x less compute than an unlucky one. Based on these findings, we recommend a new FID evaluation protocol: evaluate under per-cell optimal guidance, treat any FID gap below the empirically measured ~1.3% CoV as inconclusive, and report an error bar over several training seeds rather than a single FID number.

item.title: TimeProVe: Propose, then Verify for Efficient Long Video Temporal Reasoning in Activities of Daily Living
item.author: Arkaprava Sinha, Dominick Reilly, Siddharth Krishnan, Hieu Le, Srijan Das
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为TimeProVe的高效混合框架，用于长视频问答中的时间定位推理，通过结合轻量级模块与视觉语言模型，显著降低了计算成本并提升了推理性能。

背景: 长视频问答需要在长达数小时的不剪辑视频中识别稀疏且与查询相关的证据。现有方法要么使用大型视觉语言模型密集处理视频，导致计算成本过高，要么依赖稀疏的基于字幕的推理，容易遗漏时间局部化和以动作为中心的证据。

目的: 开发一种计算成本高效的混合框架，以实现长视频中的时间定位推理。

方法: 提出TimeProVe框架，首先使用轻量级模块生成基于动作的答案与证据假设，随后仅针对目标内容进行昂贵的视觉语言模型验证。核心模块为基于动作的候选证据模块，通过轻量级语言模型推理将时间局部化动作转化为查询条件化的候选答案和支持证据窗口。同时引入了面向日常生活场景的开放式基准测试集。

主要发现: 该框架在基准测试上超越最强基线百分之七点三，视觉语言模型调用次数减少百分之七十五，推理成本降低百分之九十三。在未进行显式时间定位训练的情况下，在另一数据集上取得具有竞争力的性能，结合定位视觉语言模型后达到最先进结果。

结论: TimeProVe成功解决了长视频问答中计算效率与推理精度之间的权衡问题，为复杂视频理解提供了高效且可扩展的解决方案。

翻译: 长视频问答需要在长达数小时的不剪辑视频中识别稀疏且与查询相关的证据。现有方法要么使用大型视觉语言模型密集处理视频，导致计算成本过高，要么依赖稀疏的基于字幕的推理，往往遗漏时间局部化和以动作为中心的证据。我们提出了TimeProVe，一种用于长视频时间定位推理的高效混合框架。TimeProVe首先采用轻量级模块生成基于动作的答案与证据假设，随后仅针对目标内容进行昂贵的视觉语言模型验证。我们框架的核心在于基于动作的候选证据模块，该模块通过轻量级语言模型推理将时间局部化动作转化为查询条件化的候选答案和支持证据窗口。我们进一步引入了OpenTSUBench，这是一个旨在评估现实日常生活场景中时间定位推理的开放式基准测试。实验表明，TimeProVe在OpenTSUBench上超越最强基线百分之七点三，同时视觉语言模型调用次数减少百分之七十五，推理成本降低百分之九十三。此外，在未进行显式时间定位训练的情况下，TimeProVe在Charades-STA数据集上取得了具有竞争力的性能，并在结合定位视觉语言模型后达到最先进结果。

Abstract

Long Video Question Answering (LVQA) requires identifying sparse, query-relevant evidence within hours-long untrimmed videos. Existing approaches either process videos densely with large vision-language models (VLMs), incurring prohibitive computational cost, or rely on sparse caption-based reasoning, which often misses temporally localized and motion-centric evidence. We introduce TimeProVe, a cost-efficient hybrid framework for temporally grounded reasoning in long videos. TimeProVe first employs lightweight modules to generate action-grounded answer--evidence hypotheses and subsequently invokes an expensive VLM only for targeted verification. The core of our framework lies in the Action-based Candidate Evidence (ACE) module, which converts temporally localized actions into query-conditioned candidate answers and supporting evidence windows through lightweight LLM reasoning. We further introduce OpenTSUBench (OTB), an open-ended benchmark designed to evaluate temporally grounded reasoning in real-world Activities of Daily Living (ADL) scenarios. Experiments show that TimeProVe outperforms the strongest baseline on OTB by 7.3%, while reducing VLM calls by 75% and inference cost by 93%. Furthermore, without explicit temporal grounding training, TimeProVe achieves competitive performance on Charades-STA, and reaches state-of-the-art results when enhanced with grounding VLMs.

item.title: Sparse Point-Guided Fusion of Supervised and Self-Supervised Learning Model for Seaweed Segmentation
item.author: Tatsuya Suzuki, Kazuya Ijuin, Hideki Tomimori, Megumi Chikano, Katsushi Sakai
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文针对海洋数字孪生中的蓝碳量化需求，提出一种新颖的两阶段海藻分割技术，有效解决水下复杂环境中的海藻精确分类与分割难题，显著提升分类精度并展现广阔应用前景。

背景: 海洋在缓解气候变化中至关重要，蓝碳生态系统是重要自然碳汇。水下环境复杂且海藻物种多样，传统监督学习受限于数据稀缺与领域差异，自监督学习则无法分配类别标签。

目的: 为海洋数字孪生倡议提供精确的海藻分类方法，以支持蓝碳量化，克服水下复杂环境与多样物种带来的分类挑战。

方法: 提出两阶段分割技术。第一阶段采用监督与自监督学习模型传播机制，利用监督学习提供初始类别与近似位置，引导自监督学习进行详细分割。第二阶段引入掩码融合技术，合并实例级掩码以优化结果。该方法通过实例分割定位稀疏点来引导自监督学习，实现自动标签分配并缓解领域差异。

主要发现: 在日本山口县水下图像测试中，完整方法相比基准方法在平均交并比指标上提升百分之零点零六八，显著提高了整体精度，尤其对小规模海藻的识别效果更佳。

结论: 该整合方法在提升蓝碳量化精度与海洋生态系统监测方面展现出强大潜力。

翻译: 海洋在可持续发展中扮演关键角色，尤其在缓解气候变化方面。在海洋生态系统中，蓝碳生态系统被公认为重要的自然碳汇。在此背景下，本文针对海洋数字孪生倡议中的蓝碳量化需求，探讨精确的海藻分类问题。传统方法包括受限于数据稀缺和领域差异的监督学习，以及无法分配类别标签的自监督学习，均难以应对水下复杂环境与多样的海藻物种。为克服这一难题，我们提出一种新颖的两阶段海藻分割技术。该技术首先利用监督与自监督学习模型传播机制，借助监督学习获取初始类别信息与近似位置，进而引导自监督学习进行详细且准确的分割。随后，掩码融合技术通过合并实例级掩码进一步优化分割结果。该整合方法实现了自动类别标签分配，并有效缓解了领域差异效应。具体而言，实例分割用于估算稀疏点位置，进而引导自监督学习进行详细的区域分割。在日本山口县水下图像上的评估表明，我们提出的完整方法相比现有方法在平均交并比指标上提升了百分之零点零六八，展现出显著的精度提升，尤其针对小规模海藻。该方法在改善蓝碳量化与海洋生态系统监测方面展现出巨大潜力。

Abstract

The ocean plays a critical role in sustainable development, particularly in climate change mitigation. Among marine ecosystems, blue carbon ecosystems are recognized as important natural carbon sinks. In this context, this paper addresses precise seaweed classification for blue carbon quantification in Ocean Digital Twin initiatives. Conventional methods, including supervised learning (limited by data scarcity and domain gaps) and self-supervised learning (unable to assign class labels), struggle with underwater complexities and diverse seaweed species. To overcome this, we propose a novel two-stage seaweed segmentation technique. This technique first utilizes Supervised and Self-supervised Learning Model Propagation (SSL.Prop.), which leverages supervised learning for initial class information and approximate locations, guiding self-supervised learning for detailed, accurate segmentation. Subsequently, MaskFusion (MF) refines these results by merging instance-level masks for highly accurate segmentation. This integrated approach allows automatic class label assignment and mitigates domain gap effects. Specifically, instance segmentation estimates sparse point locations which then guide self-supervised learning for detailed region segmentation. Evaluated with underwater images from Yamaguchi Prefecture, our full proposed method (SSL.Prop.+MF) achieved a 0.068 mIoU improvement over USIS-SAM, demonstrating significant accuracy gains, particularly for small seaweed. This approach demonstrates strong potential for improving blue carbon quantification and marine ecosystem monitoring.

Abstract

Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise for supporting decision-making in cybersecurity, but their reliability in high-stakes, time-evolving environments remains limited due to hallucinations, poor temporal reasoning, and shallow grounding in system context. We introduce DEFENGRAPH, an LLM-driven assistant designed to support human defenders during cybersecurity incidents. DEFENGRAPH improves contextual reasoning by integrating a dual-layer Static-Dynamic Knowledge Graph (KG) with graph-based path retrieval, LLM-driven contextual filtering, and reasoning-based re-ranking. The framework grounds LLM outputs in both long-term domain knowledge and evolving event context, enabling faithful and temporally aware decision support. We evaluate DEFENGRAPH in a cyber defense setting using knowledge graphs constructed from heterogeneous security artifacts, including SIEM alerts, system topology, attacker behaviors, and prior defensive actions. The evaluation uses data collected during live Red vs. Blue team cyber range exercises simulating attacks on critical infrastructure, which generate realistic and noisy datasets reflecting real-world defender workflows and system dynamics. Evaluations across four prevalent LLMs show that DEFENGRAPH sets a new state-of-the-art: on GPT-4o it boosts reasoning-recall from 61.45\% to 73.49\% and ticket-action recall from 52.17% to 72.46% (precision 24.49\% to 29.24\%), with similar gains on LLaMA-3 (46.99\% to 61.45\%), DeepSeek-R1 (45.78\% to 56.63\%) and QWen-3 (51.81\% to 59.04\%), while surfacing up to 50 correct defense actions versus 36 for the next best baseline and holding fault rates steady.

item.title: An Efficient and Effective Architecture for Large-Scale Traffic Prediction via Geometry-Adaptive Square Partitioning
item.author: Yongfeng Su, Hongwen Li, Zijian Zhang, Ziquan Fang, Lu Chen, Christian S. Jensen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ...

背景: ...

目的: ...

方法: ...

主要发现: ...

结论: ...

翻译: ...

Abstract

Traffic prediction is a core task in intelligent transportation systems and urban-scale decision making. Despite the effectiveness of mainstream neural-network based methods, their deployment in real-world settings with thousands of traffic sensors is jeopardized severely by their poor computational scalability. To address this, the community has attempted to incorporate spatial database partitioning techniques (e.g., Grid, Quadtree, and K-D Tree) to improve model scalability. However, these approaches rely on handcrafted geometric heuristics and often produce irregular or imbalanced data partitions, leading to boundary fragmentation, excessive padding overheads, and degraded model accuracy. In this paper, we propose SqLinear, an efficient and effective architecture for large-scale traffic prediction. First, we design Square Partition, a geometry-adaptive algorithm that partitions massive traffic sensors into balanced, non-overlapping, and near-square spatial regions. Unlike existing heuristic-based designs, Square Partition is theoretically grounded and provides provable guarantees on aspect ratio, balance, and partition utilization, establishing a high-quality foundation for downstream spatiotemporal modeling. Next, we propose a Hierarchical Linear Interaction (HLI) module that abandons the costly attention mechanisms commonly used in Transformer-based spatio-temporal models. HLI efficiently captures both local intra-region dynamics and global inter-region dependencies through a lightweight linear interaction scheme, enabling effective spatiotemporal modeling with linear computational complexity. Extensive experiments on four large-scale traffic datasets and 10 baselines show that SqLinear reduces MAE by 2.30% on average under standard setting and by 5.81% under extreme scalability settings, while reducing training runtime by 13.27%--30.84% in spatial- and horizon-scaling scenarios.

主要发现: ...

结论: ...

翻译: ...

Abstract

Object-centric image generation is important in settings with few labeled examples, including pedestrian analysis in smart-city scenes, traffic-sign inspection, and domain-specific object detection. Synthetic images are most useful for training and evaluation when datasets preserve object structure, bounding boxes, visual diversity, and realistic context. Existing image datasets usually target classification, detection, or scene understanding rather than controlled object-centric generation and augmentation with limited class-specific data. We present a shareable collection of three object-centric dataset resources: Cityscapes-Pedestrian, TrafficSigns, and COCO PottedPlant. The collection standardizes 256-by-256 object-centric crops and bounding-box annotations across three regimes: dense pedestrian scenes with privacy blur and occlusion, cleaner high-contrast traffic signs, and context-diverse potted-plant scenes. The release contains 3,009 TrafficSigns samples, 2,156 Cityscapes-Pedestrian manifest records, and 7,679 COCO PottedPlant manifest records. The larger COCO-derived manifest preserves contextual and multi-instance diversity, while equal-size subsets can be drawn with a fixed random seed for controlled comparisons. The release provides direct TrafficSigns data where redistribution is permitted, together with scripts, manifests, box-level annotation tables, checksums, and reconstruction documentation for the Cityscapes- and COCO-derived subsets. It is available through the Latzi/object-centric-low-data-datasets GitHub repository and Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20573001. The collection supports label and split inspection, subset creation, reconstruction from upstream data, and evaluation of object-centric image generation or synthetic-data augmentation methods on shared records.

item.title: CoughPhase-CLR: Designing an acoustics-informed foundation model for coughing sound classification
item.author: Marius Moldovan, Anton Batliner, Thomas M. Berghaus, Björn W. Schuller, Andreas Triantafyllopoulos
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出CoughPhase-CLR自监督学习框架，通过利用咳嗽的生理声学阶段构建正样本对，在多项健康状态检测任务中展现出优于传统随机裁剪技术的特征表示能力。

背景: 现有的通用对比学习框架多采用随机裁剪技术，未能充分利用咳嗽音频中蕴含的特定生理声学阶段信息。

目的: 设计一种自监督学习框架，以咳嗽的生理阶段为基础，实现更鲁棒的音频特征表示学习。

方法: 在约四十小时公开咳嗽音频数据集上进行预训练，构建基于特定声学阶段的正样本对，并在包括新冠检测、慢阻肺状态分类及吸烟者状态预测在内的五项下游任务中进行评估。

主要发现: 咳嗽特异性预训练在训练咳嗽录音时始终优于标准随机裁剪技术；慢阻肺状态分类任务难度较高，基于通用音频或呼吸音预训练的最佳模型准确率达到百分之五十七，未能超越基于语音分析的最先进方法（百分之八十四）。

结论: 针对咳嗽音频特性的预训练策略能有效提升模型性能，但在复杂呼吸系统疾病分类任务上仍面临挑战，需进一步探索更优的评估与建模方法。

翻译: 在本研究中，我们引入了CoughPhase-CLR，这是一种旨在利用咳嗽生理阶段进行鲁棒表示学习的自监督学习框架。与通用对比框架不同，CoughPhase-CLR基于这些特定的声学阶段构建正样本对。我们在约四十小时的公开咳嗽音频上预训练了模型，并在五项下游任务中对其进行了评估，包括新冠检测、慢性阻塞性肺病状态分类和吸烟者状态预测。我们的结果表明，在训练咳嗽录音时，针对咳嗽的预训练始终优于标准的随机裁剪技术。此外，我们在慢阻肺状态分类上对多种最先进模型进行了基准测试，凸显了该任务的难度。表现最佳的模型分别在通用音频或呼吸音上预训练，达到了百分之五十七的未加权平均召回率，未能超越使用语音分析实现的最先进百分之八十四的未加权平均召回率性能。

Abstract

In this work, we introduce CoughPhase-CLR, a self-supervised learning framework designed to leverage the physiological phases of a cough for robust representation learning. Unlike generic contrastive frameworks, CoughPhase-CLR constructs positive pairs based on these specific acoustic phases. We pre-trained our model on approximately 40 hours of public cough audio and evaluated it across five downstream tasks, including COVID-19 detection, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) state classification, and smoker status prediction. Our results demonstrate that cough-specific pre-training consistently outperforms standard random-cropping techniques when training on cough recordings. Additionally, we benchmarked a diverse set of state-of-the-art models on COPD state classification, highlighting the difficulty of this task. The best-performing models, pretrained on either general audio or respiratory sounds, achieved a UAR of 57\%, failing to outperform the state-of-the-art performance of 84\% UAR achieved using speech analysis.

item.title: A Skin-Tone-Aware Dual-Representation Remote Photoplethysmography Framework for Contactless Respiratory Rate Estimation
item.author: Trishna Saikia, Anup Kumar Gupta, Puneet Gupta, Pasi Liljeberg
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于面部视频的无接触呼吸率估计框架，通过结合肤色感知的欧拉域动态信号投影与去噪的拉格朗日域运动信号，并引入对比损失函数协同学习，显著提升了估计精度，同时发布了包含印度人口特征的呼吸率数据集。

背景: 呼吸率是心肺健康的重要指标，传统测量方法具有侵入性。远程光电容积脉搏波技术提供了非接触替代方案，但其在呼吸率估计方面的潜力尚未充分探索。现有方法多沿用针对心率估计的固定或经验性投影，仅能部分捕捉呼吸动态，且主要聚焦于欧拉域表示。

目的: 解决现有远程呼吸率估计方法中投影方式单一、对非呼吸运动敏感以及缺乏多样化数据集等问题，实现更准确的面部视频无接触呼吸率估计。

方法: 提出肤色感知的动态红绿蓝信号投影以捕捉呼吸信息；引入去噪网络降低拉格朗日表示对非呼吸运动的敏感性；设计相位无关的对比损失函数使欧拉域与拉格朗日域协同学习呼吸率信息；构建并发布了包含印度人口特征的呼吸率面部视频数据集。

主要发现: 在自建数据集与公开数据集上的实验表明，该方法 consistently 优于对比方法，在多种设置下平均绝对误差最高降低百分之四十二点一。

结论: 联合使用肤色感知的欧拉域表示与去噪的拉格朗日域表示能有效实现无接触呼吸率估计。发布的数据集为未来远程呼吸监测研究提供了多样化基准。代码与数据集将在论文接收后公开。

翻译: 呼吸率是心肺健康的重要指标，然而传统的呼吸率估计方法通常因其接触式特性而具有侵入性。远程光电容积脉搏波技术提供了一种有前景的非接触替代方案，并已被广泛用于心率估计；然而，其在呼吸率估计方面的潜力仍未得到充分探索。现有方法通常采用最初为心率估计而设计的绿色和基于色度学的投影，这些方法仅能部分捕捉呼吸动态。大多数先前的工作专注于欧拉域表示，并使用固定或经验选择的红绿蓝投影。为解决这些不足，我们提出了一种肤色感知的动态红绿蓝信号投影以捕捉呼吸信息。为减轻拉格朗日表示对非呼吸运动的敏感性，我们引入了一种用于运动型远程光电容积脉搏波信号的去噪网络。我们进一步设计了一种相位无关的对比损失函数，使欧拉域和拉格朗日表示能够协同学习呼吸率信息。我们还引入了呼吸率面部视频数据集，该数据集包含印度人口特征。我们在该数据集和公开的公开数据集上评估了该方法，它在各种设置下均一致优于对比方法，并使平均绝对误差最高降低了百分之四十二点一。所提出的框架证明了联合利用肤色感知的欧拉域表示和去噪的拉格朗日域表示在从面部视频中进行无接触呼吸率估计方面的有效性。此外，该数据集为未来的远程呼吸监测研究贡献了一个多样化的基准资源。代码和数据集将在论文接收后公开。

Abstract

Respiratory rate is a vital indicator of pulmonary and cardiovascular health, yet conventional methods for estimating respiratory rate are often intrusive due to their contact-based nature. Remote photoplethysmography offers a promising non-contact alternative and has been widely used for heart rate estimation; however, its potential for respiratory rate estimation remains underexplored. Existing methods typically adapt green and chrominance-based projections originally designed for heart rate estimation, which only partially capture respiratory dynamics. Most prior work focuses on the Eulerian representation with fixed or empirically selected RGB projections. To address these gaps, we propose a skin-tone-aware dynamic RGB signal projection that captures respiratory information. To mitigate the sensitivity of the Lagrangian representation to non-respiratory motion, we introduce a denoising network for motion-based remote photoplethysmography signals. We further design a phase-independent contrastive loss that enables Eulerian and Lagrangian representations to collaboratively learn respiratory rate information. We also introduce RR-rPPG, a respiratory-rate facial video dataset with Indian demographic representation. We evaluate the method on RR-rPPG and the publicly available COHFACE dataset, where it consistently outperforms comparison methods and achieves up to a 42.1% reduction in mean absolute error across the evaluated settings. The proposed framework demonstrates the effectiveness of jointly leveraging skin-tone-aware Eulerian and denoised Lagrangian representations for contactless respiratory rate estimation from facial videos. In addition, RR-rPPG contributes a diverse benchmark resource for future research in remote respiratory monitoring. The code and dataset will be made publicly available upon paper acceptance.

item.title: Toward Open Weight Models Without Risks: Separating Public and Private Capabilities in LLMs
item.author: Feghali, Charbel El, Patel, Arkil, Meade, Nicholas, Gella, Spandana, Dankers, Verna, Reddy, Siva
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出分层语言模型，通过单一权重集支持不同能力层级，实现开放权重发布与敏感能力访问控制的平衡。

背景: 开放权重大语言模型虽促进科研与广泛部署，但难以控制敏感能力访问。现有方法要么在发布前压制危险能力，易受越狱攻击且牺牲整体能力；要么通过封闭服务中介访问，与开放权重发布不兼容。

目的: 解决开放权重发布与选择性能力控制之间的矛盾，实现安全且灵活的能力访问管理。

方法: 提出分层语言模型架构，使用单一权重集支持多能力层级。默认公开配置表现为常规模型；通过紧凑密钥对少量参数子集进行置换，生成替代计算图以暴露额外能力。训练协议包括联合从头预训练两种配置，随后在私有数据上微调密钥配置，并加入正则化以保持公开模型行为。

主要发现: 预训练一亿八千万参数和六亿五千万参数模型验证，密钥配置可习得新语言、获得指令遵循能力并记忆私有事实知识，而公开配置无此能力。该方法可扩展至多层级结构，且因授权基于模型权重结构而非输入空间，能有效抵抗基于微调的提取攻击和部分密钥泄露风险。

结论: 分层语言模型为调和开放权重发布与选择性能力控制提供了有效路径。

翻译: 开放权重大语言模型推动了科学进步与广泛部署。然而，它们使得控制对敏感能力的访问变得困难。当前实践要么在发布前压制危险能力，要么通过封闭服务中介访问，后者使用专用模型变体、输入输出监控器和应用程序接口权限。前者易受越狱攻击，且为缓解少数人带来的风险而牺牲了所有用户的能力；后者则与开放权重发布根本不相容。在本文中，我们提出分层语言模型，其中一组发布的权重支持多个能力层级。在其默认公开配置下，分层语言模型表现为传统大语言模型。一个紧凑的密钥指定了少量参数子集上的置换，从而在相同权重上诱导替代计算图，以暴露额外能力。我们开发了一种训练协议，从头联合预训练两种配置，随后在私有数据上对密钥配置进行微调，并加入正则化以保持公开模型的行为。我们预训练了一亿八千万参数和六亿五千万参数的分层语言模型，并证明密钥配置能够习得一门新语言、获得指令遵循能力并记忆私有事实知识，而公开配置则不具备这些能力。此外，我们表明该方法自然扩展至多个分层层级。由于授权作用于模型的权重结构而非输入空间，该机制能够抵抗基于微调的提取和部分密钥泄露。总体而言，分层语言模型在调和开放权重发布与选择性能力控制方面迈出了重要一步。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决开放权重大语言模型在公开共享后难以控制敏感或私有能力访问权限的问题。它提出通过密钥重新排列模型参数来划分能力层级，使同一套公开参数在默认状态下仅具备通用功能，而授权用户解锁后可获得受限的高级能力。该问题在研究与现实中至关重要，因为它能在促进模型开源共享与科研进步的同时，有效保护私有数据与敏感知识，避免传统方法中牺牲整体性能或依赖封闭服务的成本与局限。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对开源大语言模型难以控制敏感能力访问的痛点，认为将授权密钥放在提示词中容易被绕过，因此创新性地提出将权限编码在模型参数结构中。他们设计了一种通过密钥对少量参数进行重排来生成不同计算图的方法，并采用两阶段训练协议确保公开配置与密钥配置的能力分离。该方法借鉴了早期基于提示词密码的锁定技术、模块化组件方案以及利用权重置换隐藏网络的TrojanNet等现有工作，但通过参数级重排和联合训练协议克服了它们在安全性、开源兼容性和基础设施复杂度上的局限。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是利用同一组模型权重，通过一个紧凑密钥对少量参数进行位置置换，在不改变参数值的前提下生成两套不同的计算路径。默认状态下模型仅具备公开能力，授权用户输入密钥后，模型会切换至私有配置以解锁受限知识，且该机制将权限控制内嵌于参数结构而非输入提示中，提升了安全性。整体流程分为两阶段：首先基于公开数据对两套配置进行非对称联合预训练，使公开配置学会依赖不受密钥影响的参数；随后仅对密钥可置换的参数在私有数据上进行微调，并加入行为一致性约束以防止公开模型能力泄露，最终实现单模型多权限层级的安全部署。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种分层语言模型框架，通过一个紧凑的密钥对模型少量参数进行重排，使同一组公开权重在默认状态下仅具备公共能力，而授权用户通过密钥可解锁受限的私有能力。相比以往将权限控制放在提示词中的方法，该机制将授权编码于模型参数结构中，有效抵御了基于提示词或微调的越权提取攻击。同时，与依赖额外适配器或模块化组件的方案不同，该方法无需分发额外参数或外部记忆，实现了真正的完全开放权重发布，同时通过特殊的训练协议保证了公共模型的稳定性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种分层语言模型框架，通过秘密密钥重排模型少量参数，使单一开源权重模型能够安全分离公开能力与私有能力，并配套设计了联合预训练与正则化微调的训练协议。

Abstract

Open-weight Large Language Models (LLMs) enable scientific progress and broad deployment. However, they make it difficult to control access to sensitive capabilities. Current practice either suppresses dangerous capabilities before release or mediates access through closed services that use specialized model variants, input/output monitors, and API permissions. The former is susceptible to jailbreaks while sacrificing capability for all users to mitigate the risks posed by a few, and the latter is fundamentally incompatible with open-weight release. In this paper, we propose Tiered Language Models (TLMs), where a single set of released weights supports multiple capability levels. In its default public configuration, a TLM behaves as a conventional LLM. A compact secret key specifies a permutation over a small parameter subset, inducing an alternative computation graph over the same weights that exposes additional capabilities. We develop a training protocol that jointly pretrains both configurations from scratch, then fine-tunes the keyed configuration on private data with regularization to preserve the public model's behavior. We pretrain 180M- and 650M-parameter TLMs and demonstrate that the keyed configuration can acquire a new language, gain instruction-following ability, and memorize private factual knowledge, whereas the public configuration exhibits none of these capabilities. Moreover, we show that our approach extends naturally to multiple hierarchical tiers. Because authorization operates on the model's weight structure rather than in the input space, the mechanism resists fine-tuning-based extraction and partial key compromise. In general, TLMs take a step toward reconciling open-weight release with selective capability control.

item.title: Improving Text-to-Music Generation with Human Preference Rewards
item.author: Kim, Yonghyun, Lee, Junwon, Xia, Haiwen, Ma, Yinghao, Donahue, Chris
