In this work, we improve MRI self-supervised MRI reconstruction with two modifications. Methods: We propose a multi-contrast self-supervised learning framework that jointly trains on multiple under-sampled contrasts without requiring fully sampled k-space data as a reference. Moreover, we learn an optimal self-supervised data partitioning for each contrast in an end-to-end manner, further enhancing reconstruction quality. Specifically, we learn an optimal partitioning probability distribution, which is sampled to generate a mask for partitioning. Results: Experiments on two publicly available multi-contrast MRI datasets demonstrate the improved reconstruction quality of our proposed self-supervised multi-contrast learned partitioning method compared to the current single-contrast self-supervised learning methods. We also demonstrate that learning the partitioning of k-space data further enhances the fidelity of reconstructions. Conclusion: Multi-contrast reconstruction combined with learned partitioning improves reconstruction fidelity over single-contrast self-supervised MRI reconstructions. Significance: Our method can facilitate higher image fidelity and/or accelerated MRI protocol times compared to previous self-supervised methods, and without requiring fully sampled k-space for training.

Abstract

Objective: Deep Learning has shown promise in accelerating MRI by reconstructing high-quality images from under-sampled data. While recent work has leveraged multi-contrast information to improve reconstruction performance, these methods rely on supervised learning, which requires fully sampled k-space for training. One method, self-supervised learning via data undersampling (SSDU), enables direct training on under-sampled k-space by partitioning it into two sets, with a network mapping between the two. In this work, we improve MRI self-supervised MRI reconstruction with two modifications. Methods: We propose a multi-contrast self-supervised learning framework that jointly trains on multiple under-sampled contrasts without requiring fully sampled k-space data as a reference. Moreover, we learn an optimal self-supervised data partitioning for each contrast in an end-to-end manner, further enhancing reconstruction quality. Specifically, we learn an optimal partitioning probability distribution, which is sampled to generate a mask for partitioning. Results: Experiments on two publicly available multi-contrast MRI datasets demonstrate the improved reconstruction quality of our proposed self-supervised multi-contrast learned partitioning method compared to the current single-contrast self-supervised learning methods. We also demonstrate that learning the partitioning of k-space data further enhances the fidelity of reconstructions. Conclusion: Multi-contrast reconstruction combined with learned partitioning improves reconstruction fidelity over single-contrast self-supervised MRI reconstructions. Significance: Our method can facilitate higher image fidelity and/or accelerated MRI protocol times compared to previous self-supervised methods, and without requiring fully sampled k-space for training.

item.title: JWST-TST High Contrast: First Direct Spectroscopy of GJ 504 b reveals Clouds and Possible Metal Enrichment
item.author: Aneesh Baburaj, Jean-Baptiste Ruffio, Marshall Perrin, Jerry W. Xuan, William O. Balmer, Yayaati Chachan, Quinn M. Konopacky, Travis S. Barman, Mathilde Mâlin, Kielan K. W. Hoch, Emily Rickman, Kimberly Ward-Duong, Laurent Pueyo, Julien H. Girard, Isabel Rebollido, Alexis Bidot, Christine Chen, Kadin Worthen, Cicero Lu, Jens Kammerer, Roeland P. van der Marel, Nikole K. Lewis, Jeff Valenti, Sara Seager, Chris Stark, Rémi Soummer, Jay Anderson, Charles-Philippe Lajoie, Mark Clampin, C. Matt Mountain
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 利用詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜的近红外光谱仪对直接成像的行星质量伴星GJ 504 b进行了中等分辨率光谱观测。通过先进的后处理技术和正向建模框架，成功探测到该伴星并提取了其光谱。光谱分析显示存在多种分子物种，大气模型拟合得出有效温度、表面重力、金属丰度等参数。推导出的质量与演化模型一致，暗示了特定的年龄范围。与主星丰度对比显示该伴星可能存在金属增丰，支持类行星形成机制。

背景: 利用直接光谱学表征最冷的直接成像伴星在詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜之前仅通过光度观测成为可能，而GJ 504 b作为前韦伯时代最冷的成像行星质量伴星，因太暗而无法进行地基光谱观测。

目的: 对直接成像的行星质量伴星GJ 504 b进行中等分辨率光谱观测，以表征其物理和化学特性。

方法: 使用詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜的近红外光谱仪进行观测，采用先进的后处理技术和正向建模框架，结合角差分成像进行点扩散函数减法，提取光谱并使用petitRADTRANS进行大气建模。

主要发现: 成功以高信噪比探测到GJ 504 b，并首次在近红外光谱点云中通过角差分成像实现点扩散函数减法。提取的光谱显示存在水、一氧化碳、甲烷、二氧化碳、氨、硫化氢等多种分子物种。大气模型拟合得到有效温度约为五百六十四开尔文，表面重力、金属丰度、碳氧比等参数。推导出的质量约为二十五点木星质量，与演化模型一致。与主星对比显示该伴星存在硫丰度、超恒星碳丰度及可能的氧丰度。

结论: GJ 504 b的质量与年龄范围与演化模型一致。观测到的金属增丰现象初步支持类行星形成机制，但并未完全排除其具有恒星丰度的可能性。

翻译: Characterizing the coldest directly imaged companions through direct spectroscopy has only recently become possible with the James Webb Space Telescope. We present moderate-resolution spectroscopic observations of the directly imaged planetary-mass companion GJ 504 b using the JWST/NIRSpec. Leveraging advanced post-processing techniques with a forward modeling framework, we detect the companion at high signal-to-noise. We also present the first successful PSF subtraction with angular differential imaging in the NIRSpec point cloud. The extracted spectra show strong signatures of several molecular species. Atmospheric modeling yields an effective temperature, surface gravity, metallicity, C/O ratio, and strong evidence of disequilibrium chemistry and salt clouds. The retrieved parameters indicate a mass in agreement with evolutionary models, implying a specific age range. Comparing abundances to its primary shows metal enrichment, tentatively supporting planet-like formation.

Abstract

Characterizing the coldest directly imaged companions through direct spectroscopy has only recently become possible with the James Webb Space Telescope. We present moderate-resolution (R $\sim$ 2,700) spectroscopic observations of the directly imaged planetary-mass companion (PMC), GJ 504 b, using the $JWST$/NIRSpec. As the coldest imaged PMC of the pre-JWST era GJ 504 b is too faint for ground-based spectroscopy, with only photometric observations possible. Leveraging advanced post-processing techniques with a forward modeling framework, we detect the companion at high signal-to-noise (S/N$>$300). We also present the first successful PSF subtraction with angular differential imaging (ADI) in the NIRSpec point cloud, detecting GJ 504 b at S/N$>10$ and reaching contrast limits $<10^{-4}$. The extracted 2.9--5.3 $μm$ spectra show strong signatures of several molecular species, including H$_2$O, $^{12}$C$^{16}$O, CH$_4$, CO$_2$, NH$_3$, H$_2$S, $^{13}$C$^{16}$O, and $^{12}$C$^{18}$O. Atmospheric modeling of the spectra using \texttt{petitRADTRANS}, yields an effective temperature = 564$\pm$4 K, surface gravity $\log{g}$ = 4.87$^{+0.13}_{-0.12}$, metallicity [M/H] = 0.67$^{+0.13}_{-0.12}$, C/O ratio = 0.64$^{+0.02}_{-0.02}$, interstellar $^{12}$C/$^{13}$C and $^{16}$O/$^{18}$O isotopologue ratios, and strong evidence of disequilibrium chemistry and salt clouds. The retrieved parameters indicate a mass 25.2$^{+8.4}_{-6.0}$ $M_\mathrm{Jup}$, which is in agreement with the mass range (19--27 $M_\mathrm{Jup}$) obtained from ATMO evolutionary models, implying an age of 2.5--4.0 Gyr. Lastly, we compare the abundances of GJ 504 b to its primary, obtaining a stellar abundance of sulfur (S), super-stellar carbon (C), and possibly, oxygen (O). The observed metal enrichment tentatively supports planet-like formation, but does not entirely exclude stellar abundances for GJ 504 b.

item.title: A Unified Framework for Efficient Remote Sensing Visual Question Answering: Adapting Dual, Hybrid, and Encoder-Decoder Architectures
item.author: Timothy Agboada, Shikha Chandel, Yadav Raj Ghimire, Leila Hashemi-Beni
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本研究针对遥感领域视觉问答任务中高分辨率图像带来的挑战，比较了参数高效微调策略在不同视觉语言模型架构上的应用效果，发现混合架构在保持资源效率的同时实现了更优的多模态推理与检索能力。

背景: 遥感领域的视觉问答任务因航拍图像具有高分辨率、多尺度目标分布及语义复杂性而面临独特挑战。尽管通用领域的基础模型取得了显著成功，但直接应用于遥感视觉问答任务会受到巨大领域差异的阻碍，且全参数微调的计算成本过高。

目的: 比较参数高效微调策略在三种不同视觉语言模型架构上的应用效果，旨在为灾害评估和城市监控建立资源高效的视觉问答新基准。

方法: 引入统一的架构手术流程，将轻量级瓶颈适配器注入冻结主干网络的注意力层和多层感知机层。该策略应用于双编码器CLIP、编码器解码器BLIP和混合FLAVA三种视觉语言模型架构，仅需训练不到百分之五的参数即可实现快速适应。

主要发现: 在高分辨率遥感视觉问答数据集上的实验表明，所有适配模型均能收敛。其中，混合FLAVA架构相比单模态对应模型，在多模态推理和检索能力方面提供了更优越的平衡。

结论: 该研究确立了资源高效的遥感视觉问答新基准，证明了参数高效微调策略在应对领域差异和降低计算成本方面的有效性。

翻译: Visual Question Answering (VQA) in the Remote Sensing (RS) domain presents unique challenges due to the high resolution, multi scale object distribution, and semantic complexity of aerial imagery. While general domain Foundation Models have achieved remarkable success, their direct application to RSVQA is hindered by massive domain shifts and the computationally prohibitive nature of full fine tuning. This study presents a comparative analysis of RS Adapter, a Parameter Efficient Fine Tuning (PEFT) strategy, applied across three distinct Vision Language Model (VLM) architectures: the Dual Encoder CLIP, the Encoder Decoder BLIP, and the Hybrid FLAVA. We introduce a unified architectural surgery pipeline that injects lightweight bottleneck adapters into the attention and MLP layers of frozen backbones, enabling rapid adaptation with less than 5 percent of trainable parameters. Experimental results on the high resolution RSVQA x dataset demonstrate that while all adapted models achieve convergence, the Hybrid FLAVA architecture offers a superior balance of multimodal reasoning and retrieval capabilities compared to its unimodal counterparts. Our findings establish a new baseline for resource efficient VQA in disaster assessment and urban monitoring.

Abstract

Visual Question Answering (VQA) in the Remote Sensing (RS) domain presents unique challenges due to the high resolution, multi scale object distribution, and semantic complexity of aerial imagery. While general domain Foundation Models have achieved remarkable success, their direct application to RSVQA is hindered by massive domain shifts and the computationally prohibitive nature of full fine tuning. This study presents a comparative analysis of RS Adapter, a Parameter Efficient Fine Tuning (PEFT) strategy, applied across three distinct Vision Language Model (VLM) architectures: the Dual Encoder CLIP, the Encoder Decoder BLIP, and the Hybrid FLAVA. We introduce a unified architectural surgery pipeline that injects lightweight bottleneck adapters into the attention and MLP layers of frozen backbones, enabling rapid adaptation with less than 5 percent of trainable parameters. Experimental results on the high resolution RSVQA x dataset demonstrate that while all adapted models achieve convergence, the Hybrid FLAVA architecture offers a superior balance of multimodal reasoning and retrieval capabilities compared to its unimodal counterparts. Our findings establish a new baseline for resource efficient VQA in disaster assessment and urban monitoring.

item.title: Modeling Branches for Active Manipulation using Iterative Parameter Estimation
item.author: Madhav Rijal, Rashik Shrestha, Trevor Smith, Yu Gu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种通过迭代估计材料参数来建模多样化植物分支的方法，以支持精细的分支操作。

背景: 在农业机器人技术中，需要对植物进行重新定位、稳定以及在茂密枝叶中清除视觉遮挡，因此分支操作是必要的。

目的: 支持对植物分支进行精细的操作。

方法: 从点云数据构建四面体分支模型，并使用有限元方法模拟其行为。利用实际观察到的变形数据迭代估计分支参数，然后通过变形感知运动规划器计算最优路径，以在另一台机器人的视野内移动和稳定分支。

主要发现: 在三十次针对不同几何形状和材料特性的分支试验中，该方法平均将变形能量降低了百分之三十五点六九，同时将路径长度增加了百分之八点一零。

结论: 该方法能够有效降低分支操作过程中的变形能量，为农业机器人中的植物操作提供了支持。

翻译: This study presents a method for modeling diverse plant branches by iteratively estimating material parameters to support delicate branch manipulation. Branch manipulation is necessary in agricultural robotics for plant repositioning, stabilizing, and clearing visual obstructions in dense foliage. The proposed method builds a tetrahedral branch model from point-cloud data and simulates its behavior using the finite element method. Using real observed deformation data, it iteratively estimates branch parameters and then computes an optimal path with a deformation-aware motion planner to move and stabilize branches within another robot's field of view. Across 30 trials on branches with varying geometries and material properties, the proposed method reduced the deformation energy by 35.69% while increasing the path length by 8.10% on average.

Abstract

This study presents a method for modeling diverse plant branches by iteratively estimating material parameters to support delicate branch manipulation. Branch manipulation is necessary in agricultural robotics for plant repositioning, stabilizing, and clearing visual obstructions in dense foliage. The proposed method builds a tetrahedral branch model from point-cloud data and simulates its behavior using the finite element method. Using real observed deformation data, it iteratively estimates branch parameters and then computes an optimal path with a deformation-aware motion planner to move and stabilize branches within another robot's field of view. Across 30 trials on branches with varying geometries and material properties, the proposed method reduced the deformation energy by 35.69% while increasing the path length by 8.10% on average.

item.title: Native Active Perception as Reasoning for Omni-Modal Understanding
item.author: Zhenghao Xing, Ruiyang Xu, Yuxuan Wang, Jinzheng He, Ziyang Ma, Qize Yang, Yunfei Chu, Jin Xu, Junyang Lin, Chi-Wing Fu, Pheng-Ann Heng
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为OmniAgent的原生全模态智能体，将视频理解建模为基于部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程的迭代观察-思考-行动循环。该智能体通过按需执行动作选择性提取音视频线索并存储于持久文本记忆中，有效解耦了推理复杂度与视频时长的关系。通过代理监督微调与代理强化学习（TAURA）技术，实现了主动感知能力。在十个基准测试中达到开源模型的最先进性能，并在LVBench上以较小参数规模超越了参数量大十倍的模型。

背景: 被动式长视频理解模型通常依赖“观看所有”范式，无论查询难度如何均均匀处理帧，导致计算成本随视频时长增长。虽然出现了交互式框架，但它们通常依赖全局预扫描，且上下文成本仍随视频长度扩展。

目的: 提出一种原生全模态智能体，将视频理解转化为基于部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程的迭代过程，以按需执行动作选择性提取音视频线索，从而解耦推理复杂度与视频时长，实现主动感知。

方法: 1. 将视频理解建模为基于部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程的迭代观察-思考-行动循环。2. 引入代理监督微调，通过最佳N轨迹合成与双阶段质量控制启动原生主动感知。3. 采用代理强化学习，利用TAURA（回合感知自适应不确定性重缩放优势）技术，通过回合级熵将信用分配引导至关键发现回合。

主要发现: 1. OmniAgent表现出正测试时扩展性，即随着推理回合数增加，性能提升。2. 在十个基准测试（如VideoMME、LVBench）中达到开源模型的最先进性能。3. 在LVBench上，七百亿参数规模的智能体以百分之五十点五的得分超越了参数量大十倍的一千二百亿参数模型Qwen2.5-VL-72B（百分之四十七点三）。

结论: OmniAgent通过主动感知机制有效解决了长视频理解中的计算成本与复杂度问题，实现了性能随推理回合数增加而提升的正测试时扩展性，并在多项基准测试中取得了领先的开源模型性能。

翻译: Passive models for long video understanding typically rely on a watch-it-all paradigm, processing frames uniformly regardless of query difficulty, causing computational cost to grow with video duration. Although interactive frameworks have emerged, they often rely on global pre-scanning, and their context cost still scales with video length. We propose OmniAgent, the first native omni-modal agent that formulates video understanding as a POMDP-based iterative Observation-Thought-Action cycle. OmniAgent executes on-demand actions to selectively distill audio-visual cues into a persistent textual memory, effectively decoupling reasoning complexity from raw video duration. To operationalize this, we introduce (1) Agentic Supervised Fine-Tuning to bootstrap native active perception via best-of-N trajectory synthesis with dual-stage quality control, and (2) Agentic Reinforcement Learning with TAURA (Turn-aware Adaptive Uncertainty Rescaled Advantage), which leverages turn-level entropy to steer credit assignment toward pivotal discovery turns. Crucially, OmniAgent exhibits positive test-time scaling, where performance improves as the number of reasoning turns increases, validating the efficacy of active perception. Empirical results across ten benchmarks (e.g., VideoMME, LVBench) demonstrate that OmniAgent achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source models. Notably, on LVBench, our 7B agent outperforms the 10x larger Qwen2.5-VL-72B (50.5% vs. 47.3%).

Abstract

Passive models for long video understanding typically rely on a "watch-it-all" paradigm, processing frames uniformly regardless of query difficulty, causing computational cost to grow with video duration. Although interactive frameworks have emerged, they often rely on global pre-scanning, and their context cost still scales with video length. We propose OmniAgent, the first native omni-modal agent that formulates video understanding as a POMDP-based iterative Observation-Thought-Action cycle. OmniAgent executes on-demand actions to selectively distill audio-visual cues into a persistent textual memory, effectively decoupling reasoning complexity from raw video duration. To operationalize this, we introduce (1) Agentic Supervised Fine-Tuning to bootstrap native active perception via best-of-N trajectory synthesis with dual-stage quality control, and (2) Agentic Reinforcement Learning with TAURA (Turn-aware Adaptive Uncertainty Rescaled Advantage), which leverages turn-level entropy to steer credit assignment toward pivotal discovery turns. Crucially, OmniAgent exhibits positive test-time scaling, where performance improves as the number of reasoning turns increases, validating the efficacy of active perception. Empirical results across ten benchmarks (e.g., VideoMME, LVBench) demonstrate that OmniAgent achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source models. Notably, on LVBench, our 7B agent outperforms the 10$\times$ larger Qwen2.5-VL-72B (50.5% vs. 47.3%).

item.title: TRIAGE: Dialectical Reasoning for Explainable Risk Prediction on Irregularly Sampled Medical Time Series with LLMs
item.author: Jang, Hyeongwon, Chu, Gyouk, Kim, Changhun, Park, Joonhyung, Yoon, Hangyul, Yang, Eunho
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出TRIAGE框架，通过训练大语言模型生成对抗性临床结果的辩证推理，解决电子健康记录中临床风险预测的极化问题，实现连续风险评分和可解释的临床推理。

背景: 基于电子健康记录构建的临床早期预警系统需要为病人分诊提供校准的风险评分和可验证的解释。大语言模型在此任务中常将分级临床风险坍缩为过度自信的二元预测，导致风险极化，损害校准性和跨病人可比性。

目的: 解决大语言模型在临床风险预测中的风险极化问题，使单一模型能够生成基于明确临床推理的连续风险评分。

方法: 提出TRIAGE框架，训练大语言模型通过引出特定结果的推理来生成对抗性临床结果的辩证推理。

主要发现: 在三个不规则采样医疗时间序列基准上，TRIAGE平均AUPRC提升3.3%，校准误差减少81%。LLM作为裁判的评估显示，其推理质量比基线的事后解释高出20%。

结论: TRIAGE框架有效缓解风险极化，提供校准的连续风险评分和高质量的可解释临床推理。

翻译: 基于电子健康记录构建的临床早期预警系统，其中临床观察被记录为不规则采样的医疗时间序列，必须为病人分诊提供校准的风险评分和临床医生可以验证的可解释理由。大语言模型已被探索用于此任务，但它们将分级的临床风险坍缩为过度自信的二元预测。这种风险极化损害了校准性和跨病人可比性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了TRIAGE，一个训练大语言模型通过引出特定结果的推理来生成对抗性临床结果的辩证推理的框架。这种辩证表述缓解了风险极化，使单一的大语言模型能够产生基于明确临床推理的连续风险评分。在三个不规则采样医疗时间序列基准上的评估显示，与有竞争力的基线相比，TRIAGE的平均AUPRC提高了3.3%，校准误差减少了81%。LLM作为裁判的评估进一步表明，我们的推理在临床推理质量上比基线的事后解释高出20%。源代码可在该URL获取。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决大语言模型在临床风险预测中出现的风险极化问题，即模型在生成推理过程后，风险评分会坍缩为接近绝对确定的极端值，无法提供连续且可跨患者比较的风险等级。该问题在临床研究和现实中至关重要，因为有效的早期预警系统必须同时提供精确校准的风险评分用于患者分级与资源分配，以及医生可验证的自然语言解释。若无法兼顾两者，将直接影响医疗决策的可靠性与临床信任度。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者通过初步实验发现，常规大语言模型在生成推理时容易预先锁定单一结果并产生片面偏差，导致风险评分失去区分度。基于此，他们确立了保留连续风险信号与分别权衡各结果证据的设计原则，进而提出针对每个候选结果生成独立推理链的辩证推理机制，并直接从模型固定位置的隐式概率中提取风险评分。在方法设计上，作者借鉴了处理不规则时间序列的集合编码技术，并针对现有研究仅能提供连续风险评分或自然语言解释之一的局限，将两者统一整合到单一模型框架中。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是克服传统大语言模型在临床预测中因单向推理导致的风险评分极端化问题，通过要求模型对每种可能的临床结局分别生成独立的推理依据，从而得出连续且可校准的风险评分。整体实现流程首先将不规则的医疗记录转化为文本提示，接着让模型分别阐述支持不同结局的证据形成辩证推理链，最后直接输出最终决策词并提取其隐含概率作为风险评分。该方法还包含两个训练阶段，先通过监督微调让模型掌握结构化推理能力，再进行自我优化以提升预测的准确性。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种基于辩证推理的风险预测框架，通过要求模型对每种可能的临床结局分别生成专属推理依据，有效避免了传统方法中推理过程导致风险评分趋向极端两极分化的问题。与以往仅输出离散分类结果或仅依赖模型隐式概率的工作不同，该方法能在单次生成中同时提供连续可比的精确风险评分与符合临床逻辑的自然语言解释。其核心差异在于用多结局的辩证权衡替代了以往单方面的倾向性推理，并结合两阶段训练策略显著提升了风险校准度与解释质量。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出TRIAGE框架，通过引导大语言模型针对每种可能的临床结果分别生成独立的推理依据，有效克服了传统方法中的风险极化问题，使模型能够同时输出连续且校准良好的风险评分与可解释的临床推理过程。

Abstract

Clinical early warning systems built on electronic health records, in which clinical observations are recorded as irregularly sampled medical time series (ISMTS), must deliver both calibrated risk scores for patient triage and interpretable rationales that clinicians can verify. Large Language Models (LLMs) have been explored for this task, yet they collapse graded clinical risk into overconfident binary predictions. This risk polarization undermines both calibration and cross-patient comparability. To address this, we propose TRIAGE, a framework that trains an LLM to generate dialectical reasoning over competing clinical outcomes by eliciting outcome-specific rationales. This dialectical formulation mitigates risk polarization, enabling a single LLM to yield continuous risk scores grounded in explicit clinical reasoning. Evaluated on three ISMTS benchmarks, TRIAGE achieves an average AUPRC improvement of 3.3% and reduces calibration error by 81% compared to the competitive baselines. An LLM-as-a-judge assessment further shows that our rationales surpass post-hoc explanations from the baseline by 20% in clinical reasoning quality. The source code is available at this https URL .

item.title: GMN4AD: Graph Matching Network for Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis with Test-Time Domain Adaptation using Multi-centered Structure Magnetic Resonance Imaging
item.author: Chen Zhao, Huan Huang, Yixin Xie, Jiajing Huang, Weihua Zhou
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种用于阿尔茨海默病诊断的图匹配网络，通过建模异质脑图之间的交互关系并引入测试时域适应策略，显著提升了诊断性能。

背景: 阿尔茨海默病是一种影响众多老年人的进行性神经退行性疾病，早期诊断对于及时干预至关重要。结构磁共振成像在检测相关脑变化方面具有关键作用，但传统基于图的方法常因模态和跨站点异质性而面临挑战。

目的: 旨在解决传统方法在异质性处理上的不足，通过建模异质脑图之间的交互关系来提升阿尔茨海默病诊断的精确性和鲁棒性。

方法: 提出了图匹配网络用于阿尔茨海默病诊断，利用图匹配技术捕捉跨图关系以增强诊断精度，并引入结合对比学习的测试时域适应策略以缓解推理过程中的域偏移。

主要发现: 在三个公开阿尔茨海默病数据集上的广泛实验表明，该方法优于现有最先进方法，展现出优越的性能。

结论: 该方法为阿尔茨海默病诊断提供了一种稳健且可泛化的解决方案。

翻译: Alzheimer's Disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder that affects millions of older adults, with prevalence expected to rise significantly in the coming years. Early diagnosis, particularly during the mild cognitive impairment (MCI) stage, is critical for timely intervention. Structural Magnetic Resonance Imaging (sMRI) has emerged as a key modality for detecting AD-related brain changes, but traditional graph-based approaches often struggle with modality and inter-site heterogeneity, limiting diagnostic performance. In this paper, we propose Graph Matching Network for Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis (GMN4AD), designed to model interactions between heterogeneous brain graphs derived from neuroimaging data. Unlike conventional methods that treat each brain graph independently, GMN4AD leverages graph matching to capture cross-graph relationships, enhancing diagnostic precision. Furthermore, we introduce a test-time domain adaptation strategy that combines contrastive learning to mitigate domain shifts during inference. Extensive experiments on three public AD datasets demonstrate that GMN4AD achieves superior performance compared to state-of-the-art methods, offering a robust and generalizable solution for AD diagnosis.

Abstract

Alzheimer's Disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder that affects millions of older adults, with prevalence expected to rise significantly in the coming years. Early diagnosis, particularly during the mild cognitive impairment (MCI) stage, is critical for timely intervention. Structural Magnetic Resonance Imaging (sMRI) has emerged as a key modality for detecting AD-related brain changes, but traditional graph-based approaches often struggle with modality and inter-site heterogeneity, limiting diagnostic performance. In this paper, we propose Graph Matching Network for Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis (GMN4AD), designed to model interactions between heterogeneous brain graphs derived from neuroimaging data. Unlike conventional methods that treat each brain graph independently, GMN4AD leverages graph matching to capture cross-graph relationships, enhancing diagnostic precision. Furthermore, we introduce a test-time domain adaptation strategy that combines contrastive learning to mitigate domain shifts during inference. Extensive experiments on three public AD datasets demonstrate that GMN4AD achieves superior performance compared to state-of-the-art methods, offering a robust and generalizable solution for AD diagnosis.

item.title: Dr-DCI: Scaling Direct Corpus Interaction via Dynamic Workspace Expansion
item.author: Lu, Yi, Li, Zhuofeng, Nie, Ping, Zhang, Haoxiang, Zhang, Yuyu, Zou, Kai, Chen, Wenhu, Lin, Jimmy, Jiang, Dongfu, Zhang, Yu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为DR-DCI的检索器引导的直接语料库交互框架，旨在解决大型语料库中智能体搜索的可扩展性和效率问题。该框架通过动态将相关文档拉入局部工作区并在其中执行交互操作，结合了检索器的召回能力和直接语料库交互的精确性。实验表明，该方法在不同规模的语料库上均有效且高效，显著提升了准确率并降低了资源消耗。

背景: 基于大型语料库的智能体搜索依赖于检索器中介接口（如BM25或ColBERT）进行可扩展的候选发现。虽然这些接口在排序相关文档方面有效，但它们仅以排序结果或受限的文档视图暴露证据，限制了智能体重排材料和跨文档验证约束的能力。直接语料库交互（DCI）通过暴露可执行shell的语料库操作来解决这一限制，但全语料库终端命令随着语料库增长而变慢和不稳定，导致性能和效率下降。

目的: 解决直接语料库交互（DCI）在全语料库操作时因语料库规模增长而导致的性能下降和效率问题，同时保持智能体对证据的灵活搜索、过滤、比较和验证能力。

方法: 提出DR-DCI框架，将检索视为智能体可调用的操作，用于扩展局部工作区。智能体不再直接在整个语料库上操作，而是动态将相关文档拉入不断演化的工作区，并在其中进行直接语料库交互操作。这种设计结合了检索器级别的召回率和直接语料库交互式的精确性。

主要发现: 在Browsecomp-Plus数据集上，DR-DCI准确率达到71.2%，比原始DCI和消融变体最高提升8.3个百分点，同时减少了工具使用、运行时间和估计成本。通过工作区保留的上下文重置，准确率进一步提升至73.3%。在语料库扩展实验中，DR-DCI在10万到1000万文档范围内保持有效，而原始DCI变得不稳定，BM25表现显著更差。DR-DCI还能扩展到2000万规模的Wiki-18问答设置，在六个基准测试中平均得分为63.0，优于基于检索和训练过的搜索智能体基线。消融分析表明，排序预览和跨文档直接语料库交互对性能至关重要。

结论: DR-DCI框架通过结合检索器的可扩展性和直接语料库交互的精确性，在大规模语料库搜索中实现了有效且高效的性能，解决了传统方法在可扩展性和证据验证方面的局限性。

翻译: Agentic search over large corpora relies on retriever-mediated interfaces (e.g., BM25 or ColBERT) for scalable candidate discovery. While effective at ranking relevant documents, these interfaces expose evidence only as ranked results or bounded document views, limiting agents' ability to reorganize material and verify constraints across documents. Direct Corpus Interaction (DCI) addresses this limitation by exposing shell-executable corpus operations for flexible search, filtering, comparison, and verification. However, full-corpus terminal commands become slow and unstable as the corpus grows, degrading performance and efficiency. We introduce DR-DCI, a retriever-steered DCI framework that treats retrieval as an agent-callable action for expanding a local workspace. Rather than operating directly over the full corpus, the agent dynamically pulls relevant documents into an evolving workspace and conducts DCI operations within it. This design combines retriever-level recall with DCI-style precision: retrieval keeps exploration scalable, while DCI preserves the local operations needed for effective evidence resolution. Experiments show that DR-DCI is both effective and efficient across scales. On Browsecomp-Plus, DR-DCI reaches 71.2% accuracy, improving over raw DCI and ablated variants by up to 8.3 points while reducing tool usage, wall time, and estimated cost. With workspace-preserving context reset, accuracy further improves to 73.3%. In corpus-scaling experiments, DR-DCI remains effective from 100K to 10M documents, whereas raw DCI becomes unstable and BM25 performs substantially worse. DR-DCI also scales to a 20M-scale file-per-document Wiki-18 QA setting, achieving an average score of 63.0 across six benchmarks and outperforming retrieval-based and trained search-agent baselines. Ablation analysis further shows that ranked previews and inter-document DCI are key to performance.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决如何在大语料库中扩展直接语料库交互技术，同时保持其精确性和灵活性的问题。传统检索方法虽然扩展性好但交互受限，而直接交互技术虽控制精细却在大规模数据下运行缓慢且不稳定。解决这一问题对于实现高效、精准的大规模文档智能搜索与证据验证至关重要，能显著提升人工智能代理在复杂研究或现实检索任务中的实际应用能力。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对传统检索交互受限与直接语料操作在大规模数据下效率低下的矛盾，提出了将检索作为动态扩展本地工作区的核心思路。设计上，他们让智能体按需调用检索动作拉取文档，随后在有限的本地工作区内使用终端命令进行精确搜索与验证，从而兼顾了全局探索的扩展性与局部操作的精确性。该方法明确借鉴了直接语料交互技术与检索增强生成框架，将检索从一次性上下文选择模块重新定义为可动态管理工作区的智能体动作，并吸收了长程搜索智能体在上下文管理方面的经验。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将检索视为动态扩展本地文档库的动作，从而将大规模语料的全局候选发现与局部精确交互分离。整体流程是智能体根据当前线索生成查询，将相关文档动态拉取并累积到本地工作区中，随后在工作区内使用终端命令进行精确检索、跨文档比对与证据验证。智能体会在拉取新文档与检查工作区之间交替循环，直至积累足够证据并生成最终答案。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于将检索重新定义为动态扩展智能体本地工作区的操作，而非一次性提供固定上下文。相比传统方法仅返回排名列表限制跨文档验证，以及直接操作全量语料库的方法在数据量增大时易卡顿失效，该方法通过检索筛选候选文档构建局部工作区，再在工作区内进行精确的终端命令交互。这种设计有效分离了大规模语料探索与局部证据验证的负担，使智能体在千万级文档规模下仍能保持高效与高精度。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种将检索作为动态扩展本地工作区动作的框架，通过将大规模语料库的候选发现与精细的本地文档交互相结合，在保持直接语料库交互精度的同时实现了其在海量数据上的可扩展性。

Abstract

Agentic search over large corpora relies on retriever-mediated interfaces (e.g., BM25 or ColBERT) for scalable candidate discovery. While effective at ranking relevant documents, these interfaces expose evidence only as ranked results or bounded document views, limiting agents' ability to reorganize material and verify constraints across documents. Direct Corpus Interaction (DCI) addresses this limitation by exposing shell-executable corpus operations for flexible search, filtering, comparison, and verification. However, full-corpus terminal commands become slow and unstable as the corpus grows, degrading performance and efficiency. We introduce DR-DCI, a retriever-steered DCI framework that treats retrieval as an agent-callable action for expanding a local workspace. Rather than operating directly over the full corpus, the agent dynamically pulls relevant documents into an evolving workspace and conducts DCI operations within it. This design combines retriever-level recall with DCI-style precision: retrieval keeps exploration scalable, while DCI preserves the local operations needed for effective evidence resolution. Experiments show that DR-DCI is both effective and efficient across scales. On Browsecomp-Plus, DR-DCI reaches 71.2\% accuracy, improving over raw DCI and ablated variants by up to 8.3 points while reducing tool usage, wall time, and estimated cost. With workspace-preserving context reset, accuracy further improves to 73.3\%. In corpus-scaling experiments, DR-DCI remains effective from 100K to 10M documents, whereas raw DCI becomes unstable and BM25 performs substantially worse. DR-DCI also scales to a 20M-scale file-per-document Wiki-18 QA setting, achieving an average score of 63.0 across six benchmarks and outperforming retrieval-based and trained search-agent baselines. Ablation analysis further shows that ranked previews and inter-document DCI are key to performance.

item.title: RefGC-SR$^2$: Reference-guided Generated Content Super-Resolution and Refinement
item.author: Sung, Jeahun, Kye, Dahyeon, Kim, Soo Ye, Oh, Jihyong
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种新的任务参考引导生成内容超分辨率细化，旨在同时恢复丢失的细节、细化生成伪影并提升输出分辨率。

背景: 当前参考引导生成方法在输入高分辨率参考图像时，会将其下采样为低分辨率，导致细节丢失，且生成过程会引入新的伪影。现有的细化方法仍在低分辨率域操作，而超分辨率方法则假设自然图像退化，忽略了生成管道的伪影分布。

目的: 解决现有方法在细节恢复和伪影细化方面的不足，通过重用原始高分辨率参考图像，在后期处理阶段同时恢复细节、细化伪影并提升分辨率。

方法: 构建了首个真实世界三元组数据生成管道，训练双联条件生成器合成配对低质量锚点。提出了频率感知扩散变换器模型，选择性注入高分辨率参考图像中的细节，同时去除生成伪影。

主要发现: 实验表明，该模型能够忠实于参考图像细化对象身份，并恢复高分辨率细节，最终结果质量显著提升，实用性更强。

结论: 提出的参考引导生成内容超分辨率细化模型在对象身份细化和高分辨率细节恢复方面优于现有基线方法，具有更高的实用价值。

翻译: Reference-guided generation (e.g., object compositing, customization) has progressed rapidly, yet current pipelines share a fundamental limitation: the object-centric high-resolution reference image (HRRI) provided by users is downsampled to a fixed low-resolution (LR) before being fed into the model, so the fine-grained details are discarded before the output is even produced. In addition, the generation step then introduces its own artifacts (e.g., identity distortion) on top of this loss. Existing reference-guided generated content refinement (RefGCR) methods can correct some of these artifacts but still operate in the LR domain; reference-guided super-resolution (RefSR) methods recover resolution but assume natural-image degradations and ignore the artifact distribution of generative pipelines. To address both gaps in a single formulation, we introduce a new task: reference-guided generated content super-resolution-refinement (RefGC-SR$^2$), where the original HRRI is reused at the post-processing stage to recover lost details, refine generative artifacts, and upscale the output simultaneously. We construct the first real-world triplet data generation pipeline for this RefGC-SR$^2$ task, training a diptych-conditioned generator to synthesize paired low-quality anchors that public pretrained models cannot provide. We further present a frequency-aware diffusion transformer model for RefGC-SR$^2$ that selectively injects fine details from the HRRI while removing generative artifacts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our RefGC-SR$^2$ model successfully (i) refines the object identity faithfully with respect to the reference, and (ii) recovers high-resolution details, so that the final result is significantly higher quality and practically more usable compared to existing RefGCR and RefSR baselines.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有参考引导式人工智能图像生成流程中，高分辨率参考图在输入前被强制降采样导致细节丢失，且生成结果常伴随身份失真、纹理缺失等固有缺陷的问题。该问题在现实中非常重要，因为用户通常提供高质量参考图以实现个性化创作，但当前技术无法有效利用这些参考信息，导致最终输出质量低下且难以直接应用。通过同时实现超分辨率重建与生成缺陷修复，该方法能显著提升生成内容的实用价值。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者首先发现现有生成流程会丢弃参考图细节并引入伪影，而现有方法无法同时完成画质提升与修复。在设计时，他们借鉴了基础生成模型的层级特性，发现网络前期负责构建整体轮廓、后期负责刻画细节。据此，他们设计了自适应模块，让网络前期侧重整体结构对齐，后期侧重从参考图中提取精细纹理，并配合专门的频率损失函数进行训练，从而实现分辨率提升与伪影修复。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是在后处理阶段直接复用用户提供的原始高分辨率参考图像，同步完成生成图像的尺寸放大与生成伪影修复，以恢复丢失的精细细节并提升输出质量。整体流程首先构建包含低分辨率生成图、高分辨率参考图与目标真值的配对数据集，接着在扩散模型骨干网络中注入按网络深度自适应分配权重的低频与高频特征处理模块，最后通过频率感知损失函数进行训练，使模型在推理时能够精准提取参考图的高频细节并消除生成伪影。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于首次提出了参考引导生成内容超分辨率与修复任务，通过在后处理阶段复用原始高分辨率参考图像，同时实现图像分辨率提升与生成伪影修复。相比以往仅能在低分辨率下修复伪影或仅针对自然图像降质进行超分辨率的工作，该方法能精准保留参考图像的细节并恢复高分辨率输出。此外，论文还构建了首个配套的三元组数据集，并设计了频率感知的扩散模型架构，使模型能自适应地分配低频结构重建与高频细节恢复的权重。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文首次提出了参考引导生成内容超分辨率与细化任务，构建了首个配套的三元组数据集，并设计了频率感知模型以同步实现图像超分辨率与生成伪影的精细修复。

Abstract

Reference-guided generation (e.g., object compositing, customization) has progressed rapidly, yet current pipelines share a fundamental limitation: the object-centric high-resolution reference image (HRRI) provided by users is downsampled to a fixed low-resolution (LR) before being fed into the model, so the fine-grained details are discarded before the output is even produced. In addition, the generation step then introduces its own artifacts (e.g., identity distortion) on top of this loss. Existing reference-guided generated content refinement (RefGCR) methods can correct some of these artifacts but still operate in the LR domain; reference-guided super-resolution (RefSR) methods recover resolution but assume natural-image degradations and ignore the artifact distribution of generative pipelines. To address both gaps in a single formulation, we introduce a new task: reference-guided generated content super-resolution-refinement (RefGC-SR$^2$), where the original HRRI is reused at the post-processing stage to recover lost details, refine generative artifacts, and upscale the output simultaneously. We construct the first real-world triplet data generation pipeline for this RefGC-SR$^2$ task, training a diptych-conditioned generator to synthesize paired low-quality anchors that public pretrained models cannot provide. We further present a frequency-aware diffusion transformer model for RefGC-SR$^2$ that selectively injects fine details from the HRRI while removing generative artifacts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our RefGC-SR$^2$ model successfully (i) refines the object identity faithfully with respect to the reference, and (ii) recovers high-resolution details, so that the final result is significantly higher quality and practically more usable compared to existing RefGCR and RefSR baselines.

item.title: Visual-Seeker: Towards Visual-Native Multimodal Agentic Search via Active Visual Reasoning
item.author: Zhang, Zhengbo, Miao, Changtao, Su, Jinbo, Zhou, Zhaowen, Zhang, Chunxia, Wang, Xukai, Liu, Ruiqi, Zheng, Kaiyuan, Cai, Jiansheng, Zhang, Bo, Li, Zhe, Xiang, Shiming, Yan, Ying
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Visual-Seeker的视觉原生多模态深度搜索智能体，通过主动视觉推理解决多模态大语言模型在复杂开放世界场景中的事实 grounding 问题。

背景: 多模态大语言模型在许多视觉任务中表现出色，但在复杂开放世界场景中常面临事实 grounding 困难。现有的多模态深度搜索智能体主要依赖简单图像和纯文本证据轨迹，限制了多跳跨模态推理和搜索能力。

目的: 解决现有方法在视觉原生搜索范式上的不足，提升智能体在多跳跨模态推理和搜索中的能力。

方法: 提出Visual-Seeker智能体，通过主动视觉推理动态关注细粒度视觉细节并 Harvest 视觉证据。设计了主动视觉推理数据流水线，合成五千条高质量多模态轨迹用于模型训练。

主要发现: 在五个具有挑战性的多模态搜索基准测试中取得了最先进性能，甚至超越了一些专有模型，验证了其在真实网络环境中强大的视觉原生推理和搜索能力。

结论: Visual-Seeker 通过视觉原生推理和搜索范式，有效提升了多模态大语言模型在复杂场景下的事实 grounding 能力，为相关研究提供了新的方向。

翻译: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in many visual tasks, but they often struggle with factual grounding when confronted with complex, open-world scenarios. While recent multimodal deep search agents attempt to address this issue by utilizing external tools, the visual-native search paradigm remains underexplored. Existing methods primarily rely on simple images with explicit semantics and text-only evidence trajectories, limiting the agent's ability to perform multi-hop, cross-modal reasoning and search. To address these limitations, we propose Visual-Seeker, a visual-native multimodal deep search agent via active visual reasoning. Rather than treating vision as a static input, our agent actively attends to fine-grained visual details, dynamically harvests visual evidence throughout the search process. To unlock its visual-native potential, we design an active visual reasoning data pipeline and synthesize 5K high-quality multimodal trajectories for model training. Extensive experiments demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance across five challenging multimodal search benchmarks, even surpassing several proprietary models, validating robust visual-native reasoning and search in real-world web environments. The code and data can be accessed at: this https URL .

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有视觉多模态搜索智能体在复杂开放场景中视觉感知能力不足，且无法主动收集和利用视觉证据进行多步跨模态推理的问题。该问题在研究和现实中非常重要，因为真实世界的查询往往包含复杂背景和多个实体，而网络环境中又富含丰富的视觉信息。只有赋予模型主动的视觉推理能力，才能准确识别目标并动态整合多源线索，从而在开放世界任务中实现更可靠的事实依据与综合回答。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有方法将视觉仅作为静态输入且缺乏复杂图像与视觉证据轨迹的局限，设计了以主动视觉推理为核心的多模态深度搜索智能体。该方法通过构建包含复杂实体筛选、基于知识图谱的双策略随机游走扩展以及视觉证据注入的三阶段数据合成流水线，生成高质量多跳轨迹用于监督微调。在借鉴现有文本深度搜索与多模态智能体交互框架的基础上，作者参考了公开视觉问答数据集进行实体提取，并引入维基百科知识图谱构建搜索路径，但核心创新在于自主设计了激活模型视觉原生能力的训练数据生成机制。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是让多模态搜索智能体从被动接收图像信息转变为主动进行视觉推理，通过动态关注细粒度视觉细节并主动搜集网络中的视觉证据，实现跨模态的深度搜索。整体实现流程首先从复杂真实图像中提取并筛选高质量的目标实体作为起点，接着利用知识图谱随机游走生成多跳推理路径并构造问答对，然后注入视觉证据强制模型调用搜索工具获取并分析相关图片，最后基于合成的五千条高质量多模态轨迹对模型进行监督微调，使其在实际搜索中通过循环调用文本与图像工具逐步推理并生成答案。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了名为Visual-Seeker的视觉原生多模态深度搜索智能体，并设计了一套主动视觉推理数据合成流水线。与以往将视觉仅作为静态辅助输入、依赖简单图像和纯文本证据轨迹的方法不同，该工作使模型能够主动关注复杂真实图像中的细粒度视觉细节，并在搜索过程中动态收集与整合视觉证据。通过合成高质量多模态轨迹进行训练，模型显著提升了多跳跨模态推理能力，并在多项测试中达到最优性能。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种名为Visual-Seeker的视觉原生多模态深度搜索智能体，通过设计主动视觉推理数据合成流水线生成高质量训练轨迹，使模型能够主动收集视觉证据并进行跨模态推理，在多项多模态搜索基准测试中取得了最先进性能。

Abstract

Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in many visual tasks, but they often struggle with factual grounding when confronted with complex, open-world scenarios. While recent multimodal deep search agents attempt to address this issue by utilizing external tools, the visual-native search paradigm remains underexplored. Existing methods primarily rely on simple images with explicit semantics and text-only evidence trajectories, limiting the agent's ability to perform multi-hop, cross-modal reasoning and search. To address these limitations, we propose Visual-Seeker, a visual-native multimodal deep search agent via active visual reasoning. Rather than treating vision as a static input, our agent actively attends to fine-grained visual details, dynamically harvests visual evidence throughout the search process. To unlock its visual-native potential, we design an active visual reasoning data pipeline and synthesize 5K high-quality multimodal trajectories for model training. Extensive experiments demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance across five challenging multimodal search benchmarks, even surpassing several proprietary models, validating robust visual-native reasoning and search in real-world web environments. The code and data can be accessed at: this https URL .

item.title: Show the Signal, Hide the Noise: Spectral Forcing for Pixel-Space Diffusion
item.author: Fan, Weichen, Diao, Haiwen, Wu, Penghao, Liu, Ziwei
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为频谱强制的新方法，用于优化像素空间扩散模型。该方法通过在噪声输入进入补丁嵌入器之前应用一个参数自由、时间条件的一维离散余弦变换低通算子，显式地分离信号与噪声。实验表明，该方法在ImageNet-256数据集上提升了FID和Inception Score，并在SenseNova-U1统一文本到图像模型中改善了DPG-Bench和GenEval指标，证明了其在容量效率方面的有效性。

背景: 像素空间扩散模型在全带宽噪声图像上进行训练，但去噪器可用的有用信号具有强烈的频率依赖性。在整流流扩散和自然图像幂律谱下，存在一个随时间变化的每带数据噪声轮廓，该轮廓将信号丰富的低频区域与噪声主导的高频区域分离开来。

目的: 解决标准像素空间去噪器在内部发现移动带宽边界时面临的容量分配问题，避免在最优预测退化为确定性基线而非数据分布建模的频率时间区域浪费计算资源，从而显式地分离信号与噪声。

方法: 引入频谱强制方法，这是一种参数自由、时间条件的二维离散余弦变换低通算子。该算子应用于噪声输入在进入补丁嵌入器之前，其截止频率随扩散时间单调扩展，并在数据端点变为恒等变换。

主要发现: 通过受控的合成实验确定了该算子有效的条件：即粗粒度补丁标记化和数据的高频内容主要为噪声而非必要信号的情况。在ImageNet-256数据集上使用JiT-700M/32模型时，频谱强制在不同训练时期持续改善FID和Inception Score；在更细粒度的标记化下仍具竞争力。将其插入SenseNova-U1统一文本到图像模型后，提升了DPG-Bench和GenEval指标。

结论: 频谱强制通过显式分离信号和隐藏噪声，为像素空间扩散模型提供了一条容量高效的途径。

翻译: Pixel-space diffusion models are trained on full-bandwidth noisy images, yet the useful signal available to the denoiser is strongly frequency dependent. Under rectified-flow diffusion and natural-image power-law spectra, the per-band data-to-noise contour separates a signal-bearing low-frequency region from a noise-dominated high-frequency region at each time t. We show that this implicit coarse-to-fine structure is not merely descriptive: it induces a capacity-allocation problem. A standard pixel-space denoiser must discover the moving bandwidth boundary internally and can spend computation on frequency-time regions where the optimal prediction collapses to deterministic baselines rather than data-distribution modeling. To make this boundary explicit, we introduce Spectral Forcing, a parameter-free, time-conditional 2D-DCT low-pass operator applied to the noisy input before the patch embedder. Its cutoff expands monotonically with the diffusion time and becomes the identity at the data endpoint. Through controlled synthetic experiments, we identify the regime in which the operator is beneficial: coarse patch tokenization and data whose high-frequency content is predominantly noise rather than essential signal. On ImageNet-256 with JiT-700M/32, Spectral Forcing consistently improves both FID and Inception Score across different training epochs, demonstrating robust gains throughout training; at finer tokenization, the spectral forcing is still competitive. We further insert the unchanged operator into SenseNova-U1, a unified text-to-image model, where it improves DPG-Bench and GenEval, showing that the input-side spectral prior transfers beyond class-conditional generation. These results suggest a route to capacity-efficient pixel-space diffusion by showing the signal and hiding the noise.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决像素空间扩散模型在去噪时因无法自动区分有效信号与噪声的频率边界，从而浪费计算资源的问题。通过在前端显式过滤高频噪声，模型能够将算力集中在真实数据分布的学习上。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为它能显著提升图像生成的效率与质量，降低训练成本，并为直接处理原始图像块的新型多模态模型提供了更实用的技术路径。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现标准像素空间扩散模型在训练时会隐式地遵循由频率决定的粗到细结构，导致网络在高频噪声区域浪费大量计算能力。基于这一观察，他们在输入端显式加入了一个随扩散时间单调扩展的低通滤波器，以提前屏蔽高频噪声并释放模型容量专注于有效信号恢复。该方法并未直接沿用现有工作，而是借鉴了前期对扩散模型隐式频率偏置与自然图像频谱特性的理论分析，创新性地将其设计为无需训练参数的输入侧适配器，且完全保留了原有的网络架构、损失函数与采样流程。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是利用扩散过程中信号与噪声在不同频率上的分布差异，在模型输入端显式过滤高频噪声，迫使网络将计算能力集中在有效信号区域。整体实现流程是在每次扩散步骤前，对加噪图像进行一种无参数的频域低通滤波，滤波的截止范围随扩散时间单调递增，最终在生成终点恢复全频带，且不改变原有模型架构与训练目标。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点是提出了一种名为频谱强制的无参数输入端预处理模块。该模块在图像进入网络前，根据扩散进度动态施加二维离散余弦变换低通滤波，显式地过滤掉高频噪声区域，仅保留有效信号。与以往修改扩散前向过程、直接在频域生成或引入复杂频率损失的工作不同，该方法完全不改变原有的网络架构、损失函数和采样器，仅作为即插即用的轻量级适配器，显著提升了像素空间扩散模型的计算效率与生成质量。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种无需训练参数的时间条件低通滤波方法，通过显式分离图像频带中的有效信号与噪声，显著提升了像素空间扩散模型的生成质量与计算效率，并明确了该方法适用的模型配置与数据分布条件。

Abstract

Pixel-space diffusion models are trained on full-bandwidth noisy images, yet the useful signal available to the denoiser is strongly frequency dependent. Under rectified-flow diffusion and natural-image power-law spectra, the per-band data-to-noise contour $k^{*}(t) = (1-t)^{-2/\alpha}$ separates a signal-bearing low-frequency region from a noise-dominated high-frequency region at each time $t$. We show that this implicit coarse-to-fine structure is not merely descriptive: it induces a capacity-allocation problem. A standard pixel-space denoiser must discover the moving bandwidth boundary internally and can spend computation on frequency-time regions where the optimal prediction collapses to deterministic baselines rather than data-distribution modeling. To make this boundary explicit, we introduce Spectral Forcing, a parameter-free, time-conditional 2D-DCT low-pass operator applied to the noisy input before the patch embedder. Its cutoff expands monotonically with the diffusion time and becomes the identity at the data endpoint. Through controlled synthetic experiments, we identify the regime in which the operator is beneficial: coarse patch tokenization and data whose high-frequency content is predominantly noise rather than essential signal. On ImageNet-256 with JiT-700M/32, Spectral Forcing consistently improves both FID and Inception Score across different training epochs, demonstrating robust gains throughout training; at finer tokenization, the spectral forcing is still competitive. We further insert the unchanged operator into SenseNova-U1, a unified text-to-image model, where it improves DPG-Bench and GenEval, showing that the input-side spectral prior transfers beyond class-conditional generation. These results suggest a route to capacity-efficient pixel-space diffusion by showing the signal and hiding the noise.

item.title: Beyond Monolingual Deep Research: Evaluating Agents and Retrievers with Cross-Lingual BrowseComp-Plus
item.author: Lu, Yuheng, Zeng, Qingcheng, Qi, Heli, Yu, Puxuan, Zhao, Fuheng, Yang, Rui, Yanaka, Hitomi, Yokoya, Naoto, Xuan, Weihao
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究评估了深度研究智能体在跨语言环境下的证据搜索、推理及生成答案的能力。

背景: 现有浏览基准测试通常假设用户查询与支持证据使用相同语言，未充分考察智能体在证据语言与查询语言不一致时的表现。

目的: 引入XBCP基准测试，以探究智能体在支持文档语言与查询语言不同的情况下的操作能力。

方法: 构建XBCCP基准测试，保留BrowseComp-Plus的英文问答空间但改变支持文档的语言。设置跨语言和 multilingual 两种场景，使用稀疏和密集多语言检索器评估四个深度研究智能体，测量答案准确性、证据召回率、搜索行为、校准度、引用保真度和oracle检索。

主要发现: 证据翻译导致性能显著下降。即使使用强大的密集检索器，证据召回率也会降低，智能体校准度变差且引用证据更不可靠。即使直接提供所有黄金证据，准确性仍然较低。

结论: 跨语言深度研究不仅暴露检索失败问题，还揭示了智能体在整合语言不匹配证据方面存在独立的困难。

翻译: Deep research agents are increasingly evaluated on their ability to search for evidence, reason over retrieved sources, and produce grounded answers. Existing browsing benchmarks, however, largely assume that the user's query and the supporting evidence are written in the same language, leaving open whether agentic search systems can operate when relevant evidence appears in another language. We introduce XBCP (Cross-lingual BrowseComp-Plus), a controlled benchmark that preserves the English question-and-answer space of BrowseComp-Plus but varies the languages of the supporting documents. XBCP instantiates two complementary settings: in the cross-lingual setting, each query is paired with evidence in a single assigned language. In the multilingual setting, the full evidence corpus is distributed equally and randomly across 12 languages spanning high-resource and low-resource regimes. We evaluate four deep research agents using sparse and dense multilingual retrievers, measuring answer accuracy, evidence recall, search behavior, calibration, citation fidelity, and oracle retrieval. Results reveal substantial degradation when evidence is translated. Even strong, dense retrievers lose evidence recall, and agents become less calibrated and cite evidence less reliably. Notably, accuracy remains lower even when all gold evidence is supplied directly. These findings suggest that cross-lingual deep research exposes both retrieval failures and an independent, agent-side difficulty in integrating language-mismatched evidence.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有深度研究智能体评测基准大多局限于单语环境，无法评估系统在查询与证据语言不一致时的实际能力这一问题。该问题在研究和现实中非常重要，因为真实世界中的信息需求往往跨越语言，评估智能体在多语言或跨语言场景下的检索与推理能力，有助于发现当前系统在语言不匹配时的检索缺陷和整合困难，从而推动构建更强大、更通用的多语言人工智能搜索系统。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者指出当前评测基准多局限于单语环境，且跨语言检索研究通常仅关注独立排序任务，缺乏对智能体在迭代搜索中整合异质语言证据能力的检验。基于此，他们借鉴了单语控制基准的固定语料与验证框架，保留英文问答结构，仅将支持文档翻译为多种高低资源语言，从而构建出跨语言与多语言两种对照设置。该方法直接沿用了原有基准的评测流程，并参考了多项多语言嵌入模型与检索基准的设计思路，但将其核心场景从独立检索扩展至智能体完整搜索闭环中。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是构建一个跨语言深度研究评测基准，在保留英文问答的前提下，将原始语料中的支撑证据翻译为多种语言，以测试智能体在查询与证据语言不一致时的检索与推理能力。整体流程首先利用大语言模型将原始证据文档翻译为目标语言并进行人工质量校验，随后按单语言和多语言两种配置重组语料并构建检索索引，最后将处理后的语料与深度研究智能体及检索器配对，通过端到端准确率、证据召回率及置信度校准等指标进行全面评测。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点是首次构建了跨语言深度研究评测基准，通过仅将原始基准中的证据文档翻译为不同语言，而保持问题与答案语言不变，设计了单语言证据和多语言混合证据两种受控评估场景。与以往主要局限于单一语言环境（问题、证据和答案同语言）的评测基准不同，该工作专门针对查询与证据语言不一致的真实场景，系统评估了检索系统与智能体在跨语言环境下的表现，揭示了语言不匹配带来的检索失败与智能体整合困难。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文首次构建了首个跨语言深度研究评测基准，通过改变证据文档的语言设置，系统评估了智能体在查询与证据语言不一致时的检索与推理能力，并揭示了该场景下模型性能与引用可靠性的显著下降。

Abstract

Deep research agents are increasingly evaluated on their ability to search for evidence, reason over retrieved sources, and produce grounded answers. Existing browsing benchmarks, however, largely assume that the user's query and the supporting evidence are written in the same language, leaving open whether agentic search systems can operate when relevant evidence appears in another language. We introduce XBCP (Cross-lingual BrowseComp-Plus), a controlled benchmark that preserves the English question-and-answer space of BrowseComp-Plus but varies the languages of the supporting documents. XBCP instantiates two complementary settings: in the cross-lingual setting, each query is paired with evidence in a single assigned language. In the multilingual setting, the full evidence corpus is distributed equally and randomly across 12 languages spanning high-resource and low-resource regimes. We evaluate four deep research agents using sparse and dense multilingual retrievers, measuring answer accuracy, evidence recall, search behavior, calibration, citation fidelity, and oracle retrieval. Results reveal substantial degradation when evidence is translated. Even strong, dense retrievers lose evidence recall, and agents become less calibrated and cite evidence less reliably. Notably, accuracy remains lower even when all gold evidence is supplied directly. These findings suggest that cross-lingual deep research exposes both retrieval failures and an independent, agent-side difficulty in integrating language-mismatched evidence.

item.title: Rethinking the Role of Efficient Attention in Hybrid Architectures
item.author: Qiao, Ziqing, Xu, Yinuo, Xiao, Chaojun, Su, Zhou, Zhou, Zihan, Chen, Yingfa, Xu, Xiaoyue, Han, Xu, Liu, Zhiyuan
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文系统分析了混合架构中高效注意力模块对模型能力的影响，揭示了长上下文能力的演化机制，并提出了针对性的架构优化策略。

背景: 现代语言模型越来越多地采用混合架构，将全注意力与高效注意力模块（如滑动窗口注意力和循环序列混合器）相结合，但高效模块如何塑造模型能力尚不清楚。

目的: 填补关于高效注意力模块如何影响模型能力的认知空白，系统分析混合架构在不同视角下的表现。

方法: 从缩放行为、机制分析和架构设计三个视角对混合架构进行系统分析。

主要发现: 第一，从缩放角度看，高效注意力设计主要影响长上下文能力出现的速度，但在充分训练后不同混合架构最终能达到可比的长上下文性能。第二，从机制上看，长距离检索主要由全注意力承担，而高效注意力塑造其优化轨迹；较大的滑动窗口会延迟全注意力层中检索头的形成，这一现象被称为大窗口惰性。第三，基于该机制，仅在小窗口滑动窗口混合架构的全注意力层应用无位置编码，能在几乎不影响短上下文性能的情况下显著提升长上下文性能。

结论: 高效注意力模块主要影响长上下文能力的演化速度和优化轨迹，而非最终性能上限；通过针对性地在全注意力层应用无位置编码等策略，可以有效提升混合架构的长上下文性能。

翻译: Modern language models increasingly adopt hybrid architectures that combine full attention with efficient attention modules, such as sliding-window attention (SWA) and recurrent sequence mixers. However, how these efficient modules shape model capabilities remains poorly understood. To address this gap, we conduct a systematic analysis across hybrid architectures from three perspectives: scaling behavior, mechanism analysis, and architecture design. First, from a scaling perspective, we find that efficient-attention design primarily affects how fast long-context capability emerges, while different hybrids eventually converge to comparable long-context performance under sufficient training. Second, mechanistically, we show that long-range retrieval is mainly carried by full attention, whereas efficient attention shapes its optimization trajectory. This explains a counter-intuitive phenomenon we call Large-Window Laziness: larger SWA windows can delay the formation of retrieval heads in full-attention layers. Third, guided by this mechanism, we show that applying NoPE to only the full-attention layers of a small-window SWA hybrid substantially improves long-context performance with negligible impact on short-context performance.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要探讨混合架构中的高效注意力模块究竟如何影响模型能力，特别是长文本处理能力。当前大语言模型为降低计算成本广泛采用此类混合设计，但学界对其实际作用机制缺乏清晰认知。明确这一问题有助于优化模型训练策略、指导更有效的架构设计，并避免盲目增加模块复杂度，对提升长文本处理效率具有重要价值。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者首先通过系统分析发现，高效注意力模块主要影响长上下文能力的训练速度，而长程信息检索实际由全注意力层承担。基于这一机制认知，他们将设计重点转向如何更有效地训练全注意力层，并借鉴了现有的位置编码技术与混合架构研究，提出仅在小窗口滑动注意力混合架构的全注意力层中应用无位置编码方法。该设计直接针对

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是高效注意力模块主要起优化引导作用，长距离信息检索实际由全注意力层负责，因此强化全注意力层即可提升长上下文能力。整体实现流程为：采用全注意力层与小型滑动窗口注意力层交替堆叠的混合架构，并仅在全注意力层中移除绝对位置编码，其余部分保持标准设计，随后进行常规预训练。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于系统揭示了高效注意力模块的真实作用机制，指出其并不直接决定最终的长上下文能力，而是作为优化先验影响全注意力模块学习长距离检索的速度。论文还发现了大窗口设计会延迟检索头形成的“大窗口惰性”现象，并据此提出仅在全注意力层改进位置编码即可显著提升长上下文性能的设计原则。相比以往工作多关注最终评测分数或局限于特定模型的有限实验，本研究通过受控的缩放定律设置与机制探针，提供了跨架构的统一对比与深层原理解释。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 这篇论文通过系统分析指出，混合架构中的高效注意力模块主要影响长上下文能力的训练速度而非最终上限，其核心作用是作为优化先验引导全注意力模块学习长程检索，并据此提出通过强化全注意力层设计即可显著提升长上下文性能的新原则。

Abstract

Modern language models increasingly adopt hybrid architectures that combine full attention with efficient attention modules, such as sliding-window attention (SWA) and recurrent sequence mixers. However, how these efficient modules shape model capabilities remains poorly understood. To address this gap, we conduct a systematic analysis across hybrid architectures from three perspectives: scaling behavior, mechanism analysis, and architecture design. First, from a scaling perspective, we find that efficient-attention design primarily affects how fast long-context capability emerges, while different hybrids eventually converge to comparable long-context performance under sufficient training. Second, mechanistically, we show that long-range retrieval is mainly carried by full attention, whereas efficient attention shapes its optimization trajectory. This explains a counter-intuitive phenomenon we call Large-Window Laziness: larger SWA windows can delay the formation of retrieval heads in full-attention layers. Third, guided by this mechanism, we show that applying NoPE to only the full-attention layers of a small-window SWA hybrid substantially improves long-context performance with negligible impact on short-context performance.

item.title: A Gradient Perspective on RLVR Stability and Winner Advantage Policy Optimization
item.author: YSS, Prasanth, Ren, Zhichen, Hosseinzadeh, Rasa, Gofman, Ilan, Chen, Yuqi, Liu, Zhaoyan, Yu, Guangwei, Cresswell, Jesse C., Gorti, Satya Krishna
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文分析了强化学习中可验证奖励优化导致语言模型推理能力改进但存在不稳定的问题，提出了一种新的策略优化方法WAPO，通过仅更新正优势完成来改善训练稳定性，并在多个基准测试中表现优异。

背景: 强化学习结合可验证奖励能够提升语言模型的推理能力，但类似GRPO的优化方法容易出现崩溃或不稳定现象。

目的: 分析GRPO风格优化不稳定的原因，并提出一种更稳定的策略优化方法。

方法: 通过令牌级梯度动态分析不稳定性，提出WAPO方法，这是一种简单的在线裁剪策略梯度目标函数，仅在正优势完成时进行更新。

主要发现: 稳定性取决于优势符号和当前策略下的令牌分布；WAPO在数学推理和多跳问答基准测试中提高了训练稳定性，并在多个模型家族中匹配或优于基线方法。

结论: WAPO方法有效改善了训练稳定性，并在多个任务中表现良好，代码已公开。

翻译: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves language-model reasoning, but GRPO-style optimization remains prone to collapse. We analyse this instability through token-level gradient dynamics, deriving a taxonomy that predicts how updates affect next-token probabilities and entropy. The taxonomy shows that stability depends jointly on the advantage sign and token distribution under the current policy. Motivated by this finding, we propose Winner Advantage Policy Optimization (WAPO), a simple online clipped policy-gradient objective that updates only on positive-advantage completions. Across mathematical reasoning and multi-hop QA benchmarks, WAPO improves training stability and matches or outperforms baselines across multiple model families. Full code can be found at this https URL .

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决强化学习可验证奖励训练过程中模型参数更新容易引发崩溃和训练不稳定的问题。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为训练崩溃会直接导致模型无法有效学习推理能力，甚至输出无意义或重复的内容，严重阻碍大语言模型在数学推理和复杂问答等实际任务中的可靠应用。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者通过逐词元梯度动态分析发现，训练崩溃不仅与策略偏离有关，更取决于优势值符号与当前词元概率分布的交互作用。基于此发现，他们提出将策略梯度更新限制在仅使用正优势值完成序列上，从而设计了WAPO方法。该方法并未借鉴其他特定算法，而是对现有在线策略梯度训练框架的极简修改，并明确区别于拒绝采样微调等离线过滤方法。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是仅利用优势值为正的完成结果进行策略参数更新，从而避免引发模型崩溃的熵增更新，同时保留成功回答的有效学习信号。整体实现流程基于验证奖励的强化学习框架，先生成一组回答并计算组内相对优势值，随后在策略梯度更新阶段直接屏蔽所有非正优势的回答，仅对包含至少一个正优势回答的提示词进行归一化与参数更新。该方法保留了在线裁剪策略梯度的特性，但通过筛选正优势样本显著提升了训练稳定性。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种仅利用成功生成结果进行参数更新的策略优化方法。相比以往工作主要关注新旧策略偏差并依赖复杂的裁剪机制来防止训练崩溃，本文从词元级梯度动态出发，揭示了负优势更新会破坏概率分布并引发崩溃。该方法通过直接过滤负优势样本的梯度贡献，以极简设计显著提升了训练稳定性，并在多项测试中达到或超越了现有基线。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文从令牌级梯度动力学视角揭示了强化学习训练不稳定的内在机制，并提出仅利用正优势样本进行更新的策略优化方法，显著提升了模型训练的稳定性与推理性能。

Abstract

Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves language-model reasoning, but GRPO-style optimization remains prone to collapse. We analyse this instability through token-level gradient dynamics, deriving a taxonomy that predicts how updates affect next-token probabilities and entropy. The taxonomy shows that stability depends jointly on the advantage sign and token distribution under the current policy. Motivated by this finding, we propose Winner Advantage Policy Optimization (WAPO), a simple online clipped policy-gradient objective that updates only on positive-advantage completions. Across mathematical reasoning and multi-hop QA benchmarks, WAPO improves training stability and matches or outperforms baselines across multiple model families. Full code can be found at this https URL .

item.title: Scalable and Interpretable Representation Alignment with Ordinal Similarity
item.author: Diogo Soares, Pankhil Gawade, Andrea Dittadi, Ewa Szczurek
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于序数相似性的框架，通过三元组和四元组相似性指数来衡量表示的一致性，解决了现有指标在可解释性、鲁棒性和计算效率方面的不足。

背景: 现有表示相似性评估指标存在显著局限性，包括因基线漂移导致缺乏可解释性、对异常值缺乏鲁棒性，以及在大样本数据上计算不可行而依赖启发式近似。

目的: 开发一种新的序数相似性框架，以解决现有指标在可解释性、鲁棒性和计算效率方面的不足，为表示学习提供更有效的评估方法。

方法: 提出三元组相似性指数和四元组相似性指数，通过量化序数关系的一致性来衡量对齐程度，并建立其与局部邻域对齐（通过相互最近邻测量）的正式等价关系。

主要发现: 该框架在理论上具有内在可解释性、对异常值鲁棒且计算高效；实证验证了这些特性，并表明序数相似性提供了一种可扩展的对齐测量方法。

结论: 序数相似性为表示对齐的测量提供了一种可扩展的方法，帮助实践者更好地理解和设计表示。

翻译: Evaluating representation similarity is fundamental to representation learning. However, existing metrics suffer from significant limitations: they lack interpretability due to shifting baselines, lack robustness to outliers, and are computationally intractable for large datasets, forcing reliance on heuristic approximations. To address this, we develop an ordinal-similarity framework, instantiated by the Triplet (TSI) and Quadruplet (QSI) Similarity Indices, which measure alignment by quantifying the consistency of ordinal relationships. We theoretically demonstrate this formulation is inherently interpretable, robust to outliers, and computationally efficient. Finally, we establish a formal equivalence between TSI and local neighborhood alignment, measured by Mutual Nearest Neighbors. Empirically, we validate these properties and show that ordinal similarity offers a scalable approach to measuring alignment, enabling practitioners to better understand and design representations.

Abstract

Evaluating representation similarity is fundamental to representation learning. However, existing metrics suffer from significant limitations: they lack interpretability due to shifting baselines, lack robustness to outliers, and are computationally intractable for large datasets, forcing reliance on heuristic approximations. To address this, we develop an ordinal-similarity framework, instantiated by the Triplet (TSI) and Quadruplet (QSI) Similarity Indices, which measure alignment by quantifying the consistency of ordinal relationships. We theoretically demonstrate this formulation is inherently interpretable, robust to outliers, and computationally efficient. Finally, we establish a formal equivalence between TSI and local neighborhood alignment, measured by Mutual Nearest Neighbors. Empirically, we validate these properties and show that ordinal similarity offers a scalable approach to measuring alignment, enabling practitioners to better understand and design representations.

item.title: Lect\=uraAgents: A Multi-Agent Framework for Adaptive Personalized AI-Assisted Learning and Embodied Teaching
item.author: Sesay, Jaward, Yu, Yue, Dong, Siwei, Shi, Yemin, Chen, Guangyao, Karlsson, Börje F.
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出LectūraAgents框架，通过端到端自适应具身教学实现个性化学习，包含分层多智能体架构、自适应具身教学机制及教学动作语音对齐算法，在多个教育层级课程中验证其有效性。

背景: 现有教育智能体主要关注讲座内容自动化和模拟，难以建模针对个体学习者的多模态和具身教学方法。

目的: 开发能够生成准确学习者特定教育材料并动态适应不同学习者的系统，实现个性化学习。

方法: 构建LectūraAgents多智能体框架，模拟教授与学生关系，由教授智能体领导专业子智能体团队进行内容研究、规划、审查和具身交付，采用分层架构、自适应具身教学机制及基于显著性启发式和时序语义分割的教学动作语音对齐算法。

主要发现: 在高中、本科和研究生级别的多门课程中，通过专家评估和基于量规的分析，LectūraAgents在讲座内容质量、具身教学质量、评估和个性化方面均优于现有方法。

结论: LectūraAgents是一个具有良好教学基础的框架，能够实现大规模个性化学习。

翻译: Effective personalized AI-assisted learning demands systems that can not only generate accurate learner-specific educational materials, but also dynamically adapt their instruction to diverse learners. However, existing educational agents have primarily focused on lecture content automation and simulations, which often fall short of modelling multimodal and embodied instructional methods tailored for the individual learner. To this end, we propose LectūraAgents - a multi-agent framework that enables personalized learning through end-to-end adaptive embodied teaching. At its core, LectūraAgents mirrors a professor-student relationship, in which a ProfessorAgent leads a collaborative team of specialized subordinate agents through research, planning, review, and embodied delivery of lecture contents that adapt to a learner's needs. The framework offers three main contributions: (1) a hierarchical multi-agent architecture for end-to-end personalized learning; (2) an adaptive embodied teaching mechanism, wherein the ProfessorAgent executes visible and pedagogically motivated teaching actions (e.g., handwrite, highlight, underline, etc.) over contents in a teaching environment; and (3) a Teaching Action-Speech Alignment (TASA) algorithm that employs salience-based heuristics and temporal semantic segmentation to generate coherent teaching action sequences aligned with learner profiles. We evaluate LectūraAgents on diverse courses at high school, undergraduate, and graduate levels using sample-specific rubric-based analysis; with generated lecture materials and teaching actions assessed and validated by expert educators. Experimental results show consistent gains in lecture content quality, embodied teaching quality, assessment, and personalization over existing approaches, positioning LectūraAgents as a pedagogically well-grounded framework for personalized learning at scale.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 该论文主要解决现有教育智能体框架多局限于内容生成或虚拟模拟，缺乏针对个体学习者进行多模态和具身化教学的问题。这一问题之所以重要，是因为真实学习不仅需要动态调整教学内容，更需要通过书写、高亮等教学动作来引导注意力并提升学习效果。将自适应内容生成与具身化教学相结合，能够打破现有系统的局限，为现实教育场景提供真正贴合学生需求的教学体验。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有教育智能体框架多局限于文本生成或虚拟仿真、缺乏个性化具身教学互动的问题，提出将自适应内容生成与具身讲授相结合的设计思路。该方法借鉴了认知科学中的个性化学习理论、大型语言模型智能体协作机制以及数字环境中的具身教学研究成果。在设计上，作者模仿教授与学生的真实关系，构建了包含大语言模型、多层级智能体协作、教学动作与语音对齐算法及记忆模块的端到端分层架构，以实现从备课到授课的全流程个性化适配。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是模拟教授与学生的关系，由一个主导智能体协调多个专业子智能体，为不同学习者生成并动态调整个性化的教学内容与授课动作。整体流程分为备课与授课两个阶段：备课阶段由主导智能体带领团队完成内容规划、资料检索、课件生成与质量审核；授课阶段主导智能体根据学习者画像，在课件上实时执行书写或高亮等具身教学动作，并使动作与讲解语音精准同步，从而实现端到端的自适应个性化教学。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于构建了一种端到端的分层多智能体架构，能够根据学习者特征自动生成并动态调整个性化讲义。同时，它设计了教学动作与语音对齐机制，使虚拟教师能在讲解时同步执行书写、高亮等具身教学动作。与以往主要聚焦文本内容生成或虚拟对话仿真的研究不同，该框架首次将个性化内容创作与可解释的具身教学交付深度融合，实现了从备课到授课的全流程自适应教学。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种分层多智能体框架，通过协同的内容生成规划与创新的语音动作对齐算法，实现了面向个体学习者的端到端自适应具身教学。

Abstract

Effective personalized AI-assisted learning demands systems that can not only generate accurate learner-specific educational materials, but also dynamically adapt their instruction to diverse learners. However, existing educational agents have primarily focused on lecture content automation and simulations, which often fall short of modelling multimodal and embodied instructional methods tailored for the individual learner. To this end, we propose LectūraAgents - a multi-agent framework that enables personalized learning through end-to-end adaptive embodied teaching. At its core, LectūraAgents mirrors a professor-student relationship, in which a ProfessorAgent leads a collaborative team of specialized subordinate agents through research, planning, review, and embodied delivery of lecture contents that adapt to a learner's needs. The framework offers three main contributions: (1) a hierarchical multi-agent architecture for end-to-end personalized learning; (2) an adaptive embodied teaching mechanism, wherein the ProfessorAgent executes visible and pedagogically motivated teaching actions (e.g., handwrite, highlight, underline, etc.) over contents in a teaching environment; and (3) a Teaching Action-Speech Alignment (TASA) algorithm that employs salience-based heuristics and temporal semantic segmentation to generate coherent teaching action sequences aligned with learner profiles. We evaluate LectūraAgents on diverse courses at high school, undergraduate, and graduate levels using sample-specific rubric-based analysis; with generated lecture materials and teaching actions assessed and validated by expert educators. Experimental results show consistent gains in lecture content quality, embodied teaching quality, assessment, and personalization over existing approaches, positioning LectūraAgents as a pedagogically well-grounded framework for personalized learning at scale.

item.title: Text-Vision Co-Instructed Image Editing
item.author: Xie, Chenxi, Wu, Yuhui, Yi, Qiaosi, Zhang, Lei
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种文本与视觉协同指导的图像编辑方法，通过联合建模文本指令的语义意图和稀疏视觉指令的空间引导，实现了精确且忠实于意图的图像编辑。

背景: 现有的图像编辑方法主要分为基于文本指令和基于视觉提示两类。文本指令具有语义表达能力，但空间控制粒度较粗；视觉提示（如拖拽和点选）能提供精确的空间引导，但存在语义意图的固有模糊性。

目的: 统一文本和视觉提示的优势，实现精确且忠实于意图的图像编辑。

方法: 首先构建包含超过两万三千个样本的文本-视觉指令配对数据集，用于跨模态指令的对齐监督。然后提出TV-Edit框架，将基于拖拽或点选的视觉指令与图像文本语义相结合，转化为语义感知的控制表示，以增强预训练编辑骨干网络。

主要发现: TV-Edit在多个编辑骨干网络上均表现出更精确的空间控制、更少的指令模糊性和更强的结构一致性，显著优于仅基于文本或基于拖拽的基线方法。

结论: TV-Edit方法在精确性和意图忠实性方面均优于现有最先进的方法，为图像编辑提供了更可靠的评估基准和解决方案。

翻译: Existing image editing methods can be generally categorized into textual instruction-based and visual prompt-based ones. Textual instructions are semantically expressive, but are limited by the coarse granularity of spatial control of the editing results. In contrast, visual prompts such as drag and point can provide precise spatial guidance, but are limited by the inherent ambiguity in semantic intent. To unify the strength of textual and visual prompts, we present Text-Vision Co-Instructed Image Editing, which jointly models textual instructions as semantic intent and sparse visual instructions as spatial guidance, aiming to achieve precise and intent-faithful image manipulation. To this end, we first construct a textual-visual instruction paired dataset with more than 23K samples derived from dynamic videos, enabling aligned supervision for cross-modal instruction. We then propose TV-Edit, a Textual-Visual instruction unified Editing framework to contextualize drag or point-based visual instructions with image-text semantics and lift them into semantic-aware control representations for pretrained editing backbones. By integrating semantic intent and spatial constraints, TV-Edit leads to more precise spatial control, less instruction ambiguity, and stronger structural consistency than text-only or drag-based alternatives. Finally, we establish TV-Edit-Bench, a deliberately designed benchmark to evaluate semantic faithfulness, spatial alignment, and visual consistency with ground-truth references and controlled textual-visual variations for reliable assessment. Our experiments across multiple editing backbones demonstrate that TV-Edit consistently yields more precise and intent-faithful edits, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art instruction-based and drag-based baselines.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有图像编辑方法中单一指令模态无法完整表达用户意图的问题。它通过结合文本指令的语义表达与视觉提示的空间定位，实现更精准且符合用户真实意图的图像编辑。该问题在研究与现实中非常重要，因为纯文本编辑缺乏精细的空间控制，而纯视觉提示又容易忽略语义逻辑，两者单独使用都容易产生偏差或误操作。融合两者能显著降低指令歧义，提升编辑结果的准确性与一致性，使图像编辑工具更可靠、易用。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现纯文本指令擅长表达语义但空间控制粗糙，而视觉提示能精准定位却缺乏语义理解，因此决定将两者结合以消除单一模态的模糊性。在设计上，他们利用视频数据构建了图文与视觉提示对齐的大规模数据集，并设计了包含主编辑分支与控制分支的框架，将稀疏的视觉轨迹与图像内容及文本语义融合，生成密集的控制特征以引导预训练模型。该方法充分借鉴了现有的文本指令编辑和拖拽编辑技术，同时吸收了视频运动追踪、多模态大模型文本生成及闭环验证等成熟工具来构建数据与优化流程。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是将自然语言指令与稀疏视觉提示相结合，利用文本明确编辑的语义意图，同时借助视觉提示提供精确的空间位置引导，从而克服单一模态在空间控制或语义理解上的不足。整体流程首先从视频中构建包含图像对、点轨迹和对应文本的大规模配对数据集，随后通过一个包含主编辑分支与控制分支的框架进行训练，其中控制分支将稀疏点轨迹转化为空间特征并与图像及文本信息融合，最终引导预训练的图像编辑模型生成既符合语义又精准对齐空间约束的编辑结果。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于首次提出图文协同指令图像编辑任务，将自然语言指令用于表达语义意图，将稀疏视觉提示用于提供精确空间引导。相比以往仅依赖文本或仅依赖拖拽提示的方法，该工作通过构建大规模图文配对数据集和引入内容感知空间控制器，实现了语义与空间约束的统一建模。这使得模型在保持编辑意图准确性的同时，显著提升了空间控制的精度和结构一致性，且能即插即用适配现有主流编辑模型。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种融合文本语义指令与稀疏视觉空间提示的统一图像编辑框架，并配套构建了大规模配对数据集与评估基准，从而实现了更精准且忠实于用户意图的图像编辑。

Abstract

Existing image editing methods can be generally categorized into textual instruction-based and visual prompt-based ones. Textual instructions are semantically expressive, but are limited by the coarse granularity of spatial control of the editing results. In contrast, visual prompts such as drag and point can provide precise spatial guidance, but are limited by the inherent ambiguity in semantic intent. To unify the strength of textual and visual prompts, we present Text-Vision Co-Instructed Image Editing, which jointly models textual instructions as semantic intent and sparse visual instructions as spatial guidance, aiming to achieve precise and intent-faithful image manipulation. To this end, we first construct a textual-visual instruction paired dataset with more than 23K samples derived from dynamic videos, enabling aligned supervision for cross-modal instruction. We then propose TV-Edit, a Textual-Visual instruction unified Editing framework to contextualize drag or point-based visual instructions with image-text semantics and lift them into semantic-aware control representations for pretrained editing backbones. By integrating semantic intent and spatial constraints, TV-Edit leads to more precise spatial control, less instruction ambiguity, and stronger structural consistency than text-only or drag-based alternatives. Finally, we establish TV-Edit-Bench, a deliberately designed benchmark to evaluate semantic faithfulness, spatial alignment, and visual consistency with ground-truth references and controlled textual-visual variations for reliable assessment. Our experiments across multiple editing backbones demonstrate that TV-Edit consistently yields more precise and intent-faithful edits, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art instruction-based and drag-based baselines.

item.title: The Price of Anarchy in Disaggregated Inference
item.author: Georgiou, Athos
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文对解耦推理架构进行了博弈论分析，以NVIDIA Dynamo为案例，通过建模资源分配、缓存和路由三个游戏，揭示了GPU饱和对系统性能的影响，并设计了自适应控制器优化路由策略，显著降低了价格之乱并提升了吞吐量。

背景: 解耦推理架构将预填充和解码阶段物理分离到不同的GPU池中，形成共享固定硬件预算的竞争代理。

目的: 对解耦推理架构进行形式化的博弈论分析，并设计自适应控制器以优化系统性能。

方法: 将解耦服务建模为三个耦合游戏：预填充与解码池之间的双玩家资源游戏、分层KV缓存上的自私缓存游戏以及具有正外部性的请求路由拥塞游戏。通过实证验证后两个游戏，对资源游戏进行解析分析。基于分析设计自适应控制器，实时检测饱和转换并调整路由参数。在运行Dynamo的3节点NVIDIA B200集群上进行实例化测试。

主要发现: GPU饱和引发状态转换，改变游戏的收益结构。低于饱和时，自私行为的无效率价格有界；在饱和状态下，超线性延迟和缓存外部性导致无效率价格估计值上升。自适应路由将模型转移到更好的操作点。在70B 1P/5D拓扑中，饱和阶段的无效率价格估计值下降3.1倍，吞吐量成本为13%。在70B 1P/2D中，无效率价格估计值下降2.2倍，TTFT P99下降7.6倍。

结论: 自适应控制器通过实时检测饱和转换并调整路由参数，能够有效优化解耦推理架构的性能，显著降低无效率价格并提升吞吐量。

翻译: Disaggregated inference architectures physically separate prefill and decode phases onto distinct GPU pools, creating competing agents that share a fixed hardware budget. We provide, to our knowledge, the first formal game-theoretic analysis of this architecture, using NVIDIA Dynamo as a concrete case study. We model disaggregated serving as three coupled games: a two-player resource game between prefill and decode pools, a selfish caching game over the hierarchical KV cache, and a congestion game with positive externalities for request routing. We empirically validate the latter two; the P/D resource game is treated analytically. We characterize how GPU saturation induces regime transitions that shift the game payoff structure: below saturation, selfish behavior has bounded Price of Anarchy; at saturation, superlinear latency and cache externalities drive our empirical estimator Price of Anarchy upward. Based on this analysis, we design an adaptive controller that detects saturation transitions in real time and adjusts routing parameters accordingly, shifting from cache-affinity exploitation to load-balanced congestion avoidance. We instantiate our framework on a 3-node NVIDIA B200 cluster running Dynamo with two models, Nemotron-4-340B and Llama-3.1-70B, and find the same three-regime Price of Anarchy structure with the same first post-knee grid point on both models. Adaptive routing shifts each model to a better operating point. Our strongest result is on the 70B 1P/5D topology, where Price of Anarchy drops 3.1x in the saturated phase at a 13% throughput cost. On the 70B 1P/2D, Price of Anarchy drops 2.2x and TTFT P99 drops 7.6x.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决的是大规模大语言模型推理中，将预填充和解码阶段物理分离的架构所引发的资源竞争与路由效率问题。通过博弈论视角，论文量化了系统在各组件基于局部利益进行路由时的效率损失，并设计了能实时检测负载饱和并自动调整路由策略的控制器。该问题在现实中至关重要，因为分离式架构已成为高吞吐推理的主流方案，但缺乏对其底层竞争机制的理论解释；本研究不仅填补了该领域的理论空白，还为提升实际系统的延迟与吞吐量提供了可落地的自适应优化方法。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者将分离式推理架构中不同计算阶段的资源竞争与请求分配视为多智能体博弈系统，并采用机制设计视角，将现有路由器的贪心决策类比为博弈中的最优响应过程。在方法设计上，他们借鉴了算法博弈论中理论用于分析而非直接计算

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是将分离式推理架构中的资源分配、缓存管理与请求路由抽象为博弈模型，利用无政府状态代价指标量化系统因局部最优决策导致的效率损失，并据此设计自适应调控机制。整体实现流程为：在真实集群上运行推理服务并采集运行指标，实时监测系统是否跨越计算或带宽饱和的临界点，一旦检测到状态切换，控制器便动态调整路由策略参数，使系统从优先利用缓存命中转向负载均衡的拥塞规避，从而在保障延迟的同时提升整体吞吐。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文首次将博弈论框架系统性地应用于解耦式大型语言模型推理架构，将计算资源分配、缓存管理与请求路由建模为三个相互耦合的博弈过程，并量化了系统自私调度带来的效率损失。与以往聚焦于秒级至分钟级作业调度的研究不同，本文专门针对微秒至毫秒级的单次请求路由决策进行分析，填补了推理系统实时调度领域的理论空白。文章并未采用计算复杂的均衡求解算法，而是将博弈论作为分析工具揭示系统负载饱和时的性能跃变规律，并据此设计了能够实时感知负载状态并动态优化路由策略的自适应控制器。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文首次对解耦推理架构进行博弈论分析，实证揭示了计算节点饱和度对路由效率的影响机制，并据此设计了一种能实时检测饱和度并动态调整路由策略的自适应控制器。

Abstract

Disaggregated inference architectures physically separate prefill and decode phases onto distinct GPU pools, creating competing "agents" that share a fixed hardware budget. We provide, to our knowledge, the first formal game-theoretic analysis of this architecture, using NVIDIA Dynamo as a concrete case study. We model disaggregated serving as three coupled games: a two-player resource game between prefill and decode pools, a selfish caching game over the hierarchical KV cache, and a congestion game with positive externalities for request routing. We empirically validate the latter two; the P/D resource game is treated analytically (Section 9.2). We characterize how GPU saturation induces regime transitions that shift the game's payoff structure: below saturation, selfish behavior has bounded Price of Anarchy (PoA); at saturation, superlinear latency and cache externalities drive our empirical estimator PoA-hat (defined in Section 6.4) upward. Based on this analysis, we design an adaptive controller that detects saturation transitions in real time and adjusts routing parameters accordingly, shifting from cache-affinity exploitation to load-balanced congestion avoidance. We instantiate our framework on a 3-node NVIDIA B200 cluster running Dynamo with two models, Nemotron-4-340B (TP=8, full-node workers with cross-InfiniBand KV transfers) and Llama-3.1-70B (TP=4), and find the same three-regime PoA-hat structure with the same first post-knee grid point (C=128) on both models. Adaptive routing shifts each model to a better operating point. Our strongest result is on the 70B 1P/5D topology, where PoA-hat drops 3.1x (66.4 to 21.5) in the saturated phase at a 13% throughput cost. On the 70B 1P/2D, PoA-hat drops 2.2x and TTFT P99 drops 7.6x (see Section 8.5).

item.title: Timestamp-Aware Spatio-Temporal Graph Contrastive Learning for Network Intrusion Detection
item.author: Jianli Dai, Guangwei Wu, Jiacheng Li, Weiping Wang, An He, Xinjun Xiao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出一种基于图神经网络的自监督网络入侵检测框架，通过利用真实时间戳构建时序图，结合E-GraphSAGE和LSTM编码器提取时空信息，并采用多视图图对比学习及自适应权重优化策略，在多个数据集上显著优于现有自监督方法，性能媲美监督学习最先进方法，同时保持高计算效率。

背景: 图神经网络因能有效建模网络流量流之间的关系结构，被广泛应用于网络入侵检测系统。然而，现有方法多将流量视为时间独立，限制了应对演化攻击行为的能力；且依赖监督或半监督学习，泛化到未见攻击的能力受限。

目的: 解决现有基于图神经网络的入侵检测方法在时间依赖性建模和泛化能力方面的不足，提出一种能显式利用真实时间戳的自监督框架，以捕捉时序连续性、保持结构一致性并提升泛化与鲁棒性。

方法: 根据真实时间戳构建时序图；采用基于E-GraphSAGE和LSTM的编码器提取时空依赖，避免引入高时间成本的注意力机制；引入多视图图对比学习，联合进行时序、空间和特征对比以捕捉时序连续性、保持结构一致性并提升泛化与鲁棒性；设计基于梯度范数的自适应权重策略优化对比损失权重。

主要发现: 在四个具有真实时间戳的代表性网络入侵检测数据集上的实验表明，该方法显著优于现有自监督方法，性能与监督学习最先进图神经网络方法相当，同时保持高计算效率。

结论: 该自监督图神经网络框架能有效利用时间信息，提升网络入侵检测的泛化能力和鲁棒性，在保持高效计算的同时达到与监督方法相当的性能，为处理演化攻击行为提供了有效方案。

翻译: Given their effectiveness in modeling the relational structure among network traffic flows, graph neural networks (GNNs) have been widely adopted in network intrusion detection systems (NIDSs). However, most existing GNN-based NIDS approaches focus on the relational structure of traffic flows, and treat them as temporally independent, which limits their ability to cope with evolving attack behaviors. Moreover, their reliance on supervised or semi-supervised learning often restricts generalization to unseen attacks. To address these limitations, we propose a novel self-supervised GNN-based framework. To the best of our knowledge, the proposed model is among the first self-supervised GNN-based NIDS models to explicitly leverage real timestamps, which provides faithful temporal dependencies for representation learning. We first construct a series of temporal graphs from network traffic flows according to their timestamps, and then employ an E-GraphSAGE and LSTM based encoder to fully extract temporal information and spatial dependencies of network traffic, without introducing time-costly attention mechanisms. A multi-view graph contrastive learning (GCL) scheme is introduced, where temporal, spatial, and feature contrasts are jointly performed to capture temporal continuity, preserve structural consistency, and improve the generalization and robustness of the learned representations, respectively. In addition, a gradient-norm-based adaptive weighting strategy is designed to optimize the contrastive loss weights. Experimental results on four representative NIDS datasets with real timestamps demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing self-supervised approaches and achieves performance comparable to the supervised state-of-the-art GNN method, while maintaining high computational efficiency.

Abstract

Given their effectiveness in modeling the relational structure among network traffic flows, graph neural networks (GNNs) have been widely adopted in network intrusion detection systems (NIDSs). However, most existing GNN-based NIDS approaches focus on the relational structure of traffic flows, and treat them as temporally independent, which limits their ability to cope with evolving attack behaviors. Moreover, their reliance on supervised or semi-supervised learning often restricts generalization to unseen attacks. To address these limitations, we propose a novel self-supervised GNN-based framework. To the best of our knowledge, the proposed model is among the first self-supervised GNN-based NIDS models to explicitly leverage real timestamps, which provides faithful temporal dependencies for representation learning. We first construct a series of temporal graphs from network traffic flows according to their timestamps, and then employ an E-GraphSAGE and LSTM based encoder to fully extract temporal information and spatial dependencies of network traffic, without introducing time-costly attention mechanisms. A multi-view graph contrastive learning (GCL) scheme is introduced, where temporal, spatial, and feature contrasts are jointly performed to capture temporal continuity, preserve structural consistency, and improve the generalization and robustness of the learned representations, respectively. In addition, a gradient-norm-based adaptive weighting strategy is designed to optimize the contrastive loss weights.
