Experimental results on four representative NIDS datasets with real timestamps demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing self-supervised approaches and achieves performance comparable to the supervised state-of-the-art GNN method, while maintaining high computational efficiency.

item.title: RepSelect: Robust LLM Unlearning via Representation Selectivity
item.author: Sondej, Filip, Yang, Yushi, Mahdi, Adam
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为RepSelect的新方法，旨在使大语言模型在不损害通用能力的情况下深度遗忘特定知识和价值观。该方法通过隔离与遗忘集相关的特定表示，解决了现有方法易被逆转且破坏通用能力的问题。

背景: 使大语言模型在不牺牲通用能力的情况下深度遗忘特定知识和价值观是机器遗忘领域的核心挑战。然而，当前方法容易被微调或少样本提示逆转，表明其遗忘程度较浅。

目的: 识别现有方法易被逆转且破坏通用能力的根本原因，并提出一种能够隔离遗忘集特定表示、保持通用能力完整并限制微调恢复能力的新方法。

方法: 提出RepSelect（表示选择性）方法，在每次更新前通过折叠权重梯度的主要主成分来隔离与遗忘集相关的特定表示。

主要发现: 在生物危害知识和滥用倾向两类遗忘任务上，针对四种不同架构的大语言模型进行评估。与五种流行基线方法相比，RepSelect在重新学习后的答案准确率降低幅度比最强基线大四到五十倍，并且对少样本提示攻击具有近乎完美的鲁棒性。

结论: 针对选择性表示是实现深度且稳健的大语言模型遗忘的重要一步。

翻译: Making large language models (LLMs) deeply forget specific knowledge and values without sacrificing general capabilities remains a central challenge in unlearning. However, current methods are easily reversed by fine-tuning or few-shot prompting, suggesting their forgetting is only shallow. We identify the root cause. Existing methods target representations shared with both the retain set and the subspace recovered by a fine-tuning attacker, making unlearning both disruptive to general capabilities and easy to reverse. We propose RepSelect (Representation Selectivity), isolates forget-set-specific representations by collapsing top principal components of weight gradients before each update, leaving general capabilities intact while limiting what fine-tuning can recover. We evaluate across two forget categories, biohazardous knowledge and abusive tendencies, and four model families spanning dense and Mixture-of-Experts architectures (Llama 3, Qwen 3.5, Gemma 4 E4B, DeepSeek V2 Lite). Compared to five popular baselines (GradDiff, NPO, SimNPO, RMU, UNDIAL), RepSelect achieves a 4-50x larger reduction in post-relearning answer accuracy than the strongest baseline, and is near-perfectly robust to few-shot prompting attacks. Targeting selective representations is thus an important step towards deep and robust LLM forgetting.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决大语言模型在删除特定有害知识时，无法同时实现深度遗忘、保持通用能力以及抵抗重新学习的问题。现有方法往往只能浅层抑制，容易被微调或少样本提示轻易恢复。该问题在现实中至关重要，因为生物安全、数据隐私和版权等法规要求模型必须真正彻底地删除敏感内容，同时不能损害其正常功能，且需防止恶意攻击者重新获取被禁用的知识。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者通过研究发现，现有方法主要修改高方差表示，但这些表示与通用知识和攻击者恢复路径高度重叠，导致遗忘不彻底且易被逆转。基于此，他们设计出该方法，在每次参数更新前对遗忘数据的梯度进行矩阵分解并压制高方差方向，仅保留与遗忘内容强相关的低方差方向进行更新，从而在保留通用能力的同时提升抗攻击性。该方法在评估环节借用了统一的开源测试框架，在行为激发环节使用了低秩适配器技术，但核心的表示筛选机制是作者针对上述痛点独立提出的。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是通过表示选择性隔离仅与遗忘数据相关的特征，主动抑制与通用知识共享的高方差方向，从而在保留模型通用能力的同时阻断攻击者通过微调或提示恢复被遗忘知识的路径。整体实现流程为：先利用轻量适配器激活遗忘数据中的有害行为，接着计算模型在该数据上的权重梯度，对梯度进行数学分解以识别高方差主成分，随后在参数更新前将这些高方差方向进行折叠抑制，最后仅使用过滤后的梯度更新模型并移除适配器。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种名为RepSelect的模型遗忘方法，通过奇异值分解分析遗忘数据的权重梯度，并在每次参数更新前主动压制高方差的主成分。与以往方法直接针对高方差方向进行遗忘不同，RepSelect将参数更新严格限制在低方差且更专属于遗忘数据的子空间中。这种做法有效避免了破坏模型的一般能力，同时切断了攻击者通过微调或提示重新恢复被遗忘知识的途径，从而在遗忘深度、能力保持和抗攻击鲁棒性上实现了显著突破。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种名为RepSelect的大语言模型遗忘方法，通过过滤掉与通用能力高度重叠的高方差表示，仅针对遗忘数据特有的低方差表示进行参数更新，从而在保持模型通用能力的同时实现了深度且难以被重学攻击恢复的遗忘效果。

Abstract

Making large language models (LLMs) deeply forget specific knowledge and values without sacrificing general capabilities remains a central challenge in unlearning. However, current methods are easily reversed by fine-tuning or few-shot prompting, suggesting their forgetting is only shallow. We identify the root cause. Existing methods target representations shared with both the retain set and the subspace recovered by a fine-tuning attacker, making unlearning both disruptive to general capabilities and easy to reverse. We propose RepSelect (Representation Selectivity), isolates forget-set-specific representations by collapsing top principal components of weight gradients before each update, leaving general capabilities intact while limiting what fine-tuning can recover. We evaluate across two forget categories, biohazardous knowledge and abusive tendencies, and four model families spanning dense and Mixture-of-Experts architectures (Llama 3, Qwen 3.5, Gemma 4 E4B, DeepSeek V2 Lite). Compared to five popular baselines (GradDiff, NPO, SimNPO, RMU, UNDIAL), RepSelect achieves a 4-50x larger reduction in post-relearning answer accuracy than the strongest baseline, and is near-perfectly robust to few-shot prompting attacks. Targeting selective representations is thus an important step towards deep and robust LLM forgetting.

item.title: ACE-Ego-0: Unifying Egocentric Human and Robotic Data for VLA Pretraining
item.author: Li, Hao, Zhao, Ganlong, Liu, Yufei, Hou, Haotian, Ye, Guoquan, Fang, Tongyan, Liu, Chunxiao, Huang, Siyuan, Liu, Jianbo, Wang, Xiaogang, Li, Hongsheng
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种统一的视觉语言动作模型预训练框架ACE-EGO-0，通过结合异构数据源（机器人数据和人类视频数据）来提升模型性能。

背景: 视觉语言动作模型受益于大规模多样化的具身数据，但机器人轨迹收集成本高且劳动密集。近期研究表明，大规模第一人称人类视频在预训练阶段能提供互补的真实世界监督信号。然而，由于动作空间、身体结构、时间动态和监督质量等方面的差异，在人类和机器人数据上进行联合训练仍然具有挑战性。

目的: 构建一个统一的预训练框架，以联合利用异构数据源，特别是从第一人称人类视频中提取大规模预训练监督信号，并解决联合训练中的挑战。

方法: 构建了一个可扩展的第一人称视频到动作的流水线，将原始人类视频转换为机器人格式的伪动作轨迹。使用基于相机空间动作、形态条件和时间对齐动作分块的统一动作表示，使这些标签与机器人演示具有可比性。提出了一种可靠性感知的训练目标，通过人类辅助损失将监督集中在可靠信号上，以鲁棒地利用来自第一人称人类视频的噪声伪动作监督。

主要发现: 在4530小时的机器人和仿真数据以及1480小时的第一人称人类数据上实例化ACE-EGO-0。实验表明，在可靠性感知加权下结合大规模人类监督， consistently 提升了统一联合预训练和监督微调的性能。ACE-EGO-0在RoboCasa GR1 TableTop和RoboTwin 2.0上达到了最先进的性能，并展示了向真实世界双手机器人操作的良好迁移能力。

结论: ACE-EGO-0通过结合大规模人类监督信号，有效提升了视觉语言动作模型的性能，并在多个基准测试和真实世界任务中表现出色。

翻译: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models benefit from large-scale and diverse embodied data, yet scaling robot trajectory collection is costly and labor-intensive. Recent advances show that large-scale egocentric human videos provide complementary real-world supervision in pretraining. However, joint training on human and robot data remains challenging due to divergences in action spaces, embodiment structures, temporal dynamics, and supervision quality. We introduce ACE-EGO-0, a unified VLA pretraining framework jointly leveraging heterogeneous data sources. To extract large-scale pretraining supervision from egocentric human videos, we build a scalable egocentric video-to-action pipeline that converts raw human videos into robot-format pseudo-action trajectories. To make these labels comparable with robot demonstrations, ACE-EGO-0 uses a unified action representation based on camera-space actions, morphology conditioning, and time-aligned action chunking. To robustly leverage noisy pseudo-action supervision from egocentric human videos, we formulate a reliability-aware training objective with a human auxiliary loss that concentrates supervision on reliable signals. We instantiate ACE-EGO-0 on 4.53K hours of robot and simulation data, together with 1.48K hours of pseudo-action-labeled egocentric human data. Experiments show that incorporating large-scale human supervision under reliability-aware weighting consistently improves both unified joint pretraining and supervised fine-tuning. ACE-EGO-0 achieves state-of-the-art performance on RoboCasa GR1 TableTop and RoboTwin 2.0, while demonstrating strong transfer to real-world bimanual manipulation.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决如何将大规模第一人称人类视频与机器人演示数据统一训练的问题，以克服两者在动作空间、身体结构、时间动态和监督质量上的差异。该问题在研究中非常重要，因为单纯收集机器人数据成本高昂且效率低下，严重限制了模型的泛化能力。通过有效融合低成本的人类视频数据，可以大幅提升视觉语言动作模型的训练效果，并增强其在真实世界复杂任务中的操作与迁移能力。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对机器人演示数据收集昂贵且人类第一视角视频存在动作空间、身体结构、时间节奏和标签噪声等差异的问题，设计了统一的数据对齐与训练框架。他们借鉴了现有跨具身视觉语言动作模型以及从人类视频中提取动作代理的相关研究，但指出这些工作未能同时解决数据表示异构和监督质量不匹配的挑战。为此，作者通过统一相机空间坐标、引入形态条件编码和时间对齐分块来消除空间与结构差异，并设计可靠性感知训练目标，让高保真机器人数据主导核心训练，同时利用人类视频提供安全的辅助监督。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是通过统一动作表示和可靠性感知训练目标，将大规模第一人称人类视频与机器人数据融合，以解决两者在空间、结构和监督质量上的差异。整体流程首先通过五阶段流水线将人类视频转化为机器人兼容的伪动作轨迹，接着利用相机空间坐标、形态条件编码和时间对齐技术实现多源数据的统一表示，最后在训练时以高质量机器人数据为主监督信号，并根据数据质量动态加权人类伪动作作为辅助监督，完成模型预训练与微调。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该框架的关键创新在于提出统一动作表示与可靠性感知训练目标。统一动作表示通过相机空间坐标、形态条件编码和时间对齐分块，系统对齐了多源数据在空间、结构和时间上的差异。可靠性感知训练目标则针对人类视频提取的伪动作噪声，通过动态加权将高质量机器人数据作为主要监督，仅将人类数据作为辅助监督。相比以往工作，该方法不仅联合解决了异构数据表示差异，还首次显式区分并处理了不同数据源的监督质量差异，避免了噪声直接污染模型，从而实现了更高效的大规模混合数据预训练。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种统一框架，通过空间与时间对齐的动作表示以及可靠性感知训练目标，将大规模第一人称人类视频与机器人数据有效融合进行预训练，显著提升了机器人的操作性能与泛化能力。

Abstract

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models benefit from large-scale and diverse embodied data, yet scaling robot trajectory collection is costly and labor-intensive. Recent advances show that large-scale egocentric human videos provide complementary real-world supervision in pretraining. However, joint training on human and robot data remains challenging due to divergences in action spaces, embodiment structures, temporal dynamics, and supervision quality. We introduce ACE-EGO-0, a unified VLA pretraining framework jointly leveraging heterogeneous data sources. To extract large-scale pretraining supervision from egocentric human videos, we build a scalable egocentric video-to-action pipeline that converts raw human videos into robot-format pseudo-action trajectories. To make these labels comparable with robot demonstrations, ACE-EGO-0 uses a unified action representation based on camera-space actions, morphology conditioning, and time-aligned action chunking. To robustly leverage noisy pseudo-action supervision from egocentric human videos, we formulate a reliability-aware training objective with a human auxiliary loss that concentrates supervision on reliable signals. We instantiate ACE-EGO-0 on 4.53K hours of robot and simulation data, together with 1.48K hours of pseudo-action-labeled egocentric human data. Experiments show that incorporating large-scale human supervision under reliability-aware weighting consistently improves both unified joint pretraining and supervised fine-tuning. ACE-EGO-0 achieves state-of-the-art performance on RoboCasa GR1 TableTop and RoboTwin 2.0, while demonstrating strong transfer to real-world bimanual manipulation.

item.title: Phenotyping TPF via Self-Supervised Learning: A Label-Agnostic Framework with Expert Validation
item.author: Miral Elnakib, Muhammad Saad, Ahmad Al-Kabbany
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本研究提出并验证了一种无标签的自监督学习框架，用于胫骨平台骨折的影像表型分析。该框架通过对比学习从X光图像中直接学习骨折特征，无需依赖人工标注的分类标签。研究发现该方法能稳定识别出四种具有临床意义的影像表型，且与传统分类体系正交，为骨折评估提供了可重复且可解释的补充手段。

背景: 人工智能在胫骨平台骨折特征分析中的潜力尚未完全释放，主要受限于对标注数据集的根本依赖。传统的分类方案如Schatzker和AO/OTA存在观察者间变异性，导致监督模型学习的是人类意见分歧而非稳定的骨折形态。

目的: 设计、实施并验证一种无标签框架，以消除对人工标注标签的依赖，直接从影像数据中学习骨折表示。

方法: 使用经过数据清洗的154张膝关节X光片，对基于RadImageNet预训练的ResNet-50编码器进行微调，采用SimCLR对比学习目标。随后进行UMAP降维和k-means聚类，以发现影像衍生的表型。通过两名独立临床医生的盲审专家审查协议评估表型的有效性。

主要发现: 识别出四种影像衍生的表型，具有稳健的稳定性（引导指数ARI为0.319加减0.041）和较强的内部凝聚力（轮廓系数为0.511）。在盲审条件下，两位评审者的连贯性评分为3至5分。其中一个表型被一致识别为具有粉碎性特征，这是一种无需监督信号即可隔离的高复杂度特征。与传统Schatzker标签的分区比较显示ARI为0.013，证实了与传统分类边界的正交性。

结论: 无标签自监督学习表型分析作为一种可重复且临床可解释的方法，可作为传统分类体系的补充。

翻译: The full potential of artificial intelligence in tibial plateau fracture characterisation remains unrealised, constrained by a fundamental dependency on labelled datasets whose consistency cannot be guaranteed: conventional classification schemes such as Schatzker and AO/OTA suffer from inter-observer variability, causing supervised models to learn human disagreement rather than stable fracture morphology. We design, implement, and validate a label-agnostic framework that eliminates this constraint by learning fracture representations directly from imaging data without observer-assigned labels. A RadImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50 encoder is fine-tuned on 154 cleaned knee radiographs using the SimCLR contrastive objective, preceded by a data cleaning protocol and followed by UMAP dimensionality reduction and k-means clustering to discover four imaging-derived phenotypes. Phenotype validity is assessed through a blinded expert review protocol administered to two independent clinicians. The four phenotypes demonstrate robust stability (bootstrap ARI = 0.319 +/- 0.041), strong internal cohesion (silhouette = 0.511), and coherence ratings of 3-5/5 from both reviewers under blinded conditions; one phenotype was unanimously identified as exhibiting comminution -- a high-complexity feature isolated without any supervisory signal. Inter-partition comparison against Schatzker labels yields ARI = 0.013, confirming orthogonality to conventional classification boundaries. Notably, expert reviewers anchored to established classification vocabularies perceived imaging-derived groups as heterogeneous precisely where Schatzker alignment was lowest, suggesting that Schatzker-trained perception and label-agnostic embedding geometry measure orthogonal dimensions. These findings establish label-agnostic SSL phenotyping as a reproducible and clinically interpretable complement to conventional classification.

Abstract

The full potential of artificial intelligence in tibial plateau fracture characterisation remains unrealised, constrained by a fundamental dependency on labelled datasets whose consistency cannot be guaranteed: conventional classification schemes such as Schatzker and AO/OTA suffer from inter-observer variability, causing supervised models to learn human disagreement rather than stable fracture morphology. We design, implement, and validate a label-agnostic framework that eliminates this constraint by learning fracture representations directly from imaging data without observer-assigned labels. A RadImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50 encoder is fine-tuned on 154 cleaned knee radiographs using the SimCLR contrastive objective, preceded by a data cleaning protocol and followed by UMAP dimensionality reduction and k-means clustering to discover four imaging-derived phenotypes. Phenotype validity is assessed through a blinded expert review protocol administered to two independent clinicians. The four phenotypes demonstrate robust stability (bootstrap ARI = 0.319 +/- 0.041), strong internal cohesion (silhouette = 0.511), and coherence ratings of 3-5/5 from both reviewers under blinded conditions; one phenotype was unanimously identified as exhibiting comminution -- a high-complexity feature isolated without any supervisory signal. Inter-partition comparison against Schatzker labels yields ARI = 0.013, confirming orthogonality to conventional classification boundaries. Notably, expert reviewers anchored to established classification vocabularies perceived imaging-derived groups as heterogeneous precisely where Schatzker alignment was lowest, suggesting that Schatzker-trained perception and label-agnostic embedding geometry measure orthogonal dimensions. These findings establish label-agnostic SSL phenotyping as a reproducible and clinically interpretable complement to conventional classification.

item.title: ProCUA-SFT Technical Report
item.author: Jung, Jaehun, Lu, Ximing, Cui, Brandon, Khalifa, Muhammad, Zhang, Shaokun, Zhang, Hao, Xu, Jin, Deshmukh, Amala Sanjay, Sapra, Karan, Tao, Andrew, Choi, Yejin, Kautz, Jan, Liu, Mingjie, Dong, Yi
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出ProCUA-SFT数据集，包含310万步级监督微调样本，通过自动化流程从2484种应用组合的9.3万条合成轨迹中提取，用于训练计算机使用代理。

背景: 训练计算机使用代理需要大规模多样化轨迹数据，但现有最大公开资源AgentNet在监督微调时会导致负迁移，使OSWorld成功率从26.3%降至8-10%。

目的: 解决AgentNet数据导致的负迁移问题，提升计算机使用代理在桌面环境中的任务成功率。

方法: 构建自动化数据生成流程，在真实桌面环境中合成带内容种子（如电子表格、演示文稿）的任务，通过二元前置条件检查验证可行性，使用单一视觉语言模型生成目标、判断条件和执行轨迹，并将轨迹扩展为步骤前缀样本。

主要发现: 在UI-TARS 7B模型上对ProCUA-SFT进行一个周期的微调，OSWorld成功率提升至45.0%，较基线模型提高18.7个百分点，较使用AgentNet训练的模型提高超过35%。

结论: ProCUA-SFT数据集有效提升了计算机使用代理的性能，其子集已被用于Nemotron 3 Nano Omni模型的训练，增强了其计算机使用能力。

翻译: unknown

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决计算机桌面交互智能体在训练时因缺乏高质量且可行的数据而导致性能下降的问题。现有公开数据集直接用于微调反而会引起性能倒退，而简单的自动生成数据又常包含无法实现的任务。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为桌面交互数据的收集成本极高且难以规模化，突破数据瓶颈是提升智能体处理复杂真实任务能力的关键，对推动自动化办公和通用人工智能落地具有现实意义。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有公开数据集会导致模型训练时性能不升反降，且传统自动生成的任务常因引用不存在的文件而不可行。为此，他们设计了一套全自动数据流水线，核心思路是统一使用单一视觉语言模型同时负责生成目标、验证前置条件并执行操作，从而消除规划与执行的能力差距。在数据构建上，他们借鉴了现有桌面配置框架与公开的真实文档资源，将复杂的真实电子表格和演示文稿注入初始桌面环境。该方法在参考现有图形界面智能体与合成数据研究的基础上，通过引入循环可行性验证和真实内容播种，有效解决了任务不可行与多样性不足的问题。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用单一视觉语言模型同时负责生成可验证的桌面任务与执行操作，并结合真实复杂文件初始化桌面环境，从而高效生成大规模且切实可行的高质量训练数据。整体流程首先用真实电子表格和演示文稿等外部内容初始化虚拟桌面；接着由模型生成任务目标及多项二进制前置条件，并通过独立验证环节反复重试直至条件全部满足；随后同一模型在桌面上逐步执行该任务生成完整轨迹；最后将每条轨迹拆解为多步上下文样本，用于微调计算机使用代理模型。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于构建了一套全自动的合成数据生成流水线，核心包括基于运行中前置条件验证的任务生成机制、使用真实复杂文档初始化桌面环境，以及采用单一视觉语言模型同时负责目标生成与轨迹执行。与以往工作相比，该方法通过即时验证任务可行性而非事后过滤，有效避免了生成不可行任务的问题；同时通过引入真实外部内容打破了默认空状态的局限，并实现了规划与执行能力的统一。最终该方法构建了目前规模最大的开源桌面智能体训练数据集，显著提升了模型在真实桌面任务上的成功率。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了ProCUA-SFT数据集，通过全自动流程生成并严格验证了三百一十万条桌面智能体训练样本，有效克服了现有数据的负迁移问题，显著提升了智能体在真实桌面环境中的任务成功率。

Abstract

Training computer-use agents (CUAs) -- models that interact with graphical desktops through screenshots and keyboard/mouse actions -- requires large-scale, diverse trajectory data collected in full desktop environments. The largest public resource, AgentNet (22.5K human trajectories), leads to negative transfer when used for supervised fine-tuning (SFT): continuing training UI-TARS 7B on AgentNet causes OSWorld success rate to fall from 26.3% to 8-10%. We present ProCUA-SFT, a dataset of 3.1M step-level SFT samples distilled from 93K synthetic trajectories across 2,484 application combinations. The dataset is produced by a fully automated pipeline that (i) synthesizes grounded tasks on live desktops seeded with real-world content -- 912 spreadsheets from SpreadsheetBench, approximately 10K permissively-licensed presentations from Zenodo10K, and multi-application OSWorld configs -- and (ii) verifies each task's feasibility through binary precondition checking before rollout. A single VLM (Kimi-K2.5) serves as goal generator, precondition judge, and trajectory executor, eliminating planner-actor capability gaps. Each trajectory is expanded into step-prefix samples that exactly reproduce the context layout seen at inference time. Fine-tuning UI-TARS 7B on ProCUA-SFT for one epoch yields 45.0% on OSWorld -- an 18.7 percentage-point improvement over the base model and over 35% above AgentNet-trained counterparts. A subset of ProCUA was incorporated into the training data for the Nemotron 3 Nano Omni model, contributing to its computer-use capabilities.

item.title: Learning a Maximum Entropy Model for Visual Textures using Diffusion
item.author: Xinyuan Zhao, Eero P. Simoncelli
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种无监督学习统计量的原则性方法，用于约束最大熵概率模型，以生成高质量的视觉纹理图像。

背景: 视觉纹理是图像中空间均匀且包含重复元素（如草地、树皮）的区域，在识别和分析材料和物体时提供重要线索。现有的纹理模型通常从单张纹理图像中提取统计量，并通过匹配这些统计量生成视觉上相似的样本，但这些统计量要么是手工设计的，要么基于为其他目的（如物体识别）预训练的神经网络。

目的: 开发一种无监督学习统计量的方法，用于约束最大熵概率模型，以生成高质量的视觉纹理图像。

方法: 利用生成扩散模型中开发的方法，推导出训练和采样过程，并与传统的通过匹配统计量进行采样的方法进行比较。

主要发现: 尽管训练模型仅包含五百一十二个统计量，但其生成的纹理图像质量与或优于当前最先进模型（约十七万七千个统计量）。通过合成对一种模型不可区分但对另一种模型最大差异的图像，直接比较两种模型的优缺点。此外，与之前的统计纹理模型不同，该模型表示空间中的直线轨迹可以生成均匀纹理样本，平滑插值两个端点的特征。

结论: 该方法在生成高质量视觉纹理图像方面具有显著优势，且模型紧凑，能够有效插值纹理特征。

翻译: Visual textures -- spatially homogeneous image regions containing repeated elements (e.g. a field of grass, the bark of a tree) -- are ubiquitous in visual scenes and provide important cues for recognizing and analyzing materials and objects. A number of existing texture models extract essential statistics from a single texture image, and can then generate high-quality samples that are visually similar to the original by matching these statistics. However, their statistics are either hand-designed or based on a network pretrained for another purpose (e.g., object recognition). Here, we develop the first principled method for unsupervised learning of a set of statistics that are used to constrain a maximum entropy probability model. We leverage methods developed for generative diffusion models to derive training and sampling procedures, and compare these to the traditional method of sampling via matching the statistics. Despite the compactness of our trained model (512 statistics), it generates texture images whose quality is as good as or better than the current state-of-the-art model (~177k statistics). A more direct comparison of the two models, obtained by synthesizing images that are indistinguishable for one model but maximally different for the other, reveals their relative strengths and weaknesses. Finally, we show that unlike previous statistical texture models, a straight trajectory in the representation space of our model generates homogeneous texture samples that interpolate smoothly between the features of the two end points.

Abstract

Visual textures -- spatially homogeneous image regions containing repeated elements (e.g. a field of grass, the bark of a tree) -- are ubiquitous in visual scenes and provide important cues for recognizing and analyzing materials and objects. A number of existing texture models extract essential statistics from a single texture image, and can then generate high-quality samples that are visually similar to the original by matching these statistics. However, their statistics are either hand-designed or based on a network pretrained for another purpose (e.g., object recognition). Here, we develop the first principled method for unsupervised learning of a set of statistics that are used to constrain a maximum entropy probability model. We leverage methods developed for generative diffusion models to derive training and sampling procedures, and compare these to the traditional method of sampling via matching the statistics. Despite the compactness of our trained model (512 statistics), it generates texture images whose quality is as good as or better than the current state-of-the-art model (~177k statistics). A more direct comparison of the two models, obtained by synthesizing images that are indistinguishable for one model but maximally different for the other, reveals their relative strengths and weaknesses. Finally, we show that unlike previous statistical texture models, a straight trajectory in the representation space of our model generates homogeneous texture samples that interpolate smoothly between the features of the two end points.

item.title: Visuals Lie, Consistency Speaks: Disentangling Spatial Attention from Reliability in Vision-Language Models
item.author: Logan Mann, Yi Xia, Ajit Saravanan, Ishan Dave, Saadullah Ismail, Shikhar Shiromani, Emily Huang, Ruizhe Li, Kevin Zhu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 多模态基础模型作为推理代理的可靠性问题，特别是幻觉检测。

背景: 多模态基础模型越来越多地用作推理代理，可靠性及模型何时可能产生幻觉成为关键问题。

目的: 挑战注意力置信度假设，即认为视觉感知的结构（如注意力集中）能反映模型可靠性。

方法: 通过视觉语言模型可靠性探针进行系统性跨家族研究，引入结构注意力指标（聚类计数和空间熵）量化视觉编码器的注视，并追踪其在层间的演变。

主要发现: 模型存在符号性脱离现象，早期锁定视觉特征后注意力扩散；空间注意力与准确率几乎无相关性；可靠性主要源于生成动态和内部状态分布，自一致性是主要预测因子；不同模型架构在可靠性分布上存在显著差异。

结论: 当前视觉语言模型的可靠性信号与视觉 grounding 地图脱节，最好从生成时间动态和隐藏状态探针中推断。

翻译: Multimodal Foundation Models are increasingly used as reasoning agents, making reliability, knowing when a model may hallucinate, critical. A common intuition, which we call the Attention-Confidence Assumption, holds that reliability follows from

Abstract

Multimodal Foundation Models are increasingly used as reasoning agents, making reliability, knowing when a model may hallucinate, critical. A common intuition, which we call the Attention-Confidence Assumption, holds that reliability follows from "structural" visual perception: tight attention on relevant regions should signal a trustworthy answer, while scattered attention signals confusion. We challenge this through the VLM Reliability Probe (VRP), a systematic cross-family study of reliability signals in contemporary Vision-Language Models (VLMs). We introduce structural-attention metrics, cluster counts (C_k) and spatial entropy (H_s), to quantify the visual encoder's gaze, and track its evolution (Delta H_s) across layers. This reveals a "Symbolic Detachment": models often "Early Lock" visual features only to diffuse attention later, severing early perception from final generation. Contrary to the grounding hypothesis, we find a "Cluster Failure": spatial attention has near-zero correlation (R approx 0.001) with accuracy. Instead, reliability is a phenomenon of generation dynamics and internal-state distributions. Self-Consistency, the agreement rate across sampled reasoning paths, is the dominant predictor of truth (R = 0.429). Scaling causal interventions exposes a sharp architectural divergence: LLaVA locks its prediction in a fragile late-stage bottleneck, whereas PaliGemma and Qwen2-VL distribute reliability globally, staying resilient even when ~50% or more of their most predictive layer is destroyed. For current VLMs, reliability signals are detached from visual grounding maps and are best inferred from generation-time dynamics and hidden-state probes.

item.title: SoK: AI-Augmented Binary Reversing
item.author: Yujeong Kwon, Yiyue Zhang, Shakhzod Yuldoshkhujaev, Kexin Pei, Dokyung Song, Hyungjoon Koo
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文对人工智能增强的二进制逆向工程领域进行了首次全面的知识系统化。

背景: 二进制逆向工程对于软件理解、漏洞发现、恶意软件调查和固件审计至关重要，但由于编译过程中语义信息的不可逆丢失，该领域一直面临固有挑战。近年来，机器学习、大型语言模型和智能体人工智能系统的进步加速了人工智能增强二进制逆向工程的采用，但相关研究在逆向工程领域、工件表示、学习方法和评估实践方面日益碎片化。

目的: 提供该领域过去十年演变的整体视角，建立共同词汇和结构化框架，为下一代可靠且可扩展的人工智能增强二进制逆向工程系统奠定基础。

方法: 分析了自二零一五年以来发表的一百四十四篇研究论文，根据推理任务将其组织成二十二个二进制逆向工程领域，并引入涵盖传统和人工智能增强逆向工程管道的统一分类法，连接传统分析技术、二进制衍生工件、表示策略、学习范式和下游推理任务。

主要发现: 揭示了看似不同的方法背后存在的共同结构，突出了持续存在的技术挑战和评估差距，并确定了未来研究的有前景的机会。

结论: 这些见解阐明了该领域的现状，并为下一代可靠且可扩展的人工智能增强二进制逆向工程系统提供了基础。

翻译: Binary reversing is fundamental to software understanding, vulnerability discovery, malware investigation, and firmware auditing. However, it remains inherently challenging due to the irreversible loss of semantic information during compilation. Recent advances in machine learning, large language models (LLMs), and agentic AI systems have accelerated the adoption of AI-augmented binary reversing. Yet, the resulting body of work has become increasingly fragmented across reversing domains, artifact representations, learning approaches, and evaluation practices. This paper presents the first comprehensive systematization of knowledge on AI-augmented binary reversing. We analyze 144 research papers published since 2015, and organize them into 22 binary reversing domains according to the inference tasks. We further introduce a unified taxonomy spanning conventional and AI-augmented reversing pipelines. Our taxonomy connects traditional analysis techniques, binary-derived artifacts, representation strategies, learning paradigms, and downstream inference tasks, while clarifying the emerging roles of LLMs and agentic AI systems. By establishing a common vocabulary and structured framework, we provide a holistic view of the field's evolution over the past decade. Our study reveals common structures underlying seemingly disparate approaches, highlights persistent technical challenges and evaluation gaps, and identifies promising opportunities for future research. Collectively, these insights clarify the current state of the field and provide a foundation for the next generation of reliable and scalable AI-augmented binary reversing systems.

Abstract

Binary reversing is fundamental to software understanding, vulnerability discovery, malware investigation, and firmware auditing. However, it remains inherently challenging due to the irreversible loss of semantic information during compilation. Recent advances in machine learning, large language models (LLMs), and agentic AI systems have accelerated the adoption of AI-augmented binary reversing. Yet, the resulting body of work has become increasingly fragmented across reversing domains, artifact representations, learning approaches, and evaluation practices. This paper presents the first comprehensive systematization of knowledge on AI-augmented binary reversing. We analyze 144 research papers published since 2015, and organize them into 22 binary reversing domains according to the inference tasks. We further introduce a unified taxonomy spanning conventional and AI-augmented reversing pipelines. Our taxonomy connects traditional analysis techniques, binary-derived artifacts, representation strategies, learning paradigms, and downstream inference tasks, while clarifying the emerging roles of LLMs and agentic AI systems. By establishing a common vocabulary and structured framework, we provide a holistic view of the field's evolution over the past decade. Our study reveals common structures underlying seemingly disparate approaches, highlights persistent technical challenges and evaluation gaps, and identifies promising opportunities for future research. Collectively, these insights clarify the current state of the field and provide a foundation for the next generation of reliable and scalable AI-augmented binary reversing systems.

item.title: A Closer Look at Failure Modes in Temporal Understanding of Large Audio-Language Models
item.author: Apoorva Kulkarni, Kaousheik Jayakumar, Sreyan Ghosh, Sarah Wiegreffe, Dinesh Manocha, Ramani Duraiswami
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 大型音频语言模型在音频理解任务上表现强劲，但在时间推理方面存在不足。本文通过引入包含一千六百五十七个问题的基准测试，对模型在时间推理上的失败原因进行了机制分析。研究发现模型在文本线索可用时往往未能充分利用音频信息，且重新分配注意力比增加音频注意力更有效。通过针对任务相关令牌调整注意力，模型准确率从百分之五十五点九提升至百分之五十九点一，表明仅靠模态不平衡无法解释失败原因，为未来工作提供了方向。

背景: 大型音频语言模型在多种音频理解任务上取得了良好性能，但在时间推理这一人类听觉感知核心能力上仍存在困难。现有基准测试仅报告性能差距，未能深入探究潜在机制。

目的: 解决现有基准测试无法深入探究模型失败机制的问题，通过引入专门用于机制分析的基准测试，理解大型音频语言模型在时间推理上失败的原因。

方法: 引入一个包含一千六百五十七个问题、涵盖三个基础任务的基准测试。通过行为分析考察模型在不同输入设置下的输出，比较注意力上加权与缩放的效果，并针对任务相关令牌进行优化。

主要发现: 模型在文本线索可用时往往未能充分利用音频信息。重新分配音频令牌间的注意力比单纯增加音频注意力更有效。针对任务相关令牌进行优化能进一步提升性能。注意力缩放在瓶颈层的应用可将准确率从百分之五十五点九提升至百分之五十九点一，且无需微调。

结论: 仅靠模态不平衡无法完全解释大型音频语言模型在时间推理上的失败。通过注意力缩放优化瓶颈层是一种有前景的未来工作方向。

翻译: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) achieve strong performance on a variety of audio understanding tasks but continue to struggle with temporal reasoning, a fundamental capability central to human auditory perception. Understanding the causes of these failures remains challenging as existing benchmarks report performance gaps without probing underlying mechanisms. To address this, we introduce a benchmark with 1,657 questions across three foundational tasks designed specifically for mechanistic analysis. Examining model outputs across varying input settings (behavioral analysis) reveals that models often under-utilize audio when textual cues are available. We also provide the first causal mechanistic analysis of temporal reasoning failures in LALMs. Comparing attention upweighting against scaling, we find that redistributing attention across audio tokens is more effective than increasing audio attention. Targeting task-relevant tokens yields further gains. These findings suggest that modality imbalance alone cannot explain failures. Attention scaling at bottleneck layers improves accuracy from 55.9% to 59.1% without fine-tuning, demonstrating a promising direction for future work.

Abstract

Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) achieve strong performance on a variety of audio understanding tasks but continue to struggle with temporal reasoning, a fundamental capability central to human auditory perception. Understanding the causes of these failures remains challenging as existing benchmarks report performance gaps without probing underlying mechanisms. To address this, we introduce a benchmark with 1,657 questions across three foundational tasks designed specifically for mechanistic analysis. Examining model outputs across varying input settings (behavioral analysis) reveals that models often under-utilize audio when textual cues are available. We also provide the first causal mechanistic analysis of temporal reasoning failures in LALMs. Comparing attention upweighting against scaling, we find that redistributing attention across audio tokens is more effective than increasing audio attention. Targeting task-relevant tokens yields further gains. These findings suggest that modality imbalance alone cannot explain failures. Attention scaling at bottleneck layers improves accuracy from 55.9% to 59.1% without fine-tuning, demonstrating a promising direction for future work.

item.title: LADBench: A Benchmark for Logical Fault Detection in Images
item.author: Sahasra Kondapalli, Lara Radovanovic, Aadi Palnitkar, Mingyang Mao, Xiaomin Lin
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了LAD-bench基准测试，包含一千多个合成图像，涵盖住宅、城市、协作和自然四个领域的逻辑异常。提出了一种分层提示协议，用于评估模型在检测逻辑错误时所需的显式辅助程度。评估结果显示当前大型视觉语言模型在自主逻辑推理方面存在显著弱点，即使提供明确提示也难以识别异常。该基准测试为提升自主视觉系统的安全性、可靠性和认知对齐提供了严谨框架。

背景: 大型视觉语言模型在视觉问答和语义定位方面表现优异，但其自主逻辑推理能力尚未得到充分探索。现有的异常基准测试侧重于视觉错误或直接提示，而非开放世界部署所需的物理和社会常识。

目的: 解决现有基准测试在物理和社会常识方面的不足，为评估大型视觉语言模型的自主逻辑推理能力提供一个更全面的基准。

方法: 构建包含一千多个合成图像的LAD-bench基准测试，涵盖四个领域：住宅、城市、协作和自然。提出分层提示协议，基于渐进式披露，测量模型在定位和推理逻辑错误时所需的显式辅助程度。

主要发现: 评估领先的基础模型发现，即使最佳模型的整体准确率仅为百分之七十一点一一，表明隐式逻辑错误检测仍未解决。模型在收到更深层次的明确提示后，往往仍无法识别异常。

结论: LAD-bench通过揭示顺序多模态推理中的局限性，为提升自主视觉系统的安全性、可靠性和认知对齐提供了严谨框架。

翻译: Large Vision Language Models (VLMs) excel at visual question answering and semantic grounding, but their capacity for autonomous logical reasoning remains underexplored. Existing anomaly benchmarks emphasize visual errors or direct prompting rather than the physical and social common sense needed for open-world deployment. To address this, we introduce LAD-bench, a benchmark of more than 1,000 curated synthetic images with logical anomalies across four domains: Residential, Urban, Collaborative, and Nature. We further propose a Tiered Prompting Protocol based on progressive disclosure, which measures how much explicit assistance a model needs to localize and reason about a logical fault. Evaluating leading foundation models reveals substantial weaknesses: even the best achieves only 70.11% overall accuracy, showing that implicit logical fault detection remains unsolved. Crucially, models often fail to identify anomalies even after receiving explicit hints in deeper tiers. By surfacing these limitations in sequential multimodal reasoning, LAD-Bench offers a rigorous framework for advancing the safety, reliability, and cognitive alignment of autonomous visual systems. Dataset and Code: https://huggingface.co/datasets/SahasraK/LADBench

Abstract

Large Vision Language Models (VLMs) excel at visual question answering and semantic grounding, but their capacity for autonomous logical reasoning remains underexplored. Existing anomaly benchmarks emphasize visual errors or direct prompting rather than the physical and social common sense needed for open-world deployment. To address this, we introduce LAD-bench, a benchmark of more than 1,000 curated synthetic images with logical anomalies across four domains: Residential, Urban, Collaborative, and Nature. We further propose a Tiered Prompting Protocol based on progressive disclosure, which measures how much explicit assistance a model needs to localize and reason about a logical fault. Evaluating leading foundation models reveals substantial weaknesses: even the best achieves only 70.11% overall accuracy, showing that implicit logical fault detection remains unsolved. Crucially, models often fail to identify anomalies even after receiving explicit hints in deeper tiers. By surfacing these limitations in sequential multimodal reasoning, LAD-Bench offers a rigorous framework for advancing the safety, reliability, and cognitive alignment of autonomous visual systems. Dataset and Code: https://huggingface.co/datasets/SahasraK/LADBench

item.title: UoU: A Universal Fingerprint Foundation Model Based on Large-Scale Unsupervised Learning
item.author: Xiongjun Guan, Jianjiang Feng, Jie Zhou
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为UoU的通用指纹基础模型，该模型基于大规模无监督学习，旨在解决传统指纹识别任务特定流水线中各阶段孤立优化导致表示无法跨传感器、质量和下游应用复用的问题。UoU将指纹特征提取重构为领域特定的基础模型问题，采用多层级表示层次结构，涵盖图像恢复、结构场、语义令牌、点级生物特征实体和紧凑全局描述符。其训练策略结合了精确标注的监督冷启动、大规模弱监督细化以及大规模无监督巩固，后两个阶段在大规模训练中迭代进行。UoU利用指纹图像特有的领域对称性和中间结构，如方向流、周期性脊线模式、稀疏生物特征实体和空间等变性。该框架具有架构无关性，支持多任务学习、可扩展模型配置及下游应用的专业化。

背景: 指纹识别目前仍由任务特定的流水线主导，其中增强、结构解析、对齐和匹配等步骤被孤立优化。尽管这种设计在狭窄场景下有效，但它限制了表示在不同传感器、质量和下游应用之间的复用。

目的: 提出一种基于大规模无监督学习的通用指纹基础模型UoU，将指纹特征提取重构为领域特定的基础模型问题，以克服传统流水线设计的局限性，实现表示的跨领域复用。

方法: UoU采用多层级表示层次结构，包括图像恢复、结构场、语义令牌、点级生物特征实体和紧凑全局描述符。训练策略包括精确标注的监督冷启动、大规模弱监督细化以及大规模无监督巩固，后两个阶段在训练中迭代进行。模型利用指纹图像特有的领域对称性和中间结构，如方向流、周期性脊线模式、稀疏生物特征实体和空间等变性。框架设计具有架构无关性，支持多任务学习和可扩展配置。

主要发现: UoU通过结合监督冷启动、弱监督细化和无监督巩固的训练策略，能够有效利用指纹图像的领域特定结构，实现表示的稳定性和不变性。该模型支持多任务学习，并可用于匹配、对齐、增强、注册等相关指纹应用。

结论: UoU提供了一种通用的指纹基础模型框架，通过大规模无监督学习和领域特定结构利用，实现了指纹特征提取的改进和表示复用。该框架具有架构无关性，支持多种下游应用，部分基线实现已公开。

翻译: Fingerprint recognition is still dominated by task-specific pipelines, where enhancement, structural parsing, alignment, and matching are optimized in isolation. Although effective in narrow settings, this design limits representation reuse across sensors, qualities, and downstream applications. We therefore present UoU, short for a Universal fingerprint foundation model based on large-scale Unsupervised learning, which reframes fingerprint feature extraction as a domain-specific foundation-model problem. UoU is organized around a multi-level representation hierarchy spanning image restoration, structural fields, semantic tokens, point-level biometric entities, and compact global descriptors. Its training recipe combines a supervised cold start on precise annotations, large-scale weakly supervised refinement, and large-scale unsupervised consolidation, with the latter two stages iterated during large-scale training so that weak supervision broadens semantic coverage while unsupervised learning stabilizes correspondences, invariances, and representation geometry. Rather than treating fingerprint imagery as generic texture, UoU exploits domain-specific symmetries and intermediate structure, including orientation flow, periodic ridge patterns, sparse biometric entities, and spatial equivariance. The framework is intentionally architecture-agnostic: while the present study includes an initial transformer-based structured-prediction instantiation, the broader design supports multi-task learning, scalable model configurations, and downstream specialization for matching, alignment, enhancement, registration, and related fingerprint applications. This paper presents the technical motivation, system design, and validation protocol of UoU, and part of the baseline implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/XiongjunGuan/UoU.

Abstract

Fingerprint recognition is still dominated by task-specific pipelines, where enhancement, structural parsing, alignment, and matching are optimized in isolation. Although effective in narrow settings, this design limits representation reuse across sensors, qualities, and downstream applications. We therefore present UoU, short for ``a \textbf{U}niversal fingerprint foundation model based \textbf{o}n large-scale \textbf{U}nsupervised learning,'' which reframes fingerprint feature extraction as a domain-specific foundation-model problem. UoU is organized around a multi-level representation hierarchy spanning image restoration, structural fields, semantic tokens, point-level biometric entities, and compact global descriptors. Its training recipe combines a supervised cold start on precise annotations, large-scale weakly supervised refinement, and large-scale unsupervised consolidation, with the latter two stages iterated during large-scale training so that weak supervision broadens semantic coverage while unsupervised learning stabilizes correspondences, invariances, and representation geometry. Rather than treating fingerprint imagery as generic texture, UoU exploits domain-specific symmetries and intermediate structure, including orientation flow, periodic ridge patterns, sparse biometric entities, and spatial equivariance. The framework is intentionally architecture-agnostic: while the present study includes an initial transformer-based structured-prediction instantiation, the broader design supports multi-task learning, scalable model configurations, and downstream specialization for matching, alignment, enhancement, registration, and related fingerprint applications. This paper presents the technical motivation, system design, and validation protocol of UoU, and part of the baseline implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/XiongjunGuan/UoU.

item.title: Two-Stage Fine-Tuning of ResNet50 for High-Sensitivity Melanoma Detection on Dermoscopic Images
item.author: Aryan Bhagat
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出并评估了一种应用于皮肤镜图像的二分类黑色素瘤分类的两阶段微调方法，旨在解决类别不平衡和单阶段微调的次优迁移学习问题。

背景: 黑色素瘤是最危险的皮肤癌类型，早期检测时五年生存率超过百分之九十九，但一旦扩散则生存率急剧下降。

目的: 解决类别不平衡和单阶段微调导致的次优迁移学习问题，提高黑色素瘤分类性能。

方法: 采用分层训练/验证/测试集划分，仅在训练集上使用随机过采样实现一比一的类别平衡；第一阶段冻结ResNet50基础网络仅训练分类头，第二阶段以极低学习率联合微调所有层以防止灾难性遗忘。

主要发现: 在三千八百二十六张独立测试集图像上，模型达到零点九五五九的AUC-ROC、百分之八十八点三四的准确率、百分之八十七点五六的敏感度、百分之八十九点一三的特异度和百分之八十八点二九的F1分数；消融研究证实两阶段协议显著优于单阶段微调，敏感度提升超过百分之四；Grad-CAM可视化显示病灶定位正确。

结论: 两阶段微调方法有效提升了黑色素瘤分类性能，并提供了可部署的Streamlit检测应用及全部训练代码。

翻译: Melanoma is the most dangerous form of skin cancer with five-year survival rates exceeding 99% when detected early but falling sharply once the disease spreads. This paper proposes and evaluates a two-stage fine-tuning approach for ResNet50 applied to binary melanoma classification on dermoscopic images. The core challenges addressed are class imbalance and suboptimal transfer learning from single-stage fine-tuning. After stratified train/validation/test splitting, random oversampling was applied exclusively to the training set to achieve a 1:1 class balance. Stage 1 trained only the classification head with the ResNet50 base frozen, while Stage 2 fine-tuned all layers jointly at a low learning rate of 1e-5 to prevent catastrophic forgetting of learned visual features. On an independent test set of 3,826 images, the model achieved an AUC-ROC of 0.9559, accuracy of 88.34%, sensitivity of 87.56%, specificity of 89.13%, and F1-score of 88.29%. An ablation study confirms the two-stage protocol significantly outperforms single-stage fine-tuning, with sensitivity gains of over 4%. Grad-CAM visualizations demonstrate correct lesion localization. A fully deployable Streamlit detection application is provided alongside all training code.

Abstract

Melanoma is the most dangerous form of skin cancer with five-year survival rates exceeding 99% when detected early but falling sharply once the disease spreads. This paper proposes and evaluates a two-stage fine-tuning approach for ResNet50 applied to binary melanoma classification on dermoscopic images. The core challenges addressed are class imbalance and suboptimal transfer learning from single-stage fine-tuning. After stratified train/validation/test splitting, random oversampling was applied exclusively to the training set to achieve a 1:1 class balance. Stage 1 trained only the classification head with the ResNet50 base frozen, while Stage 2 fine-tuned all layers jointly at a low learning rate of 1e-5 to prevent catastrophic forgetting of learned visual features. On an independent test set of 3,826 images, the model achieved an AUC-ROC of 0.9559, accuracy of 88.34%, sensitivity of 87.56%, specificity of 89.13%, and F1-score of 88.29%. An ablation study confirms the two-stage protocol significantly outperforms single-stage fine-tuning, with sensitivity gains of over 4%. Grad-CAM visualizations demonstrate correct lesion localization. A fully deployable Streamlit detection application is provided alongside all training code.

item.title: Geometry-Aware Post-Hoc Uncertainty Quantification in Operator Learning
item.author: Oriol Vendrell-Gallart, Nima Negarandeh, Ramin Bostanabad
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为REEF-GP的后验不确定性量化框架，该框架利用冻结神经算子的内部嵌入来构建几何感知的不确定性，在保持预测精度的同时实现了校准的不确定性估计，且成本远低于深度集成方法。

背景: 神经算子虽然能提供偏微分方程的快速代理模型，但其确定性预测限制了在需要不确定性量化的任务中的应用，尤其是在几何变异性场景下。现有方法主要对网络参数建模不确定性，忽略了算子本身学习的几何感知表示。

目的: 开发一种能够利用神经算子内在几何感知表示的后验不确定性量化方法，以解决几何变异性下的不确定性估计问题，同时保持计算效率和预测准确性。

方法: 提出REEF-GP框架，将高斯过程拟合到冻结神经算子的残差上，利用算子的内部嵌入定义核特征空间。该方法通过谱归一化投影、异方差几何感知噪声和基于子集的高效训练来确保在非结构化域上的稳定性和可扩展性，避免使用限制性低秩近似。

主要发现: 在五个具有不同几何形状的偏微分方程基准测试中，REEF-GP在保持预测精度的同时，实现了与深度集成方法相当但成本更低的可校准不确定性估计。该方法在几何分布偏移下保持稳健，不确定性集中在具有物理意义的区域（如激波前沿）。

结论: 直接在神经算子学习到的特征空间中可以实现准确且可扩展的后验不确定性量化，为参数中心的方法提供了实用的替代方案。

翻译: Neural operators provide fast surrogates for PDEs but their deterministic predictions limit their use in tasks requiring uncertainty quantification (UQ), especially under geometric variability. Existing approaches primarily model uncertainty in network parameters, largely overlooking the geometry-aware representations learned by the operator itself. We propose REEF-GP (Residual on Embedded Features Gaussian Process), a post-hoc UQ framework that fits a GP to the residuals of a frozen neural operator whose internal embeddings define the kernel feature space. Rather than learning a separate feature map, REEF-GP adapts the operator's intrinsic coordinate-feature representations to construct geometry-aware uncertainties. To ensure stability and scalability on unstructured domains, REEF-GP incorporates spectral-normalized projections, heteroscedastic geometry-aware noise, and efficient subset-based training that avoids restrictive low-rank approximations. Across five PDE benchmarks with varying geometries, REEF-GP preserves predictive accuracy while achieving calibrated uncertainty estimates competitive with deep ensembles but at a fraction of their cost. Our approach remains robust under geometric distribution shift, with uncertainty concentrating in physically meaningful regions (e.g., shock fronts). Our results demonstrate that accurate and scalable post-hoc UQ for neural operators can be achieved directly in their learned feature space, offering a practical alternative to parameter-centric approaches.

Abstract

Neural operators provide fast surrogates for PDEs but their deterministic predictions limit their use in tasks requiring uncertainty quantification (UQ), especially under geometric variability. Existing approaches primarily model uncertainty in network parameters, largely overlooking the geometry-aware representations learned by the operator itself. We propose REEF-GP (Residual on Embedded Features Gaussian Process), a post-hoc UQ framework that fits a GP to the residuals of a frozen neural operator whose internal embeddings define the kernel feature space. Rather than learning a separate feature map, REEF-GP adapts the operator's intrinsic coordinate-feature representations to construct geometry-aware uncertainties. To ensure stability and scalability on unstructured domains, REEF-GP incorporates spectral-normalized projections, heteroscedastic geometry-aware noise, and efficient subset-based training that avoids restrictive low-rank approximations. Across five PDE benchmarks with varying geometries, REEF-GP preserves predictive accuracy while achieving calibrated uncertainty estimates competitive with deep ensembles but at a fraction of their cost. Our approach remains robust under geometric distribution shift, with uncertainty concentrating in physically meaningful regions (e.g., shock fronts). Our results demonstrate that accurate and scalable post-hoc UQ for neural operators can be achieved directly in their learned feature space, offering a practical alternative to parameter-centric approaches.

item.title: Public transit gains and spatially uneven travel demand changes after NYC congestion pricing
item.author: Donghang Li, Dingyi Zhuang, Yunlin Li, Chenan Shen, Nina Cao, Yunhan Zheng, Shenhao Wang, Jinhua Zhao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文评估了纽约市在二零二五年一月实施的首个基于路网的拥堵收费计划对城市整体交通出行的影响。研究利用时间序列基础模型生成概率性反事实需求预测，发现政策实施后公交和地铁客流量显著增加，而整体出行需求 modestly 下降。影响具有空间异质性，出行需求减少集中在拥堵缓解区内，而公共交通增长延伸至曼哈顿核心区之外。社会经济分析显示不同社区适应程度不均，凸显了空间公平性问题。该框架为缺乏干净对照组时的城市干预措施评估提供了可扩展的方法。

背景: 纽约市在二零二五年一月实施了全国首个基于路网的拥堵收费计划。此类政策会在不同交通方式和地点之间产生溢出效应，使得构建可信的对照组变得困难。

目的: 评估大规模定价干预措施对城市整体交通出行的响应情况。

方法: 使用时间序列基础模型生成带有校准不确定性的概率性反事实需求预测。将框架应用于公交车、地铁和总体出行量数据。

主要发现: 政策实施后，相对于预期的无政策需求，公交和地铁客流量显著增加，而整体出行需求 modestly 下降。影响具有空间异质性：整体出行需求的减少集中在拥堵缓解区内，而公共交通的增长延伸至曼哈顿核心区之外。社会经济分析显示不同社区的适应程度不均，凸显了空间公平性问题。

结论: 该框架为在缺乏干净对照组的情况下，对城市整体干预措施进行不确定性感知的评估提供了一种可扩展的方法。

翻译: New York City implemented the nation's first cordon-based congestion pricing program in January 2025, providing an opportunity to evaluate how system-wide urban mobility responds to large-scale pricing interventions. Because such policies generate spillovers across modes and locations, credible control groups are difficult to construct. We address this challenge using time series foundation models to generate probabilistic counterfactual demand forecasts with calibrated uncertainty. Applying this framework to bus, subway, and aggregate trip volume data, we find that post-policy bus and subway ridership increased significantly relative to expected no-policy demand, while overall travel demand decreased modestly. The effects are spatially heterogeneous: while reductions in overall travel demand are concentrated within the Congestion Relief Zone, transit gains extend beyond Manhattan's core. Socio-demographic analyses further reveal uneven adaptation across neighborhoods, highlighting spatial equity implications. Our framework provides a scalable approach for the uncertainty-aware evaluation of system-wide urban interventions when clean control groups are unavailable.

Abstract

New York City implemented the nation's first cordon-based congestion pricing program in January 2025, providing an opportunity to evaluate how system-wide urban mobility responds to large-scale pricing interventions. Because such policies generate spillovers across modes and locations, credible control groups are difficult to construct. We address this challenge using time series foundation models to generate probabilistic counterfactual demand forecasts with calibrated uncertainty. Applying this framework to bus, subway, and aggregate trip volume data, we find that post-policy bus and subway ridership increased significantly relative to expected no-policy demand, while overall travel demand decreased modestly. The effects are spatially heterogeneous: while reductions in overall travel demand are concentrated within the Congestion Relief Zone, transit gains extend beyond Manhattan's core. Socio-demographic analyses further reveal uneven adaptation across neighborhoods, highlighting spatial equity implications. Our framework provides a scalable approach for the uncertainty-aware evaluation of system-wide urban interventions when clean control groups are unavailable.

item.title: RT-Counter: Real-Time Text-Guided Open-Vocabulary Object Counting
item.author: Hao-Yuan Ma, Li Zhang, Zhiwei Zhu, Jie Gao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为实时计数器（RT-Counter）的实时开放词汇对象计数框架，旨在解决现有视觉语言预训练模型在细粒度空间理解和实时推理方面的不足。该框架通过视觉原型文本化模块和编织变换器层，实现了高精度与高计算效率的平衡。

背景: 文本引导的开放词汇对象计数任务旨在根据自然语言描述计数特定类别的对象。尽管视觉语言预训练模型已成功应用于该任务，但在计数场景中仍面临细粒度空间理解和实时推理要求的挑战。

目的: 提出一种实时开放词汇对象计数框架，以在保持良好计数精度的同时提高计算效率，打破精度与速度的权衡。

方法: 设计了视觉原型文本化模块，将学习到的视觉特征投影到文本特征空间，生成包含抽象信息和详细原型信息的特征。同时引入了编织变换器层，采用混合注意力机制高效结合局部和全局视觉特征，以较低的计算成本保持高描述能力。

主要发现: 在三个公共数据集上的实验表明，RT-Counter在FSC147数据集上达到了13.30的平均绝对误差，运行速度为每秒112.48帧，比现有领先方法快7.4倍，参数效率提高4倍以上。

结论: RT-Counter成功平衡了开放词汇对象计数任务中的高精度和实时性能，为该类任务提供了高效的解决方案。

翻译: Text-guided open-vocabulary object counting aims to count objects belonging to the categories specified by natural language descriptions. Although vision-language pre-trained models have been successfully applied to TOOC tasks, they still struggle with fine-grained spatial understanding and real-time inference requirements in counting scenarios. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a real-time TOOC framework, called the Real-Time Counter, that achieves not only good counting accuracy but also high computational efficiency. RT-Counter designs a novel Visual Prototype Textualization module that can project learned visual features into a text feature space and then generate features containing the abstract information that is hard to capture with visual prototypes and the detailed prototype information that is difficult to describe in text, enhancing the object-level visual-language model's counting capabilities. Additionally, RT-Counter incorporates our Weaving Transformer layers, maintaining high descriptive power at a fraction of the computational cost. The Weaformer layer adopts a novel hybrid attention mechanism that can efficiently weave together local and global visual features. Extensive experiments on three public datasets show that RT-Counter successfully breaks the accuracy-speed trade-off in TOOC. While achieving a competitive MAE of 13.30 on FSC147, RT-Counter operates at 112.48 FPS, making it 7.4 times faster and over 4 times more parameter-efficient than the existing leading methods in TOOC. Our work aims at balancing high accuracy and real-time performance in TOOC. Code is available at: https://github.com/Jason-Mar1/RT-Counter.

Abstract

Text-guided open-vocabulary object counting (TOOC) aims to count objects belonging to the categories specified by natural language descriptions. Although vision-language pre-trained models have been successful applied to TOOC tasks, they still struggle with fine-grained spatial understanding and real-time inference requirements in counting scenarios. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a real-time TOOC framework, called the Real-Time Counter (RT-Counter), that achieves not only good counting accuracy but also high computational efficiency. RT-Counter designs a novel Visual Prototype Textualization (VPT) module that can project learned visual features into a text feature space and then generate features containing the abstract information that is hard to capture with visual prototypes and the detailed prototype information that is difficult to describe in text, enhancing the object-level visual-language model's counting capabilities. Additionally, RT-Counter incorporates our Weaving Transformer (Weaformer) layers, maintaining high descriptive power at a fraction of the computational cost. The Weaformer layer adopts a novel hybrid attention mechanism that can efficiently weave together local and global visual features. Extensive experiments on three public datasets show that RT-Counter successfully breaks the accuracy-speed trade-off in TOOC. While achieving a competitive MAE of 13.30 on FSC147, RT-Counter operates at 112.48 FPS, making it 7.4x faster and over 4$\times$ more parameter-efficient than the existing leading methods in TOOC. Our work aims at balancing high accuracy and real-time performance in TOOC. Code is available at: https://github.com/Jason-Mar1/RT-Counter.

item.title: Anywhere, Any-Stymie: Remote Activation of Trojan Malware on LiDAR with Modulated Signals
item.author: R. Spencer Hallyburton, Miroslav Pajic
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究揭示了激光雷达传感器中一种新的攻击面，即潜伏在感知流水线中的恶意软件可在部署后被外部触发，无需攻击时访问硬件或网络。研究团队设计了能够进行底层点云操作的恶意软件并嵌入固件，通过光学触发器远程激活，实现了虚假物体注入和真实物体抑制，证明了攻击的可行性及对安全关键决策的影响。

背景: 激光雷达传感器广泛应用于自动驾驶系统的三维感知和安全关键决策中。

目的: 识别并操作化一种此前未被探索的攻击面，即潜伏在激光雷达感知流水线中的恶意软件在正常操作期间保持休眠，部署后可被外部触发，且无需攻击时访问传感器硬件或网络。

方法: 在供应商技术支持下的封闭研究测试环境中，设计了能够进行底层点云操作的恶意软件并嵌入激光雷达固件；设计了光学触发器，通过向感知环境发送调制信号远程激活恶意软件；在静态和移动平台上演示了虚假物体注入和真实物体抑制；评估了攻击可行性、检测器对注入伪影的语义检测能力以及对部署的战术自主车辆的安全关键影响。

主要发现: 攻击在静态距离三百英尺及行驶速度三十五英里的记录通过性测试中可行；注入的类人伪影可被最先进的三维物体检测器语义检测；攻击能对部署的战术自主车辆产生多种安全关键影响。

结论: 结果强调了在整个激光雷达传感器开发和部署流水线中需要更强的完整性保障。

翻译: LiDAR sensors are widely deployed in autonomous systems for 3D perception and safety-critical decision-making. We identify a previously unexplored attack surface in which dormant malware embedded in the LiDAR sensing pipeline remains inactive during normal operation and can be externally triggered after deployment, without requiring access to sensor hardware or networking at attack time. To operationalize this threat, we design malware capable of low-level point-cloud manipulation and embed it into LiDAR firmware. This malware was developed in a closed research test environment with vendor technical support, rather than by exploiting an inherent production supply-chain vulnerability. To selectively trigger attack activation, we design and implement an optical trigger that remotely activates the malware by delivering a modulated signal into the sensing environment. Once triggered, the malware performs real-time point cloud manipulation, and we demonstrate false object injection and real object suppression on static and mobile victim platforms. Our evaluation first establishes attack feasibility, including static operation at 300~ft and recorded drive-by runs reaching 35~mph. We then illustrate quantitatively that injected person-like artifacts can remain semantically detectable by a state-of-the-art 3D object detector. Finally, we demonstrate multiple modes of safety-critical impact on a deployed tactical autonomous vehicle. Together, these results highlight the need for stronger integrity guarantees throughout the LiDAR sensor development and deployment pipeline.

Abstract

LiDAR sensors are widely deployed in autonomous systems for 3D perception and safety-critical decision-making. We identify a previously unexplored attack surface in which dormant malware embedded in the LiDAR sensing pipeline remains inactive during normal operation and can be externally triggered after deployment, without requiring access to sensor hardware or networking at attack time. To operationalize this threat, we design malware capable of low-level point-cloud manipulation and embed it into LiDAR firmware. This malware was developed in a closed research test environment with vendor technical support, rather than by exploiting an inherent production supply-chain vulnerability. To selectively trigger attack activation, we design and implement an optical trigger that remotely activates the malware by delivering a modulated signal into the sensing environment. Once triggered, the malware performs real-time point cloud manipulation, and we demonstrate false object injection and real object suppression on static and mobile victim platforms. Our evaluation first establishes attack feasibility, including static operation at 300~ft and recorded drive-by runs reaching 35~mph. We then illustrate quantitatively that injected person-like artifacts can remain semantically detectable by a state-of-the-art 3D object detector. Finally, we demonstrate multiple modes of safety-critical impact on a deployed tactical autonomous vehicle. Together, these results highlight the need for stronger integrity guarantees throughout the LiDAR sensor development and deployment pipeline.

item.title: DeepInsight: A Unified Evaluation Infrastructure Across the Physical AI Stack
item.author: Siyi Li, Chunyu Sun, Jiahao Zhang, Yuchen Kang, Wuliang Wang, Yu Qiu, Rui Jiang, Haitao Cui, Jie Chen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了DeepInsight，一个用于评估物理人工智能堆栈的单一运行时基础设施。该框架通过三个抽象（任务、资源、结果）保持各层异构性，实现了跨层回归诊断，并在生产环境中部署，展现出高效能和可扩展性。

背景: 物理人工智能堆栈的评估涉及跨度超过三个数量级的操作，从基础模型解码步骤到全身控制的数千次物理模拟。现有框架无法覆盖这一范围，目前通常通过拼接不同的工具进行评估，这些工具共享运行时和评分标准，导致无法诊断跨层回归问题。

目的: 提出DeepInsight，一个能够覆盖物理人工智能堆栈全频谱的单一运行时评估基础设施，以解决现有方法无法统一评估和诊断跨层问题的局限。

方法: DeepInsight通过三个窄抽象（任务、资源、结果）来保持各层的异构性。每个抽象由所有子系统共享的不变量实现：一个剧集驱动器、一个资源句柄协议（适用于大型语言模型推理和沙盒运行时等昂贵后端），以及一个追踪身份方案，所有事件均在此方案下记录。

主要发现: DeepInsight在生产环境中部署于具身人形堆栈的三层。它通过配置即可轻松接入新基准测试。在基础模型端，它能复现已发表的参考结果和同行框架读数，并在单个节点上更快运行相同测试套件，且在多节点扩展时接近线性扩展。其独特优势在于诊断能力：由于所有层写入同一共享追踪，跨层回归问题可被定位。

结论: DeepInsight提供了一个统一的评估基础设施，通过共享追踪实现了跨层回归诊断，这是分段工具联邦无法实现的。它在性能、扩展性和诊断能力方面表现出色，适用于物理人工智能堆栈的全面评估。

翻译: 评估物理人工智能堆栈涉及跨度超过三个数量级的操作——从单次基础模型解码步骤到全身控制的数千次物理模拟——在模态、奖励语义和资源配置文件方面正交变化。现有框架无法覆盖这一范围，因此目前通过拼接不同的工具进行评估，这些工具既不共享运行时也不共享评分标准，保留了各段的局部有效性，但失去了诊断跨层回归所需的共享身份。我们提出了DeepInsight，一个在单一运行时上服务这一全频谱的评估基础设施。它没有同质化这些机制，而是通过三个窄抽象——任务、资源和结果——保持其异构性，每个抽象由每个子系统共享的一个不变量实现：一个剧集驱动器、一个资源句柄协议（由每个昂贵后端实现，包括大型语言模型推理和沙盒运行时），以及一个追踪身份方案，所有事件均在此方案下写入。在生产环境中部署于具身人形堆栈的三层，这一套不变量通过配置即可轻松接入新基准测试。在成熟同行协调器存在的地方——在基础模型端——它在各自的范围内复现了已发表的参考结果和同行框架读数，在单个节点上更快运行相同的测试套件，并在节点间接近线性扩展。其独特的回报是诊断性的：因为每一层都写入同一个共享追踪，从一个层开始并在另一个层显现的回归问题在该追踪上保持可定位——这是分段工具联邦无法复制的跨层收益。

Abstract

Evaluating a Physical AI stack spans operators that differ by more than three orders of magnitude -- from a single foundation-model decoding step to thousands of physics ticks of whole-body control -- varying orthogonally in modality, reward semantics, and resource profile. No existing framework spans this range, so the stack is evaluated today by stitching together separate harnesses that share neither runtime nor scoring, preserving each segment's local validity but losing the shared identity needed to diagnose cross-layer regressions. We present DeepInsight, an evaluation infrastructure that serves this full spectrum on a single runtime. Rather than homogenize the regimes, it preserves their heterogeneity behind three narrow abstractions -- task, resource, and result -- each realized as one invariant shared by every subsystem: one episode driver, one resource-handle protocol implemented by every expensive backend (LLM inference and sandboxed runtimes alike), and one trace identity scheme under which every event is written. Deployed in production across all three layers of an embodied humanoid stack, this single set of invariants onboards new benchmarks largely by configuration. Where mature peer orchestrators exist -- at the foundation-model end -- it reproduces published references and peer-framework readings within their own spread, runs the same suites faster on a single node, and scales near-linearly across nodes. Its distinctive return is diagnostic: because every layer writes into one shared trace, a regression that begins in one layer and surfaces in another stays localizable on that trace -- a cross-layer payoff no federation of per-segment harnesses can reproduce.

item.title: Surrogate Assisted Pedestrian Protection Design via a Foundation Model Orchestrated Workflow
item.author: Osamu Ito, Akihiko Katagiri, Yoshikazu Nakagawa, Shin Saeki, Jun Shiraishi, Masato Sasaki
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种由基础模型协调的碰撞安全设计工作流，通过代理辅助探索实现行人保护设计，将评估时间从数小时缩短至数秒。

背景: 人工智能驱动的工程设计工作流在碰撞安全设计中面临挑战，因为碰撞事件涉及高度非线性的接触动力学、材料非线性和离散状态转换，这些数据难以用数据驱动的代理模型捕捉。

目的: 构建首个由基础模型协调的碰撞安全设计工作流，以支持行人保护的代理辅助探索。

方法: 工作流整合了四个组件：一是基于碰撞仿真训练的代理模型，用于从设计参数预测行人腿部损伤指标并提供预测区间；二是多目标进化搜索算法，用于在约束下发现可行的参数集；三是基于变形的几何生成器，将参数映射为保持拓扑的三维形状；四是自然语言接口，其中大语言模型协调工作流，视觉语言模型支持生成设计的语义比较。

主要发现: 在汽车前保险杠案例研究中，该工作流在一次探索中生成了三十五个不同的安全合规替代方案，而传统计算机辅助工程迭代需要数周时间。

结论: 基础模型可以作为机器学习代理与基于物理的仿真之间的集成层，有助于将人工智能能力引入安全关键的工程领域。

翻译: AI-driven engineering workflows face particular challenges in crash safety design: unlike aerodynamics, crash events involve highly nonlinear contact dynamics, material nonlinearity, and discrete state transitions that are difficult to capture with data-driven surrogate models. To the best of our knowledge, we present the first foundation model--orchestrated workflow for crash safety design that enables surrogate-assisted exploration for pedestrian protection, reducing evaluation time from hours per CAE simulation to seconds. The workflow integrates four components: (1) a surrogate trained on CAE crash simulations to predict pedestrian leg injury metrics from design parameters, achieving an average R squared equals zero point eight seven and providing distribution-free conformal prediction intervals; (2) multiobjective evolutionary search to discover diverse feasible parameter sets under user-specified constraints; (3) a morphing-based geometry generator that maps parameters to topology-preserving 3D shapes; and (4) a natural-language interface in which an LLM orchestrates the workflow and a vision-language model supports semantic comparison of generated designs. In an automotive front-bumper case study, the workflow produces thirty-five distinct safety-compliant alternatives from a single exploration, a process that would require weeks with conventional CAE iteration. These results suggest that foundation models can serve as integration layers between ML surrogates and physics-based simulation, helping bring AI capabilities to safety-critical engineering domains.

Abstract

AI-driven engineering workflows face particular challenges in crash safety design: unlike aerodynamics, crash events involve highly nonlinear contact dynamics, material nonlinearity, and discrete state transitions that are difficult to capture with data-driven surrogate models. To the best of our knowledge, we present the first foundation model--orchestrated workflow for crash safety design that enables surrogate-assisted exploration for pedestrian protection, reducing evaluation time from hours per CAE simulation to seconds. The workflow integrates four components: (1) a surrogate trained on CAE crash simulations to predict pedestrian leg injury metrics from design parameters, achieving an average $R^2=0.87$ and providing distribution-free conformal prediction intervals; (2) multiobjective evolutionary search (NSGA-II) to discover diverse feasible parameter sets under user-specified constraints; (3) a morphing-based geometry generator that maps parameters to topology-preserving 3D shapes; and (4) a natural-language interface in which an LLM orchestrates the workflow and a vision--language model supports semantic comparison of generated designs. In an automotive front-bumper case study, the workflow produces 35 distinct safety-compliant alternatives from a single exploration, a process that would require weeks with conventional CAE iteration. These results suggest that foundation models can serve as integration layers between ML surrogates and physics-based simulation, helping bring AI capabilities to safety-critical engineering domains.

item.title: Expanding SPHERE-JEPA: A Family of Statistical Regularizers for the Hypersphere
item.author: Léo Nicollier, Enric Meinhardt-Llopis, Max Dunitz, Marc Pic, Pablo Musé, Gabriele Facciolo
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种在单位超球面上直接应用确定性统计正则化方法（如最大均值差异、核斯坦差异和KL散度）的自监督学习框架，通过消除随机投影带来的方差，实现了更稳定的优化和更快的收敛，并在不同数据集上取得了优于现有方法的性能。

背景: 在自监督学习中，通过在单位超球面上强制均匀分布来防止表示坍缩是有效的。然而，现有框架通常依赖基于蒙特卡洛采样的切片统计正则化器，这种随机性会向训练梯度中注入投影方差，导致优化不稳定并阻碍收敛。

目的: 旨在消除切片方法中的随机投影方差，通过解析积分随机投影得到确定性统计量，并在超球面上直接构建全维度的统计检验目标，以强制表示分布均匀，同时避免空间偏差。

方法: 1. 解析积分随机投影，将切片方法转化为确定性的最大均值差异。2. 在超球面上直接构建最大均值差异、核斯坦差异和KL散度的全维度目标。3. 使用基于谱理论构建的旋转不变核函数，具体评估了平滑指数衰减（热核）和严格频率截断（带限）两种滤波器。

主要发现: 1. 去除投影诱导的噪声后，优化过程更加稳定，收敛速度更快。2. 在ImageNet和Galaxy10数据集上，该方法一致优于随机切片正则化器。3. 统计检验的选择会影响潜在空间的几何结构：最大均值差异和核斯坦差异倾向于适合以对象为中心的领域的局部聚类组织，而基于连续核密度估计的KL散度促进细粒度的实例分离，在未聚类的程序化纹理检索中取得最强结果。

结论: 在超球面上直接应用确定性统计正则化器可以有效防止表示坍缩，提升自监督学习的稳定性和性能，且不同的统计检验方法适用于不同类型的视觉任务和数据分布。

翻译: In Self-Supervised Learning (SSL), preventing representation collapse by explicitly enforcing a uniform distribution on the unit hypersphere has proven to be effective. However, current frameworks typically rely on sliced statistical regularizers such as SIGReg (used in LeJEPA) and SUSReg (used in SPHERE-JEPA), which approximate this continuous objective via Monte Carlo sampling along random 1D directions. This stochasticity injects projection variance into the training gradients, destabilizing optimization, and hindering convergence. In this work, we first show that analytically integrating out these random projections natively yields a deterministic Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD), bypassing the variance of sliced methods. Motivated by this equivalence, we formulate full-dimensional objectives for MMD, Kernel Stein Discrepancy (KSD), and Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence directly on the sphere to enforce a uniform distribution. To prevent spatial bias, we equip these tests with rotationally invariant kernels constructed via spectral theory, systematically evaluating two canonical families: smooth exponential decay (Heat) and strict frequency cutoff (Bandlimited) filters. Empirically, removing projection-induced noise results in more stable optimization, faster convergence, and consistent improvements over stochastic sliced regularizers on ImageNet and Galaxy10. Furthermore, we reveal that the choice of the statistical test shapes the geometry of the learned latent space: MMD and KSD favor locally clustered organization suitable for object-centric domains, whereas the continuous KDE-based KL divergence promotes fine-grained instance separation, yielding the strongest results on unclustered procedural texture retrieval.

Abstract

In Self-Supervised Learning (SSL), preventing representation collapse by explicitly enforcing a uniform distribution on the unit hypersphere has proven to be effective. However, current frameworks typically rely on sliced statistical regularizers such as SIGReg (used in LeJEPA) and SUSReg (used in SPHERE-JEPA), which approximate this continuous objective via Monte Carlo sampling along random 1D directions. This stochasticity injects projection variance into the training gradients, destabilizing optimization, and hindering convergence. In this work, we first show that analytically integrating out these random projections natively yields a deterministic Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD), bypassing the variance of sliced methods. Motivated by this equivalence, we formulate full-dimensional objectives for MMD, Kernel Stein Discrepancy (KSD), and Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence directly on the sphere to enforce a uniform distribution. To prevent spatial bias, we equip these tests with rotationally invariant kernels constructed via spectral theory, systematically evaluating two canonical families: smooth exponential decay (Heat) and strict frequency cutoff (Bandlimited) filters. Empirically, removing projection-induced noise results in more stable optimization, faster convergence, and consistent improvements over stochastic sliced regularizers on ImageNet and Galaxy10. Furthermore, we reveal that the choice of the statistical test shapes the geometry of the learned latent space: MMD and KSD favor locally clustered organization suitable for object-centric domains, whereas the continuous KDE-based KL divergence promotes fine-grained instance separation, yielding the strongest results on unclustered procedural texture retrieval.

item.title: PracRepair: LLM-Empowered Automated Program Repair Inspired by Human-Like Debugging Practices
item.author: Yu Cheng, Zhongxin Liu, Zhenchang Xing, Chao Ni, Qing Huang, Xiaoxue Ren
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为PracRepair的自动化大语言模型程序修复框架，通过构建静态动态上下文、驱动式故障诊断和迭代补丁优化，有效利用动态信息提升修复效果，在多个基准测试中表现优于现有方法。

背景: 软件系统规模与复杂性增长导致调试和修复成本高，现有基于大语言模型的自动程序修复方法主要依赖静态或检索上下文、错误消息和粗粒度验证结果，未能充分利用故障执行动态和补丁验证动态等动态信息。

目的: 解决现有方法对动态信息利用不足的问题，提出一种受人类调试实践启发的自动化框架，以更好地理解和修复软件故障。

方法: 构建按需静态动态上下文，执行问题驱动的故障诊断以形成明确的修复假设，并通过验证诊断和跟踪级行为变化迭代优化候选补丁。

主要发现: 在Defects4J V1.2和V2.0基准测试中，PracRepair在GPT-3.5和GPT-4o模型下均显著优于现有基线方法，修复成功率分别达到139/136和162/171，并在真实世界故障数据集上展现出良好的泛化能力。

结论: PracRepair框架通过有效利用动态信息，显著提升了自动程序修复的准确性和泛化能力，为复杂软件系统的调试和修复提供了新的解决方案。

翻译: As software systems grow in scale and complexity, debugging and repair remain costly and time-consuming. Large language models (LLMs) have advanced automated program repair (APR), but existing LLM-based APR approaches still largely rely on static or retrieved context, error messages, and coarse-grained validation outcomes. As a result, they underutilize dynamic information for failure understanding and repair, including failure-execution dynamics and patch-validation dynamics. Effectively leveraging such information, however, is challenging: failure-execution traces are large and noisy, raw static-dynamic context is not self-explanatory, and patch-validation dynamics are often reduced to coarse feedback. To address these challenges, we propose PracRepair, a fully automated LLM-based APR framework inspired by human-like debugging practices. PracRepair constructs an on-demand static-dynamic context from buggy programs and failure executions, performs question-driven failure diagnosis to formulate explicit repair hypotheses, and iteratively refines candidate patches using validation diagnostics and trace-level behavioral changes. Experimental results on Defects4J V1.2 and V2.0 show that PracRepair consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Specifically, under GPT-3.5, PracRepair correctly fixes 139/136 bugs on Defects4J V1.2/V2.0, while under GPT-4o it further improves to 162/171. Moreover, PracRepair generalizes effectively to RWB (Real-World Bugs), achieving the best performance across multiple foundation models.

Abstract

As software systems grow in scale and complexity, debugging and repair remain costly and time-consuming. Large language models (LLMs) have advanced automated program repair (APR), but existing LLM-based APR approaches still largely rely on static or retrieved context, error messages, and coarse-grained validation outcomes. As a result, they underutilize dynamic information for failure understanding and repair, including failure-execution dynamics and patch-validation dynamics. Effectively leveraging such information, however, is challenging: failure-execution traces are large and noisy, raw static-dynamic context is not self-explanatory, and patch-validation dynamics are often reduced to coarse feedback. To address these challenges, we propose \textsc{PracRepair}, a fully automated LLM-based APR framework inspired by human-like debugging practices. \textsc{PracRepair} constructs an on-demand static-dynamic context from buggy programs and failure executions, performs question-driven failure diagnosis to formulate explicit repair hypotheses, and iteratively refines candidate patches using validation diagnostics and trace-level behavioral changes. Experimental results on Defects4J V1.2 and V2.0 show that \textsc{PracRepair} consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Specifically, under GPT-3.5, \textsc{PracRepair} correctly fixes 139/136 bugs on Defects4J V1.2/V2.0, while under GPT-4o it further improves to 162/171. Moreover, \textsc{PracRepair} generalizes effectively to RWB (Real-World Bugs), achieving the best performance across multiple foundation models.

item.title: OPD-Evolver: Cultivating Holistic Agent Evolver via On-Policy Distillation
item.author: Zhang, Guibin, Xu, Xun, Yue, Yanwei, Su, Zikun, Zhou, Wangchunshu, Hu, Xiaobin, Yan, Shuicheng
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为OPD-Evolver的慢快协同进化框架，通过在线策略自蒸馏培养具备自主进化能力的智能体。该框架利用四级记忆层次结构，在快速循环中实现经验的读取、使用、写入和维护，在慢速循环中通过结果校准的记忆归因和特权 hindsight 蒸馏将能力整合到可部署策略中。实验表明，OPD-Evolver在多个领域基准测试中显著优于现有记忆系统和训练方法，并成功将模型规模缩小至9B参数，挑战了参数量更大的模型。

背景: 记忆已成为自进化智能体的标准基础，但保留经验与学习如何通过经验进化是不同的。现有的记忆智能体能够存储轨迹、检索反思或积累技能，但通常缺乏选择有用经验、基于经验行动、编写可重用知识以及维护不断增长的知识库的整体能力。

目的: 培养具备整体能力的智能体进化器，使其能够选择有用经验、基于经验行动、编写可重用知识并维护不断增长的知识库。

方法: 提出OPD-Evolver框架，采用慢快协同进化机制。在快速循环中，智能体与四级记忆层次结构交互，进行经验的读取、使用、写入和维护，以实现快速的测试时进化。在慢速循环中，通过结果校准的记忆归因和特权 hindsight 蒸馏，将上述四种能力整合到可部署的策略中。

主要发现: 在多个领域的基准测试中，OPD-Evolver的性能比记忆系统（如ReasoningBank）高出最多11.5%，比基于训练的方法（如Skill0）高出约5.8%。进一步分析显示，OPD-Evolver内化了高价值经验和记忆管理能力，使得9B参数版本的模型能够挑战参数量更大的模型（如Qwen3.5-397B-A17B和Step-3.5-Flash）。

结论: OPD-Evolver通过内化高价值经验和记忆管理能力，实现了从记忆增强智能体向真正合格的智能体进化器的转变。

翻译: Memory has become a standard substrate for self-evolving agents, yet retaining experience is not the same as learning how to evolve through it. Existing memory agents can store trajectories, retrieve reflections, or accumulate skills, but often lack the holistic competence to select useful experience, act on it, write reusable knowledge, and maintain a growing repository. We introduce OPD-Evolver, a slow-fast co-evolution framework that cultivates such an agent evolver through on-policy self-distillation. In the fast loop, OPD-Evolver interacts with a four-level memory hierarchy to read, use, write, and maintain experience for rapid test-time evolution. In the slow loop, outcome-calibrated memory attribution and privileged hindsight distill these four abilities into the deployable policy. Across multi-domain benchmarks, OPD-Evolver surpasses memory systems such as ReasoningBank by up to 11.5%, and training-based methods such as Skill0 by ~5.8%. Further analysis shows that OPD-Evolver internalizes high-value experience and memory management, enabling OPD-Evolver-9B to challenge giant counterparts such as Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and Step-3.5-Flash, pointing beyond memory-augmented agents toward genuinely qualified agent evolvers.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有记忆增强型智能体缺乏系统性自我进化能力的问题，即无法在单一策略中协同完成经验筛选、基于经验的执行、知识写入与长期记忆管理。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为单纯的记忆存储无法转化为持续的行为改进，只有将这四个耦合能力统一训练，才能打破对提示词引导的依赖，实现智能体在长期交互中真正的自主进化与性能提升。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者指出现有记忆智能体往往只能优化经验利用的单一环节，缺乏整合选择、执行、写入和管理的综合能力，因此将合格智能体进化器定义为具备这四项耦合能力的系统。基于此，他们设计了快慢双循环框架，快循环负责在线交互与即时记忆更新，慢循环则利用任务结果校准的记忆归因和特权事后洞察信息，通过在线策略自蒸馏将四项能力内化为模型策略。该方法借鉴了现有记忆增强智能体、技能蒸馏以及在线策略蒸馏等技术，但突破了以往仅优化单一环节或仅提升执行能力的局限，实现了全生命周期的联合训练。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是通过慢快双循环协同进化，利用在线策略自蒸馏技术，将任务结果反馈转化为对经验选择、执行、写入和管理的联合监督，从而培养具备完整生命周期能力的智能体。整体流程分为快速与慢速两个循环：快速循环负责在线交互，智能体在四级记忆库中检索、筛选、使用经验并执行任务，随后写入新知识并定期维护记忆库；慢速循环则利用快速循环产生的日志，通过结果校准的记忆归因生成蒸馏目标，反向训练策略模型，使其内化并同步提升上述四项核心能力。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种慢快协同的在线策略自蒸馏框架，将智能体的自我进化能力系统定义为经验选择、经验驱动执行、经验写入和经验管理四项紧密耦合的能力。相比以往工作通常只优化记忆检索、执行或参数化训练中的单一环节，该方法通过快速循环进行实时交互与记忆维护，并利用慢速循环将任务结果校准后的特权事后反馈蒸馏为统一策略，从而在单一模型中协同训练这四项能力。这使得智能体不仅能存储经验，更能将其转化为持续的行为改进，实现了从单纯记忆增强向真正具备全生命周期进化能力的智能体的跨越。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种快慢循环协同的在线策略自蒸馏框架，通过将任务结果转化为监督信号，系统性地训练智能体在经验选择、执行、写入与管理四个维度上的综合能力，使其具备持续自我进化的能力。

Abstract

Memory has become a standard substrate for self-evolving agents, yet retaining experience is not the same as learning how to evolve through it. Existing memory agents can store trajectories, retrieve reflections, or accumulate skills, but often lack the holistic competence to select useful experience, act on it, write reusable knowledge, and maintain a growing repository. We introduce OPD-Evolver, a slow-fast co-evolution framework that cultivates such an agent evolver through on-policy self-distillation. In the fast loop, OPD-Evolver interacts with a four-level memory hierarchy to read, use, write, and maintain experience for rapid test-time evolution. In the slow loop, outcome-calibrated memory attribution and privileged hindsight distill these four abilities into the deployable policy. Across multi-domain benchmarks, OPD-Evolver surpasses memory systems such as ReasoningBank by up to 11.5%, and training-based methods such as Skill0 by ~5.8%. Further analysis shows that OPD-Evolver internalizes high-value experience and memory management, enabling OPD-Evolver-9B to challenge giant counterparts such as Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and Step-3.5-Flash, pointing beyond memory-augmented agents toward genuinely qualified agent evolvers.

item.title: Temporal Preference Optimization for Unsupervised Retrieval
item.author: HyunJin Kim, Jaejun Shim, Young Jin Kim, JinYeong Bak
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为TPOUR的无监督密集检索器，通过时间偏好优化方法解决检索结果在时间维度上的不匹配问题。

背景: 无监督密集检索器通过对比学习从非标注文档中学习语义相似度，具有可扩展性，但难以捕捉时间相关性，容易检索到语义相关但时间不匹配的文档，这在跨越多个时间段的文档集合中尤为重要。现有方法依赖带有明确时间戳的监督训练，而时间戳数据并不总是可用。

目的: 提出一种无需显式时间戳监督训练的方法，使检索器能够捕捉时间相关性，并泛化到未见过的时间段。

方法: 提出TPOUR（时间偏好优化用于无监督检索器），采用新颖的训练方法时间检索偏好优化（TRPO）。TRPO在时间维度上重新解释偏好学习，引导检索器偏好时间对齐的文档。TPOUR通过学习的时间嵌入进行插值，泛化到未见过的时间段，实现连续的时间对齐。

主要发现: 在时间信息检索任务上，TPOUR优于无监督和监督基线。与Qwen-Embedding-8B相比，TPOUR Contriever模型规模小约72.7倍，在显式查询上平均nDCG@5提升4.04（12.15%），在隐式查询上提升4.98（15.21%）。

结论: TPOUR通过时间偏好优化有效解决了无监督检索器在时间相关性捕捉上的不足，并在性能上显著优于现有方法，同时保持较小的模型规模。

翻译: Unsupervised dense retrievers offer scalability by learning semantic similarity from unlabeled documents via contrastive learning, but they struggle to capture the temporal relevance, retrieving semantically related but temporally misaligned documents-an important aspect when a document collection spans multiple time periods (e.g., retrieving documents from 2018-2025 for 'Who is the president in 2019?' introduces temporal ambiguity). Existing methods rely on supervised training with explicit timestamps, which are not always feasible. We propose TPOUR (Temporal Preference Optimization for Unsupervised Retriever), which uses our novel training method Temporal Retrieval Preference Optimization (TRPO). TRPO reinterprets preference learning in the temporal dimension, guiding the retriever to favor temporally aligned documents.
