Inside each window, tokens are scanned in four directions and passed through a two-stage slice-and-mix reservoir module. In the first stage, directional sequences are split into contiguous slices, each processed by its own fixed reservoir with a trainable closed-loop readout. The resulting slice outputs are summarized using the start, end, and mean representations, and then mixed by a second-stage fixed reservoir for each direction. The mixed slice representations are expanded back to the token level and fused with the first-stage outputs, after which the four directional outputs are realigned and averaged. Consecutive blocks alternate between regular and shifted windows to enable cross-window interaction, followed by layer normalization, a residual feed-forward network, and global pooling for classification. This design combines regular and shifted window partitioning with hierarchical multi-directional reservoirs to make an efficient local-to-cross-window token-mixing framework for image classification. Despite using under 1M trainable parameters and significantly lower memory and time than transformer-style baselines, HiRo also achieves 99.46%, 85.57%, and 59.10% accuracy on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100, respectively.

Abstract

Recent image classification models must balance local feature modeling, cross-window interaction, and parameter efficiency. Many high-performing architectures rely on fully trainable token-mixers, which improve representation learning but increase parameter count, optimization complexity and computational cost. We propose a parameter-efficient image classification model called HiRo that integrates shifted-window partitioning with multi-directional hierarchical reservoir computing. Images are divided into non-overlapping patches (treated as tokens), linearly projected, normalized, and enriched with 2D sinusoidal positional encodings, then processed within local windows. Inside each window, tokens are scanned in four directions and passed through a two-stage slice-and-mix reservoir module. In the first stage, directional sequences are split into contiguous slices, each processed by its own fixed reservoir with a trainable closed-loop readout. The resulting slice outputs are summarized using the start, end, and mean representations, and then mixed by a second-stage fixed reservoir for each direction. The mixed slice representations are expanded back to the token level and fused with the first-stage outputs, after which the four directional outputs are realigned and averaged. Consecutive blocks alternate between regular and shifted windows to enable cross-window interaction, followed by layer normalization, a residual feed-forward network, and global pooling for classification. This design combines regular and shifted window partitioning with hierarchical multi-directional reservoirs to make an efficient local-to-cross-window token-mixing framework for image classification. Despite using under 1M trainable parameters and significantly lower memory and time than transformer-style baselines, HiRo also achieves 99.46%, 85.57%, and 59.10% accuracy on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100, respectively.

item.title: Semantic Reasoning in Medicine: The Role of Knowledge Graphs Across Five Key Domains
item.author: Haniye Sherafatmandjoo, Mohammad Akbari, Zahed Rahmati
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 知识图谱在医疗保健领域整合和推理复杂生物医学及临床数据方面展现出巨大潜力，为决策、预测、推荐和个性化护理提供语义支持。

背景: 知识图谱通过表示疾病、药物、症状和患者记录等实体之间的结构化关系，在临床决策支持、疾病和治疗结果预测、健康推荐系统、精准医学和医学问答等多种医疗应用中展现出效用，增强了可解释性、语义连贯性和患者特定推理能力。

目的: 本综述旨在回顾和分类医学领域知识图谱的相关研究，讨论其益处和技术基础，概述关键局限性和开放的研究方向，以指导未来知识图谱驱动的医疗人工智能系统的发展，并支持其安全有效地整合到医疗环境中。

方法: 从应用导向和方法导向两个维度对医学知识图谱的研究进行回顾和分类，分析趋势、架构和评估实践。

主要发现: 尽管在从电子健康记录、临床叙述、生物医学文献和网络资源构建医学知识图谱方面取得了进展，但仍面临知识覆盖有限且碎片化、异构数据源对齐困难、当前推理和表示学习方法在密集多关系图上脆弱，以及隐私、偏见和问责制问题未解决等挑战。

结论: 知识图谱在医疗领域的应用具有广阔前景，但需克服现有技术和伦理挑战，未来研究应关注提升知识覆盖、数据对齐、推理鲁棒性以及解决隐私和偏见问题，以实现其在医疗环境中的安全有效整合。

翻译: Knowledge graphs (KGs) have emerged as a promising solution for integrating and reasoning over complex biomedical and clinical data in healthcare. By representing structured relationships among entities such as diseases, drugs, symptoms, and patient records, KGs provide a semantic backbone for decision-making, prediction, recommendation, and personalized care. Recent advances have demonstrated their utility across diverse medical applications--including clinical decision support systems, disease and treatment outcome prediction, health recommender systems, precision medicine, and medical question answering--where KGs often enhance interpretability, semantic coherence, and patient-specific reasoning. In parallel, a growing body of work focuses on medical KG generation itself, proposing frameworks that construct graphs from EHRs, clinical narratives, biomedical literature, and web resources using ontologies, semantic web technologies, deep-learning-based information extraction, and hybrid neuro-symbolic pipelines. Despite this progress, significant challenges remain, including limited and fragmented knowledge coverage, difficulties in aligning heterogeneous data sources, the fragility of current reasoning and representation-learning methods on dense multi-relational graphs, and unresolved issues related to privacy, bias, and accountability. This survey reviews and categorizes current research on KGs in medicine along both application-oriented and methodology-oriented dimensions, discusses their benefits and technical foundations, and outlines key limitations and open research directions. By analyzing trends, architectures, and evaluation practices, this work aims to guide future developments in KG-driven medical AI systems and support their safe and effective integration into healthcare environments.

Abstract

Knowledge graphs (KGs) have emerged as a promising solution for integrating and reasoning over complex biomedical and clinical data in healthcare. By representing structured relationships among entities such as diseases, drugs, symptoms, and patient records, KGs provide a semantic backbone for decision-making, prediction, recommendation, and personalized care. Recent advances have demonstrated their utility across diverse medical applications--including clinical decision support systems, disease and treatment outcome prediction, health recommender systems, precision medicine, and medical question answering--where KGs often enhance interpretability, semantic coherence, and patient-specific reasoning. In parallel, a growing body of work focuses on medical KG generation itself, proposing frameworks that construct graphs from EHRs, clinical narratives, biomedical literature, and web resources using ontologies, semantic web technologies, deep-learning-based information extraction, and hybrid neuro-symbolic pipelines. Despite this progress, significant challenges remain, including limited and fragmented knowledge coverage, difficulties in aligning heterogeneous data sources, the fragility of current reasoning and representation-learning methods on dense multi-relational graphs, and unresolved issues related to privacy, bias, and accountability. This survey reviews and categorizes current research on KGs in medicine along both application-oriented and methodology-oriented dimensions, discusses their benefits and technical foundations, and outlines key limitations and open research directions. By analyzing trends, architectures, and evaluation practices, this work aims to guide future developments in KG-driven medical AI systems and support their safe and effective integration into healthcare environments.

item.title: Controlled Dynamics Attractor Transformer
item.author: Cheng Zhang, Minnan Luo, Zesheng Yang, Ming Li, Yong-Jin Liu, Qinghua Zheng
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为受控动力学吸引子变换器（CDAT）的新模型，该模型结合了混合冯·米塞斯-费舍尔注意力能量与霍普菲尔德细化能量，并引入了类连续吸引子神经网络的兴奋抑制调制机制，以改进深度模型中的表示学习和推理过程。

背景: 变换器架构通过自注意力机制极大地推动了深度模型中的表示学习和推理。同时，联想记忆框架将表示映射到能量景观上，提供了可解释的检索机制。然而，其连续时间推理动力学缺乏经典连续吸引子神经网络的生物学合理性。

目的: 为了弥合变换器与连续吸引子神经网络在推理动力学上的差距，提出一种具有生物学合理性和可解释性的新型模型。

方法: 提出CDAT模型，将混合冯·米塞斯-费舍尔注意力能量与霍普菲尔德细化能量耦合，并增强能量下降过程，引入受连续吸引子神经网络启发的兴奋抑制调制。该模型实例化了一个拓扑约束的动力学系统，其耦合编码了标记之间的结构关系。

主要发现: CDAT通过结构化的动力学实现了受控推理过程，并在图异常检测和图分类的多个基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。

结论: CDAT成功地将吸引子动力学与现代基于能量的注意力机制联系起来，提供了鲁棒且结构化的推理动力学，并在多个任务中表现出色。

翻译: Transformer architectures have dramatically advanced representation learning and inference in deep models through self-attention mechanisms. In parallel, associative memory frameworks map representations onto energy landscapes, offering interpretable retrieval mechanisms. However, their continuous-time inference dynamics lack the biological plausibility of classical Continuous Attractor Neural Networks. To bridge this gap, we propose Controlled Dynamics Attractor Transformer, which couples a mixture von Mises-Fisher attention energy with a Hopfield refinement energy, while augmenting energy descent with a CANN-inspired excitation-inhibition modulation. CDAT instantiates a topology-constrained dynamical system whose couplings encode relational structure among tokens, thereby linking attractor-style dynamics to modern energy-based attention. We further provide a constructive dissipation analysis to formally establish their controlled inference dynamics. Benefiting from these robust and structured dynamics, CDAT achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks in graph anomaly detection and graph classification.

Abstract

Transformer architectures have dramatically advanced representation learning and inference in deep models through self-attention mechanisms. In parallel,associative memory (AM) frameworks map representations onto energy landscapes, offering interpretable retrieval mechanisms. However, their continuous-time inference dynamics lack the biological plausibility of classical Continuous Attractor Neural Networks (CANNs). To bridge this gap, we propose Controlled Dynamics Attractor Transformer (CDAT), which couples a mixture von Mises-Fisher (Mo-vMF) attention energy with a Hopfield refinement energy, while augmenting energy descent with a CANN-inspired excitation-inhibition modulation. CDAT instantiates a topology-constrained dynamical system whose couplings encode relational structure among tokens, thereby linking attractor-style dynamics to modern energy-based attention. We further provide a constructive dissipation analysis to formally establish their controlled inference dynamics. Benefiting from these robust and structured dynamics, CDAT achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks in graph anomaly detection and graph classification.

item.title: EnvShip-Bench: An Environment-Enhanced Benchmark for Short-Term Vessel Trajectory Prediction
item.author: Kun Ma, Qilong Han, Chengjing Song, Jingzheng Yao, Hao Wang, Changmao Wu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出EnvShip-Bench，一个基于大规模原始AIS数据构建的统一短期船舶轨迹预测基准，旨在解决现有海事AIS资源在预测协议、数据质量和上下文标注方面不一致的问题，为海事轨迹预测研究提供标准化、可扩展且具备上下文感知能力的基础。

背景: 船舶轨迹预测对智能航运、海事监视和导航安全至关重要。然而，现有的公开海事AIS资源通常受限于不一致的预测协议、不均匀的数据质量以及缺乏面向基准测试的上下文标注，这阻碍了公平比较和上下文感知建模。

目的: 解决现有海事AIS资源在预测协议、数据质量和上下文标注方面不一致的问题，为海事轨迹预测研究提供一个统一、标准化且具备上下文感知能力的基准。

方法: 通过统一的处理流程，利用丹麦海事局和NOAA的大规模原始AIS数据构建EnvShip-Bench。该基准采用标准化的预测协议，包括十分钟的观察期、十分钟的预测期和二十秒的采样间隔，并在以船舶为中心的局部度量坐标系中进行。除了大规模核心基准外，还提供高质量紧凑子集以支持高效可复现的实验，并同步提供环境和附近船舶的上下文扩展。

主要发现: EnvShip-Bench支持仅轨迹、环境感知和交互感知的预测，并在统一评估框架下进行了广泛的基准统计和分析。

结论: EnvShip-Bench为海事轨迹预测研究提供了一个标准化、可扩展且具备上下文感知能力的基础。

翻译: Vessel trajectory prediction is important for intelligent shipping, maritime surveillance, and navigation safety. However, existing public maritime AIS resources are often limited by inconsistent forecasting protocols, uneven data quality, and the lack of benchmark-ready contextual annotations, which hinder fair comparison and context-aware modeling. To address this gap, we present EnvShip-Bench, a unified benchmark for short-term vessel trajectory prediction built from large-scale raw AIS data from the Danish Maritime Authority (DMA) and NOAA through a common processing pipeline. EnvShip-Bench adopts a standardized forecasting protocol with 10 minutes of observation, 10 minutes of prediction, and 20-second sampling in vessel-centric local metric coordinates. Beyond the large-scale core benchmark, it provides a quality-first compact subset for efficient and reproducible experimentation, together with synchronized environmental and nearby-vessel context extensions. As a result, EnvShip-Bench supports trajectory-only, environment-aware, and interaction-aware forecasting under a unified evaluation framework. Extensive benchmark statistics and analysis demonstrate that EnvShip-Bench offers a standardized, extensible, and context-aware foundation for maritime trajectory forecasting research.

Abstract

Vessel trajectory prediction is important for intelligent shipping, maritime surveillance, and navigation safety. However, existing public maritime AIS resources are often limited by inconsistent forecasting protocols, uneven data quality, and the lack of benchmark-ready contextual annotations, which hinder fair comparison and context-aware modeling. To address this gap, we present EnvShip-Bench, a unified benchmark for short-term vessel trajectory prediction built from large-scale raw AIS data from the Danish Maritime Authority (DMA) and NOAA through a common processing pipeline. EnvShip-Bench adopts a standardized forecasting protocol with 10 minutes of observation, 10 minutes of prediction, and 20-second sampling in vessel-centric local metric coordinates. Beyond the large-scale core benchmark, it provides a quality-first compact subset for efficient and reproducible experimentation, together with synchronized environmental and nearby-vessel context extensions. As a result, EnvShip-Bench supports trajectory-only, environment-aware, and interaction-aware forecasting under a unified evaluation framework. Extensive benchmark statistics and analysis demonstrate that EnvShip-Bench offers a standardized, extensible, and context-aware foundation for maritime trajectory forecasting research.

item.title: Driving, Fast or Slow? Neuro-Symbolic Guidance for Motion Prediction in Multi-Modal Ground Mobility
item.author: Simon Kohaut, Felix Divo, Julius Hahnewald, Benedict Flade, Julian Eggert, Kristian Kersting, Devendra Singh Dhami
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为轨迹合规塑造的神经符号框架，用于异构交通空间中的准确且可解释的运动预测。

背景: 准确且可解释的运动预测对于自动驾驶导航至关重要，但现有方法多为黑盒，缺乏对现实世界交通法规和行为的显式编码。

目的: 增强现有黑盒运动预测骨干网络，使其具备可解释性和概率性一阶逻辑能力，以解决缺乏显式编码交通法规和行为规范的问题。

方法: 采用代理代码生成管道将自然语言描述的交通规则与概率运动预测相结合；使用反应式数据流推理引擎维护和更新合规景观；提出神经置信度评分作为上下文感知的合规信号衰减，以防止过度自信的错误引导。

主要发现: 在Argoverse 2基准测试中，该框架一致地提升了现有最先进预测骨干网络的性能，证明了概率和符号合规推理是一种广泛适用且计算高效的补充方法。

结论: 概率和符号合规推理可以作为纯神经运动预测器的有效补充，提升预测的准确性和可解释性。

翻译: Accurate and interpretable motion prediction for heterogeneous traffic spaces, including pedestrians, bicycles, cars, and trucks, is essential for safe autonomous navigation. Nevertheless, state-of-the-art approaches remain predominantly black-box, lacking explicit encoding of the regulatory and behavioral constraints of real-world mobility. We propose Trajectory Compliance-Shaping (TraCS), a neuro-symbolic framework that augments existing black-box motion prediction backbones with interpretable and probabilistic first-order logic. To do so, TraCS employs an agentic code-generation pipeline to bridge the gap between natural-language descriptions of traffic regulations and probabilistic motion prediction. Furthermore, TraCS employs a reactive data-streaming inference engine that maintains and efficiently updates compliance landscapes as scenes evolve. To prevent TraCS from overconfidently steering the backbone's predictions in the wrong direction, we propose a neural confidence rating learned as a context-aware attenuation of the compliance signal. We demonstrate on the Argoverse 2 benchmark how TraCS consistently improves state-of-the-art prediction backbones, showing that probabilistic and symbolic compliance reasoning is a broadly applicable and computationally efficient complement to purely neural motion predictors.

Abstract

Accurate and interpretable motion prediction for heterogeneous traffic spaces, including pedestrians, bicycles, cars, and trucks, is essential for safe autonomous navigation. Nevertheless, state-of-the-art approaches remain predominantly black-box, lacking explicit encoding of the regulatory and behavioral constraints of real-world mobility. We propose Trajectory Compliance-Shaping (TraCS), a neuro-symbolic framework that augments existing black-box motion prediction backbones with interpretable and probabilistic first-order logic. To do so, TraCS employs an agentic code-generation pipeline to bridge the gap between natural-language descriptions of traffic regulations and probabilistic motion prediction. Furthermore, TraCS employs a reactive data-streaming inference engine that maintains and efficiently updates compliance landscapes as scenes evolve. To prevent TraCS from overconfidently steering the backbone's predictions in the wrong direction, we propose a neural confidence rating learned as a context-aware attenuation of the compliance signal. We demonstrate on the Argoverse 2 benchmark how TraCS consistently improves state-of-the-art prediction backbones, showing that probabilistic and symbolic compliance reasoning is a broadly applicable and computationally efficient complement to purely neural motion predictors.

item.title: MamBOA: State-Space Architecture for Video Recognition
item.author: Mustafa Bora Çelik
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 MamBOA 的骨干网络无关的时序框架，该框架基于一种新颖的交错扫描结构，将选择性状态空间递归重新定义为原生运动合成器。通过交错提取的特征表示，该结构驱动递归编码每个位置的时序观测，并将帧间转换作为状态动态的内在组成部分。随后通过专门的对齐和解码操作将联合编码提炼为显式运动表示，并通过双路径池化机制自适应聚合。该框架与 CNN、Transformer 和 Mamba 骨干网络无缝接口，仅增加少量计算量。在 Diving48 数据集上取得了高精度，证明了结构诱导的状态空间动态是运动建模的 principled 和通用基础。

背景: 细粒度动作识别需要能够泛化的时序推理。通用架构通过不同的成本-准确性权衡来解决这一问题：三维密集算子将计算与输入体积耦合，而基于差异的方法通过未上下文特征的刚性手工减法来近似运动。每种方法都反映了在设计选择上的局限性，即在表达能力或灵活性方面的不足。

目的: 提出 MamBOA，一个骨干网络无关的时序框架，旨在解决现有方法在表达能力或灵活性上的局限性，提供一种 principled 和通用的运动建模基础。

方法: 1. 构建基于新颖交错扫描结构的 MamBOA 框架。2. 将选择性状态空间递归作为原生运动合成器。3. 交错提取的连续特征表示形成单一交替序列，驱动递归编码时序观测。4. 帧间转换成为状态动态的内在组成部分。5. 通过专门的对齐和解码操作提炼显式运动表示。6. 使用双路径池化机制自适应聚合运动表示，平衡注意力驱动的选择与均匀的时间覆盖。7. 框架与 CNN、Transformer 和 Mamba 骨干网络兼容。

主要发现: 1. MamBOA 在 Diving48 数据集上，使用图像预训练骨干网络时达到百分之八十五点零二的 Top-1 准确率。2. 使用视频预训练骨干网络处理整个视频单次前向传播时达到百分之八十六点二四的 Top-1 准确率。3. 该框架仅增加约两点一 GFLOPs 的计算量。4. 结构诱导的状态空间动态构成了运动建模的 principled 和通用基础。

结论: 结构诱导的状态空间动态构成了一种原则性和通用的运动建模基础。MamBOA 框架通过其独特的交错扫描结构和状态空间递归设计，实现了高效且高精度的细粒度动作识别，证明了其在不同骨干网络上的通用性和有效性。

翻译: Fine-grained action recognition demands temporal reasoning that general-purpose architectures address through different cost-accuracy tradeoffs: 3D dense operators couple computation to the input volume, while difference-based methods approximate motion through rigid, hand-crafted subtraction of uncontextualized features - each reflecting a deliberate design choice with corresponding limitations in expressiveness or flexibility. We present MamBOA, a backbone-agnostic temporal framework built upon a novel interleaved scan structure that recasts the selective state-space recurrence as a native motion synthesizer. By interleaving consecutive feature representations extracted from a pretrained backbone into a single alternating sequence, the proposed scan structurally drives the recurrence to encode both temporal observations of each position within a shared hidden state, separated by only a single decay step - rendering the inter-frame transition an intrinsic component of the state dynamics rather than an externally computed quantity. A cascade of dedicated alignment and decoding operations then distills this joint encoding into an explicit motion representation, which a dual-path pooling mechanism adaptively aggregates by balancing attention-driven selection with uniform temporal coverage. The framework interfaces seamlessly with CNN, Transformer, and Mamba backbone families, adding only ~2.1 GFLOPs per feature pair. On Diving48, MamBOA achieves 85.02% Top-1 accuracy with an image-pretrained backbone and 86.24% with a video-pretrained backbone processing the entire video in a single forward pass - demonstrating that structurally induced state-space dynamics constitute a principled and general foundation for motion modeling.

Abstract

Fine-grained action recognition demands temporal reasoning that general-purpose architectures address through different cost-accuracy tradeoffs: 3D dense operators couple computation to the input volume, while difference-based methods approximate motion through rigid, hand-crafted subtraction of uncontextualized features - each reflecting a deliberate design choice with corresponding limitations in expressiveness or flexibility. We present MamBOA, a backbone-agnostic temporal framework built upon a novel interleaved scan structure that recasts the selective state-space recurrence (S6) as a native motion synthesizer. By interleaving consecutive feature representations extracted from a pretrained backbone into a single alternating sequence, the proposed scan structurally drives the recurrence to encode both temporal observations of each position within a shared hidden state, separated by only a single decay step - rendering the inter-frame transition an intrinsic component of the state dynamics rather than an externally computed quantity. A cascade of dedicated alignment and decoding operations then distills this joint encoding into an explicit motion representation, which a dual-path pooling mechanism adaptively aggregates by balancing attention-driven selection with uniform temporal coverage. The framework interfaces seamlessly with CNN, Transformer, and Mamba backbone families, adding only ~2.1 GFLOPs per feature pair. On Diving48, MamBOA achieves 85.02% Top-1 accuracy with an image-pretrained backbone and 86.24% with a video-pretrained backbone processing the entire video in a single forward pass - demonstrating that structurally induced state-space dynamics constitute a principled and general foundation for motion modeling.

item.title: RECTOR: Masked Region-Channel-Temporal Modeling for Affective and Cognitive Representation Learning
item.author: Jinhan Liu, Mahsa Shoaran
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 情感与认知障碍表现为跨脑区、通道和时间的动态网络变化，对脑电图或立体定向脑电图的鲁棒表征学习构成挑战。本文提出RECTOR框架，通过掩码区域-通道-时间建模实现端到端自监督学习，结合自适应功能分区与层级块稀疏自注意力机制，优化预测建模、拓扑结构建模与跨视图一致性。该模型在脑电图情绪识别和立体定向脑电图任务参与度分类任务中达到最新水平，对缺失通道和跨设备泛化具有强鲁棒性，支持大规模异质数据预训练并提供可解释洞察。

背景: 情感与认知障碍表现为跨脑区、通道和时间的动态网络变化，对脑电图或立体定向脑电图的鲁棒表征学习构成挑战。

目的: 提出RECTOR框架，通过掩码区域-通道-时间建模实现端到端自监督学习，结合自适应功能分区与层级块稀疏自注意力机制，优化预测建模、拓扑结构建模与跨视图一致性。

方法: 提出RECTOR框架，通过掩码区域-通道-时间建模实现端到端自监督学习，结合自适应功能分区与层级块稀疏自注意力机制，优化预测建模、拓扑结构建模与跨视图一致性。

主要发现: 该模型在脑电图情绪识别和立体定向脑电图任务参与度分类任务中达到最新水平，对缺失通道和跨设备泛化具有强鲁棒性，支持大规模异质数据预训练并提供可解释洞察。

结论: 该模型在脑电图情绪识别和立体定向脑电图任务参与度分类任务中达到最新水平，对缺失通道和跨设备泛化具有强鲁棒性，支持大规模异质数据预训练并提供可解释洞察。

翻译: Affective and cognitive disorders manifest as distributed, time-varying brain network dynamics across regions, channels, and time, challenging robust representation learning from EEG/sEEG for clinical diagnosis. We propose RECTOR (Masked Region-Channel-Temporal Modeling), an end-to-end self-supervised framework that unifies joint region-channel-temporal representation learning beyond fixed anatomical priors. At its core, RECTOR-SA is a hierarchical, block-sparse self-attention induced by Adaptive Functional Partitioning that evolves region structures from static anatomical definitions to adaptive functional regions. The self-supervision is driven by Masked Topology and Representation Learning, which jointly optimizes three complementary objectives: Masked Predictive Modeling, Topological Structure Modeling, and Cross-View Consistency. Across diverse benchmarks, RECTOR sets a new state-of-the-art in EEG emotion recognition and sEEG task-engagement classification. Crucially, its strong robustness to missing channels and cross-montage generalization underscores its potential for large-scale pre-training on heterogeneous EEG/sEEG, providing interpretable insights at both region and channel levels.

Abstract

Affective and cognitive disorders manifest as distributed, time-varying brain network dynamics across regions, channels, and time, challenging robust representation learning from EEG/sEEG for clinical diagnosis. We propose RECTOR (Masked Region-Channel-Temporal Modeling), an end-to-end self-supervised framework that unifies joint region-channel-temporal representation learning beyond fixed anatomical priors. At its core, RECTOR-SA is a hierarchical, block-sparse self-attention induced by Adaptive Functional Partitioning that evolves region structures from static anatomical definitions to adaptive functional regions. The self-supervision is driven by Masked Topology and Representation Learning, which jointly optimizes three complementary objectives: Masked Predictive Modeling, Topological Structure Modeling, and Cross-View Consistency. Across diverse benchmarks, RECTOR sets a new state-of-the-art in EEG emotion recognition and sEEG task-engagement classification. Crucially, its strong robustness to missing channels and cross-montage generalization underscores its potential for large-scale pre-training on heterogeneous EEG/sEEG, providing interpretable insights at both region and channel levels.

item.title: CAP: Towards PPG Universal Representation Learning with Patient-level Supervision
item.author: Chenyang He, Xinyi Shao, Shun Huang, Bosong Huang, Daoqiang Zhang, Ming Jing, Cheng Ding
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于临床锚定预训练的PPG表示学习方法，通过构建大规模配对PPG-EHR多模态数据集，将PPG信号与患者级电子健康记录对齐，提升了在复杂临床任务中的泛化能力和鲁棒性。

背景: 光电容积脉搏波在可穿戴健康监测和临床决策支持中起核心作用，但现有方法多关注信号级目标，忽视患者级健康上下文，限制了在复杂临床任务和异质队列中的泛化能力。

目的: 解决现有方法忽视患者级健康上下文的问题，提升PPG表示在复杂临床任务中的泛化能力。

方法: 构建大规模配对PPG-EHR多模态数据集，提出临床锚定预训练方法，在预训练阶段进行跨模态对比对齐，将PPG表示锚定到患者级临床语义，在下游适应阶段提供临床基础的表示。

主要发现: 该方法在四个下游任务中 consistently 优于强基线，在呼吸频率预测任务上获得显著提升，相对最先进基线提升达百分之八十七点六，所有任务平均相对提升百分之二十六点七。

结论: 临床锚定预训练方法通过跨模态对齐提升了PPG表示的临床相关性和泛化能力，具有可解释性，代码已公开。

翻译: Photoplethysmography (PPG) plays a central role in wearable health monitoring and clinical decision support. Yet existing approaches to universal PPG representation learning largely focus on signal-level objectives and often overlook patient-level health context, which limits generalization to complex clinical tasks and heterogeneous cohorts. To address this gap, we construct a large-scale paired PPG-EHR multimodal dataset by distilling fragmented medical histories and clinical records into cohesive, patient-level electronic health records (EHR). Building on this resource, we propose Clinical Anchored Pretraining for PPG (CAP). During pretraining, CAP performs cross-modal contrastive alignment that anchors PPG representations to patient-level clinical semantics, guiding the encoder beyond waveform fitting toward modeling consistency in a patient's overall physiological state. During downstream adaptation, the pretrained PPG encoder provides clinically grounded representations that strengthen inductive bias and improve robustness and transferability. Experiments demonstrate that CAP consistently outperforms strong baselines on four diverse downstream tasks. CAP achieves a particularly large gain on respiratory rate prediction (up to +87.6% relative improvement over the state-of-the-art baseline) and delivers an average relative +26.7% across all tasks. We further enhance the interpretability of our approach through comprehensive analyses, including ablations and multiple complementary visualizations of the learned representations. The code for our experiments is available at: https://github.com/gody123gody/CAP .

Abstract

Photoplethysmography (PPG) plays a central role in wearable health monitoring and clinical decision support. Yet existing approaches to universal PPG representation learning largely focus on signal-level objectives and often overlook patient-level health context, which limits generalization to complex clinical tasks and heterogeneous cohorts. To address this gap, we construct a large-scale paired PPG-EHR multimodal dataset by distilling fragmented medical histories and clinical records into cohesive, patient-level electronic health records (EHR). Building on this resource, we propose Clinical Anchored Pretraining for PPG (CAP). During pretraining, CAP performs cross-modal contrastive alignment that anchors PPG representations to patient-level clinical semantics, guiding the encoder beyond waveform fitting toward modeling consistency in a patient's overall physiological state. During downstream adaptation, the pretrained PPG encoder provides clinically grounded representations that strengthen inductive bias and improve robustness and transferability. Experiments demonstrate that CAP consistently outperforms strong baselines on four diverse downstream tasks. CAP achieves a particularly large gain on respiratory rate prediction (up to +87.6% relative improvement over the state-of-the-art baseline) and delivers an average relative +26.7% across all tasks. We further enhance the interpretability of our approach through comprehensive analyses, including ablations and multiple complementary visualizations of the learned representations. The code for our experiments is available at: https://github.com/gody123gody/CAP .

item.title: Decoupled Motion Representation Learning for Moving Infrared Small Target Detection
item.author: Guoyi Zhang, Peiwen Wu, Han Wang, Xiangpeng Xu, Xiaohu Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种解耦运动表示学习框架，用于动态场景中的红外小目标检测。

背景: 动态场景中红外小目标检测面临目标、成像平台和动态背景之间高度耦合运动的挑战。现有方法通常进行隐式时间建模，导致背景动力学主导运动对应关系学习，从而在检测与虚警之间产生权衡。

目的: 提出一种解耦运动表示学习框架，以解决动态场景中红外小目标检测的问题。

方法: 引入显式运动分支，利用预训练的光流先验对全局相干运动动力学进行建模，并结合结构保持的自监督适应策略进行红外运动对应关系学习。同时，设计基于可变形特征对齐的隐式运动分支，在相干运动引导下捕捉对目标敏感的局部运动异常。此外，提出相干运动引导的局部异常推理模块，以在局部运动建模过程中识别并抑制由相干运动引起的虚警响应。

主要发现: 背景运动表现出强全局相干性，而小目标主要对应稀疏局部运动异常。许多虚警响应与全局相干运动模式保持高度一致性，表明它们主要源于相干背景动力学而非真实目标运动。

结论: 在两个具有挑战性的红外小目标检测基准上的广泛实验表明，所提方法在复杂运动的动态场景中持续优于现有最先进方法，同时保持了良好的推理效率。

翻译: Infrared small target detection in dynamic scenes remains challenging due to the highly coupled motions among targets, imaging platforms, and dynamic backgrounds. Existing multi-frame methods usually perform implicit temporal modeling, where coherent background dynamics dominate motion correspondence learning, leading to an inherent trade-off between detection and false alarms. In this work, we observe that background motions exhibit strong global coherence, whereas small targets mainly correspond to sparse local motion anomalies. Moreover, many false-alarm responses maintain high consistency with globally coherent motion patterns, indicating that they mainly originate from coherent background dynamics rather than genuine target motions. Based on these observations, we propose a decoupled motion representation learning framework for moving infrared small target detection. Specifically, an explicit motion branch is introduced to model globally coherent motion dynamics using pretrained optical flow priors, together with a structure-preserving self-supervised adaptation strategy for infrared motion correspondence learning. Meanwhile, an implicit motion branch based on deformable feature alignment is designed to capture target-sensitive local motion anomalies under coherent motion guidance. Furthermore, a coherent-motion-guided local anomaly reasoning module is proposed to identify and suppress coherent-motion-induced false responses during localized motion modeling. Extensive experiments on two challenging infrared small target detection benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches, particularly in dynamic scenes with complex motions, while maintaining favorable inference efficiency.

Abstract

Infrared small target detection in dynamic scenes remains challenging due to the highly coupled motions among targets, imaging platforms, and dynamic backgrounds. Existing multi-frame methods usually perform implicit temporal modeling, where coherent background dynamics dominate motion correspondence learning, leading to an inherent trade-off between detection and false alarms. In this work, we observe that background motions exhibit strong global coherence, whereas small targets mainly correspond to sparse local motion anomalies. Moreover, many false-alarm responses maintain high consistency with globally coherent motion patterns, indicating that they mainly originate from coherent background dynamics rather than genuine target motions. Based on these observations, we propose a decoupled motion representation learning framework for moving infrared small target detection. Specifically, an explicit motion branch is introduced to model globally coherent motion dynamics using pretrained optical flow priors, together with a structure-preserving self-supervised adaptation strategy for infrared motion correspondence learning. Meanwhile, an implicit motion branch based on deformable feature alignment is designed to capture target-sensitive local motion anomalies under coherent motion guidance. Furthermore, a coherent-motion-guided local anomaly reasoning module is proposed to identify and suppress coherent-motion-induced false responses during localized motion modeling. Extensive experiments on two challenging infrared small target detection benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches, particularly in dynamic scenes with complex motions, while maintaining favorable inference efficiency.

item.title: CODA-BENCH: Can Code Agents Handle Data-Intensive Tasks?
item.author: Zhang, Yuxin, Fan, Ju, Fan, Meihao, Zhang, Shaolei, Du, Xiaoyong
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了CODA-BENCH，这是首个在数据密集型环境中联合评估代码和数据智能的基准测试。该基准测试基于Kaggle生态系统构建，包含大量数据集和复杂文件层级，旨在模拟真实开发场景。评估结果显示，即使是表现最好的智能体在整合数据发现与代码执行方面仍存在显著困难，成功率仅为61.1%，揭示了当前智能体在数据密集型任务中的能力差距。

背景: 高级智能体展现出作为自主工程师的潜力，导致对能够捕捉现实世界开发复杂性的评估基准的需求日益增长。现实开发环境通常涉及复杂的代码和大规模数据（即文件系统）。然而，现有的基准测试通常孤立地评估以代码为中心或以数据为中心的能力，与现实开发场景存在明显差距。

目的: 弥合现有基准测试与现实开发场景之间的差距，通过引入CODA-BENCH来联合评估代码和数据智能。

方法: 构建一个基于Kaggle生态系统的数据密集型Linux沙箱，其中包含数百个数据集。智能体必须主动探索复杂的文件层级以识别相关资源，并为数据驱动的分析任务生成代码。CODA-BENCH包含1009个任务，涵盖31个社区，每个任务环境平均包含980个文件，以模拟真实的数据规模和噪声。

主要发现: 对高级智能体的评估显示，即使是表现最好的系统也难以有效整合数据发现与代码执行，成功率仅为61.1%。

结论: 当前智能体在数据密集型任务方面的能力存在显著差距，这为未来的研究指明了有前景的方向。

翻译: Advanced agents are increasingly demonstrating the potential to operate as autonomous engineers, creating a growing demand for evaluation benchmarks that capture the complexity of real-world development. Such environments typically involve both complex code and large-scale data (i.e., file system). However, existing benchmarks usually evaluate code-centric or data-centric capabilities in isolation, leaving a clear gap with real development scenarios. In this paper, we bridge this gap by introducing CODA-BENCH, the first benchmark to jointly evaluate code and data intelligence in a data-intensive environment. We construct a data-intensive Linux sandbox based on the Kaggle ecosystem (containing hundreds of datasets), where agents must actively explore complex file hierarchies to identify relevant resources and generate code for data-driven analytical tasks. CODA-BENCH comprises 1,009 tasks spanning 31 communities, with each task environment containing an average of 980 files, simulating realistic data scale and noise. Evaluations of advanced agents reveal that even top-performing systems struggle to effectively integrate data discovery with code execution, achieving a success rate of only 61.1%. These results highlight a substantial gap in current agentic capabilities for data-intensive tasks and point to promising directions for future research.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有评估基准将代码能力和数据能力割裂评估的问题，旨在首次联合测试智能体在数据密集型环境中自主发现数据并编写代码完成任务的综合能力。该问题在现实中非常重要，因为实际开发中智能体必须面对海量且杂乱的文件系统，无法直接获取现成数据。只有同时具备代码生成与数据探索能力，智能体才能真正胜任复杂的现实工程任务，而现有基准的单一评估方式无法反映这一真实需求。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者指出传统评测将代码与数据能力割裂，无法模拟真实开发中智能体自主探索复杂文件系统的场景，因此设计了联合评估这两项能力的基准。在具体构建上，他们依托数据科学社区的公开笔记，通过统计文件共现关系构建包含大量干扰项的仿真环境，并采用从标准答案反推问题的方式生成任务。同时，作者借鉴了生成对抗网络的理念，设计了由生成器与判别器博弈的迭代框架，以动态平衡任务的难度与可解性。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用真实数据科学社区的协作模式构建包含大量干扰文件的复杂文件系统，要求智能体自主探索并定位目标数据，进而编写代码完成分析任务，以此同时评估其代码能力与数据探索能力。整体实现流程首先通过分析人类编写的分析笔记构建数据集关联网络，按领域划分社区并生成包含目标数据与干扰项的评测环境。接着从笔记中提取确定的数值结果作为答案锚点，反向推导计算路径并生成自然语言题目。最后通过对抗性迭代机制不断调整题目难度，经人工审核确认题目既具挑战性又可解后，最终形成标准化评测基准。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了首个联合评估代码智能与数据智能的基准测试。它利用真实数据共现关系构建包含大量干扰文件的大规模沙盒环境，并采用基于解决方案的反向构建与对抗演化方法生成高难度任务。与以往仅单独评估代码生成或数据处理的基准不同，该工作要求智能体在复杂目录中自主发现目标数据并编写代码，填补了真实开发场景下双能力联合评估的空白。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了首个联合评估代码智能与数据智能的评测基准，通过构建基于公开数据集生态的真实大规模文件环境，揭示了当前智能体在处理数据密集型开发任务时的能力瓶颈。

Abstract

Advanced agents are increasingly demonstrating the potential to operate as autonomous engineers, creating a growing demand for evaluation benchmarks that capture the complexity of real-world development. Such environments typically involve both complex code and large-scale data (i.e., file system). However, existing benchmarks usually evaluate code-centric or data-centric capabilities in isolation, leaving a clear gap with real development scenarios. In this paper, we bridge this gap by introducing CODA-BENCH, the first benchmark to jointly evaluate code and data intelligence in a data-intensive environment. We construct a data-intensive Linux sandbox based on the Kaggle ecosystem (containing hundreds of datasets), where agents must actively explore complex file hierarchies to identify relevant resources and generate code for data-driven analytical tasks. CODA-BENCH comprises 1,009 tasks spanning 31 communities, with each task environment containing an average of 980 files, simulating realistic data scale and noise. Evaluations of advanced agents reveal that even top-performing systems struggle to effectively integrate data discovery with code execution, achieving a success rate of only 61.1%. These results highlight a substantial gap in current agentic capabilities for data-intensive tasks and point to promising directions for future research.

item.title: OneBar: An End-to-End Content-Grounded Generative Query Recommendation Framework for E-Commerce Video Feeds
item.author: Yao Tang, Ying Yang, Ben Chen, Yufei Ma, Zihan Liang, Chenyi Lei, Wenwu Ou, Jian Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出OneBar，一个用于电商视频流实时查询推荐的端到端生成框架，通过融合多模态视频理解与行为协作锚点、统一端到端架构及渐进式偏好学习策略，显著提升查询曝光、点击及GMV。

背景: 短视频平台在视频播放器下方提供可点击的搜索入口，使用户能轻松表达内容驱动的搜索意图。然而，传统查询推荐系统存在延迟限制和目标错位问题，近期生成式方法则面临噪声内容元数据和偏好漂移的挑战。

目的: 解决短视频平台查询推荐系统中的延迟限制、目标错位、噪声元数据及偏好漂移问题，实现实时查询推荐。

方法: 提出OneBar框架，包含三个关键创新：一是融合多模态视频理解和行为衍生协作锚点的协作多模态意图 grounding 模块；二是配备提示压缩机制以实现高效在线服务的统一端到端架构；三是渐进式偏好学习策略，将分层行为偏好内化到生成策略中，无需单独训练奖励模型。

主要发现: 与在线基线相比，OneBar使查询曝光增加百分之十六点九一，查询点击增加百分之十八点六八，查询点击率略有增长百分之零点一九。额外的搜索流量进一步带来百分之二十点三六的引导订单增长和百分之二十一点六七的GMV提升。

结论: OneBar框架有效解决了短视频平台查询推荐中的多项挑战，显著提升了用户搜索行为及电商转化指标。

翻译: Short-video platforms now expose clickable search entries beneath the video player, enabling users to easily express content-induced search intent. However, conventional query recommendation systems on short-video platforms suffer from latency constraints and objective misalignment, while recent generative approaches struggle with noisy content-side metadata and preference drift. To address these issues, we propose OneBar, an end-to-end generative framework for real-time query recommendation for E-Commerce video feeds. OneBar features three key innovations: (1) a collaborative-multimodal intent grounding module that fuses multimodal video understanding and behavior-derived collaborative anchors; (2) a Unified End-to-End architecture equipped with a prompt-compression mechanism for efficient online serving; and (3) a progressive preference learning strategy for efficient preference-internalization, which internalizes hierarchical behavior preferences into the generative policy, eliminating the need for a separately trained reward model. Compared with online base, OneBar increases Query Exposure by 16.91% and Query Click by 18.68%, while maintaining a slight Query CTR gain of 0.19%. The additional search traffic further contributes to 20.36% more guided orders and 21.67% higher GMV.

Abstract

Short-video platforms now expose clickable search entries beneath the video player, enabling users to easily express content-induced search intent. However, conventional query recommendation systems on short-video platforms suffer from latency constraints and objective misalignment, while recent generative approaches struggle with noisy content-side metadata and preference drift. To address these issues, we propose OneBar, an end-to-end generative framework for real-time query recommendation for E-Commerce video feeds. OneBar features three key innovations: (1) a collaborative-multimodal intent grounding module that fuses multimodal video understanding and behavior-derived collaborative anchors; (2) a Unified End-to-End architecture equipped with a prompt-compression mechanism for efficient online serving; and (3) a progressive preference learning strategy for efficient preference-internalization, which internalizes hierarchical behavior preferences into the generative policy, eliminating the need for a separately trained reward model. Compared with online base, OneBar increases Query Exposure by 16.91\% and Query Click by 18.68\%, while maintaining a slight Query CTR gain of 0.19\%. The additional search traffic further contributes to 20.36\% more guided orders and 21.67\% higher GMV.

item.title: Hierarchical Modeling of ICD Codes in EHR Foundation Models
item.author: Megha Thukral, Dong Gyun Kang, Rudra Pratap Singh, Shruthi Kashinath Hiremath, Katrin Hänsel, Thomas Plötz
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了ICD-10-CM层级结构作为临床表示学习的归纳偏置，通过增强诊断序列和注入图结构两种机制整合层级信息，并在真实临床数据集上验证了其有效性。

背景: 电子健康记录基础模型通常将ICD诊断代码视为扁平标记，忽略了具有临床意义的层级结构，现有方法未显式利用编码系统中已有的层级结构。

目的: 研究ICD-10-CM层级结构作为临床表示学习的归纳偏置，评估显式层级编码是否提升下游预测性能、层级有效性、跨数据集迁移能力及嵌入相似度结构。

方法: 采用两种互补机制整合层级：一是在BERT风格Transformer中增强诊断序列，添加对应不同层级ICD的标记；二是通过层级感知边与诊断共现结构结合，将层级注入基于图的代码表示。在MIMIC-IV和eICU数据集上进行实验。

主要发现: 显式编码ICD层级在域内和跨数据集设置下均优于扁平代码表示；最有益的层级取决于任务和建模方法；层级编码带来的收益在不同建模设置和层级中具有一般性。

结论: 层级感知的电子健康记录表示学习中，编码层级结构具有普遍优势，可提升模型性能并适用于多种场景。

翻译: Electronic health record foundation models typically treat ICD diagnosis codes as flat tokens, overlooking the clinically meaningful hierarchical structure that captures disease families, subcategories, and fine-grained diagnostic detail. As a result, existing EHR representation learning methods do not explicitly exploit the hierarchical structure already present in the coding system. In this work, we study ICD-10-CM hierarchy as a general inductive bias for clinical representation learning. We investigate two complementary mechanisms for incorporating hierarchy: first, by augmenting diagnosis sequences in a BERT-style transformer with tokens corresponding to different levels of the ICD hierarchy, and second, by injecting hierarchy into graph-based code representations through hierarchy-aware edges combined with diagnosis co-occurrence structure. Across these settings, we evaluate whether explicit hierarchy improves downstream prediction, which levels of the hierarchy are most useful, whether hierarchy encoding improves transfer across datasets, and how hierarchy reshapes embedding similarity structure. We conduct experiments on two large-scale real-world clinical datasets: MIMIC-IV, used for pretraining and in-domain evaluation, and eICU, used to assess cross-dataset transfer via frozen encoder probing. Our findings show that explicitly encoding ICD hierarchy improves over flat code representations in both in-domain and cross-dataset settings, while revealing that the most useful level of hierarchy depends on both the task and the modeling approach. More broadly, we focus on hierarchy-aware EHR representation learning and show that the benefits of encoding hierarchy are generalizable across modeling settings and hierarchy levels.

Abstract

Electronic health record foundation models typically treat ICD diagnosis codes as flat tokens, overlooking the clinically meaningful hierarchical structure that captures disease families, subcategories, and fine-grained diagnostic detail. As a result, existing EHR representation learning methods do not explicitly exploit the hierarchical structure already present in the coding system. In this work, we study ICD-10-CM hierarchy as a general inductive bias for clinical representation learning. We investigate two complementary mechanisms for incorporating hierarchy: first, by augmenting diagnosis sequences in a BERT-style transformer with tokens corresponding to different levels of the ICD hierarchy, and second, by injecting hierarchy into graph-based code representations through hierarchy-aware edges combined with diagnosis co-occurrence structure. Across these settings, we evaluate whether explicit hierarchy improves downstream prediction, which levels of the hierarchy are most useful, whether hierarchy encoding improves transfer across datasets, and how hierarchy reshapes embedding similarity structure. We conduct experiments on two large-scale real-world clinical datasets: MIMIC-IV, used for pretraining and in-domain evaluation, and eICU, used to assess cross-dataset transfer via frozen encoder probing. Our findings show that explicitly encoding ICD hierarchy improves over flat code representations in both in-domain and cross-dataset settings, while revealing that the most useful level of hierarchy depends on both the task and the modeling approach. More broadly, we focus on hierarchy-aware EHR representation learning and show that the benefits of encoding hierarchy are generalizable across modeling settings and hierarchy levels.

item.title: Transfer Learning for FHIR Questionnaire Terminology Binding
item.author: Maxim Gorshkov
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了电子预先授权工作流中FHIR问卷项与LOINC代码的匹配问题，将其视为检索问题，并比较了六种方法在包含九万七千三百一十四种活跃代码的池中的表现。

背景: 电子预先授权工作流要求FHIR问卷项携带LOINC代码，但HL7 Da Vinci CDS-Library中的大多数问卷项缺乏这些绑定。

目的: 给定问卷项的文本，从九万七千三百一十四种活跃代码池中找出正确的LOINC代码。

方法: 将问题视为检索问题，比较了六种方法：TF-IDF、冻结的MiniLM、BioBERT、BioLORD、对比微调的MiniLM以及TF-IDF加GPT重排序器。评估集包含五十四项，涵盖三种查询风格。

主要发现: 没有单一方法在所有指标上获胜。BioLORD（一种在生物医学本体定义上预训练的冻结编码器）在未见任务特定数据的情况下取得了最好的顶部排名准确率。对比微调在原始LHC-Forms对上的表现优于使用GPT生成 paraphrases 增强的数据。性能在五千个训练对时达到峰值。BioLORD的错误分析显示，错误特异性和模糊文本案例占错误的百分之五十九。

结论: BioLORD在零样本设置下表现最佳，而对比微调在特定指标上表现更好，但数据增强（添加GPT生成的paraphrases）可能降低性能。

翻译: Electronic prior authorization workflows require FHIR Questionnaire items to carry LOINC codes, yet most items in the HL7 Da Vinci CDS-Library lack these bindings. We treat this as a retrieval problem: given a Questionnaire item's text, find the correct LOINC code in a pool of 97,314 active codes. We compare six methods (TF-IDF, frozen MiniLM, BioBERT, BioLORD, contrastively fine-tuned MiniLM, and a TF-IDF+GPT reranker) on a 54-item evaluation set spanning three query styles (natural question, medium, and terse). No single method wins on every metric. BioLORD, a frozen encoder pre-trained on biomedical ontology definitions, has the best top-rank accuracy (R@1 = 0.185, MRR = 0.246) despite seeing no task-specific data, while a contrastive fine-tune on raw LHC-Forms pairs takes R@5 (0.389) and R@10 (0.426). A distribution-shift ablation shows why the fine-tune in our main table is not the strongest one: adding GPT-generated paraphrases to the raw pairs drops R@5 from 0.389 to 0.296, so the augmented union underperforms raw-only training on every metric except R@1. Performance peaks at 5k training pairs. Error analysis on BioLORD's R@1 failures shows that wrong-specificity and ambiguous-text cases together account for 59% of errors.

Abstract

Electronic prior authorization workflows require FHIR Questionnaire items to carry LOINC codes, yet most items in the HL7 Da Vinci CDS-Library lack these bindings. We treat this as a retrieval problem: given a Questionnaire item's text, find the correct LOINC code in a pool of 97,314 active codes. We compare six methods (TF-IDF, frozen MiniLM, BioBERT, BioLORD, contrastively fine-tuned MiniLM, and a TF-IDF+GPT reranker) on a 54-item evaluation set spanning three query styles (natural question, medium, and terse). No single method wins on every metric. BioLORD, a frozen encoder pre-trained on biomedical ontology definitions, has the best top-rank accuracy (R@1 = 0.185, MRR = 0.246) despite seeing no task-specific data, while a contrastive fine-tune on raw LHC-Forms pairs takes R@5 (0.389) and R@10 (0.426). A distribution-shift ablation shows why the fine-tune in our main table is not the strongest one: adding GPT-generated paraphrases to the raw pairs drops R@5 from 0.389 to 0.296, so the augmented union underperforms raw-only training on every metric except R@1. Performance peaks at 5k training pairs. Error analysis on BioLORD's R@1 failures shows that wrong-specificity and ambiguous-text cases together account for 59% of errors.

item.title: PHINN: Persistent Homology Inspired Neural Network for Rare-Event Time Series Generation
item.author: Emre Yusuf, Ren Takahashi, Jayabrata Bhaduri
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为PHINN的流匹配框架，用于生成时间序列中的罕见事件。该框架利用动态贝蒂曲线作为条件信号，并采用持续景观损失来确保同调一致性。实验表明，PHINN在金融、流行病学和多模态基准测试中，在拓扑保真度方面优于统计和扩散基线模型，在尾部覆盖方面与跳跃扩散模型相当，但在形状保真度上更优。

背景: 时间序列中的罕见事件对于建模至关重要，但由于数据稀缺而难以学习。当前的生成模型在处理极端值方面存在困难。

目的: 解决罕见事件生成问题，利用贝蒂数的拓扑特征（贝蒂曲线）作为更稳定和具有判别性的条件信号，以生成具有特定拓扑特征的时间序列数据。

方法: 提出PHINN框架，这是一种流匹配方法。它使用动态贝蒂曲线作为条件信号，并引入持续景观损失以保证同调一致性。该框架支持多变量数据扩展，提供自然语言接口以设置贝蒂目标，支持跨领域元学习和少样本生成，并提供认证的对抗鲁棒性。

主要发现: 在金融、流行病学和多模态基准测试中，PHINN在拓扑保真度方面显著优于统计和扩散基线模型（贝塔均方根误差降低41-63%，转换准确率提高84%）。在尾部覆盖方面与跳跃扩散模型相当，但在形状保真度上超过它们。所有结果均具有95%的置信区间。

结论: PHINN框架能够有效生成罕见事件，在拓扑特征保持和形状保真度方面表现优异，为罕见事件的时间序列生成提供了一种新的有效方法。

翻译: Time series rare events are critical to model but hard to learn due to data scarcity. Current generative models struggle with extreme values. We observe that rare events leave distinct topological fingerprints - transitions in Betti numbers from point-cloud embeddings - that are more stable and discriminative than statistical moments. We introduce PHINN, a flow-matching framework using dynamic Betti curves as conditioning signals and a persistence landscape loss for homology consistency. It scales to multivariate data, includes a natural-language interface to set Betti targets, supports cross-domain meta-learning and few-shot generation, and provides certified adversarial robustness. On financial, epidemiological, and multi-modal benchmarks, PHINN outperforms statistical and diffusion baselines in topological fidelity (beta-RMSE down 41-63%, transition accuracy up 84%) and matches jump-diffusion models in tail coverage while exceeding them in shape fidelity. All results have 95% confidence intervals.

Abstract

Rare events in time series are critical to model but hard to learn due to data scarcity. Current generative models struggle with extreme values. We observe that rare events leave distinct topological fingerprints - transitions in Betti numbers from point-cloud embeddings - that are more stable and discriminative than statistical moments. We introduce PHINN, a flow-matching framework using dynamic Betti curves as conditioning signals and a persistence landscape loss for homology consistency. It scales to multivariate data, includes a natural-language interface to set Betti targets, supports cross-domain meta-learning and few-shot generation, and provides certified adversarial robustness. On financial, epidemiological, and multi-modal benchmarks, PHINN outperforms statistical and diffusion baselines in topological fidelity (beta-RMSE down 41-63%, transition accuracy up 84%) and matches jump-diffusion models in tail coverage while exceeding them in shape fidelity. All results have 95% confidence intervals.

item.title: Contrastive learning of dynamical representations for enhanced molecular sampling
item.author: Kai Zhu, Jintu Zhang, Pietro Novelli, Tingjun Hou, Luigi Bonati
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为SelfTICA的自监督对比学习框架，用于发现复杂系统中的集体变量。该方法将集体变量发现重新定义为动力学表示学习，通过时间滞后分子构型定义正负样本对，利用与谱变分原理相关的对比目标学习可重用特征，并在表示空间中应用时间滞后独立成分分析提取正交慢模式。SelfTICA解耦了表示学习与慢模式提取，避免了直接优化基于特征分解的目标，并允许在不同滞后时间下评估频谱和集体变量而无需重新训练。在多种原子系统中，SelfTICA能够从有限、有偏或探索性数据中学习动力学表示，并将其转化为加速稀有事件探索和自由能收敛的集体变量。

背景: 识别捕捉慢动力学模式的集体变量对于在复杂系统中采样稀有事件至关重要。现有的机器学习方法通常需要预定义的亚稳态、精心选择的描述符或具有高质量动力学信息的训练轨迹。

目的: 引入SelfTICA框架，以解决现有方法对预定义状态或高质量数据的依赖，实现集体变量的自动发现。

方法: 提出SelfTICA框架，通过自监督对比学习将集体变量发现转化为动力学表示学习。具体步骤包括：从时间滞后分子构型中定义正负样本对；利用与谱变分原理相关的对比目标学习可重用特征；在表示空间中应用时间滞后独立成分分析提取正交慢模式。

主要发现: SelfTICA能够解耦表示学习与慢模式提取，避免直接优化基于特征分解的目标，并允许在不同滞后时间下评估频谱和集体变量而无需重新训练。在多种原子系统中，该方法能够从有限、有偏或探索性数据中学习动力学表示，并转化为加速稀有事件探索和自由能收敛的集体变量。

结论: SelfTICA提供了一种有效的集体变量发现方法，能够从有限或偏置数据中学习动力学表示，从而加速复杂系统中的稀有事件探索和自由能收敛。

翻译: Identifying collective variables that capture slow dynamical modes is essential for sampling rare events in complex systems. Existing machine-learning approaches often require predefined metastable states, carefully chosen descriptors, or training trajectories with high-quality kinetic information. Here, we introduce SelfTICA, a self-supervised contrastive-learning framework that reformulates collective-variable discovery as dynamical representation learning. SelfTICA defines positive and negative pairs from time-lagged molecular configurations, learns reusable features through a contrastive objective linked to spectral variational principles, and extracts orthogonal slow modes by applying time-lagged independent component analysis in the learned representation space. By decoupling representation learning from slow-mode extraction, SelfTICA avoids direct optimization of eigendecomposition-based objectives and enables spectra and collective variables to be evaluated across lag times without retraining. Across different atomistic systems, SelfTICA learns dynamical representations from limited, biased, or exploratory data and converts them into collective variables that accelerate rare-event exploration and improve free-energy convergence.

Abstract

Identifying collective variables that capture slow dynamical modes is essential for sampling rare events in complex systems. Existing machine-learning approaches often require predefined metastable states, carefully chosen descriptors, or training trajectories with high-quality kinetic information. Here, we introduce SelfTICA, a self-supervised contrastive-learning framework that reformulates collective-variable discovery as dynamical representation learning. SelfTICA defines positive and negative pairs from time-lagged molecular configurations, learns reusable features through a contrastive objective linked to spectral variational principles, and extracts orthogonal slow modes by applying time-lagged independent component analysis in the learned representation space. By decoupling representation learning from slow-mode extraction, SelfTICA avoids direct optimization of eigendecomposition-based objectives and enables spectra and collective variables to be evaluated across lag times without retraining. Across different atomistic systems, SelfTICA learns dynamical representations from limited, biased, or exploratory data and converts them into collective variables that accelerate rare-event exploration and improve free-energy convergence.

item.title: Selective Synergistic Learning for Video Object-Centric Learning
item.author: WonJun Moon, Jae-Pil Heo
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种选择性协同学习方法，旨在解决视频对象中心学习中基于槽的框架存在的重建驱动架构问题。

背景: 典型的视频对象中心学习方法采用基于槽的框架，依赖重建驱动的编码器-解码器架构，通过注意力图和对象图进行空间映射。最近的研究尝试通过密集对齐策略解决两种地图属性差异的问题，但存在误差传播和计算成本高的问题。

目的: 提出一种选择性协同学习方法，避免误差传播，提高分解质量，并作为即插即用模块增强鲁棒性。

方法: 采用选择性蒸馏最可靠线索的方法，利用编码器进行边界细化，解码器进行内部去噪。通过伪标签技术实现线性复杂度，避免二次空间比较。引入传递伪标签合并，基于时空激活一致性整合重叠槽。

主要发现: 选择性协同学习方法提高了分解质量，作为即插即用模块表现出对槽配置的鲁棒性。

结论: 该方法有效解决了现有方法的局限性，提升了视频对象中心学习的性能。

翻译: Typical video object-centric learning approaches use slot-based frameworks with reconstruction-driven encoder-decoder architectures. A recent dense alignment strategy attempted to reconcile discrepancies between attention and object maps but propagated errors and incurred high computational costs. We propose Selective Synergistic Learning to prevent error propagation by selectively distilling reliable cues for boundary refinement and interior denoising. This is achieved via pseudo-labeling with linear complexity and transitive pseudo-label merging to consolidate overlapping slots. Extensive studies show improved decomposition quality and robustness to slot configurations.

Abstract

Typical video object-centric learning (VOCL) approaches employ slot-based frameworks that rely on reconstruction-driven encoder-decoder architectures, where learning is mediated by two spatial maps: attention maps from the encoder and object maps from the decoder. As these two distinct maps exhibit different properties, a recent dense alignment strategy attempted to reconcile this discrepancy by enforcing agreement across all spatio-temporal patches via contrastive learning. However, this indiscriminate alignment inadvertently propagates the inherent weaknesses of each module, such as noisy encoder predictions and blurred decoder boundaries. Moreover, computing dense similarities across all pairs incurs a computational cost quadratic in the total number of spatio-temporal patches, severely limiting scalability. Motivated by this, we propose Selective Synergistic Learning (SSync). Instead of exhaustive patch-to-patch alignment, SSync prevents error propagation by selectively distilling only the most reliable cues: leveraging the encoder strictly for boundary refinement and the decoder for interior denoising. This is realized via a pseudo-labeling with linear complexity, eliminating the need for quadratic spatial comparisons. Also, to prevent the reinforcement of architectural biases like slot redundancy, we introduce a transitive pseudo-label merging that consolidates overlapping slots based on spatio-temporal activation consistency. Extensive studies demonstrate that SSync improves decomposition quality and serves as a versatile, plug-and-play module while also exhibiting exceptional robustness to slot configurations. Code is available at github.com/wjun0830/SSync.

item.title: DenseControl: Instance-Level Controllable Synthesis of Dense Crowd Image
item.author: Juncheng Wang, Lei Shang, Wang Lu, Baigui Sun, Shujun Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为DenseControl的新颖流水线，用于生成密集人群图像。该流水线能够精确控制每个生成实例的位置和大小，并支持对背景、风格和实例属性的控制。

背景: 在合成人群图像时面临两个主要挑战：控制信号嵌入和维持拓扑完整性，特别是在提供实例尺度指导时。

目的: 解决密集人群图像合成中的控制信号嵌入和拓扑完整性问题，实现精确的位置和尺度控制，并支持背景、风格和属性的控制。

方法: 引入隔离对象嵌入（IOE）图以实现空间位置控制；提出隐式尺度嵌入（ISE）策略以编码精确尺度信息；结合位置捷径机制增强交叉注意力，缓解投影挑战。

主要发现: 在不同控制条件下的实验表明，DenseControl在密集人群图像合成方面达到了最先进（SOTA）的结果。

结论: DenseControl在密集人群图像合成中表现出色，并在数据稀缺下的群体分析增强、迁移学习和天气泛化场景中展示了其实用价值。代码库将公开。

翻译: In this paper, we introduce DenseControl, a novel pipeline for generating dense crowd images. Specifically, DenseControl meticulously positions and sizes each generated instance to align precisely with the predefined coordinates and scales. Based on this, we further allow for control over the background, style, and attributes of instances. The motivation behind DenseControl stems from the observation of two main challenges in synthesizing crowd images: controlling signal embedding and maintaining topological integrity when imparting instance scale guidance. To address these, we first introduce the Isolated Object Embedding (IOE) map, a novel representation that facilitates spatial location control while mitigating the difficulties associated with learning projections for model. Secondly, we propose an Implicit Scale Embedding (ISE) strategy that seamlessly integrates with the IOE map to encode precise scale information. To further enhance the efficacy of combining ISE with the IOE map, we incorporate a Position Shortcut mechanism that enhances cross-attention to alleviate projection challenges. We evaluate DenseControl through two lenses: synthesis quality and applicability in latent applications. Experiments across different control conditions demonstrate DenseControl achieves state-of-the-art results in dense crowd image synthesis. Furthermore, we showcase applications in augmenting crowd analysis under data scarcity, transfer learning, and weather generalization scenes, to highlight the practical utility of DenseControl. The codebase will be released.

Abstract

In this paper, we introduce DenseControl, a novel pipeline for generating dense crowd images. Specifically, DenseControl meticulously positions and sizes each generated instance to align precisely with the predefined coordinates and scales. Based on this, we further allow for control over the background, style, and attributes of instances. The motivation behind DenseControl stems from the observation of two main challenges in synthesizing crowd images: controlling signal embedding and maintaining topological integrity when imparting instance scale guidance. To address these, we first introduce the Isolated Object Embedding (IOE) map, a novel representation that facilitates spatial location control while mitigating the difficulties associated with learning projections for model. Secondly, we propose an Implicit Scale Embedding (ISE) strategy that seamlessly integrates with the IOE map to encode precise scale information. To further enhance the efficacy of combining ISE with the IOE map, we incorporate a Position Shortcut mechanism that enhances cross-attention to alleviate projection challenges. We evaluate DenseControl through two lenses: synthesis quality and applicability in latent applications. Experiments across different control conditions demonstrate DenseControl achieves state-of-the-art results in dense crowd image synthesis. Furthermore, we showcase applications in augmenting crowd analysis under data scarcity, transfer learning, and weather generalization scenes, to highlight the practical utility of DenseControl. The codebase will be released.

item.title: Retrieve, Don't Retrain: Extending Vision Language Action Models to New Tasks at Test Time
item.author: Park, Jeongeun, Park, Juhan, Kim, Taekyung, Choi, Sungjoon, Han, Dongyoon, Yun, Sangdoo
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种检索增强的视觉语言动作策略，通过检索替代目标侧的逐任务微调，降低了新任务适应的数据收集和计算成本。

背景: 扩展视觉语言动作策略到新任务通常需要特定任务的遥操作演示和逐任务微调，导致数据收集和计算成本高昂。

目的: 用检索替代目标侧的逐任务适应成本，实现更高效的新任务适应。

方法: 在目标本体和更便宜的本体（如人手视频）的配对演示上训练一次检索增强策略，然后冻结。部署时通过向检索池追加演示来添加新任务，策略在每个控制步骤基于检索到的轨迹进行条件判断。

主要发现: 检索提升了策略性能，尤其在基于视频生成的世界动作模型中效果显著。检索提供粗粒度的任务进展，而未来图像目标提供额外的视觉一致性信号。在PushT任务中，检索提供了可重用的高级运动先验，实现了跨本体泛化。在RoboTwin 2.0上，该方法在未见任务上优于跨本体基线。

结论: 检索增强策略通过索引数据而非更新参数来吸收新任务，仅需在新本体出现时进行微调，显著降低了适应成本。

翻译: 将新任务扩展到视觉语言动作策略通常需要特定任务的遥操作演示和逐任务微调，这使得数据收集和计算成本高昂。在本文中，我们表明这种目标侧的逐任务适应成本可以被检索所替代。我们的检索增强策略在目标本体（查询）和更便宜的本体（池，例如人手视频）的配对演示上训练一次，然后冻结。新任务在部署时通过向检索池追加池侧演示来添加。冻结的策略在每个控制步骤基于检索到的轨迹进行条件判断，因此新任务通过索引数据而非更新参数被吸收。微调仅用于应对新的、未见过的本体，而不是每个新任务。我们表明检索提升了策略性能，超越了特定的骨干网络，包括标准的视觉语言动作策略，但其效果在基于视频生成的世界动作模型中尤为显著。在这种设置下，检索提供了粗粒度的任务进展，而世界动作模型的未来图像目标提供了额外的视觉一致性信号，加强了检索条件动作。在PushT任务中，我们研究了检索如何提供可重用的高级运动先验，以实现对未见目标角度的跨本体泛化。在RoboTwin 2.0上，我们的方法在未见任务上优于跨本体基线，并且我们还在真实机器人上演示了该方法。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决机器人策略在应对新任务时，因需要逐次收集遥操作演示数据并对模型进行逐任务微调而产生的高昂数据与计算成本问题。该问题在现实与研究中至关重要，因为传统方法严重依赖耗时且受硬件限制的遥操作数据采集，且大型模型微调消耗大量算力，严重阻碍了机器人技术的规模化应用与快速部署。本文提出的检索增强方法通过冻结模型参数并仅扩展外部演示库，实现了零训练成本的新任务扩展，大幅降低了机器人适应新环境的门槛。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者认为传统方法为每个新任务收集遥操作数据并微调模型成本过高，因此提出将任务适应从重复训练转向基于检索的范式。他们设计了一个只需训练一次并冻结的策略，通过检索廉价源端的演示数据来提供高层运动规划，策略仅学习针对目标机器人的具体执行修正，并借鉴了自然语言处理中检索增强生成的思想。同时，该方法在视觉语言动作模型和跨具身迁移的现有研究基础上进行了改进，避免了每次新任务都需重新训练或微调的开销。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是放弃为每个新任务重新训练模型，改为在测试时通过检索已有的低成本演示数据来扩展任务能力。整体流程为：首先用目标机器人和低成本演示的配对数据训练一次模型并冻结参数；随后将低成本演示存入检索库；遇到新任务时，系统根据当前状态从库中检索最匹配的演示片段，输入冻结的模型中直接生成控制指令；新增任务只需向库中添加对应演示数据即可，无需更新模型参数。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种测试时检索替代重训练的范式，将策略对新任务的适应过程从反复的参数微调转变为单纯的数据索引。模型仅需在训练阶段学习一次跨机械臂的映射关系并冻结参数，后续新增任务只需将廉价的源端演示数据加入检索库即可直接调用。相比以往需要为每个新任务单独收集遥操作数据并进行微调的工作，该方法彻底消除了新任务的训练成本，仅通过扩展检索池即可实现任务覆盖的扩展，同时利用视频生成模型的视觉一致性目标进一步提升了长程行为的执行效果。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种在测试时通过检索廉价演示数据来扩展模型的新方法，使视觉语言动作模型在保持参数冻结的情况下仅通过扩展检索库即可适应新任务，从而避免了逐任务微调带来的高昂数据与计算成本。

Abstract

Extending a vision-language-action (VLA) policy to a new task typically requires task-specific teleoperated demonstrations and per-task fine-tuning, making adaptation costly in both data collection and compute. In this paper, we show that this target-side per-task adaptation cost can be replaced by retrieval. Our retrieval-augmented policy is trained once on paired demonstrations from the target embodiment (query) and a cheaper embodiment (pool, e.g., human-hand video), then frozen. New tasks are added at deployment by appending pool-side demonstrations to a retrieval pool. The frozen policy conditions on retrieved trajectories at every control step, so new tasks are absorbed by indexing data rather than updating parameters. Fine-tuning is needed only to take on a new, unseen embodiment, not for each new task. We show that retrieval improves policies beyond a specific backbone, including standard VLA policies, but its effect is especially pronounced in Cosmos Policy, a video-generation-based world-action model (WAM). In this setting, retrieval supplies coarse task progression, while the WAM's future-image objective provides an additional visual consistency signal that strengthens the retrieval-conditioned actions. On PushT, we study how retrieval provides a reusable high-level motion prior for cross-embodiment generalization to unseen goal angles, while on RoboTwin 2.0 our method outperforms cross-embodiment baselines on unseen tasks, and we additionally demonstrate the method on a real robot.

item.title: MambAdapter: Lightweight Mamba-Based Adapters for Parameter-Efficient Transfer Learning in Speech and Audio
item.author: Salman Hussain Ali, Umberto Cappellazzo, Mirco Ravanelli
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为MambAdapter的参数高效迁移学习方法，该方法将Mamba模块集成到低秩瓶颈适配器中，用于音频和语音处理领域的领域自适应。

背景: 微调基于Transformer的基础模型已成为音频和语音处理领域自适应的主导策略。为了降低计算和内存成本，参数高效迁移学习方法已被广泛探索。同时，Mamba作为一种新兴的状态空间模型，已成为序列建模中替代Transformer的有前景的选择。

目的: 提出一种参数高效迁移学习方法，以更有效地对音频特征进行建模，同时降低计算和内存成本。

方法: 提出MambAdapter方法，将Mamba集成到低秩瓶颈适配器中。该设计结合了适配器之间的参数共享与轻量级Mamba模块的注入。

主要发现: 在四个音频分类任务和五种语音识别语言上，MambAdapter在减少参数预算的情况下，匹配或优于强大的参数高效迁移学习基线方法。

结论: MambAdapter是一种有效的参数高效迁移学习方法，能够在降低参数预算的同时实现良好的音频和语音处理性能。

翻译: Fine-tuning Transformer-based foundation models has become the dominant strategy for domain adaptation in audio and speech processing. To reduce the computational and memory costs of this process, parameter-efficient transfer learning (PETL) methods have been widely explored. Meanwhile, Mamba, a recent state-space model, has emerged as a promising alternative to Transformers for sequence modeling. In this work, we present MambAdapter, a parameter-efficient transfer learning approach that integrates Mamba into low-rank bottleneck adapters. Our design combines parameter sharing across adapters with the injection of a lightweight Mamba module, enabling more effective modeling of audio features. We demonstrate that MambAdapter matches or outperforms strong PETL baselines on four audio classification tasks and five speech recognition languages, even when operating under reduced parameter budgets.

Abstract

Fine-tuning Transformer-based foundation models has become the dominant strategy for domain adaptation in audio and speech processing. To reduce the computational and memory costs of this process, parameter-efficient transfer learning (PETL) methods have been widely explored. Meanwhile, Mamba, a recent state-space model, has emerged as a promising alternative to Transformers for sequence modeling. In this work, we present MambAdapter, a parameter-efficient transfer learning approach that integrates Mamba into low-rank bottleneck adapters. Our design combines parameter sharing across adapters with the injection of a lightweight Mamba module, enabling more effective modeling of audio features. We demonstrate that MambAdapter matches or outperforms strong PETL baselines on four audio classification tasks and five speech recognition languages, even when operating under reduced parameter budgets.

item.title: CIWI-CKT: Chaos-Informed Wave Interference Feature Fusion and Cross-City Knowledge Transfer for Traffic Flow Forecasting
item.author: Abdul Joseph Fofanah, Lian Wen, David Chen, Shaoyang Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为CIWI-CKT的新型框架，旨在解决跨城市数据稀缺场景下的交通流量预测问题。该框架通过混沌信息波干扰特征融合与跨城市知识转移，有效提升了预测精度并减少了对训练数据的需求。

背景: 在跨城市数据稀缺的场景中，由于历史数据有限，模型泛化能力受到限制。交通动态的混沌特性、复杂的时空依赖关系以及异质城市网络使得跨城市的少样本学习变得复杂。现有的深度学习方法要么将交通视为纯确定性过程，要么缺乏对跨区域交通动态中至关重要的波状干扰模式的建模机制。

目的: 解决现有方法在跨城市数据稀缺场景下泛化能力不足、无法有效建模波状干扰模式的问题，提高交通流量预测的准确性并减少对训练数据的需求。

方法: 提出CIWI-CKT框架，包含三个核心创新：一是混沌信息波生成，提取可测量的混沌不变量并将交通建模为自适应波分量；二是元干扰处理，捕捉支持集与查询集之间的波相互作用，并生成用于置信度估计的可预测性评分；三是混沌感知元学习，实现高效的跨城市知识转移同时保留混沌特征。

主要发现: 在四个真实世界交通数据集上的广泛实验表明，CIWI-CKT显著优于最先进的时空图学习、迁移学习、基于提示和少样本方法，在提高预测精度的同时大幅减少了所需的训练数据量。

结论: CIWI-CKT框架通过引入混沌信息波干扰特征融合与跨城市知识转移机制，有效解决了跨城市数据稀缺场景下的交通流量预测挑战，具有理论保证和显著的实验优势。

翻译: Accurate traffic flow prediction remains challenging in cross-city, data-scarce scenarios where limited historical data hinders model generalisation. The chaotic nature of traffic dynamics, complex spatio-temporal dependencies, and heterogeneous urban networks complicate few-shot learning across cities. Existing deep learning approaches either treat traffic as purely deterministic or lack mechanisms to model wave-like interference patterns essential for cross-regime traffic dynamics. To address these limitations, this paper proposes CIWI-CKT, a novel Chaos-Informed Wave Interference Feature Fusion framework with Cross-City Knowledge Transfer. Our framework introduces three core innovations: chaos-informed wave generation that extracts measurable chaos invariants and models traffic as adaptive wave components; meta-interference processing that captures wave interactions between support and query regimes while producing a predictability score for confidence estimation; and chaos-aware meta-learning that enables efficient cross-city knowledge transfer while preserving chaotic characteristics. We establish theoretical guarantees including chaos-to-wave stability, wave-induced dimension reduction, and meta-learning generalisation bounds. Extensive experiments on four real-world traffic datasets demonstrate that CIWI-CKT significantly outperforms state-of-the-art spatio-temporal graph learning, transfer learning, prompt-based, and few-shot methods, improving prediction accuracy while substantially reducing required training data.

Abstract

Accurate traffic flow prediction remains challenging in cross-city, data-scarce scenarios where limited historical data hinders model generalisation. The chaotic nature of traffic dynamics, complex spatio-temporal dependencies, and heterogeneous urban networks complicate few-shot learning across cities. Existing deep learning approaches either treat traffic as purely deterministic or lack mechanisms to model wave-like interference patterns essential for cross-regime traffic dynamics. To address these limitations, this paper proposes CIWI-CKT, a novel Chaos-Informed Wave Interference Feature Fusion framework with Cross-City Knowledge Transfer. Our framework introduces three core innovations: chaos-informed wave generation that extracts measurable chaos invariants and models traffic as adaptive wave components; meta-interference processing that captures wave interactions between support and query regimes while producing a predictability score for confidence estimation; and chaos-aware meta-learning that enables efficient cross-city knowledge transfer while preserving chaotic characteristics. We establish theoretical guarantees including chaos-to-wave stability, wave-induced dimension reduction, and meta-learning generalisation bounds. Extensive experiments on four real-world traffic datasets demonstrate that CIWI-CKT significantly outperforms state-of-the-art spatio-temporal graph learning, transfer learning, prompt-based, and few-shot methods, improving prediction accuracy while substantially reducing required training data.

item.title: Fusing Transferred Priors and Physics-based Decomposition for Underwater Image Enhancement
item.author: Haochen Hu, Yanrui Bin, Zhengyan Zhang, Minchen Wei, Chih-yung Wen, Bing Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出一种基于迁移学习的图像增强方法，无需配对标签，通过物理分解和跨域监督实现全局颜色校正、去雾和背景噪声抑制，达到当前最优性能并提升下游视觉任务效果。

背景: 水下图像因水体条件复杂存在颜色偏差、低对比度和模糊等退化问题。现有基于学习的方法多关注训练策略或网络设计，但依赖的伪标签存在噪声，导致性能受限。

目的: 解决水下图像增强中真实标签难以获取的问题，提出无需配对标签的增强方法。

方法: 将增强任务分解为全局颜色校正、去雾和背景噪声抑制三个步骤，利用其他视觉任务的先验知识作为跨域监督信号，结合物理模型进行迁移学习。

主要发现: 基于物理和先验融合的方法在图像增强任务中达到当前最优性能，并显著提升下游视觉任务效果，优于基准方法。

结论: 该方法通过物理对齐的分解和跨域监督，有效解决水下图像增强问题，具有理论依据和实际应用价值。

翻译: The underwater images are captured within diverse water-medium conditions, leading to complex degradation, including color bias, low contrast, and blur effect. Recently, learning-based methods have demonstrated their potential for underwater image enhancement (UIE). However, most of the previous work focus on the training strategy or network design to make the enhanced result aligned well with the labels in datasets, ignoring that the labels are selected from the enhanced results of previous UIE methods and these pseudo-labels are noisy. Consequently, the performance of their models is not satisfactory to a certain extent. However, collecting the true labels of the underwater images is challenging. In this work, we propose a transfer learning-based UIE that does not require underwater images to have paired noisy or true labels for learning. Instead, the UIE task is first divided into global color correction, haze removal, and background noise suppression following the underwater physics. Then multiple types of prior from other vision tasks are leveraged as cross-domain supervision in each step. In this way, a novel UIE is available via transfer learning, and the physics-aligned UIE decomposition provides theoretical soundness. Qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that our proposal based on physics and priors fusion achieves SOTA performance in the UIE task and effectively boosts downstream vision tasks, significantly outperforming benchmark methods. Project repo: https://github.com/Haru2022/P2-UIE.

Abstract

The underwater images are captured within diverse water-medium conditions, leading to complex degradation, including color bias, low contrast, and blur effect. Recently, learning-based methods have demonstrated their potential for underwater image enhancement (UIE). However, most of the previous work focus on the training strategy or network design to make the enhanced result aligned well with the labels in datasets, ignoring that the labels are selected from the enhanced results of previous UIE methods and these pseudo-labels are noisy. Consequently, the performance of their models is not satisfactory to a certain extent. However, collecting the true labels of the underwater images is challenging. In this work, we propose a transfer learning-based UIE that does not require underwater images to have paired noisy or true labels for learning. Instead, the UIE task is first divided into global color correction, haze removal, and background noise suppression following the underwater physics. Then multiple types of prior from other vision tasks are leveraged as cross-domain supervision in each step. In this way, a novel UIE is available via transfer learning, and the physics-aligned UIE decomposition provides theoretical soundness. Qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that our proposal based on physics and priors fusion achieves SOTA performance in the UIE task and effectively boosts downstream vision tasks, significantly outperforming benchmark methods. Project repo: https://github.com/Haru2022/P2-UIE.

item.title: Where Did It Go Wrong? Process-Level Evaluation of Web Agents with Semantic State Tracking
item.author: Chung, Jiwan, Byun, JiHyuk, Vineet, Vibhav, Kim, Seon Joo
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文对网页智能体进行了过程层面的分析，引入了包含一千八百个任务实例的基准测试，通过语义轨迹揭示了过程指标与结果评估的差异，并提供了细粒度的改进建议。

背景: 现有基准测试仅评估最终成功与否，丢弃了所有过程信息，对改进缺乏指导。

目的: 对网页智能体进行过程层面的分析，以提供细粒度和可操作的改进见解。

方法: 引入WebStep基准测试，包含一千八百个具有可控难度和自动语义状态跟踪的任务实例。每个网站提供确定性的语义马尔可夫决策过程与图形用户界面，环境在后台记录高级状态和转换，从而实现无需人工标注的细粒度分析。

主要发现: 过程指标揭示了结果评估中不可见的差异；不同智能体在探索范围和执行准确性上存在分歧；按技能分解揭示了同一网站内隐藏的反向技能排名；分歧分析定位了导致任务失败的特定错误，且该错误具有智能体特异性；随着任务难度增加，智能体间的差异会扩大。

结论: 过程层面的分析为网页智能体评估开辟了新途径，提供了关于每个智能体应在何处以及如何改进的细粒度和可操作的见解。

翻译: Web agents act through long interaction sequences, yet existing benchmarks evaluate only terminal success, discarding all process information and offering little guidance on improvement. In this work, we conduct a process-level analysis of web agents. We introduce WebStep, a benchmark of 1,800 task instances with controlled difficulty and automatic semantic state tracking. Each website exposes a deterministic semantic MDP alongside the GUI: the agent operates on the interface, while the environment records high-level states and transitions in the background, enabling fine-grained analysis without manual annotation. Based on the semantic trajectory, we first show that process metrics reveal differences invisible to outcome evaluation: three agents whose success rates cluster within 31-33% diverge in exploration reach versus execution accuracy. Then, decomposing by skill characterizes the nature of these differences, exposing opposite per-skill rankings hidden within the same website: e.g., on Housing, OpenAI CUA outperforms Qwen3.5 by 23.7% on commit actions yet underperforms it by 15.6% on filtering, pinpointing a concrete skill to improve even within a domain. Bifurcation analysis further localizes the decisive error that loses the task and shows that this error is agent-specific rather than shared. Finally, these differences widen as tasks grow harder: success rate is similar on easy tasks but separates sharply as exploration becomes more demanding. Our process-level analysis opens a new avenue in web agent evaluation, providing fine-grained and actionable insight into where and how each agent should be improved.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有网页智能体评测仅关注最终结果而忽略交互过程的问题。传统评测将复杂的操作轨迹压缩为单一的成功或失败标签，无法揭示智能体在探索、执行或特定技能上的具体缺陷。该问题在研究中非常重要，因为只有通过过程级分析，才能精准定位智能体失败的根本原因，从而为模型优化和训练提供明确且可操作的改进方向。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者指出传统评测仅关注最终结果，掩盖了不同的失败模式且无法指导改进，因此决定从交互过程层面进行评估。他们通过将每个网站设计为后台自动记录状态转换的语义模型，把底层的点击输入映射为高层的语义轨迹，从而实现了无需人工标注的过程追踪。该方法确实借鉴并改进了现有工作，作者对比发现传统基准缺乏过程评估与确定性环境，于是在此基础上引入了自托管的确定性网站和受控难度的任务生成机制，以提供更细粒度的诊断信息。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是为每个网站构建一个底层的确定性语义状态模型，在后台自动记录智能体图形界面操作对应的高层状态变化与动作转移，从而实现对交互过程的细粒度追踪。整体流程是：智能体仅与渲染后的网页界面交互，其每次点击或输入操作都会同步触发底层语义模型的更新；语义模型根据当前状态计算可见信息并重新渲染界面，同时自动生成完整的语义轨迹；最后系统基于该轨迹自动计算探索、执行、技能调用等过程指标，以精准诊断智能体的能力短板。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的核心创新是构建了一个全新的基准测试，通过为每个网站搭建确定性的语义状态转移模型，实现了对智能体交互过程的自动追踪与细粒度分析。与以往仅根据最终结果是否成功来排名的传统评估方法不同，该工作首次将评估视角扩展到完整的交互轨迹，能够自动区分探索与执行能力、定位具体技能短板并精准识别导致失败的步骤。这种过程级评估不仅揭示了表面成功率相近的模型在行为模式上的本质差异，还为模型优化提供了明确且可操作的改进方向。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一个包含一千八百个任务的网页智能体基准与过程级评估框架，通过自动追踪交互过程中的语义状态，揭示了传统结果评估无法发现的智能体行为差异与具体失败环节，为优化网页智能体提供了细粒度且可操作的指导。

Abstract

Web agents act through long interaction sequences, yet existing benchmarks evaluate only terminal success, discarding all process information and offering little guidance on improvement. In this work, we conduct a process-level analysis of web agents. We introduce WebStep, a benchmark of 1,800 task instances with controlled difficulty and automatic semantic state tracking. Each website exposes a deterministic semantic MDP alongside the GUI: the agent operates on the interface, while the environment records high-level states and transitions in the background, enabling fine-grained analysis without manual annotation.
