这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将预训练模型的各层视为可复用的基础模块，根据输入问题的难度动态决定跳过或重复执行这些模块，从而为每个输入定制专属的计算流程。整体实现流程是：首先通过一个轻量级的预测网络直接分析输入内容，生成包含跳过、保留或重复操作的执行指令；随后在推理时一次性调用该指令，在冻结的预训练模型上按指定顺序执行模块并输出最终结果。这一过程避免了逐样本搜索的高昂成本，实现了灵活且高效的动态推理。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出层程序概念，将预训练模型的各层视为可自由调用、跳过或重复的函数模块，并联合探索了跳过与重复操作的组合空间。相比以往仅支持单一跳过或重复机制的动态深度方法，本文方法能根据输入难度动态生成更优的执行路径。此外，论文设计了一种轻量级预测网络，将昂贵的在线搜索转化为单次推理预测，大幅提升了实际部署的可行性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种动态推理方法，将预训练语言模型的固定网络层视为可跳过或循环调用的模块，并设计轻量级预测网络为每个输入自动生成最优执行路径，从而在无需重新训练模型的情况下显著提升推理准确率并实现计算资源的自适应分配。

Abstract

Large language models (LLMs) perform inference by following a fixed depth and order, non-recurrent execution of all layers. We reveal the wide existence of training-free, flexible, dynamic program-of-layers (PoLar), where pretrained layers can be packed as modules and then skipped or looped to form a customized program for each input. For most inputs, substantially shorter program executions can achieve the same or better accuracy, while incorrect predictions of the original LLM can be corrected by alternative programs with fewer layers. These observations indicate that inference admits multiple valid latent computations beyond the standard forward pass. To efficiently achieve PoLar in practice, we propose a lightweight PoLar prediction network, which learns to generate execution programs that dynamically skip or repeat pretrained layers for each input. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that PoLar consistently improves accuracy over standard inference and prior dynamic-depth methods, often while executing fewer layers, and that these gains persist under out-of-distribution evaluation. Our results suggest that fixed-depth execution captures only a narrow subset of an LLM's latent reasoning capacity.

item.title: The Arbiter Agent: Continually Monitoring Multi-Agent Conversations to Detect Emergent Misalignment
item.author: Tonini, Filippo, Torrielli, Federico, Lautrup, Anton Danholt, Schneider-Kamp, Peter, Çelikok, Mustafa Mert, Poech, Lukas Galke
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了名为仲裁者的智能体，用于实时监控多智能体对话并识别行为不对齐的参与者。该智能体在有限的检查预算下运行，通过等待、提问、检查内部信息或记录可疑行为来工作，最终生成报告。实验表明，仲裁者能提前可靠地检测出不对齐的智能体，主动检查工具能提高检测的准确性和速度。

背景: 随着由多个语言模型智能体构建的人工智能系统日益普及，这些系统越来越多地用于共同做出决策，如讨论、协商和执行共享任务。虽然单个智能体在独立测试时可能看起来对齐良好，但它们之间的互动可能会引发问题。

目的: 引入一种名为仲裁者的智能体，旨在实时监控多智能体对话，识别行为不对齐的参与者，并在有限的检查预算下做出资源使用决策。

方法: 仲裁者在观察对话的每一步时，可以选择等待、询问参与者、检查系统提示或推理轨迹等内部信息，或记录可疑行为。在对话结束时，生成一份报告以识别不对齐的可能来源。研究在五种对话条件下评估了仲裁者，测试了五种不同能力的工具配置和两种骨干模型。

主要发现: 仲裁者能够在对话结束前可靠地检测出不对齐的智能体，主动检查工具提高了检测的准确性和速度。由权重引起的不对齐最难检测，而由指令引起的不对齐即使在被动观察下也能被可靠识别。记录工具具有双重效果，提高了召回率但降低了精确度。

结论: 持续且预算意识的监控可以有效捕捉不对齐现象，监督多智能体系统可能需要将审计员视为过程中的积极参与者。

翻译: As AI systems built from multiple language-model agents become more common, they are increasingly used to make decisions together: discussing, negotiating, and acting on shared tasks. While individual agents may appear well-aligned when tested on their own, problems can arise from how they interact with one another. We introduce the Arbiter, an agent designed to monitor multi-agent conversations in real time and identify which participants may be behaving in misaligned ways. The Arbiter operates under a limited inspection budget, meaning it must decide carefully how to use its resources. As it observes a conversation step by step, it can choose to wait, question a participant, examine internal information such as system prompts or reasoning traces, or log concerning behavior. At the end, it produces a report identifying the likely source of misalignment. We evaluate the Arbiter across five conversation conditions, ranging from risky financial advice model organisms to evaluation-aware and colluding agents, we test five tool configurations of increasing capability and two backbone models. We find that the Arbiter reliably detects misaligned agents well before the end of the conversation, with active inspection tools improving both detection accuracy and speed. Weight-induced misalignment proves hardest to detect, while instruction-induced misalignment is identified reliably even under passive observation. The logging tool exhibits a dual effect, improving recall at the cost of precision. These results suggest that continual, budget-aware monitoring can effectively catch misalignment, and that overseeing multi-agent systems may require treating the auditor as an active participant in the process. The code is available at this https URL .

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决如何在多智能体对话中实时、持续地检测智能体可能出现的对齐失效或有害行为问题。现有方法多集中在事后评估单个模型，缺乏对多智能体交互过程的动态监控能力。该问题在现实中非常重要，因为随着多智能体系统被广泛用于共同决策，即使单个智能体表现良好，它们的互动仍可能引发系统级风险或灾难性后果。及时且高效地识别这些潜在风险，对于保障人工智能系统的安全部署和实际应用至关重要。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对多智能体交互可能引发隐性对齐问题的现状，设计了具备实时观察与主动干预能力的仲裁者智能体。该方法直接借鉴了现有人工智能控制研究中预算约束的框架，并将审计角色从静态的事后分析转变为对话过程中的活跃参与者。通过整合问询、提示词检查与思维链监控等工具，在有限资源下实现高效、持续的对齐检测。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是引入一个名为仲裁者的监控智能体，在有限的检查预算下对多智能体对话进行实时持续的监测，以尽早识别潜在的不对齐行为。整体实现流程为仲裁者在对话的每一步观察最新信息，并依据预设工具选择执行动作，例如继续观察、向特定智能体提问、检查系统提示词或推理过程，或记录可疑行为。每次调用工具都会消耗预算，该循环持续进行，直到对话结束、预算耗尽或生成最终报告为止。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点是提出了名为仲裁者的智能体框架，能够在多智能体对话过程中进行持续监控，并引入检查预算机制以优化资源分配。相比以往主要关注事后评估和单一模型的工作，该研究将审计视角转向多智能体交互场景，把审计者视为可主动干预的参与者而非静态的事后分析器。此外，论文提供了一套模块化检查工具集，支持直接提问、审查提示词和推理过程等主动探测手段，有效提升了检测的准确性与速度。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种预算受限的持续监控框架与检查工具集，通过主动干预在多智能体对话中高效检测对齐偏差，并实验证实该方法能显著提升检测的准确率与速度。

Abstract

As AI systems built from multiple language-model agents become more common, they are increasingly used to make decisions together: discussing, negotiating, and acting on shared tasks. While individual agents may appear well-aligned when tested on their own, problems can arise from how they interact with one another. We introduce the Arbiter, an agent designed to monitor multi-agent conversations in real time and identify which participants may be behaving in misaligned ways. The Arbiter operates under a limited "inspection budget", meaning it must decide carefully how to use its resources. As it observes a conversation step by step, it can choose to wait, question a participant, examine internal information such as system prompts or reasoning traces, or log concerning behavior. At the end, it produces a report identifying the likely source of misalignment. We evaluate the Arbiter across five conversation conditions, ranging from risky financial advice model organisms to evaluation-aware and colluding agents, we test five tool configurations of increasing capability and two backbone models. We find that the Arbiter reliably detects misaligned agents well before the end of the conversation, with active inspection tools improving both detection accuracy and speed. Weight-induced misalignment proves hardest to detect, while instruction-induced misalignment is identified reliably even under passive observation. The logging tool exhibits a dual effect, improving recall at the cost of precision. These results suggest that continual, budget-aware monitoring can effectively catch misalignment, and that overseeing multi-agent systems may require treating the auditor as an active participant in the process. The code is available at this https URL .

item.title: RedAct: Redacting Agent Capability Traces for Procedural Skill Protection
item.author: Xu, Shuwen, He, Zhitao, Fung, Yi R.
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究针对智能体执行轨迹中可能泄露私有程序技能的风险，构建了一个基准测试集，并提出了一种受保护的轨迹发布框架，通过局部化关键信息、重写轨迹和嵌入行为水印来减少能力泄露，同时保留审计证据。

背景: 用户依赖执行轨迹来观察智能体行为、诊断故障和确保问责。这些轨迹包含丰富的程序细节，如工具调用、中间决策和错误恢复逻辑。然而，这些细节可能暴露私有程序技能，使下游方法能够在不访问模型权重或技能文件的情况下恢复关键公式、阈值和策略。

目的: 量化程序技能泄露的风险，并评估相应的保护措施。

方法: 构建了包含七个领域内七十五个专业化长周期任务和一百五十四项精心策划技能的基准测试集。提出了一种受保护的轨迹发布框架，该框架通过局部化受保护的关键信息、重写轨迹以保留验证器关键证据，并嵌入行为水印以进行下游溯源分析来实现保护。

主要发现: 在代表性轨迹重用方法中，该框架将原始轨迹上的归一化技能转移率从百分之四十四点七至百分之六十七点一降低至低于无技能基线水平，同时保留了审计证据。其独立的行为水印实现了百分之九十三点六至百分之百的准确检测率，且误报率最高仅为百分之一点九。

结论: 公共智能体轨迹可被视为安全接口，选择性编辑可以在不移除审计证据的情况下减少程序能力泄露。

翻译: Users rely on execution traces to observe agent behavior, diagnose failures, and ensure accountability. These traces contain rich procedural detail, including tool invocations, intermediate decisions, and error-recovery logic. Yet this detail can expose private procedural skills, allowing downstream methods to recover key formulas, thresholds, and strategies without access to model weights or skill files. To quantify this risk and evaluate protection, we construct CapTraceBench, a benchmark of 75 specialized long-horizon tasks and 154 curated skills across seven domains. We also introduce RedAct, a protected trace release framework that localizes protected key information, rewrites traces while preserving verifier-critical evidence, and embeds behavioral watermarks for downstream provenance analysis. Across representative trace reuse methods, RedAct reduces normalized skill transfer (NST) from 44.7-67.1% on raw traces to below the no-skill baseline, while preserving audit evidence. Its standalone behavioral watermarks reach 93.6-100.0% true detection with a false alarm rate of at most 1.9%. These results frame public agent traces as security interfaces and show that selective redaction can reduce procedural capability leakage without removing audit evidence.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决如何在公开人工智能智能体的运行记录时，既保留用于调试和审计的必要信息，又防止他人窃取其中蕴含的私有工作流程和专业技能。该问题在现实中非常重要，因为随着智能体在医疗、金融等敏感领域的应用，公开运行记录是建立用户信任和排查故障的必要手段，但原始记录往往会泄露核心商业机密或专家经验。平衡信息透明与技能保护，对于推动智能体技术的合规共享与商业化落地具有关键意义。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者基于公开执行轨迹在透明审计与技能保护之间的核心矛盾进行设计，提出了一种双层框架。第一层通过定位并抽象关键私有信息来重写轨迹以保护技能，同时保留审计所需的执行证据；第二层通过注入无害的行为模式进行溯源追踪。该方法在行为水印设计部分明确借鉴了轨迹级水印技术及相关评估经验，并结合了现有的技能提取与轨迹复用方法。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是通过选择性重写与行为水印技术，在公开智能体执行轨迹的同时隐藏可复用的私有程序技能，以平衡审计透明性与技能保护需求。整体流程首先由技能所有者定位轨迹中的敏感关键信息，接着将暴露这些信息的中间步骤抽象为通用描述以保留审计证据，最后向符合条件的轨迹中注入无害的行为水印，从而实现技能防泄露与下游来源追踪的双重目标。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点在于首次将智能体执行轨迹的公开披露形式化为黑盒轨迹披露问题，并提出了结合选择性重写与行为水印的双层保护框架。该框架通过抽象化轨迹中的私有公式、阈值和工具选择等关键程序信息来防止技能被下游复用，同时保留必要的执行证据以支持审计，并嵌入水印用于来源追踪。与以往仅关注从轨迹中蒸馏技能或简单删除答案的工作不同，本文专门针对程序性技能泄露风险，构建了首个面向技能保护的基准测试集，实现了在保护私有流程与维持轨迹可审计性之间的平衡。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了REDACT框架与CAPTRACEBENCH基准，通过选择性重写执行轨迹和嵌入行为水印，在有效防止智能体私有程序技能泄露的同时，完整保留了用于审计和溯源的执行证据。

Abstract

Users rely on execution traces to observe agent behavior, diagnose failures, and ensure accountability. These traces contain rich procedural detail, including tool invocations, intermediate decisions, and error-recovery logic. Yet this detail can expose private procedural skills, allowing downstream methods to recover key formulas, thresholds, and strategies without access to model weights or skill files. To quantify this risk and evaluate protection, we construct CapTraceBench, a benchmark of 75 specialized long-horizon tasks and 154 curated skills across seven domains. We also introduce RedAct, a protected trace release framework that localizes protected key information, rewrites traces while preserving verifier-critical evidence, and embeds behavioral watermarks for downstream provenance analysis. Across representative trace reuse methods, RedAct reduces normalized skill transfer (NST) from 44.7-67.1% on raw traces to below the no-skill baseline, while preserving audit evidence. Its standalone behavioral watermarks reach 93.6-100.0% true detection with a false alarm rate of at most 1.9%. These results frame public agent traces as security interfaces and show that selective redaction can reduce procedural capability leakage without removing audit evidence.

item.title: When is Your LLM Steerable?
item.author: Fan, Chenrui, Cheng, Yize, Li, Ming, Feizi, Soheil, Zhou, Tianyi
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 激活引导是一种在推理时控制语言模型行为的轻量级方法，但其成功与否高度依赖于提示、概念、模型和引导配置。本文研究能否从生成初期的模型内部状态预测引导的可控性，并利用该预测器提高引导成功率。

背景: 激活引导的成功与否高度依赖于提示、概念、模型和引导配置，寻找成功引导的范围和边界通常需要昂贵的网格搜索和完整自回归生成的事后评估。

目的: 研究能否从生成初期的模型内部状态预测引导的可控性，并如何利用该预测器提高引导成功率。

方法: 引入包含一百四十万条引导生成数据的测试集，涵盖一百五十个概念并标注成功或失败。通过分析引导前后各层和初始解码步骤的隐藏状态特征，理解引导效果在层和词元位置上的传播。训练梯度提升决策树分类器预测干预是引导不足、成功还是过度引导。

主要发现: 早期隐藏状态编码了关于最终引导效能的大量结构化信息。预测器在未见过概念上达到约零点七的宏观F1分数。利用该预测器作为引导强度搜索的指导，能以较小的解码成本实现接近最优的性能。

结论: 激活引导的可控性可以从生成初期的模型内部状态进行预测，且该预测器能有效指导引导强度搜索，提高引导成功率并降低计算成本。

翻译: Activation steering offers a lightweight approach to control language models' behavior at inference time, but whether it succeeds or fails heavily depends on the prompt, concept, model, and steering configuration. Finding the regime and boundaries of successful steering typically requires expensive grid searches and post-hoc evaluation of full autoregressive rollouts. In this work, we investigate whether steerability can be predicted from the model's internal states at the beginning of the generation process, e.g., after generating the first few tokens, and how to leverage such a predictor to improve steering success rate. To this end, we first introduce ASTEER, a testbed including 1.4M steered generations, spanning 150 concepts with each steering success/failure labeled. Leveraging this testbed, we analyze the model's early decoding dynamics by extracting features that compare hidden states before and after steering across layers and initial decoding steps. These features help us understand how steering's effects propagate along layers and token positions, which provide key information for steerability prediction. We then train a Gradient Boosting Decision Trees (GBDT) classifier on these features to predict whether an intervention will under-steer, succeed, or over-steer without requiring full rollout. Our predictor achieves around 0.7 macro-F1 score on unseen concepts, demonstrating that early hidden states encode substantial, structured information about eventual steering efficacy. We further leverage this steerability predictor as guidance for steering strength searching, achieving near-optimal performance with a small fraction of decoding cost.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决如何仅凭大语言模型生成初期的内部状态，提前预测激活引导干预是否会成功、引导不足或过度引导的问题。该问题在研究和应用中非常重要，因为传统方法需要生成完整回答并进行评估才能确定合适的引导强度，计算成本极高。通过早期预测，可以大幅降低搜索最优引导参数的开销，提升模型行为控制的效率与可靠性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者观察到传统激活引导方法需依赖昂贵的完整生成与网格搜索，且效果极易波动。受早期隐藏状态可预测后续模型行为（如回答正确性或幻觉）的现有研究启发，作者推测引导干预的最终效果同样可由生成初期的内部状态编码。基于这一思路，他们构建了包含大量标注数据的大型测试集，提取引导前后早期隐藏状态的动态差异特征，并训练梯度提升决策树分类器进行结果预测，从而在无需完整生成的情况下评估引导效果，并进一步将该预测器用于高效搜索最优引导强度。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是利用大语言模型在生成初期内部隐藏状态的变化，提前预测引导干预的最终效果，从而避免等待完整生成后再评估的高昂计算成本。整体流程首先构建包含大量带标签引导结果的数据集，接着提取干预前后早期隐藏状态的特征，然后训练分类器学习特征与引导结果的关系，最后将该预测器用于快速筛选最优的引导强度参数。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于构建了一个涵盖大量概念与提示词的大规模激活控制测试数据集，并首次提出仅凭模型生成初期的隐藏状态即可预测控制干预的效果。相比以往必须依赖完整文本生成与昂贵网格搜索的评估方式，该方法无需完成全部解码过程，大幅降低了计算成本。此外，该预测器可直接用于快速定位最优控制强度，实现了高效且低成本的模型行为调控。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文构建了一个涵盖多种模型与概念的大规模干预生成数据集，并基于模型生成初期的内部状态特征训练了预测模型，能够在不完成完整回答的情况下准确预判干预效果，从而大幅降低了寻找最优干预强度的计算成本。

Abstract

Activation steering offers a lightweight approach to control language models' behavior at inference time, but whether it succeeds or fails heavily depends on the prompt, concept, model, and steering configuration. Finding the regime and boundaries of successful steering typically requires expensive grid searches and post-hoc evaluation of full autoregressive rollouts. In this work, we investigate whether steerability can be predicted from the model's internal states at the beginning of the generation process, e.g., after generating the first few tokens, and how to leverage such a predictor to improve steering success rate. To this end, we first introduce ASTEER, a testbed including 1.4M steered generations, spanning 150 concepts with each steering success/failure labeled. Leveraging this testbed, we analyze the model's early decoding dynamics by extracting features that compare hidden states before and after steering across layers and initial decoding steps. These features help us understand how steering's effects propagate along layers and token positions, which provide key information for steerability prediction. We then train a Gradient Boosting Decision Trees (GBDT) classifier on these features to predict whether an intervention will under-steer, succeed, or over-steer without requiring full rollout. Our predictor achieves around 0.7 macro-F1 score on unseen concepts, demonstrating that early hidden states encode substantial, structured information about eventual steering efficacy. We further leverage this steerability predictor as guidance for steering strength searching, achieving near-optimal performance with a small fraction of decoding cost.

item.title: Measuring Epistemic Resilience of LLMs Under Misleading Medical Context
item.author: Zhou, Hongjian, Zou, Xinyu, Wu, Jinge, Wu, Sean, Yu, Junchi, Segal, Bradley Max, Niebuhr, Tobias Erich, Amro, Sara, Petrus, Michael, Momin, Sheikh, Pinto, Alexandra M. Cardoso, Niesen, Rachel, Wegner, Laura Sophie, Darji, Dhruv, Koo, Jung Moses, Fieggen, Joshua, Narain, Kapil, Zeng, Mingde, Clifton, Lei, Shapiro, Linda, Liu, Fenglin, Clifton, David A.
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 大型语言模型在医学执照考试中达到专家级水平，但其在面对误导性上下文时可能放弃正确判断，缺乏认知韧性。

背景: 大型语言模型在医学执照考试中取得专家级成绩，促使人们假设高分意味着安全的医学判断，且患者越来越多地依赖它们获取健康建议。

目的: 测试大型语言模型在面临误导性上下文时维持正确医学判断的能力（即认知韧性），并评估现有医学基准测试的局限性。

方法: 构建MedMisBench基准测试，包含10932道医学题目和48889对误导性上下文选项，涵盖医学推理、代理能力和患者旅程评估。在11种模型配置下测试模型在原始题目和注入误导性上下文后的表现，并由14国临床小组评估潜在危害。

主要发现: 在注入误导性上下文后，模型平均准确率从71.1%降至38.0%，攻击成功率为51.5%。形式化、规则类的伪造内容最具破坏性，权威框架的虚假陈述攻击成功率达69.5%，例外中毒声明达64.1%。临床小组在38.2%的案例中识别出严重潜在危害。

结论: 现有医学基准测试仅衡量模型的知识储备，未评估其在误导性上下文下维持正确医学判断的能力，暴露出医学场景下大型语言模型评估的结构盲点。

翻译: Large language models (LLMs) now reach expert-level scores on medical licensing exams, encouraging the assumption that high scores imply safe medical judgment while patients increasingly use them for health advice. We show this assumption is fragile: when misleading context is injected into questions that LLMs originally answer correctly, they abandon the correct answer. We call the ability to maintain correct judgment under adversarial context epistemic resilience, and introduce MedMisBench to measure it. MedMisBench contains 10,932 medical question items and 48,889 misleading context-option pairs spanning medical reasoning, agentic capability, and patient-journey evaluation. Across 11 model configurations, mean accuracy falls from 71.1% on original questions to 38.0% under focused misleading context, with 51.5% attack success. The most damaging injections are formal, rule-like fabrications: authority-framed falsehoods reach 69.5% attack success and exception-poisoning claims reach 64.1%. A 14-member clinical panel from 7 countries identified serious potential harm in 38.2% of reviewed cases. MedMisBench exposes a structural blind spot in LLM evaluation in medical settings: existing benchmarks measure what models know, but not whether they preserve correct medical judgment under misleading context.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决的是如何评估大语言模型在面对误导性医学信息时，能否保持原有正确医学判断能力的问题。该问题在现实中非常重要，因为患者正越来越多地使用此类模型获取健康建议，而真实场景中的信息往往杂乱且可能包含虚假内容。如果模型缺乏这种能力，极易被误导信息带偏从而给出错误医疗建议，直接威胁患者安全与临床决策的可靠性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者基于两项核心观察进行设计：一是误导性医疗上下文并非单一，其虚假主张和来源框架各不相同；二是评估应覆盖真实医疗场景中的专家推理、智能体任务和患者全流程。因此，他们将原始医学题目与针对性注入的虚假上下文配对，并从内容篡改类型和来源框架两个维度构建测试空间。在借鉴方面，作者参考了先前关于上下文操纵鲁棒性、虚假信息易感性及逻辑谬误提示的研究，但指出既往工作多聚焦于干净输入或谬误检测，而本方法将重点转向模型在面临合理但错误信息时能否维持正确判断的能力。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是评估大语言模型在接触看似合理但虚假的医疗背景信息时，能否保持原有的正确医学判断能力。整体实现流程首先从现有医学数据集中筛选出答案明确的题目，随后根据虚假内容的类型和来源框架生成针对错误选项的误导性上下文，并通过严格筛选确保其临床合理性。最后，将生成的误导性信息以单选项聚焦或全选项对比的方式输入模型，检验模型在干扰下是否仍能选出正确答案，并由临床专家进行质量验证。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点是首次提出认知韧性概念，并构建了名为MedMisBench的医学基准测试集，专门用于评估大语言模型在面临误导性医学信息时能否坚持正确判断。与以往主要测试模型在干净输入下医学知识储备的基准不同，该工作通过系统注入不同内容类型和来源框架的虚假上下文，揭示了现有模型在复杂真实环境中容易放弃正确答案的结构性缺陷。此外，该基准还结合了多国临床专家小组的评估，更全面地反映了实际医疗应用中的潜在风险。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了首个开源基准测试MedMisBench，用于系统衡量大语言模型在医疗场景下面对误导性信息时保持正确判断的“认知韧性”，并全面评估了多款模型在此类干扰下的表现与缺陷。

Abstract

Large language models (LLMs) now reach expert-level scores on medical licensing exams, encouraging the assumption that high scores imply safe medical judgment while patients increasingly use them for health advice. We show this assumption is fragile: when misleading context is injected into questions that LLMs originally answer correctly, they abandon the correct answer. We call the ability to maintain correct judgment under adversarial context epistemic resilience, and introduce MedMisBench to measure it. MedMisBench contains 10,932 medical question items and 48,889 misleading context-option pairs spanning medical reasoning, agentic capability, and patient-journey evaluation. Across 11 model configurations, mean accuracy falls from 71.1% on original questions to 38.0% under focused misleading context, with 51.5% attack success. The most damaging injections are formal, rule-like fabrications: authority-framed falsehoods reach 69.5% attack success and exception-poisoning claims reach 64.1%. A 14-member clinical panel from 7 countries identified serious potential harm in 38.2% of reviewed cases. MedMisBench exposes a structural blind spot in LLM evaluation in medical settings: existing benchmarks measure what models know, but not whether they preserve correct medical judgment under misleading context.

item.title: APPO: Agentic Procedural Policy Optimization
item.author: Wang, Xucong, Ma, Ziyu, Wang, Yong, Ji, Yuxiang, Yang, Shidong, Chen, Guanhua, Wang, Pengkun, Chu, Xiangxiang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为代理程序策略优化（APPO）的新方法，旨在通过细粒度的决策点改进大型语言模型代理的多轮工具使用能力。

背景: 近期在代理强化学习方面的进展显著提升了大型语言模型代理的多轮工具使用能力。然而，现有方法通常在粗粒度的启发式单元（如工具调用边界或固定工作流）上分配信用，难以识别哪些中间决策会影响下游结果。

目的: 研究代理强化学习中分支位置的选择以及分支后信用分配的问题。

方法: 提出代理程序策略优化（APPO），将分支和信用分配从粗粒度的交互单元转移到序列中的细粒度决策点。使用结合令牌不确定性和策略诱导的后续延续似然增益的分支分数来选择分支位置，以进行更有针对性的探索并过滤虚假的高熵位置。引入程序级优势缩放以更好地在分支 rollout 中分配信用。

主要发现: 有影响力的决策点广泛分布在生成的序列中，而不仅仅集中在工具调用处。仅凭令牌熵并不能可靠地反映其对最终结果的影响。

结论: 在 13 个基准测试上的实验表明，APPO consistently 将强代理强化学习基线提升了近 4 分，同时保持了高效的工具调用和行为可解释性。

翻译: Recent advances in agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL) have substantially improved the multi-turn tool-use capabilities of large language model agents. However, most existing methods assign credit over coarse heuristic units, such as tool-call boundaries or fixed workflows, making it difficult to identify which intermediate decisions influence downstream outcomes. In this work, we study agentic RL from two perspectives: where to branch and how to assign credit after branching. Our pilot analysis shows that influential decision points are broadly distributed throughout the generated sequence rather than concentrated at tool calls, while token entropy alone does not reliably reflect their impact on final outcomes. Motivated by these observations, we propose Agentic Procedural Policy Optimization (APPO), which shifts branching and credit assignment from coarse interaction units to fine-grained decision points in the sequence. APPO selects branching locations using a Branching Score that combines token uncertainty with policy-induced likelihood gains of subsequent continuations, enabling more targeted exploration while filtering out spurious high-entropy positions. It further introduces procedure-level advantage scaling to better distribute credit across branched rollouts. Experiments on 13 benchmarks show that APPO consistently improves strong agentic RL baselines by nearly 4 points, while keeping efficient tool-calls and maintaining behavior interpretability.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有智能体强化学习方法在训练时难以准确评估中间推理步骤对最终结果影响的问题。传统方法通常仅在工具调用或固定流程等粗粒度节点进行分支和信用分配，忽略了思考过程中细粒度的关键决策点。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为若无法精准定位并奖励关键推理环节，将导致学习效率低下和策略优化不稳定，从而严重制约大语言模型在现实复杂长程任务中的实际应用能力。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者通过初步分析发现，现有方法通常在工具调用边界等粗粒度位置进行分支，且单纯依赖词元不确定性无法可靠反映决策对最终结果的影响。基于此，作者将分支与信用分配单元细化至生成序列中的细粒度决策过程，设计了结合词元不确定性与后续续写概率增益的评分机制，并引入过程级优势缩放来优化信用分配。该方法借鉴了树状强化学习与现有智能体强化学习的相关工作，但突破了以往仅在固定位置采样的局限，转而聚焦推理过程中的细粒度程序结构进行针对性探索。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将强化学习的信用分配从粗粒度的工具调用边界转移到生成序列中细粒度的关键决策点上，通过综合评估局部不确定性与未来影响来精准定位高价值分支点。整体流程首先让模型生成初始完整轨迹；接着计算每个生成词元的综合得分，筛选出关键决策点并重新采样生成多条分支轨迹；最后分别对初始轨迹和分支轨迹计算相对优势值，结合下游影响权重进行信用分配并更新模型策略。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于将强化学习的分支与信用分配单元从粗粒度的工具调用边界或固定工作流，转移到了序列中细粒度的推理决策点上。相比以往方法仅依赖整体思考块或工具调用，本文提出了一种结合位置不确定性与未来策略增益的评分机制，能够精准筛选出真正影响最终结果的关键位置，并过滤掉虚假的高不确定性位置。此外，论文引入了程序级优势缩放技术，使信用分配更贴合细粒度推理过程，从而在保持工具调用效率的同时提升了模型性能。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种新的强化学习算法，通过将智能体的探索分支与信用分配从粗粒度的工具调用边界细化至推理过程中的关键决策点，并结合不确定性评估与未来价值增益，显著提升了大模型智能体在复杂任务中的推理性能与探索效率。

Abstract

Recent advances in agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL) have substantially improved the multi-turn tool-use capabilities of large language model agents. However, most existing methods assign credit over coarse heuristic units, such as tool-call boundaries or fixed workflows, making it difficult to identify which intermediate decisions influence downstream outcomes. In this work, we study agentic RL from two perspectives: \textit{where to branch and how to assign credit after branching}. Our pilot analysis shows that influential decision points are broadly distributed throughout the generated sequence rather than concentrated at tool calls, while token entropy alone does not reliably reflect their impact on final outcomes. Motivated by these observations, we propose \textbf{Agentic Procedural Policy Optimization (APPO)}, which shifts branching and credit assignment from coarse interaction units to fine-grained decision points in the sequence. APPO selects branching locations using a Branching Score that combines token uncertainty with policy-induced likelihood gains of subsequent continuations, enabling more targeted exploration while filtering out spurious high-entropy positions. It further introduces procedure-level advantage scaling to better distribute credit across branched rollouts. Experiments on 13 benchmarks show that APPO consistently improves strong agentic RL baselines by nearly 4 points, while keeping efficient tool-calls and maintaining behavior interpretability.

item.title: Quickest Detection of Hallucination Onset: Delay Bounds and Learned CUSUM Statistics
item.author: Itkin, Igor
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了幻觉检测器在流式监控中的反应时间问题，将其建模为最速变点检测问题。通过因果循环标签器实现类似CUSUM的检测机制，发现其在检测速度上优于基线方法，但受限于低误报率下的召回率不足。信息率最优性定理解释了性能差距，指出分类指标掩盖了延迟结构，而序贯分析使其可测量。

背景: 传统的Token级幻觉检测器以AUC作为分类器评估标准，而流式监控器更关注反应时间，即从幻觉开始到警报触发的Token数量。

目的: 将幻觉起始检测建模为最速变点检测问题，以评估和优化检测器的反应时间性能。

方法: 使用一阶马尔可夫模型对潜在忠实/幻觉状态进行建模，验证于RAGTruth数据集。提出因果循环标签器作为带有学习增量的CUSUM方法，并与线性逐Token基线进行比较。

主要发现: 因果循环标签器在检测到的起始点中仅需11-13个Token即可报警，而线性基线需要31个Token。但在低误报率下，所有检测器仅能捕获不到三分之一的起始点，召回诚实延迟为56-66个Token。速度优势主要源于更好的逐Token评分而非时间累积。

结论: 低误报率下的起始检测具有挑战性。信息率最优性定理表明，学习到的评分仅实现了特征携带发散度的四分之一，剩余差距由有限视界效应导致。分类指标掩盖了延迟结构，而序贯分析使其可测量。

翻译: Token-level hallucination detectors are evaluated as classifiers, by AUC over all tokens, yet a streaming monitor is judged by its reaction time: the number of tokens that pass between the onset of a hallucination and the alarm. We formulate hallucination onset detection as a quickest change detection problem. A first-order Markov model of the latent faithful/hallucinated state, validated on RAGTruth, places the task inside classical change-point theory and yields Lorden's lower bound on detection delay: about 1.3 tokens at a false-alarm rate of 0.01. We then show that a causal recurrent labeler acts as a CUSUM with a learned increment. Among the onsets it catches it detects in 11-13 tokens, against 31 for a linear per-token baseline, though at this false-alarm budget every detector catches under a third of onsets and the recall-honest delay is 56-66 tokens: low-false-alarm onset detection is hard. A controlled decomposition attributes the speed advantage mostly to a better per-token score rather than to temporal accumulation. An information-rate optimality theorem of Donsker-Varadhan type explains the remaining order-of-magnitude gap: the learned score realizes only 1/4.5 of the divergence the features carry, a deficit that recalibration cannot remove, with the remainder a finite-horizon effect. Classification metrics conceal this delay structure; sequential analysis makes it measurable.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决如何在语言模型流式生成过程中，最快地检测出幻觉内容开始产生的确切时刻。该问题在现实中非常重要，因为传统评估仅关注整体准确率，无法反映检测器的反应速度；若警报延迟，虚假内容就会在报警前传播给用户。通过引入序贯检测理论，论文不仅给出了理论上的最快反应极限，还揭示了现有模型与极限之间的差距来源，为开发更可靠、实时的语言模型监控工具提供了关键依据。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者将幻觉检测从传统的分类评估重新定位为序列变点检测问题，借鉴了经典的快速变点检测理论与累积和算法。他们通过数据验证了模型输出状态符合一阶马尔可夫链，并以此为基础构建了理论分析框架。在具体设计上，作者将因果循环神经网络视为一种学习型累积和检测器，利用其隐藏状态随时间累积证据，并用模型自动学习到的非线性得分替代传统固定公式，从而在控制误报的同时实现快速响应。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将大模型生成过程中的幻觉起始检测转化为序列变点检测问题，核心目标是在控制误报频率的前提下，最小化从幻觉发生到系统发出警报的时间延迟。整体实现流程是首先提取每个生成词元的多维特征，接着通过因果循环神经网络按顺序处理这些特征，利用其内部状态持续累积证据并自动学习最优的评分函数。当累积的证据强度达到预设阈值时，模型立即触发警报，从而实现流式环境下的快速在线监测。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于首次将幻觉起始检测形式化为序贯变点检测问题，并基于特征信息量推导出了检测延迟的理论下限。相比以往仅关注平均准确率的分类评估方法，本文引入了反应时间指标，揭示了传统分类指标所掩盖的延迟结构。此外，论文证明了因果循环标签器实质上是一种学习型的累积和统计方法，并从信息率不足和时间有限性角度解释了实际检测器与理论最优值之间的差距。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文首次将语言模型幻觉起始检测形式化为序贯变点检测问题，推导了理论最小检测延迟下界，并揭示现有检测器的性能差距主要源于特征信息利用率不足而非模型架构问题。

Abstract

Token-level hallucination detectors are evaluated as classifiers, by AUC over all tokens, yet a streaming monitor is judged by its reaction time: the number of tokens that pass between the onset of a hallucination and the alarm. We formulate hallucination onset detection as a quickest change detection problem. A first-order Markov model of the latent faithful/hallucinated state, validated on RAGTruth, places the task inside classical change-point theory and yields Lorden's lower bound on detection delay: about 1.3 tokens at a false-alarm rate of 0.01. We then show that a causal recurrent labeler acts as a CUSUM with a learned increment. Among the onsets it catches it detects in 11-13 tokens, against 31 for a linear per-token baseline, though at this false-alarm budget every detector catches under a third of onsets and the recall-honest delay is 56-66 tokens: low-false-alarm onset detection is hard. A controlled decomposition attributes the speed advantage mostly to a better per-token score rather than to temporal accumulation. An information-rate optimality theorem of Donsker-Varadhan type explains the remaining order-of-magnitude gap: the learned score realizes only 1/4.5 of the divergence the features carry, a deficit that recalibration cannot remove, with the remainder a finite-horizon effect. Classification metrics conceal this delay structure; sequential analysis makes it measurable.

item.title: From AGI to ASI
item.author: Genewein, Tim, Franklin, Matija, Lerchner, Alexander, Orseau, Laurent, Albanie, Samuel, Bales, Adam, Wyeth, Cole, Chan, Stephanie, Gabriel, Iason, Leibo, Joel Z., Dafoe, Allan, Hutter, Marcus, Graepel, Thore, Legg, Shane
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文探讨了在通用人工智能之后，人工智能如何沿着机器智能的连续体继续发展，重点研究了从人类水平的通用人工智能到人工通用超级智能的转变过程。

背景: 过去十年间，构建人类水平的人工智能通用智能已从遥远的推测变为许多大型人工智能组织的具体目标。实现这一目标将对人类社会产生深远影响。

目的: 调查人工智能在通用人工智能之后的世界中如何继续发展，特别是从人类水平的通用人工智能到人工通用超级智能的转变。

方法: 通过定义人工通用超级智能，讨论从通用人工智能到人工通用超级智能的四种潜在路径：扩展通用人工智能、人工智能范式转变、递归改进以及从大规模多智能体集体中涌现。

主要发现: 讨论了这些路径上可能存在的摩擦和瓶颈。由于预测人工通用超级智能进展存在很大不确定性，人工智能进展可能会继续加速，导致一系列由人工智能推动的变革性社会变化，而非单一的变革性步骤。

结论: 准备应对这一前景需要全球范围内大规模跨学科的共同努力。

翻译: Over the last decade, building human-level artificial general intelligence has moved from far-fetched speculation to being a concrete next-decade target for many of the largest AI organisations. Achieving this goal would have profound and far-reaching impacts on human society, which raises many complex questions for the decade ahead. This report investigates how AI itself might continue to develop in a post-AGI world along the continuum of machine intelligence. The endpoint of this continuum, Universal AI, is theoretically well understood, which provides some formal grounding for the main focus of this report: the transition from human-level AGI to artificial general superintelligence, which, intuitively, can be understood as a system that is more intelligent and cognitively capable than large organisations of humans. After characterizing ASI, the report discusses four potential pathways from AGI to ASI: scaling AGI, AI paradigm shifts, recursive improvement, and ASI emerging from large-scale multi-agent collectives. The report then discusses possible frictions and bottlenecks along these pathways. Determining whether the impact of these frictions will be negligible or substantial raises a number of concrete open research questions. Due to large uncertainties for predicting ASI progress, it cannot be ruled out that AI progress might continue to accelerate over the next years. This could imply that the image of a single transformative step change, caused by the introduction of human-level AGI into our society, could be inaccurate. More apt might be the prospect of a series of transformative societal changes caused by AI-enabled progress and breakthroughs across many areas of science and technology. Preparing for this prospect requires a massively interdisciplinary endeavour of global scope and interest.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要探讨人工智能在达到人类水平通用智能后，如何进一步演进为超越人类集体认知能力的超级智能，并系统梳理了可能的技术路径与潜在发展瓶颈。该问题在现实与研究中至关重要，因为超级智能的出现将对人类社会、经济、科学和治理产生深远影响，提前厘清演进路径与不确定性，有助于全球开展跨学科合作以做好充分准备，从容应对可能带来的剧烈社会变革。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 文中并未描述具体的技术方法及其设计过程，因此关于方法设计的部分为unknown。该文献实为一篇概念性分析报告，作者主要通过宏观梳理与逻辑推演，构建了分析人工智能从通用水平向超级智能演进的路径与瓶颈框架。在分析过程中，作者广泛借鉴了现有的计算力增长趋势、模型缩放定律、超指数增长理论以及大量相关学术研究与行业预测。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 本文是一篇探讨人工智能从通用智能向超级智能演进趋势的综述报告，并未提出具体的技术方法。因此文中没有明确说明该方法的核心思想与整体实现流程，答案为unknown。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该报告的关键创新在于系统构建了从人类水平通用人工智能到

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文系统梳理了人工智能从人类水平通用智能迈向超级智能的潜在发展路径与瓶颈，并据此提出了多项关键开放研究问题，为未来跨学科应对人工智能持续演进提供了理论框架与研究方向。

Abstract

Over the last decade, building human-level artificial general intelligence has moved from far-fetched speculation to being a concrete next-decade target for many of the largest AI organisations. Achieving this goal would have profound and far-reaching impacts on human society, which raises many complex questions for the decade ahead. This report investigates how AI itself might continue to develop in a post-AGI world along the continuum of machine intelligence. The endpoint of this continuum, Universal AI, is theoretically well understood, which provides some formal grounding for the main focus of this report: the transition from human-level AGI to artificial general superintelligence, which, intuitively, can be understood as a system that is more intelligent and cognitively capable than large organisations of humans. After characterizing ASI, the report discusses four potential pathways from AGI to ASI: scaling AGI, AI paradigm shifts, recursive improvement, and ASI emerging from large-scale multi-agent collectives. The report then discusses possible frictions and bottlenecks along these pathways. Determining whether the impact of these frictions will be negligible or substantial raises a number of concrete open research questions. Due to large uncertainties for predicting ASI progress, it cannot be ruled out that AI progress might continue to accelerate over the next years. This could imply that the image of a single transformative step change, caused by the introduction of human-level AGI into our society, could be inaccurate. More apt might be the prospect of a series of transformative societal changes caused by AI-enabled progress and breakthroughs across many areas of science and technology. Preparing for this prospect requires a massively interdisciplinary endeavour of global scope and interest.

item.title: Benchmarking AI Agents for Addressing Scientific Challenges Across Scales
item.author: Liu, Tianyu, Wang, Allen Xin, Panescu, Antonia, Chen, Lisa Xinyi, Long, Wenxin, Wei, Xinyu, Jing, Yueqian, Zeng, Ziyao, Chen, Jihang, Jiang, Sihan, Wang, Ziqing, Gu, Siyi, Chen, Siyu, Hu, Xinyang, Shao, Haoran, Xu, Leqi, Zheng, Wangjie, Cao, Zhiyuan, Fang, Ada, Yu, Botao, Sun, Kunyang, Ying, Rex, Cohan, Arman, Chen, Qingyu, Xue, Lingzhou, Ding, Kaize, Du, Yuanqi, Jin, Wengong, Yang, Zhuoran, Zitnik, Marinka, Zou, James, Xu, Hua, Zhao, Hongyu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了SciAgentArena，一个用于评估AI智能体在真实科学研究场景中表现的系统性基准测试。该基准包含约两百个任务，具有逐步验证和交互式环境。研究发现当前智能体在结构清晰的数据分析流程中表现有效，但在生成新颖见解、自主探索和解决开放式研究问题方面存在不足。该基准为衡量AI智能体在科学领域的进展提供了实用框架。

背景: AI智能体正被开发以加速科学发现，但其在实际研究环境中的能力尚不清楚。现有的AI智能体基准测试难以捕捉科学研究所需的复杂性、异质性和长期推理，而科学任务基准测试往往将研究简化为静态直接问题，且对交互式评估支持有限。

目的: 引入SciAgentArena，一个基于多领域新兴需求、用于在真实世界科学研究场景中评估AI智能体的系统性基准测试。

方法: 构建包含约两百个任务的基准测试，提供逐步验证机制和与智能体无关的交互式环境，以评估多样化的AI智能体。

主要发现: 当前AI智能体在结构明确、评估标准清晰的数据分析工作流程中能有效贡献；但在不同科学语境下表现不均，难以生成真正新颖的见解、维持自主探索，并难以针对开放式研究问题制定稳健的解决方案。

结论: SciAgentArena为衡量AI智能体在科学领域的进展提供了实用框架，并有助于指导未来能够应对复杂科学挑战的智能体设计。

翻译: AI agents are increasingly being developed to accelerate scientific discovery, yet their practical capabilities in real research settings remain poorly understood. Existing benchmarks for AI agents rarely capture the complexity, heterogeneity, and extended reasoning required by scientific work, whereas benchmarks for scientific tasks often reduce research to static, direct problems and provide limited support for interactive evaluation. Here, we introduce SciAgentArena, a systematic benchmark for evaluating AI agents in real-world scientific research scenarios drawn from emerging needs across multiple domains. SciAgentArena comprises approximately 200 tasks with stepwise verification and an interactive, agent-agnostic environment for assessing diverse AI agents. Using this benchmark, we find that current agents can contribute effectively to well-specified data-analysis workflows, particularly when the task structure and evaluation criteria are clear. However, their performance remains uneven across scientific contexts: agents struggle to generate genuinely novel insights, sustain self-directed exploration, and formulate robust solutions for open-ended research questions. We further characterize common failure modes across agents and identify opportunities for improving their reliability, autonomy, and scientific reasoning. Together, SciAgentArena provides a practical framework for measuring progress in AI agents for science and for guiding the design of future agents capable of addressing complex scientific challenges. Full codes, tasks, and datasets can be accessed via this link: this https URL .

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决现有智能体评测基准无法准确反映其在真实复杂科研场景中实际能力的问题。当前基准要么仅测试语言模型基础能力，要么将科研简化为静态问答，缺乏对多步推理、工具调用和交互探索的系统评估。该问题之所以重要，是因为人工智能智能体正被广泛用于加速科学发现，但其在真实研究中的可靠性、自主性和科学推理能力尚不明确。建立科学的评测体系对于指导智能体设计、确保其在医疗和化学等关键领域的可信应用，以及衡量科研智能化进展至关重要。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者通过系统梳理现有基准测试的局限来构思该方法，指出当前AI智能体基准缺乏真实科研的复杂性与交互性，而科学任务基准又过于静态单一。基于这些不足，他们设计了涵盖多领域、支持多步验证与工具调用的交互式基准，并采用运行与评估分离的架构以确保公平兼容。同时，作者明确对比并参考了现有工作以完善评估框架。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是构建一个系统化的科研智能体评估基准，强调通过多步骤工作流、可验证的中间状态和工具交互来全面衡量智能体在真实科研场景中的能力。整体实现流程采用运行环境与评估环境分离的设计，智能体在专属环境中生成数据或代码，随后统一输入至评估环境进行分步验证与指标计算，从而公平高效地测试不同智能体的可靠性与科学推理水平。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的核心创新是提出了一个面向真实科研场景的系统化智能体评测基准。与以往仅关注静态问答或单一学科、缺乏多步推理验证的评测集不同，该基准涵盖五个跨尺度科学领域，设计了包含逐步验证和工具交互的复杂任务。此外，它采用运行与评估分离的架构，能够公平比较不同配置的模型，并全面考察其稳定性、可靠性与科学推理能力，为未来智能体设计提供了实用框架。

Here, we introduce SciAgentArena, a systematic benchmark for evaluating AI agents in real-world scientific research scenarios drawn from emerging needs across multiple domains. SciAgentArena comprises approximately 200 tasks with stepwise verification and an interactive, agent-agnostic environment for assessing diverse AI agents. Using this benchmark, we find that current agents can contribute effectively to well-specified data-analysis workflows, particularly when the task structure and evaluation criteria are clear. We further characterize common failure modes across agents and identify opportunities for improving their reliability, autonomy, and scientific reasoning. Together, SciAgentArena provides a practical framework for measuring progress in AI agents for science and for guiding the design of future agents capable of addressing complex scientific challenges. item.title: The Hidden Power of Scaling Factor in LoRA Optimization
item.author: Zhang, Zicheng, Li, Haoran, Wang, Jiaxing, Gong, Guoqiang, Li, Anqi, Hu, Yudong, Xiong, Ting, Gao, Yurong, Hu, Junxing, Jiang, Zhida, Zhang, Yifeng, Liu, Pengzhang, Jiang, Qixia
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文揭示了低秩自适应中缩放因子与学习率的不同作用，提出LoRA-alpha框架以恢复缩放因子的原则性作用，从而提升性能并简化超参数搜索。

背景: 在低秩自适应中，缩放因子通常被视为学习率的补充，但其在优化中的作用尚不明确。

目的: 揭示缩放因子在优化中的主导作用，并提出一个框架以恢复其原则性作用。

方法: 通过广泛的实证分析和理论信号漂移框架，提出LoRA-alpha框架。

主要发现: 缩放因子通过放大任务信号加速收敛，且最优缩放因子与秩呈次线性关系，遵循平方根定律。

结论: LoRA-alpha框架在多种任务中 consistently 提升性能，简化超参数搜索，释放低秩自适应的学习潜力。

翻译: In Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), the scaling factor α is often treated as a mere complement to the learning rate, yet its role in optimization remains poorly understood. In this paper, we reveal that the scaling factor α and the learning rate function differently, with α emerging as the dominant driver of effective optimization, delivering gains that cannot be replicated by learning rate scaling alone. Through the synergy of extensive empirical analysis and a theoretical Signal-Drift framework, we uncover three findings into LoRA's scaling mechanism: First, LoRA's spectral suppression smooths the optimization landscape, rendering standard hyperparameters overly conservative and creating an optimization gap. Second, when leveraging this smoothness to accelerate convergence, α outperforms the learning rate by amplifying the task signal without increasing the drift ratio. Third, the optimal scaling factor follows a sublinear relationship with the rank, well characterized by a square-root law with an unexpectedly large coefficient, revealing the insufficient scaling of existing rank-tied heuristics. Based on these insights, we propose LoRA-α, a minimalist framework that restores α to its principled regime, making LoRA compatible with standard small learning rates. Extensive evaluations across diverse tasks demonstrate that LoRA-α consistently improves performance while streamlining hyperparameter search, unleashing the learning potential of LoRA.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决低秩自适应微调方法中缩放因子设置不合理且长期被忽视的问题。当前实践多采用简单的经验规则设定该因子，导致模型优化潜力受限，并迫使研究者依赖较大的学习率。深入理解并优化这一因子对于高效微调大模型至关重要，因为它不仅能显著提升训练效果，还能大幅简化超参数调优流程，降低实际应用的计算成本与门槛。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者通过广泛的超参数实验发现，低秩自适应微调的性能提升主要依赖较大的缩放因子而非单纯提高学习率。结合理论分析，他们提出了信号与漂移框架，揭示该因子能放大任务信号而不增加结构漂移，并发现最优值与秩呈平方根关系。基于这些发现，他们设计了新方法，采用平方根缩放律和大基数值来恢复缩放因子的合理范围。该方法借鉴并统一了多项现有研究，将以往零散的观察整合为统一原则，从而简化了超参数搜索并提升了优化效果。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是重新认识并放大低秩自适应微调中的缩放因子作用，指出其能有效放大任务信号而不增加结构噪声，从而加速优化。实现流程上，该方法提出了一种极简框架，依据秩的平方根规律设定较大的基础缩放值，使模型能够直接采用标准的小学习率进行训练，无需繁琐的超参数搜索即可显著提升性能。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于揭示了缩放因子与学习率在优化中的不同作用机制，并提出了信号漂移理论框架。研究发现最优缩放因子应遵循带有较大系数的平方根规律，而非以往简单的线性比例设定。基于此，论文提出了一种新的优化框架，使模型能够直接采用标准的小学习率进行训练。相比以往工作，该方法打破了传统经验法则的限制，显著提升了训练稳定性与最终性能，并大幅简化了超参数搜索过程。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文通过实证与理论分析揭示了低秩自适应中缩放因子的核心作用，提出了LoRA-α优化框架，确立了缩放因子与秩的平方根缩放规律，使模型能够直接使用标准小学习率并显著提升微调性能与调参效率。

Abstract

In Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), the scaling factor $\alpha$ is often treated as a mere complement to the learning rate, yet its role in optimization remains poorly understood. In this paper, we reveal that the scaling factor $\alpha$ and the learning rate function differently, with $\alpha$ emerging as the dominant driver of effective optimization, delivering gains that cannot be replicated by learning rate scaling alone. Through the synergy of extensive empirical analysis and a theoretical Signal-Drift framework, we uncover three findings into LoRA's scaling mechanism: First, LoRA's spectral suppression smooths the optimization landscape, rendering standard hyperparameters overly conservative and creating an optimization gap. Second, when leveraging this smoothness to accelerate convergence, $\alpha$ outperforms the learning rate by amplifying the task signal without increasing the drift ratio. Third, the optimal scaling factor follows a sublinear relationship with the rank, well characterized by a square-root law with an unexpectedly large coefficient, revealing the insufficient scaling of existing rank-tied heuristics. Based on these insights, we propose LoRA-$\alpha$, a minimalist framework that restores $\alpha$ to its principled regime, making LoRA compatible with standard small learning rates. Extensive evaluations across diverse tasks demonstrate that LoRA-$\alpha$ consistently improves performance while streamlining hyperparameter search, unleashing the learning potential of LoRA.

item.title: MP3: Multi-Period Pattern Pre-training for Spatio-Temporal Forecasting
item.author: Lilan Peng, Yandi Liu, Qingren Yao, Chongshou Li, Tianrui Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为多周期模式预训练（MP3）的即插即用预训练插件，旨在解决时空预测中因短窗口输入不完整周期观测、异构全局空间相关性和跨周期叠加因果关系导致的“时间幻影”问题。

背景: 时空预测在交通、气候和能源等领域至关重要。城市时空数据表现出时间幻影现象，即相似的短窗口输入可能具有不同的未来趋势，反之亦然。现有的时空图神经网络无法有效识别此类幻影。

目的: 旨在通过解决短窗口输入中不完整周期观测、异构全局空间相关性和跨周期叠加因果关系等核心问题，提升现有时空图神经网络的预测性能。

方法: 开发了多周期模式预训练（MP3）插件。其核心创新包括：一是多周期模式学习，利用边缘卷积识别不同多周期模式，通过瓶颈投影和全局记忆库捕捉异构全局空间关系，并采用因果增强Transformer捕获跨周期模式依赖；二是该插件可无缝集成到现有STGNN骨干网络中。

主要发现: 在五个真实世界数据集（包括大规模数据集CA）上对五种STGNN基线模型的实验验证了MP3的有效性、可扩展性和适应性。MP3在所有评估基线上均带来一致且稳健的性能提升，平均降低平均绝对误差百分之四点七和均方根误差百分之五点零。

结论: MP3作为一种即插即用插件，能有效区分时间幻影，显著提升现有时空图神经网络的预测性能，具有良好的可扩展性和适应性。

翻译: Spatio-Temporal forecasting is crucial in diverse fields, such as transportation, climate, and energy. Urban spatio-temporal data exhibits temporal mirage: similar short-window inputs have divergent future trends, and vice versa. Existing spatio-temporal graph neural networks (STGNNs) cannot effectively identify such mirages. We argue that the core reason lies in the short-window inputs that have incomplete period observation, heterogeneous global spatial correlation, and cross-period superposition causality. To bridge this gap, we develop a novel Multi- Period Pattern Pre-training (MP3), a plug-and-play pre-training plugin for distinguishing temporal mirages. MP3 presents two core innovations: (1) The multi-period pattern learning is designed to learn multi-period patterns from long time series. Specifically, multi-period temporal modeling leverages edge convolution to identify different multi-period patterns. Multi-period spatial modeling uses a bottleneck project and a global memory bank to capture heterogeneous global spatial relations efficiently. Cross-period pattern interaction employs a causality-enhanced Transformer to capture dependencies across different period patterns. (2) This plugin can seamlessly integrate into existing STGNN backbones to strengthen their forecasting performance. The experiment on five STGNN baselines across five real-world datasets (including a large-scale dataset CA) verify the effectiveness, superior scalability and strong adaptability of MP3, which brings consistent and robust performance improvements across all evaluated baselines. On average, MP3 reduces the MAE 4.7% and the RMSE 5.0%. The code can be available at https://github.com/YAN-outlook/MP3.

Abstract

Spatio-Temporal forecasting is crucial in diverse fields, such as transportation, climate, and energy. Urban spatio-temporal data exhibits temporal mirage: similar short-window inputs have divergent future trends, and vice versa. Existing spatio-temporal graph neural networks (STGNNs) cannot effectively identify such mirages. We argue that the core reason lies in the short-window inputs that have incomplete period observation, heterogeneous global spatial correlation, and cross-period superposition causality. To bridge this gap, we develop a novel Multi- Period Pattern Pre-training (MP3), a plug-and-play pre-training plugin for distinguishing temporal mirages. MP3 presents two core innovations: (1) The multi-period pattern learning is designed to learn multi-period patterns from long time series. Specifically, multi-period temporal modeling leverages edge convolution to identify different multi-period patterns. Multi-period spatial modeling uses a bottleneck project and a global memory bank to capture heterogeneous global spatial relations efficiently. Cross-period pattern interaction employs a causality-enhanced Transformer to capture dependencies across different period patterns. (2) This plugin can seamlessly integrate into existing STGNN backbones to strengthen their forecasting performance. The experiment on five STGNN baselines across five real-world datasets (including a large-scale dataset CA) verify the effectiveness, superior scalability and strong adaptability of MP3, which brings consistent and robust performance improvements across all evaluated baselines. On average, MP3 reduces the MAE 4.7% and the RMSE 5.0%. The code can be available at https://github.com/YAN-outlook/MP3.

item.title: Rethinking RAG in Long Videos: What to Retrieve and How to Use It?
item.author: Lee, Yuho, Shin, Jisu, Kim, Nicole Hee-Yeon, Bang, Jihwan, Lee, Juntae, Hwang, Kyuwoong, Porikli, Fatih, Song, Hwanjun
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文针对视频检索增强生成领域存在的基准测试缺陷和方法局限性，提出了新的基准测试V-RAGBench和方法CARVE，通过并行检索和块级自适应重排序，实现了多模态和时序粒度下的最优配置选择，显著提升了性能。

背景: 检索增强生成技术正从文本扩展到长程第一人称视频，系统需跨多模态和时间粒度选择与查询相关的片段。然而，现有基准测试允许仅凭文本回答问题而掩盖检索错误，且现有方法对每个查询仅应用单一模态-粒度配置，忽略了片段级的差异。

目的: 解决现有基准测试无法准确评估检索错误的问题，以及现有方法忽略片段级配置差异的局限性，实现对检索和生成的忠实、解耦评估，并优化视频片段的配置选择。

方法: 提出V-RAGBench基准测试，包含查询、证据片段和答案的三元组，用于解耦评估检索和生成。提出CARVE方法，通过并行运行不同配置的检索器，并采用块级自适应重排序为每个片段选择最优配置，使生成的证据形式交错呈现不同配置。

主要发现: CARVE方法在多个视频检索增强生成基线测试中表现优异，其提供的证据片段交错混合了多种配置，而非单一配置，这是查询级方法无法实现的。

结论: 通过引入V-RAGBench基准和CARVE方法，有效解决了视频检索增强生成中的评估和方法问题，实现了更精确的检索和生成性能提升。

翻译: Retrieval-augmented generation is moving beyond text into long, egocentric video, where systems must select query-relevant chunks across multiple modalities and temporal granularities. Yet progress in VideoRAG is limited by two gaps: existing benchmarks allow queries to be answered without the video, obscuring retrieval errors, and prior methods apply a single modality-granularity configuration per query, ignoring chunk-level variability. We address both by introducing V-RAGBench, a benchmark of <query, evidence chunk, answer> triplets that enables faithful, decoupled evaluation of retrieval and generation, and CARVE, a simple method that runs parallel retrievers across configurations and employs chunk-adaptive reranking to identify the winning configuration for each chunk. Each chunk then enters the generator under its winning configuration selected during retrieval, yielding an interleaved evidence form where the chunk-level decision propagates across both stages. CARVE outperforms eight recent VideoRAG baselines, with the chunks supplied to the generator interleaving multiple configurations rather than sharing a single one, a behavior unattainable by query-level methods.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决长视频检索增强生成中检索与生成评估相互掩盖，以及现有方法对每个查询固定使用单一视觉或文本特征配置的问题。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为现有测试集允许模型仅凭常识答题，导致无法准确衡量检索质量并优化系统。在现实中，随着可穿戴设备和个人智能代理的普及，长视频已成为核心知识来源，精准匹配视频片段并动态选择最合适的特征表示，是提升人工智能系统事实可靠性与实用性的关键。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有方法对每个查询只固定使用一种模态和时间粒度，忽略了视频片段内容本身的差异性。因此他们提出按片段自适应选择最佳配置，通过并行检索所有组合后，借鉴文本检索中广泛使用的重排序技术，用多模态交叉编码器为每个片段选出最优配置并传递给生成器。该方法明确借鉴了文本检索增强生成中成熟的重排序机制与分块检索思想。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是放弃为整个查询统一使用单一的视频表示方式，改为针对每个视频片段独立匹配最合适的视觉或文本模态以及帧级或片段级粒度。整体实现分为两个阶段，首先并行运行四种不同配置的检索器构建候选池，随后利用多模态交叉编码器对候选片段按其对应配置重新打分并排序。最终筛选出的片段会携带各自的最佳配置信息，以交错混合的形式输入生成模型以生成答案。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于提出了专用的评测基准V-RAGBench和一种名为CARVE的新方法。V-RAGBench通过构建问答证据三元组，实现了对检索和生成阶段的独立解耦评估。CARVE方法打破了以往工作为整个查询统一固定单一模态和时间粒度配置的做法，改为针对视频中的每个片段独立选择最优配置，并将不同配置的片段交错输入生成器。相比之前的工作，该方法在检索和生成阶段均取得了更优的性能，且证明了按片段动态选择配置比按查询统一选择更有效。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一个支持检索与生成独立评估的新基准，并设计了一种为每个视频片段自适应选择最优模态与时间粒度配置的方法，有效解决了长视频检索增强生成中评估失真与配置单一的问题，显著提升了系统性能。

Abstract

Retrieval-augmented generation is moving beyond text into long, egocentric video, where systems must select query-relevant chunks across multiple modalities and temporal granularities. Yet progress in VideoRAG is limited by two gaps: existing benchmarks allow queries to be answered without the video, obscuring retrieval errors, and prior methods apply a single modality-granularity configuration per query, ignoring chunk-level variability. We address both by introducing V-RAGBench, a benchmark of $\langle$query, evidence chunk, answer$\rangle$ triplets that enables faithful, decoupled evaluation of retrieval and generation, and CARVE, a simple method that runs parallel retrievers across configurations and employs chunk-adaptive reranking to identify the winning configuration for each chunk. Each chunk then enters the generator under its winning configuration selected during retrieval, yielding an interleaved evidence form where the chunk-level decision propagates across both stages. CARVE outperforms eight recent VideoRAG baselines, with the chunks supplied to the generator interleaving multiple configurations rather than sharing a single one, a behavior unattainable by query-level methods.

item.title: Under What Conditions Can a Machine Be Called Genuinely Creative?
item.author: Yong Zeng
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文探讨了机器在何种条件下可被视为真正具有创造力，以及如何在共享的认知与创造环境中保持人类能动性。基于意义承载的意向性变化科学，提出了一个包含十个要求的要求框架，并将创造力理解为通过递归干预动态对不完整情境的结构化转变。

背景: 近期的人工智能系统能够生成看似具有创造性的文本、软件架构、假设、设计和科学工作流。

目的: 探讨机器在何种条件下可被视为真正具有创造力，以及如何在共享的认知与创造环境中保持人类能动性。

方法: 基于意义承载的意向性变化科学，构建一个要求框架，并通过网络物理和网络生物学的研究案例展示这些要求的计算可行性，同时将开放式系统、自动化发现框架、自修改智能体、基础模型和智能体工作流作为压力测试案例进行分析。

主要发现: 真正的机器创造力不应仅由输出的新颖性、当前性能或临时架构来定义。创造力依赖于十个要求：环境表征、范围感知、冲突识别、干预能力、结果观察、知识与环境更新、重新界定范围、局部到全局展开、基于价值的范围界定以及人机共存。这些要求通过感知、冲突和能力三大定律组织。现有的生成系统虽然强大，但不足以单独确立真正的机器创造力。

结论: 主动的人工智能伦理是真正机器创造力的内在组成部分，而非事后过滤器。基于价值的范围界定和人机共存必须塑造创造性机器如何感知环境、识别冲突、选择干预、观察结果、更新知识和重新界定未来行动。

翻译: Recent AI systems can generate texts, software architectures, hypotheses, designs, and scientific workflows that appear creative. This paper asks under what conditions a machine can be called genuinely creative, and how human agency can be preserved within shared cognitive and creative environments. It develops a requirement framework derived from Designics, the science of meaning-bearing intentional change. The paper argues that genuine machine creativity should not be defined by output novelty, current performance, or transient architecture alone. Instead, creativity is understood as the structural transformation of incomplete situations through recursive intervention dynamics. On this view, it depends on ten requirements: environment representation, scoped perception, conflict identification, intervention capability, consequence observation, knowledge and environment update, rescoping, local-to-global unfolding, value-based scoping, and human-AI co-living. These are organized through the three laws of Designics: perception, conflict, and capability. The paper illustrates the computational tractability of these requirements through selected cyber-physical and cyber-biological studies, including recursive element extraction, autonomous mesh generation, and neurophysiological and workload analysis. It then treats open-ended systems, automated discovery frameworks, self-modifying agents, foundation models, and agentic workflows as pressure cases: they demonstrate powerful generative means but do not by themselves establish genuine machine creativity. Finally, the paper argues that proactive AI ethics is internal to genuine machine creativity rather than an after-the-fact filter. Value-based scoping and human-AI co-living must shape how creative machines perceive environments, identify conflicts, select interventions, observe consequences, update knowledge, and rescope future action.

Abstract

Recent AI systems can generate texts, software architectures, hypotheses, designs, and scientific workflows that appear creative. This paper asks under what conditions a machine can be called genuinely creative, and how human agency can be preserved within shared cognitive and creative environments. It develops a requirement framework derived from Designics, the science of meaning-bearing intentional change. The paper argues that genuine machine creativity should not be defined by output novelty, current performance, or transient architecture alone. Instead, creativity is understood as the structural transformation of incomplete situations through recursive intervention dynamics. On this view, it depends on ten requirements: environment representation, scoped perception, conflict identification, intervention capability, consequence observation, knowledge and environment update, rescoping, local-to-global unfolding, value-based scoping, and human-AI co-living. These are organized through the three laws of Designics: perception, conflict, and capability. The paper illustrates the computational tractability of these requirements through selected cyber-physical and cyber-biological studies, including recursive element extraction, autonomous mesh generation, and neurophysiological and workload analysis. It then treats open-ended systems, automated discovery frameworks, self-modifying agents, foundation models, and agentic workflows as pressure cases: they demonstrate powerful generative means but do not by themselves establish genuine machine creativity. Finally, the paper argues that proactive AI ethics is internal to genuine machine creativity rather than an after-the-fact filter. Value-based scoping and human-AI co-living must shape how creative machines perceive environments, identify conflicts, select interventions, observe consequences, update knowledge, and rescope future action.

item.title: OmniDirector: General Multi-Shot Camera Cloning without Cross-Paired Data
item.author: Liu, Jiwen, Li, Shujuan, Fang, Zhixue, Li, Xiaohan, Zhou, Yan, Meng, Zijie, Zhang, Zhimin, Luo, Yawen, Zhang, Guoxin, Liu, Yu-Shen, Wan, Pengfei
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种通用的相机运动表示方法，将相机编码为网格运动视频，并在此基础上构建了OmniDirector统一框架，用于多模态扩散变换器的导演级控制。

背景: 从参考视频中克隆相机运动是视频生成中的重要任务，因为视频能提供直观且精确的控制。现有方法要么直接使用参数化表示，无法处理多镜头生成；要么合成交叉配对数据，面临数据稀缺问题，导致在复杂相机运动克隆中性能不佳。

目的: 解决现有方法在复杂相机运动克隆中性能不佳的问题，实现多镜头视频生成中的相机运动克隆。

方法: 提出一种通用的相机运动表示方法，将相机编码为网格运动视频，以视觉方式表示相机参数并支持多镜头视频生成的轨迹整合。构建OmniDirector统一框架，在百万级相机网格视频对上训练，协调角色、动作和相机。设计分层提示扩展智能体，通过理解信号关系系统描述相机运动和视觉内容，和谐整合不同控制信号。

主要发现: 广泛的实验表明，该框架具有优越的性能和出色的可控性。

结论: 提出的通用相机运动表示方法和OmniDirector框架能有效解决复杂相机运动克隆问题，提供导演级控制。

翻译: Cloning camera motion from reference videos is an important task in video generation, as videos provide intuitive and precise control. Existing methods either directly use parametric representations that fail to handle multi-shot generation or synthesize cross-paired data, which suffer from data scarcity, resulting in poor performance in complicated camera motion cloning. To address these issues, we introduce a general camera motion representation that encodes cameras as grid motion videos. This camera grid represents the camera parameters visually and supports the integration of diverse trajectories for multi-shot video generation. Building upon this, we propose OmniDirector, a unified framework trained on a million-scale camera grid-video pairs that coordinates characters, actions, and cameras to provide director-level control for multimodal diffusion transformers. Furthermore, we design a novel hierarchical prompt expansion agent that harmoniously integrates different control signals by systematically describing camera motion and visual content through understanding signal relationships. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance and outstanding controllability of our framework. Project page: this https URL

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决的是从参考视频中克隆复杂摄像机运动（尤其是多镜头切换）时，现有方法因依赖稀缺的配对数据或参数化表示而导致的控制精度差和泛化能力不足的问题。该问题在视频生成研究中至关重要，因为摄像机运动直接决定了视频的叙事节奏、情感氛围与空间构图，实现直观且精准的镜头控制能够大幅降低创作门槛，满足影视制作与内容生成对导演级控制的实际需求。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有方法在参数化控制难以处理多镜头切换、以及依赖配对数据导致数据稀缺的痛点，提出将相机运动转化为空场景网格视频的统一视觉表示。该设计通过解耦镜头运动与画面内容，使模型能直接学习复杂的电影级运镜轨迹。方法借鉴了现有视频参考控制与扩散模型的研究基础，但通过网格表示和大规模数据集训练，有效克服了传统方法在尺度匹配、数据依赖及复杂运镜理解上的局限。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是将参考视频中的相机运动参数转化为空场景的网格运动视频，以此解耦相机运动与画面内容，实现复杂多镜头的精准克隆与统一控制。整体流程首先从参考视频中提取相机参数并渲染为网格运动视频，随后利用海量配对数据训练统一生成框架以学习运动规律，最后在推理时通过分层提示扩展机制将相机运动描述与其他控制信号融合，协同生成目标视频。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种名为相机网格的通用表示方法，将相机运动转化为空场景中的网格视频，从而统一处理单镜头与多镜头的复杂运镜。相比以往依赖显式参数或稀缺配对数据的方法，该方法无需配对数据即可实现多镜头克隆，有效解耦了相机运动与画面内容，避免了信息干扰。此外，论文还设计了分层提示扩展机制，将相机控制与其他信号无缝融合，为视频生成模型提供了导演级的精准控制能力。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了OmniDirector框架，通过引入相机网格表示法与百万级数据集，结合分层提示扩展机制，实现了无需交叉配对数据的多镜头相机运动克隆及导演级视频生成控制。

Abstract

Cloning camera motion from reference videos is an important task in video generation, as videos provide intuitive and precise control. Existing methods either directly use parametric representations that fail to handle multi-shot generation or synthesize cross-paired data, which suffer from data scarcity, resulting in poor performance in complicated camera motion cloning. To address these issues, we introduce a general camera motion representation that encodes cameras as grid motion videos. This camera grid represents the camera parameters visually and supports the integration of diverse trajectories for multi-shot video generation. Building upon this, we propose OmniDirector, a unified framework trained on a million-scale camera grid-video pairs that coordinates characters, actions, and cameras to provide director-level control for multimodal diffusion transformers. Furthermore, we design a novel hierarchical prompt expansion agent that harmoniously integrates different control signals by systematically describing camera motion and visual content through understanding signal relationships. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance and outstanding controllability of our framework. Project page: this https URL

item.title: Dense Supervision, Sparse Updates: On the Sparsity and Geometry of On-Policy Distillation
item.author: Yu, Guo, Liu, Wenlin, Hu, Yulan, Ma, Hao-Xuan, Jiang, Jun-Peng, Ye, Han-Jia
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了在线策略蒸馏方法对模型参数的影响，发现其更新具有稀疏性和特定的几何特征，表明该方法保留了在线策略后训练的重要几何特征。

背景: 在线策略蒸馏是一种结合在线策略学生轨迹和密集教师监督的后训练方法，但其对模型参数的具体影响尚不明确。

目的: 分析在线策略蒸馏方法如何改变模型参数，特别是在稀疏性和几何结构方面的影响。

方法: 在多个语言模型和视觉语言模型对上，通过实验分析在线策略蒸馏的更新特性，包括稀疏性、优化器性能以及更新矩阵的几何特征。

主要发现: 在线策略蒸馏的更新具有坐标稀疏性，主要分布在FFN模块中，且仅训练发现的子网络可接近全训练性能；更新矩阵数值满秩但谱集中，主要作用于源权重接近零的坐标，且需要自适应优化器如AdamW。

结论: 在线策略蒸馏并未转变为普通的密集参数重写，而是保留了在线策略后训练的重要几何特征。

翻译: On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently become a prominent post-training recipe by combining two desirable ingredients: on-policy student trajectories and dense teacher supervision. However, how this hybrid changes a model's parameters remains unclear. Across several language and vision-language model pairs and OPD use cases, our analysis yields two main findings. On sparsity, OPD updates are small and coordinate-sparse. They are distributed across layers, with the largest relative movement usually appearing in FFN modules. This sparse structure is operationally useful: training only the discovered subnetwork nearly recovers full-training performance. The sparse support does not remove the need for adaptive optimization: SGD, previously reported to be competitive in RLVR, underperforms AdamW in our OPD optimizer ablation, suggesting that dense teacher supervision preserves useful momentum structure and heterogeneous second-moment scales. On geometry, the updates are numerically full-rank but spectrally concentrated; they lie mostly away from the principal singular subspaces of the source weights and fall disproportionately on coordinates where the source weights are close to zero. These findings suggest that dense teacher supervision does not turn OPD into ordinary dense parameter rewriting; instead, OPD retains important geometric signatures of on-policy post-training.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想弄清楚在线策略蒸馏训练过程中，模型参数究竟发生了怎样的具体变化及其内在规律。尽管该方法在提升大模型推理能力方面效果显著，但其参数更新的稀疏性与几何特征长期缺乏系统分析。这一问题在研究中至关重要，因为明确参数更新机制有助于揭示不同训练范式对模型的影响本质，从而指导更高效的算法设计。在实际应用中，发现参数更新具有高度稀疏性可直接用于筛选关键参数子网络，大幅降低训练成本并提升微调效率。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 本文并未提出新方法，而是对已有的在线策略蒸馏技术进行参数机制分析。作者受在线模仿学习启发，旨在结合监督微调的密集标签优势与强化学习验证奖励的在线采样特性，以解决分布偏移与奖励稀疏问题。该研究借鉴了监督微调、离线知识蒸馏及强化学习验证奖励等现有训练范式，并参考了关于大模型后训练参数动态的先前成果，试图填补不同训练方式对模型参数影响机制的认知空白。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是让模型在生成自身回答的过程中，直接接收来自更强教师模型的逐词密集反馈，从而结合在线策略的数据适应性与传统蒸馏的密集监督优势。整体实现流程为：学生模型根据提示词生成回答序列，教师模型对生成的每个词提供监督信号，最后通过最小化师生模型输出分布的差异来更新学生模型的参数。这一过程既避免了固定数据集带来的分布偏移，又克服了强化学习中奖励信号稀疏的问题。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于首次系统揭示了在线策略蒸馏过程中模型参数更新的稀疏性与几何特征。研究发现，尽管该方法采用密集的教师反馈信号，但参数更新依然高度稀疏且主要集中于前馈神经网络层，并在几何空间上远离源模型的主方向。与以往认为密集监督必然导致密集参数修改的认知不同，本文证明在线策略的数据分布才是决定更新呈现稀疏特性的核心因素，表明该方法在参数层面更接近在线策略编辑而非传统的密集参数重写。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文系统分析了在线策略蒸馏的模型参数更新特征，发现尽管使用密集的教师监督信号，参数更新依然保持稀疏且避开源模型的主方向，证明在线策略的数据分布而非奖励稀疏性才是决定后训练参数更新几何结构的关键因素。

Abstract

On-policy distillation (\textsc{OPD}) has recently become a prominent post-training recipe by combining two desirable ingredients: on-policy student trajectories and dense teacher supervision. However, how this hybrid changes a model's parameters remains unclear. Across several language and vision-language model pairs and \textsc{OPD} use cases, our analysis yields two main findings. On sparsity, \textsc{OPD} updates are small and coordinate-sparse. They are distributed across layers, with the largest relative movement usually appearing in FFN modules. This sparse structure is operationally useful: training only the discovered subnetwork nearly recovers full-training performance. The sparse support does not remove the need for adaptive optimization: SGD, previously reported to be competitive in \textsc{RLVR}, underperforms AdamW in our \textsc{OPD} optimizer ablation, suggesting that dense teacher supervision preserves useful momentum structure and heterogeneous second-moment scales. On geometry, the updates are numerically full-rank but spectrally concentrated; they lie mostly away from the principal singular subspaces of the source weights and fall disproportionately on coordinates where the source weights are close to zero. These findings suggest that dense teacher supervision does not turn \textsc{OPD} into ordinary dense parameter rewriting; instead, \textsc{OPD} retains important geometric signatures of on-policy post-training.

item.title: Orchestra-o1: Omnimodal Agent Orchestration
item.author: Zhang, Fan, Zhang, Vireo, Qian, Shengju, Li, Haoxuan, Wu, Hao, Wu, Jinyang, Zhou, Donghao, Zhu, Zhihong, Lian, Zheng, Wang, Xin, Heng, Pheng-Ann
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Orchestra-o1的全模态智能体编排框架，旨在解决现有框架在复杂多模态场景下泛化能力不足的问题。该框架通过统一的编排机制实现了模态感知的任务分解、在线子智能体专业化以及并行子任务执行，显著提升了智能体系统在异构信息源复杂任务中的表现。

背景: 基于大型语言模型的智能体工作流正从单智能体模式转向多智能体系统，智能体编排对于任务分解和协作至关重要。然而，现有的编排框架局限于有限的模态，难以在文本、图像、音频和视频等异构模态共存且交互的全模态场景中有效泛化。

目的: 提出一种能够支持跨多模态高效智能体协作的全模态智能体编排框架，以解决现有框架在复杂全模态场景下的局限性。

方法: 提出了Orchestra-o1框架，引入统一的编排机制，支持模态感知的任务分解、在线子智能体专业化以及并行子任务执行。此外，还引入了决策对齐的组相对策略优化方法用于训练模型。

主要发现: 该框架的可扩展设计使智能体系统能有效处理涉及异构信息源的复杂现实任务。在OmniGAIA基准测试中，其准确率比第二好的方法高出百分之十点三。训练后的模型在所有现有开源全模态智能体中达到了最先进性能。

结论: Orchestra-o1框架通过统一的编排机制和高效的强化学习方法，成功实现了跨多模态的智能体协作，在复杂全模态任务中取得了显著的性能提升和领先优势。

翻译: The recent success of agent swarms has shifted the paradigm of large language model (LLM)-based agents from single-agent workflows to multi-agent systems, highlighting the importance of agent orchestration for task decomposition and collaboration. However, existing orchestration frameworks are limited to a narrow set of modalities and struggle to generalize to more complex settings where heterogeneous modalities coexist and interact. This limitation becomes particularly pronounced in omnimodal scenarios, where tasks require the unified understanding and coordination of diverse inputs such as text, image, audio, and video. In this work, we propose Orchestra-o1, an omnimodal agent orchestration framework designed to support efficient agent collaboration across multiple modalities. Orchestra-o1 introduces a unified orchestration mechanism that enables modality-aware task decomposition, online sub-agent specialization, and parallel sub-task execution. This scalable design allows agent systems to effectively tackle complex real-world tasks involving heterogeneous information sources, surpassing the second-best approach by 10.3% accuracy on the OmniGAIA benchmark. Furthermore, we introduce decision-aligned group relative policy optimization (DA-GRPO), an efficient agentic reinforcement learning approach for training Orchestra-o1-8B, which also achieves state-of-the-art performance against all existing open-source omnimodal agents.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有智能体编排框架仅支持单一或少数信息类型，难以统一理解和协调文本、图像、音频和视频等多样信息共存交互的复杂任务的问题。该问题在现实和研究中至关重要，因为真实世界的应用天然涉及多源信息的协同处理，突破现有局限是构建具备统一感知、推理与高效协作能力的高级智能系统的必经之路。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有智能体系统多局限于单一模态，且原生多模态模型难以兼顾复杂推理与工具调用，而将高层决策与底层执行分离的编排架构更具扩展性。因此，他们设计了分层协作框架，通过统一工具生态和灵活模型后端，实现模态感知的任务分解、动态角色分配与并行子任务执行。该方法明确借鉴了早期多智能体编排范式及相关开源系统，并针对其工作流僵化、工具链不完整等缺陷进行了优化，同时在训练环节扩展了原有的相对策略优化算法。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将高层任务规划与底层感知执行相分离，通过一个主控智能体动态协调多个专用子智能体与工具，以高效处理包含文本、图像、音频和视频的复杂多模态任务。整体实现流程为：主控智能体接收混合模态任务后，首先进行任务分解并匹配最合适的子智能体与工具；随后将相互独立的子任务并行分配给对应子智能体执行；最后汇总执行结果，主控智能体判断是否需继续分解或直接生成最终答案。系统还通过强化学习技术持续优化主控智能体的步骤级决策能力。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了多模态智能体编排框架及配套的强化学习训练算法。框架将高层决策与底层感知执行解耦，支持模态感知的任务分解、在线子智能体专业化分工及并行子任务执行，并兼容异构模型与统一工具生态。相比以往仅支持单一模态或依赖单一模型硬扛所有任务的现有方法，该工作通过模块化并行架构显著提升了处理复杂多模态任务的效率与准确率，同时训练算法通过对齐步骤级决策而非仅关注最终答案，有效增强了开源模型的规划与调度能力。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了Orchestra-o1多模态智能体编排框架，通过解耦高层决策与底层感知执行并支持并行任务分配，实现了复杂多模态任务的高效协作，同时引入强化学习训练方法显著提升了主智能体的规划与决策能力。

Abstract

The recent success of agent swarms has shifted the paradigm of large language model (LLM)-based agents from single-agent workflows to multi-agent systems, highlighting the importance of agent orchestration for task decomposition and collaboration. However, existing orchestration frameworks are limited to a narrow set of modalities and struggle to generalize to more complex settings where heterogeneous modalities coexist and interact. This limitation becomes particularly pronounced in omnimodal scenarios, where tasks require the unified understanding and coordination of diverse inputs such as text, image, audio, and video. This scalable design allows agent systems to effectively tackle complex real-world tasks involving heterogeneous information sources, surpassing the second-best approach by 10.3% accuracy on the OmniGAIA benchmark. Furthermore, we introduce decision-aligned group relative policy optimization (DA-GRPO), an efficient agentic reinforcement learning approach for training Orchestra-o1-8B, which also achieves state-of-the-art performance against all existing open-source omnimodal agents.

item.title: Aligning Quantum Operators with Large Language Models
item.author: Rogerio Feris, Yunchao Liu, Pengyuan Li, Hang Hua, David Kremer
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种将量子算子映射到大语言模型潜在空间的方法，实现了量子与语言输入的统一建模，并在Clifford+T电路合成任务中取得了与最先进方法相竞争的结果。

背景: 尽管大语言模型在数学和符号推理方面表现出色，但它们对量子表示（如酉矩阵）仍然缺乏理解能力。

目的: 弥合大语言模型与量子表示之间的鸿沟，使模型能够统一处理量子和语言输入。

方法: 将酉算子映射到大语言模型的潜在空间，并在Pauli旋转门集上进行Clifford+T电路合成的实例化。

主要发现: 模型在Clifford+T电路合成任务中取得了与最先进方法相竞争的结果，且性能随训练数据增加而持续提升，未出现饱和迹象；同时支持语言条件合成，允许直接以自然语言指定训练期间未见过的门约束。

结论: 该工作为量子感知基础模型提供了一条路径，使其能够原生地解释和推理量子操作，可能对量子编译和算法发现等领域产生更广泛的影响。

翻译: Can Large Language Models (LLMs) understand and reason about quantum operators? Despite their remarkable capabilities in mathematics and symbolic reasoning, LLMs remain inherently blind to quantum representations such as unitary matrices. In this work, we take a step toward bridging this gap by introducing an approach that maps unitary operators into the latent space of an LLM, enabling unified modeling over quantum and linguistic inputs. We instantiate this idea on Clifford+T circuit synthesis over a Pauli rotation gate set, where our model achieves results competitive with state-of-the-art methods and scales consistently with training data, with no signs of saturation. Our approach further enables language-conditioned synthesis, allowing gate constraints unseen during training to be specified directly in natural language. This work suggests a path toward quantum--aware foundation models that can natively interpret and reason about quantum operations, which could have broader implications reaching across quantum compilation and algorithm discovery.

Abstract

Can Large Language Models (LLMs) understand and reason about quantum operators? Despite their remarkable capabilities in mathematics and symbolic reasoning, LLMs remain inherently blind to quantum representations such as unitary matrices. In this work, we take a step toward bridging this gap by introducing an approach that maps unitary operators into the latent space of an LLM, enabling unified modeling over quantum and linguistic inputs. We instantiate this idea on Clifford+T circuit synthesis over a Pauli rotation gate set, where our model achieves results competitive with state-of-the-art methods and scales consistently with training data, with no signs of saturation. Our approach further enables language-conditioned synthesis, allowing gate constraints unseen during training to be specified directly in natural language. This work suggests a path toward quantum--aware foundation models that can natively interpret and reason about quantum operations, which could have broader implications reaching across quantum compilation and algorithm discovery.

item.title: When Plausible Is Not Realistic: Evaluating Human Mobility in LLM-Based Urban Simulation
item.author: Gustavo H. Santos, Aline Carneiro Viana, Thiago H. Silva
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种验证框架，用于评估基于大型语言模型的生成式智能体在城市模拟器中的移动性是否真实，发现其生成的移动性叙事虽具合理性但与实际数据存在显著差距，并提供了可扩展的开源基础设施以支持可重复的评估。

背景: 基于大型语言模型的生成式智能体在城市模拟器中的应用日益增多，但其生成的移动性模式是符合实证规律还是仅具备叙事合理性尚不明确。

目的: 引入一种验证框架，以评估基于大型语言模型的城市模拟器中生成式智能体的移动性是否与实际世界移动性数据相符。

方法: 使用移动性定律、时间节奏、网络基序、语义活动转换和行为移动性概况等指标，利用巴黎大区和上海的数据集，从多个维度评估AgentSociety和CitySim的移动性真实性。

主要发现: 叙事合理性与实证移动性真实性之间存在巨大差距；模拟器虽能捕捉部分高层语义活动分布，但难以再现核心时空约束（如出行长度分布、起讫点流量、停留时间和转换动态）；移动性多样性在默认提示配置下不稳定，可能需要显式的配置文件初始化。

结论: 强调了对基于大型语言模型的城市模拟器进行严格实证验证的必要性，并提供了构建更真实、可重复城市模拟系统的实用工具。

翻译: LLM-based generative agents are increasingly used in urban simulators, yet it remains unclear whether they reproduce empirically realistic human mobility patterns or merely generate plausible mobility narratives. We introduce a validation framework for evaluating the mobility of generative agents of LLM-based urban simulators against real-world mobility data. For this, we use mobility laws, temporal rhythms, network motifs, semantic activity transitions, and behavioral mobility profiles. Using datasets from the Greater Paris region and Shanghai, we evaluate AgentSociety and CitySim across multiple dimensions of mobility realism. Our analysis reveals a substantial gap between narrative plausibility and empirical mobility realism. Although the simulators capture some high-level semantic activity distributions, they struggle to reproduce core spatial and temporal constraints, including realistic trip-length distributions, origin-destination flows, dwell times, and transition dynamics. We further observe that realistic mobility diversity is unstable across default prompting configurations and may require explicit profile-aware initialization. To support reproducible evaluation, we also contribute scalable and open LLM-driven infrastructure for regional-scale map generation, observability-enhanced simulation, mobility-metric computation, and traffic simulation. Our findings highlight the need for rigorous empirical validation of LLM-based urban simulators and provide practical tools for building more realistic and reproducible urban simulation systems.

Abstract

LLM-based generative agents are increasingly used in urban simulators, yet it remains unclear whether they reproduce empirically realistic human mobility patterns or merely generate plausible mobility narratives. We introduce a validation framework for evaluating the mobility of generative agents of LLM-based urban simulators against real-world mobility data. For this, we use mobility laws, temporal rhythms, network motifs, semantic activity transitions, and behavioral mobility profiles. Using datasets from the Greater Paris region and Shanghai, we evaluate AgentSociety and CitySim across multiple dimensions of mobility realism. Our analysis reveals a substantial gap between narrative plausibility and empirical mobility realism. Although the simulators capture some high-level semantic activity distributions, they struggle to reproduce core spatial and temporal constraints, including realistic trip-length distributions, origin-destination flows, dwell times, and transition dynamics. We further observe that realistic mobility diversity is unstable across default prompting configurations and may require explicit profile-aware initialization. To support reproducible evaluation, we also contribute scalable and open LLM-driven infrastructure for regional-scale map generation, observability-enhanced simulation, mobility-metric computation, and traffic simulation. Our findings highlight the need for rigorous empirical validation of LLM-based urban simulators and provide practical tools for building more realistic and reproducible urban simulation systems.

item.title: Efficient Domain-Adaptive Policy Learning via Kernel Representation with Application to Quadrotor Control under Non-Stationary Disturbances
item.author: Hongyu Zhou, Mingtian Tan, Vasileios Tzoumas
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于核表示的高效域自适应策略学习算法，通过可微核近似和随机傅里叶特征建模未知扰动，在离线训练阶段优化控制策略，在部署阶段通过在线最小二乘估计实时更新核系数和带宽参数，实现了对非平稳环境的实时自适应。

背景: 学习域自适应策略具有挑战性，需要环境表示既能充分表达离线训练期间复杂的仿真到现实差距，又具备足够的计算效率以支持部署期间的快速在线适应。例如，四旋翼飞行器可能遇到时变非平稳扰动，如突发阵风、载荷变化或有无地面效应的飞行模式转换。

目的: 解决域自适应策略学习中的挑战，实现高效的环境表示和快速在线适应，以应对复杂扰动。

方法: 使用基于随机傅里叶特征的可微核近似建模未知扰动。离线训练阶段随机采样核系数和带宽参数生成多样化的扰动剖面，并通过可微仿真和解析梯度优化控制策略。部署阶段通过在线最小二乘估计实时更新核系数和带宽。

主要发现: 在RTX 4090 GPU上仅需50秒即可完成离线训练。在Crazyflie四旋翼飞行器的高保真数值仿真和硬件实验中，该方法在复杂气动效应、阵风、地面效应和载荷波动等扰动下实现了有效的轨迹跟踪。

结论: 该算法能够有效应对时变非平稳扰动，实现高效的域自适应策略学习，并在仿真和硬件实验中验证了其性能。

翻译: We present an algorithm for efficient domain-adaptive policy learning via kernel representations. Learning domain-adaptive policies is challenging since it requires an environment representation that is both sufficiently expressive to model complex sim-to-real gaps during offline training, and computationally efficient enough to support rapid online adaptation during deployment. For instance, a quadrotor may encounter time-varying, non-stationary disturbances, such as sudden gusts of wind, payload shifts, or transitions between distinct flight regimes with and without ground effects. To address these challenges, we model unknown disturbances using a differentiable kernel approximation based on random Fourier features. During the offline training phase, we randomly sample kernel coefficients and bandwidth parameters to generate a rich diversity of disturbance profiles. We then optimize the control policy via differentiable simulation with analytical gradients, a process that takes only 50 seconds of training time on an RTX 4090 GPU. During hardware deployment, the policy adapts to non-stationary environments in real time by updating both the kernel coefficients and bandwidth through online least-squares estimation. We evaluate our method on quadrotor trajectory tracking tasks across high-fidelity numerical simulations and hardware experiments using Crazyflie, subjected to various disturbances, including complex aerodynamic effects, wind, ground effects, and payload fluctuations.

Abstract

We present an algorithm for efficient domain-adaptive policy learning via kernel representations. Learning domain-adaptive policies is challenging since it requires an environment representation that is both sufficiently expressive to model complex sim-to-real gaps during offline training, and computationally efficient enough to support rapid online adaptation during deployment. For instance, a quadrotor may encounter time-varying, non-stationary disturbances, such as sudden gusts of wind, payload shifts, or transitions between distinct flight regimes with and without ground effects.
