To address these challenges, we model unknown disturbances using a differentiable kernel approximation based on random Fourier features. During the offline training phase, we randomly sample kernel coefficients and bandwidth parameters to generate a rich diversity of disturbance profiles. We then optimize the control policy via differentiable simulation with analytical gradients, a process that takes only 50 seconds of training time on an RTX 4090 GPU. During hardware deployment, the policy adapts to non-stationary environments in real time by updating both the kernel coefficients and bandwidth through online least-squares estimation. We evaluate our method on quadrotor trajectory tracking tasks across high-fidelity numerical simulations and hardware experiments using Crazyflie, subjected to various disturbances, including complex aerodynamic effects, wind, ground effects, and payload fluctuations.

item.title: Avatar V: Scaling Video-Reference Avatar Video Generation
item.author: Liang, Benjamin, Chen, Ce, Lin, Desmond, Somov, Ivan, Zhao, Jiajun, Yuan, Jiewei, Zhang, Jingfeng, Huang, Junhao, Nolte, Nik, Haqiqi, Pedram, Wang, Penghan, Yan, Rong, Zhang, Rui, Prokopchuk, Sam, Wang, Sivan, Goriachko, Viktor, Ren, Yi, Li, Yuanming, Chen, Yutao, Ye, Zhenhui, Hong, Zhibin, Nie, Zilong, Guo, Zujin
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Avatar V的生产级框架，用于生成不仅视觉上相似且行为上可识别的虚拟角色视频。

背景: 现有方法主要依赖单张静态图像，提供的身份信息不足，无法捕捉动态运动特征，且标准的像素级目标未能充分照顾对虚拟角色保真度至关重要的面部区域。

目的: 解决现有方法在身份信息和动态行为捕捉方面的局限性，生成具有目标个体说话节奏、手势倾向和表情动态的虚拟角色视频。

方法: 采用视频参考条件身份建模，直接对参考视频的完整令牌序列进行条件处理，学习复制静态身份属性和动态行为模式。引入稀疏参考注意力机制、运动表示流和身份感知超分辨率细化器。数据引擎从5000万原始视频中筛选出超过1亿个训练片段，采用五阶段训练流程，包括流匹配预训练、个性微调、两阶段蒸馏和强化学习人类反馈对齐。

主要发现: Avatar V能够生成无限时长的1080p视频，在跨场景基准测试中实现了最先进的身份保持、唇同步和生成质量，在自动指标和人类评估中均优于Seedance 2.0、Kling O3 Pro、Veo 3.1和OmniHuman 1.5等领先系统。

结论: Avatar V通过视频参考条件身份建模和先进的训练策略，成功解决了虚拟角色视频生成中的关键挑战，提供了高质量、行为可识别的虚拟角色视频生成解决方案。

翻译: Generating avatar videos that are not merely visually similar to a target individual but behaviorally recognizable, faithfully reproducing their talking rhythm, gestural tendencies, and expression dynamics, remains an open challenge. Existing methods predominantly condition on single static images, which provide insufficient identity information and cannot capture dynamic motion traits, while standard pixel-level objectives underserve the perceptually critical facial regions that determine avatar fidelity. We present Avatar V, a production-scale framework that addresses these limitations through video-reference-conditioned identity modeling. Rather than compressing identity into fixed-size embeddings, the model conditions directly on the full token sequence of a reference video, learning to reproduce both static identity attributes (facial geometry, skin texture) and dynamic behavioral patterns (talking rhythm, micro-expressions) through attention over the reference context. We introduce Sparse Reference Attention, an asymmetric mechanism achieving linear-complexity conditioning on arbitrarily long references; a motion representation stream enabling closed-loop talking style transfer; and an identity-aware super-resolution refiner inheriting the full reference conditioning. These are supported by a data engine curating 100M+ training clips from 50M raw videos, and a five-stage training pipeline with flow matching pre-training, personality fine-tuning, two-phase distillation (>10x acceleration), and RLHF alignment, deployed across thousands of GPUs. Avatar V generates 1080p videos of unlimited duration, achieving state-of-the-art identity preservation, lip synchronization, and generation quality on our cross-scene benchmark, consistently outperforming leading systems including Seedance 2.0, Kling O3 Pro, Veo 3.1, and OmniHuman 1.5 in both automated metrics and human evaluation.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有数字人视频生成技术仅依赖静态参考图，导致无法准确还原人物动态说话节奏、微表情和手势习惯，且面部关键细节模糊的问题。该问题在研究和现实中非常重要，因为要生成逼真且具备高度行为辨识度的数字人，必须同时精准捕捉并复现人物的静态外貌与动态行为特征，这对推动高质量可控视频生成技术的实际应用至关重要。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有方法依赖静态图片且无法捕捉动态说话习惯的缺陷，提出直接以完整参考视频序列作为条件输入的设计思路。该方法通过稀疏注意力机制降低计算成本，并引入独立的运动表征流与人类感知辅助损失，以同时还原静态外貌与动态行为特征。在借鉴现有视频扩散与口型驱动模型的基础上，作者重点改进了传统方法中身份信息压缩丢失和长视频参考计算成本过高的问题，从而实现了高保真且风格一致的生成效果。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是将人物身份与行为特征建模为视频参考条件，直接利用参考视频的完整序列进行注意力计算，从而同时提取静态外貌特征与动态说话节奏、微表情等个性化行为模式。整体流程首先通过图像引擎从参考视频中提取多视角身份特征生成高质量场景底图，随后核心模型结合参考视频、目标音频与文本提示生成视频内容，并借助专用运动流同步学习说话风格，最后通过超分辨率模块恢复面部细节输出高清视频。训练过程则依托大规模数据引擎与多阶段流水线完成从预训练到人类反馈对齐的全流程优化。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于将数字人身份建模从依赖单张静态图片转变为直接基于完整参考视频进行条件生成。相比以往方法，它通过稀疏注意力机制突破了长视频参考的计算瓶颈，能够同时精准提取人物的静态外貌与动态说话节奏、微表情等行为习惯。此外，论文引入了专用的运动表示流和基于特征空间的辅助损失函数，替代了传统的像素级训练目标，从而在超分辨率阶段也能有效恢复关键面部细节，实现了长时长、高保真且行为可识别的数字人视频生成。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了Avatar V框架，通过直接对完整参考视频序列进行注意力条件控制而非压缩为固定特征，成功实现了对数字人静态外貌与动态说话风格的精准建模及高保真视频生成。

Abstract

Generating avatar videos that are not merely visually similar to a target individual but behaviorally recognizable, faithfully reproducing their talking rhythm, gestural tendencies, and expression dynamics, remains an open challenge. Existing methods predominantly condition on single static images, which provide insufficient identity information and cannot capture dynamic motion traits, while standard pixel-level objectives underserve the perceptually critical facial regions that determine avatar fidelity. We present Avatar V, a production-scale framework that addresses these limitations through video-reference-conditioned identity modeling. Rather than compressing identity into fixed-size embeddings, the model conditions directly on the full token sequence of a reference video, learning to reproduce both static identity attributes (facial geometry, skin texture) and dynamic behavioral patterns (talking rhythm, micro-expressions) through attention over the reference context. We introduce Sparse Reference Attention, an asymmetric mechanism achieving linear-complexity conditioning on arbitrarily long references; a motion representation stream enabling closed-loop talking style transfer; and an identity-aware super-resolution refiner inheriting the full reference conditioning. These are supported by a data engine curating 100M+ training clips from 50M raw videos, and a five-stage training pipeline with flow matching pre-training, personality fine-tuning, two-phase distillation (>10x acceleration), and RLHF alignment, deployed across thousands of GPUs. Avatar V generates 1080p videos of unlimited duration, achieving state-of-the-art identity preservation, lip synchronization, and generation quality on our cross-scene benchmark, consistently outperforming leading systems including Seedance 2.0, Kling O3 Pro, Veo 3.1, and OmniHuman 1.5 in both automated metrics and human evaluation.

item.title: Natively Unlearnable Large Language Models
item.author: Gaurav R. Ghosal, Pratyush Maini, Aditi Raghunathan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为NULLs的模型类，旨在解决大语言模型中特定训练数据源的影响移除问题。

背景: 移除特定训练数据源的影响具有挑战性，因为不同数据源的贡献在模型中相互纠缠。

目的: 提出一种既能隔离特定数据源贡献又能实现跨数据源联合学习的模型。

方法: 通过训练一组共享的主干神经元和一组稀疏激活的存储池来实现。

主要发现: NULLs能够扩展到维基百科的约六百万篇文章，隔离每篇文章作为独立数据源。移除单篇文章的知识时，保留了与语义相关文章共享的事实，与从头重新训练的效果相近。NULLs在对抗性提取和重新学习方面具有鲁棒性，并保持了通用语言能力。

结论: 源级别的知识移除可以原生地构建到大语言模型的训练中，同时保留共享表示学习的优势。

翻译: Unlearning aims to remove the influence of specific training data sources, but this has proved challenging because the contributions of different sources are entangled within the model. Isolating source contributions to disjoint parameters makes removal easier, though it obstructs joint learning across sources. We propose NULLs (Natively Unlearnable LLMs), a model class that satisfies the two opposing goals of isolating source-specific contributions and learning jointly across sources, by training a set of shared backbone neurons alongside a pool of sparsely activated sinks. During training, information specific to a source naturally concentrates in its sinks while information shared across sources accumulates in the backbone. A source is then unlearned at deployment by disabling its corresponding sinks, with no gradient updates and no access to the retained data. We show that NULLs scales to Wikipedia's ~6M articles, isolating each as an independent source. Unlearning a single article removes knowledge specific to it while preserving facts shared with semantically related articles, closely matching retraining from scratch. We note that unlearning with NULLs is also robust: in a case study of unlearning the Harry Potter books, NULLs resists both adversarial extraction and relearning that reverses post-hoc unlearning. Finally, NULLs preserves general language capabilities, matching a standard transformer on downstream benchmarks. Together, these results suggest that source-level unlearning need not be an afterthought. It can be built natively into LLM training while retaining the benefits of shared representation learning.

Abstract

Unlearning aims to remove the influence of specific training data sources, but this has proved challenging because the contributions of different sources are entangled within the model. Isolating source contributions to disjoint parameters makes removal easier, though it obstructs joint learning across sources. We propose NULLs (Natively Unlearnable LLMs), a model class that satisfies the two opposing goals of isolating source-specific contributions and learning jointly across sources, by training a set of shared backbone neurons alongside a pool of sparsely activated sinks. During training, information specific to a source naturally concentrates in its sinks while information shared across sources accumulates in the backbone. A source is then unlearned at deployment by disabling its corresponding sinks, with no gradient updates and no access to the retained data. We show that NULLs scales to Wikipedia's ~6M articles, isolating each as an independent source. Unlearning a single article removes knowledge specific to it while preserving facts shared with semantically related articles, closely matching retraining from scratch. We note that unlearning with NULLs is also robust: in a case study of unlearning the Harry Potter books, NULLs resists both adversarial extraction and relearning that reverses post-hoc unlearning. Finally, NULLs preserves general language capabilities, matching a standard transformer on downstream benchmarks. Together, these results suggest that source-level unlearning need not be an afterthought. It can be built natively into LLM training while retaining the benefits of shared representation learning.

item.title: How do Self-Supervised Remote Sensing Vision Models Transfer to Downstream Tasks?
item.author: Julia Romero, Qin Lv, Morteza Karimzadeh
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了自监督地理空间基础模型在遥感数据上的可迁移表示及其下游行为，通过评估不同模型在多种任务中的表现，揭示了模型排名变化、信息分布特征及微调机制，为更合理的评估与适应策略提供了依据。

背景: 自监督地理空间基础模型能够从遥感数据中学习可迁移的表示，但其下游行为难以被准确刻画。

目的: 研究不同自监督地理空间基础模型的下游行为，评估其在不同标签可用性和下游流水线下的可迁移性，并解释模型排名变化的原因。

方法: 选取六种具有代表性的地理空间基础模型，涵盖联合嵌入、重建和多模态预训练家族，在分类、回归和分割基准上进行评估；采用逐层探测、案例研究（PASTIS和Sen1Floods11上的分割）以及交叉核相关分析等方法。

主要发现: 模型排名在不同任务和适应设置下会发生变化；任务相关信息在中间变换器块中比在最终层嵌入中更容易获取，且不同模型具有独特的深度分布特征；在分割任务中，解码器设计和微调等下游适应设置的影响可能与选择模型本身相当，标准密集预测头可能与模型的信息组织方式不匹配；微调并未在整个深度上均匀重写模型，最强变化局限于视觉变换器块中多层感知机的第一个线性层。

结论: 研究结果解释了地理空间基础模型在不同基准上排名变化的原因，并促使开发更具表示感知能力的评估和适应策略。

翻译: Self-supervised geospatial foundation models (GeoFMs) learn transferable representations from remote sensing data, but their downstream behavior is difficult to characterize. We study six representative GeoFMs spanning joint-embedding, reconstruction, and multimodal pretraining families, and evaluate transfer across classification, regression, and segmentation benchmarks under different label availability and downstream pipelines. We find that model rankings change across tasks and adaptation settings. Layerwise probing shows that, in most cases, task-relevant information is more accessible in intermediate transformer blocks compared to final-layer embeddings, and that GeoFMs exhibit distinct depthwise profiles. In segmentation case studies on PASTIS and Sen1Floods11, downstream adaptation settings such as decoder design and fine-tuning can be as impactful as the choice of GeoFM, and standard dense-prediction heads may be poorly aligned with how GeoFMs organize information over depth. Finally, CKA analysis on case studies shows that fine-tuning does not rewrite GeoFMs uniformly across depth, and the strongest changes are localized to the first linear layer of the MLP in ViT blocks. These results help explain why GeoFM rankings shift across benchmarks and motivate more representation-aware evaluation and adaptation strategies.

Abstract

Self-supervised geospatial foundation models (GeoFMs) learn transferable representations from remote sensing data, but their downstream behavior is difficult to characterize. We study six representative GeoFMs spanning joint-embedding, reconstruction, and multimodal pretraining families, and evaluate transfer across classification, regression, and segmentation benchmarks under different label availability and downstream pipelines. We find that model rankings change across tasks and adaptation settings. Layerwise probing shows that, in most cases, task-relevant information is more accessible in intermediate transformer blocks compared to final-layer embeddings, and that GeoFMs exhibit distinct depthwise profiles. In segmentation case studies on PASTIS and Sen1Floods11, downstream adaptation settings such as decoder design and fine-tuning can be as impactful as the choice of GeoFM, and standard dense-prediction heads may be poorly aligned with how GeoFMs organize information over depth. Finally, CKA analysis on case studies shows that fine-tuning does not rewrite GeoFMs uniformly across depth, and the strongest changes are localized to the first linear layer of the MLP in ViT blocks. These results help explain why GeoFM rankings shift across benchmarks and motivate more representation-aware evaluation and adaptation strategies.

item.title: Multi-modal machine learning analysis of GaSe molecular beam epitaxy growth conditions
item.author: Mingyu Yu, Isaiah A. Moses, Wesley F. Reinhart, Stephanie Law
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本研究提出了一种结合机器学习与原位诊断的分子束外延薄膜生长框架，通过反射高能电子衍射和离线表征实现过程优化。

背景: 集成机器学习与原位诊断的自主合成平台有望通过实时过程优化和减少手动调谐来革新薄膜生长，但其在分子束外延中的应用尚不成熟。

目的: 开发一种用于二硒化镓薄膜生长的机器学习引导框架，以实现实时过程控制和加速优化。

方法: 利用反射高能电子衍射作为原位诊断手段，并结合X射线衍射和原子力显微镜进行离线表征。采用无监督学习分析衍射图案，通过互信息分析评估特征相关性，并训练监督学习模型预测薄膜质量指标。

主要发现: 无监督学习能清晰区分样品质量边界；衍射特征与摇摆曲线半高宽强相关，但与原子力显微镜测得的均方根粗糙度相关性弱；生长速率对半高宽影响最大，硒与镓的流量比对粗糙度和衍射特征影响显著；结合衍射特征可显著提升预测模型的准确性。

结论: 该研究建立了一种数据驱动的机器学习辅助分子束外延框架，为薄膜合成的实时过程控制和加速优化奠定了基础。

翻译: Autonomous synthesis platforms integrating machine learning with in situ diagnostics have the potential to revolutionize thin-film growth by enabling real-time process optimization and reducing the need for manual tuning. However, their application to molecular beam epitaxy remains underdeveloped. Here, we present a machine learning-guided framework for MBE growth of GaSe films, leveraging reflection high-energy electron diffraction as an in situ diagnostic alongside ex situ characterization via X-ray diffraction and atomic force microscopy. Unsupervised learning on RHEED patterns reveals a well-defined boundary between high- and low-quality samples, capturing physically meaningful features. Mutual information analysis shows a strong correlation between RHEED embeddings and rocking curve full-width at half-maximum, while the correlation with AFM root-mean-square roughness is weak. Among key growth conditions, growth rate most strongly influences fwhm, whereas the Se/Ga flux ratio primarily affects RMS roughness and the RHEED embeddings. Supervised learning models trained to predict fwhm and RMS roughness demonstrate moderate accuracy, with significant improvement achieved by incorporating RHEED embeddings. Furthermore, anomaly detection via residual analysis in supervised learning aligns well with unsupervised classification from RHEED, reinforcing the reliability of the predictive models. This study establishes a data-driven framework for machine learning-assisted MBE, paving the way for real-time process control and accelerated optimization of thin-film synthesis.

Abstract

Autonomous synthesis platforms integrating machine learning with in situ diagnostics have the potential to revolutionize thin-film growth by enabling real-time process optimization and reducing the need for manual tuning. However, their application to molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) remains underdeveloped. Here, we present a machine learning-guided framework for MBE growth of GaSe films, leveraging reflection high-energy electron diffraction (RHEED) as an in situ diagnostic alongside ex situ characterization via X-ray diffraction and atomic force microscopy. Unsupervised learning on RHEED patterns reveals a well-defined boundary between high- and low-quality samples, capturing physically meaningful features. Mutual information analysis shows a strong correlation between RHEED embeddings and rocking curve full-width at half-maximum (fwhm), while the correlation with AFM root-mean-square (RMS) roughness is weak. Among key growth conditions, growth rate most strongly influences fwhm, whereas the Se/Ga flux ratio primarily affects RMS roughness and the RHEED embeddings. Supervised learning models trained to predict fwhm and RMS roughness demonstrate moderate accuracy, with significant improvement achieved by incorporating RHEED embeddings. Furthermore, anomaly detection via residual analysis in supervised learning aligns well with unsupervised classification from RHEED, reinforcing the reliability of the predictive models. This study establishes a data-driven framework for machine learning-assisted MBE, paving the way for real-time process control and accelerated optimization of thin-film synthesis.

item.title: SpikF-GO: Spiking Fourier Graph Operators for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
item.author: Jafar Bakhshaliyev, Niels Landwehr
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为SpikF-GO的脉冲神经网络模型，用于时间序列预测。该模型通过结合超变图形式和脉冲驱动的谱处理，解决了现有方法在多元设置中缺乏显式变量间依赖建模的问题。实验表明，SpikF-GO在多个基准测试中取得了最佳平均排名，并在降低能耗的同时保持了竞争力。

背景: 脉冲神经网络作为传统神经网络的节能替代方案，在计算机视觉和机器人领域表现出色。近年来，脉冲神经网络被应用于时间序列预测，探索了脉冲时间主干、兼容脉冲的位置编码、频域处理和重新设计的神经元动态等方法。然而，现有方法独立处理变量，缺乏显式的变量间依赖建模机制，这在多元设置中是一个关键限制。

目的: 提出SpikF-GO模型，以解决现有脉冲神经网络在时间序列预测中缺乏显式变量间依赖建模的问题，特别是在多元设置中利用跨变量相关性携带的大量预测信息。

方法: 提出SpikF-GO模型，结合超变图形式（每个标量观测值成为图节点）和脉冲驱动的谱处理。引入Hard Concrete频率门用于可学习的稀疏频率选择，以及Complex LIF门，将独立的脉冲神经元应用于实部和虚部傅里叶分量，在整个谱域中保持二进制、事件驱动的计算。还提出了一种结合中枢模式发生器位置编码的变体，以增强长程时间建模。

主要发现: 在八个基准测试的统一实验协议下，SpikF-GO在所有脉冲神经网络方法中取得了最佳平均排名，并以降低的能耗成本优于其人工神经网络对应物FourierGNN。即使在显著较小的嵌入维度下，SpikF-GO也能保持具有竞争力的准确性，从而实现显著的能耗降低。

结论: SpikF-GO是首批将基于图的多元建模引入脉冲神经网络领域用于时间序列预测的工作之一，也是首次在统一实验协议下对脉冲神经网络预测架构进行全面比较的工作。

翻译: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have emerged as an energy-efficient alternative to conventional neural networks, demonstrating strong performance in computer vision and robotics. More recently, SNNs have been applied to time series forecasting (TSF), with methods exploring spiking temporal backbones, spike-compatible positional encodings, Fourier-domain processing, and redesigned neuron dynamics. However, existing SNN forecasting approaches process variables independently, lacking explicit mechanisms for modeling inter-variable dependencies. This is a critical limitation in multivariate settings, where cross-variable correlations carry substantial predictive information. We propose Spiking Fourier Graph Operators (SpikF-GO), which addresses this gap by combining a hypervariate graph formulation in which every scalar observation becomes a graph node with spike-driven spectral processing. SpikF-GO introduces a Hard Concrete frequency gate for learnable sparse frequency selection and a Complex LIF gate that applies independent spiking neurons to real and imaginary Fourier components, preserving binary, event-driven computation throughout the spectral domain. We further present a variant incorporating Central Pattern Generator-based positional encodings for stronger long-range temporal modeling. Evaluated on eight benchmarks under a unified experimental protocol, SpikF-GO achieves the best average rank among all SNN methods and outperforms its ANN counterpart, FourierGNN, at reduced energy cost. SpikF-GO maintains competitive accuracy even at substantially smaller embedding dimensions, thereby achieving significant energy reductions. To our knowledge, this is among the first works to bring graph-based multivariate modeling into the spiking domain for TSF and the first to provide a unified comparison across SNN forecasting architectures under a common experimental protocol.

Abstract

Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have emerged as an energy-efficient alternative to conventional neural networks, demonstrating strong performance in computer vision and robotics. More recently, SNNs have been applied to time series forecasting (TSF), with methods exploring spiking temporal backbones, spike-compatible positional encodings, Fourier-domain processing, and redesigned neuron dynamics. However, existing SNN forecasting approaches process variables independently, lacking explicit mechanisms for modeling inter-variable dependencies. This is a critical limitation in multivariate settings, where cross-variable correlations carry substantial predictive information. We propose Spiking Fourier Graph Operators (SpikF-GO), which addresses this gap by combining a hypervariate graph formulation in which every scalar observation becomes a graph node with spike-driven spectral processing. SpikF-GO introduces a Hard Concrete frequency gate for learnable sparse frequency selection and a Complex LIF gate that applies independent spiking neurons to real and imaginary Fourier components, preserving binary, event-driven computation throughout the spectral domain. We further present a variant incorporating Central Pattern Generator-based positional encodings for stronger long-range temporal modeling. Evaluated on eight benchmarks under a unified experimental protocol, SpikF-GO achieves the best average rank among all SNN methods and outperforms its ANN counterpart, FourierGNN, at reduced energy cost. SpikF-GO maintains competitive accuracy even at substantially smaller embedding dimensions, thereby achieving significant energy reductions. To our knowledge, this is among the first works to bring graph-based multivariate modeling into the spiking domain for TSF and the first to provide a unified comparison across SNN forecasting architectures under a common experimental protocol.

item.title: GMN4AD: Graph Matching Network for Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis with Test-Time Domain Adaptation using Multi-centered Structure Magnetic Resonance Imaging
item.author: Chen Zhao, Huan Huang, Yixin Xie, Jiajing Huang, Weihua Zhou, Nandakumar Narayanan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种用于阿尔茨海默病诊断的图匹配网络，通过建模异质脑图之间的交互关系并引入测试时域适应策略，显著提升了诊断性能。

背景: 阿尔茨海默病是一种影响数百万老年人的进行性神经退行性疾病，早期诊断对于及时干预至关重要。结构磁共振成像在检测相关脑部变化方面具有关键作用，但传统基于图的方法常因模态和跨站点异质性而面临挑战。

目的: 旨在解决传统方法在处理异质性脑图时的局限性，通过建模脑图间的交互关系来提高阿尔茨海默病诊断的精度和鲁棒性。

方法: 提出了图匹配网络用于阿尔茨海默病诊断，利用图匹配技术捕捉跨脑图的关系以增强诊断精度，并引入结合对比学习的测试时域适应策略以缓解推理过程中的域偏移。

主要发现: 在三个公共阿尔茨海默病数据集上的广泛实验表明，该方法优于现有最先进方法，展现出优越的性能。

结论: 该方法为阿尔茨海默病诊断提供了一种稳健且可泛化的解决方案。

翻译: Alzheimer's Disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder that affects millions of older adults, with prevalence expected to rise significantly in the coming years. Early diagnosis, particularly during the mild cognitive impairment (MCI) stage, is critical for timely intervention. Structural Magnetic Resonance Imaging (sMRI) has emerged as a key modality for detecting AD-related brain changes, but traditional graph-based approaches often struggle with modality and inter-site heterogeneity, limiting diagnostic performance. In this paper, we propose Graph Matching Network for Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis (GMN4AD), designed to model interactions between heterogeneous brain graphs derived from neuroimaging data. Unlike conventional methods that treat each brain graph independently, GMN4AD leverages graph matching to capture cross-graph relationships, enhancing diagnostic precision. Furthermore, we introduce a test-time domain adaptation strategy that combines contrastive learning to mitigate domain shifts during inference. Extensive experiments on three public AD datasets demonstrate that GMN4AD achieves superior performance compared to state-of-the-art methods, offering a robust and generalizable solution for AD diagnosis.

Abstract

Alzheimer's Disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder that affects millions of older adults, with prevalence expected to rise significantly in the coming years. Early diagnosis, particularly during the mild cognitive impairment (MCI) stage, is critical for timely intervention. Structural Magnetic Resonance Imaging (sMRI) has emerged as a key modality for detecting AD-related brain changes, but traditional graph-based approaches often struggle with modality and inter-site heterogeneity, limiting diagnostic performance. In this paper, we propose Graph Matching Network for Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis (GMN4AD), designed to model interactions between heterogeneous brain graphs derived from neuroimaging data. Unlike conventional methods that treat each brain graph independently, GMN4AD leverages graph matching to capture cross-graph relationships, enhancing diagnostic precision. Furthermore, we introduce a test-time domain adaptation strategy that combines contrastive learning to mitigate domain shifts during inference. Extensive experiments on three public AD datasets demonstrate that GMN4AD achieves superior performance compared to state-of-the-art methods, offering a robust and generalizable solution for AD diagnosis.

item.title: Side-Channel Attacks Bypass Protection in 3D Printers
item.author: Eric Yocam, Varghese Vaidyan, Micah Flack, Gurcan Comert, Judith L. Mwakalonge
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本研究对商用3D打印机中部署的主动电机噪声消除技术进行了实证评估，发现其仅能消除声学侧信道攻击，而振动侧信道仍存在信息泄露。

背景: 主动电机噪声消除技术作为硬件防护措施，已应用于商用熔融沉积建模3D打印机中，旨在对抗针对知识产权的声学侧信道攻击。

目的: 对已部署的主动电机噪声消除防护措施的实证效果进行评估。

方法: 使用包含两个配备该技术的打印机在十二类物体上的同步声学和振动记录的公开数据集进行分析。

主要发现: 主动电机噪声消除技术完全消除了声学通道的信息泄露，分类准确率与随机基线无异。振动通道仍存在泄露，使用摘要统计信息的泄露较粗略且由振幅驱动，而波形形状几乎不携带信息。全序列时序模型将准确率提升至约百分之六十一，且泄露具有设备特异性。

结论: 主动电机噪声消除技术仅为声学防御，振动仍是一个未解决的几何相关侧信道，但在此数据集中不支持完整的几何重建。实现重建级攻击需要利用该技术未触及的磁场或电源通道。

翻译: Active Motor Noise Cancellation (AMNC) ships in commercial fused deposition modeling (FDM) 3D printers as a hardware countermeasure against acoustic side-channel attacks that target intellectual property (IP). We present the first empirical evaluation of a deployed AMNC countermeasure, using a public dataset of synchronized acoustic and vibration recordings from two AMNC-equipped Bambu Lab printers across 12 object classes. AMNC fully neutralizes the acoustic channel: classification accuracy is indistinguishable from the 8.33% random baseline. The vibration channel, which AMNC does not target, still leaks. With summary statistics the leak is coarse and amplitude-driven (vibration accuracy approximately 31% pooled, 36-47% within-printer), while the waveform shape carries essentially nothing (frequency-only features at chance). A full-sequence temporal model that ingests the ordered evolution of the print raises accuracy to approximately 61%, and an order-shuffling control (approximately 33%) shows that a substantial component is genuinely sequential and tied to print progression. The leak is device-specific: a classifier trained on one printer transfers near chance to the other. We conclude that AMNC is an acoustic-only defense: vibration remains a partial, geometry-correlated side channel it does not address, but one that does not, on this dataset, support full geometric reconstruction; reconstruction-grade attacks would require the magnetic or power channels AMNC also leaves untouched. We release all code.

Abstract

Active Motor Noise Cancellation (AMNC) ships in commercial fused deposition modeling (FDM) 3D printers as a hardware countermeasure against acoustic side-channel attacks that target intellectual property (IP). We present the first empirical evaluation of a deployed AMNC countermeasure, using a public dataset of synchronized acoustic and vibration recordings from two AMNC-equipped Bambu Lab printers across 12 object classes. AMNC fully neutralizes the acoustic channel: classification accuracy is indistinguishable from the 8.33% random baseline. The vibration channel, which AMNC does not target, still leaks. With summary statistics the leak is coarse and amplitude-driven (vibration accuracy approximately 31% pooled, 36-47% within-printer), while the waveform shape carries essentially nothing (frequency-only features at chance). A full-sequence temporal model that ingests the ordered evolution of the print raises accuracy to approximately 61%, and an order-shuffling control (approximately 33%) shows that a substantial component is genuinely sequential and tied to print progression. The leak is device-specific: a classifier trained on one printer transfers near chance to the other. We conclude that AMNC is an acoustic-only defense: vibration remains a partial, geometry-correlated side channel it does not address, but one that does not, on this dataset, support full geometric reconstruction; reconstruction-grade attacks would require the magnetic or power channels AMNC also leaves untouched. We release all code.

item.title: LLM Agents Can See Code Repositories
item.author: Ma, Dongjian, Chen, Silin, Yang, Yufei, Shi, Yulin, yan, Yanfu, Gu, Xiaodong
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文系统研究了基于大语言模型的编码代理在仓库级问题修复任务中利用视觉化仓库表示的效果。

背景: 当前大多数编码代理将代码仓库几乎完全作为文本处理，这与人类开发者利用文件夹层级和依赖关系等视觉结构来理解大型代码库的方式不同。

目的: 探讨多模态大语言模型能否使编码代理有效受益于仓库的视觉化表示。

方法: 对四种近期多模态模型进行实证评估，比较纯视觉设置与结合文本接口的混合设置在仓库级问题修复中的表现。

主要发现: 纯视觉设置因缺乏足够的符号细节且需重复视觉查询，导致准确率下降和令牌成本增加；而将仓库结构的视觉图作为补充模态与标准文本接口结合，能使代理更高效地理解结构，输入令牌消耗最多减少百分之二十六，同时保持或提高问题修复准确率。可视化在故障定位和代理自主控制探索深度时最为有用。

结论: 研究结果为下一代编码代理提供了实用的文本与视觉混合设计方向。

翻译: Coding agents powered by large language models have demonstrated strong performance on software engineering tasks. Yet most agents consume repositories almost entirely as text, which differs from how human developers use visual structure such as folder hierarchies and dependency relationships to orient themselves in large codebases. With multimodal large language models (MLLMs), it is an open question whether agents can effectively benefit from visual representations of repositories. This paper presents the first systematic empirical study of visual repository representations for LLM-based agents on repository-level issue resolution. We evaluate four recent multimodal models. Our results show that a strictly vision-only setup degrades accuracy and increases token cost, because agents lack sufficient symbolic detail and compensate with repeated visual queries. In contrast, integrating visual graphs of repository structure as a supplementary modality alongside standard text interfaces helps agents understand structure more efficiently: input token consumption decreases by up to 26% while issue-resolution accuracy is maintained or improved. Visualization is most useful during fault localization and when the agent autonomously controls exploration depth. These findings point to a practical hybrid text-and-vision design for next-generation coding agents.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要探讨能否通过引入代码仓库的可视化结构来辅助大语言模型智能体更高效地理解和解决软件工程问题。该问题之所以重要，是因为人类开发者在编程时依赖直观的目录层级、文件依赖和语法高亮等视觉信息，而现有AI智能体仅依赖扁平化的文本输入，导致其在理解复杂代码库时存在明显局限。结合视觉与文本信息不仅能缩小人机认知差距，还能显著降低智能体的运行成本并提升代码修复的准确率。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者观察到人类开发者习惯通过文件夹层级和依赖关系等视觉化结构理解代码，而现有智能体仅依赖扁平化的文本输入，容易丢失关键的结构线索。基于多模态大模型的发展，他们假设引入视觉布局能更高效地传递代码关系，因此设计了结合标准文本访问与自动生成代码依赖关系图的混合交互框架。该方法借鉴了以往关于代码仓库结构抽象和软件工程视觉探索的研究，但针对前人将图结构线性化为文本导致信息丢失的问题，直接以图像形式向模型提供空间拓扑信息。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将代码仓库的层级与依赖关系转化为可视化图像，作为补充模态与传统文本代码结合，以弥补纯文本在表达空间结构上的不足。整体实现流程首先通过静态分析构建仓库的依赖关系图，当智能体发起查询时，系统会将对应子图渲染为图片并连同文本一并输入模型。模型同时解析视觉空间布局与文本符号信息，在故障定位等关键阶段辅助智能体更高效地完成代码修复与验证。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于首次系统性地实证研究了视觉模态在代码仓库理解中的应用，并设计了将结构化视觉图作为补充信息的辅助框架。与以往仅依赖线性文本或序列化图结构的工作不同，本文通过保留二维空间布局的视觉信息，帮助智能体更高效地把握代码依赖关系。研究发现纯视觉模式会显著降低准确率并增加成本，而文本与视觉混合的模式能在保持或提升修复准确率的同时，大幅减少输入内容消耗。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文首次系统实证了将代码仓库的可视化结构图作为补充模态引入编程代理的效果，证明了图文混合模式能在保持或提升修复准确率的同时显著降低输入成本，并发现可视化在故障定位阶段最为有效。

Abstract

Coding agents powered by large language models have demonstrated strong performance on software engineering tasks. Yet most agents consume repositories almost entirely as text, which differs from how human developers use visual structure such as folder hierarchies and dependency relationships to orient themselves in large codebases. With multimodal large language models (MLLMs), it is an open question whether agents can effectively benefit from visual representations of repositories. This paper presents the first systematic empirical study of visual repository representations for LLM-based agents on repository-level issue resolution. We evaluate four recent multimodal models. Our results show that a strictly vision-only setup degrades accuracy and increases token cost, because agents lack sufficient symbolic detail and compensate with repeated visual queries. In contrast, integrating visual graphs of repository structure as a supplementary modality alongside standard text interfaces helps agents understand structure more efficiently: input token consumption decreases by up to 26% while issue-resolution accuracy is maintained or improved. Visualization is most useful during fault localization and when the agent autonomously controls exploration depth. These findings point to a practical hybrid text-and-vision design for next-generation coding agents.

item.title: Rethinking Backdoor Adversarial Unlearning through the Lens of Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Learning
item.author: Zhenqian Zhu, Yamin Hu, Yujiang Liu, Luping Wei, Wenbo Hou, Bin Li, Haodong Li, Wenjian Luo
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种新的后门学习与遗忘的连续学习视角下的三阶段过程框架，并设计了盲逆向后门对抗遗忘方法以彻底消除模型中的后门效应。

背景: 现有后门防御方法鲁棒性有限，常无法抵御特定攻击；主流安全微调策略仅提供表面保护，未能完全消除后门效应。

目的: 提出一种新的后门学习与遗忘的连续学习视角下的三阶段过程框架，并设计盲逆向后门对抗遗忘方法以彻底消除模型中的后门效应。

方法: 提出盲逆向后门对抗遗忘方法，将满足遗忘条件的对抗样本生成问题形式化为盲逆问题，通过结合对抗训练的双层优化过程与期望最大化算法框架优化最大后验目标，并扩展至未知目标类的非定向对抗场景及多模态对比学习任务。

主要发现: 实验表明该方法具有广泛的通用性，能有效且彻底地消除后门模型中的后门效应。

结论: 该方法在广泛的后门攻击中展现出通用性，能有效彻底消除后门效应，适用于预训练模型可能受损的实际部署场景。

翻译: Existing studies reveal that current backdoor defenses exhibit limited robustness and often fail against specific types of attacks. More concerningly, prevailing safety tuning strategies tend to provide only superficial safety protection, as they fall short of completely eliminating the backdoor effects. In this work, we present a novel formulation of backdoor learning and unlearning as a sequential, three-stage process from a continual learning perspective. Within this framework, we formally define complete backdoor unlearning and further derive the necessary conditions for achieving it based on the mechanism of catastrophic forgetting. Guided by these insights, we propose Blind Inversion-Backdoor Adversarial Unlearning, which formulates the generation of adversarial examples satisfying the unlearning conditions as a blind inversion problem. We solve this by integrating the bi-level optimization process of adversarial training into an Expectation-Maximization algorithm framework to optimize the maximum a posteriori objective. Furthermore, BI-BAU is extended to untargeted adversarial scenarios with unknown target classes, as well as to multi-modal contrastive learning tasks, enhancing its applicability to real-world deployment scenarios where pre-trained models may be compromised. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method exhibits general applicability across a wide spectrum of backdoor attacks and can effectively and thoroughly eliminate the backdoor effects from a backdoor model.

Abstract

Existing studies reveal that current backdoor defenses exhibit limited robustness and often fail against specific types of attacks. More concerningly, prevailing safety tuning strategies tend to provide only superficial safety protection, as they fall short of completely eliminating the backdoor effects. In this work, we present a novel formulation of backdoor learning and unlearning as a sequential, three-stage process from a continual learning perspective. Within this framework, we formally define complete backdoor unlearning and further derive the necessary conditions for achieving it based on the mechanism of catastrophic forgetting. Guided by these insights, we propose Blind Inversion-Backdoor Adversarial Unlearning (BI-BAU), which formulates the generation of adversarial examples satisfying the unlearning conditions as a blind inversion problem. We solve this by integrating the bi-level optimization process of adversarial training into an Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm framework to optimize the maximum a posteriori (MAP) objective. Furthermore, BI-BAU is extended to untargeted adversarial scenarios with unknown target classes, as well as to multi-modal contrastive learning tasks, enhancing its applicability to real-world deployment scenarios where pre-trained models may be compromised. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method exhibits general applicability across a wide spectrum of backdoor attacks and can effectively and thoroughly eliminate the backdoor effects from a backdoor model.

item.title: Clay-CNN Hybrids: Leveraging Geo-Foundational Models as Auxiliary Context for Landslide Detection
item.author: Huong Binh Vu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本研究评估了Geo-Foundational Model在滑坡像素级分割任务中的表现，通过比较不同模型策略，发现混合模型结合多尺度残差地形融合和两阶段低秩自适应技术取得了最佳性能，表明基础模型在补充空间细节丰富的卷积架构时最为有效。

背景: 快速的事件后滑坡制图对于灾害响应至关重要，但由于极端类别不平衡问题，自动化仍然困难。

目的: 评估Clay v1.5这一Geo-Foundational Model能否在Landslide4Sense基准测试上提高像素级滑坡分割的性能。

方法: 比较了三种策略：将Clay作为主要编码器并结合多尺度残差地形融合、在U-Net瓶颈处增强Clay语义上下文、以及标准U-Net基线。其中混合U-Net加Clay模型采用两阶段低秩自适应技术。

主要发现: 混合U-Net加Clay模型在三次种子测试中取得了最高的F1分数，优于单独的Clay主干模型和U-Net基线。单独的Clay编码器因缺乏多尺度跳跃连接而表现不佳，但其预训练表示作为辅助上下文注入时始终提升了性能。

结论: Geo-Foundational Models在滑坡检测中最为有效的方式是补充空间细节丰富的卷积架构，而不是替代它们。

翻译: Rapid post-event landslide mapping is essential for disaster response but remains difficult to automate due to extreme class imbalance. This study evaluates whether Clay v1.5, a Geo-Foundational Model (GFM), can improve pixel-level landslide segmentation on the Landslide4Sense (L4S) benchmark, which contains 3,799 training chips with 14 Sentinel-2 and terrain bands and approximately 2% positive pixels. We compare three strategies: Clay as the primary encoder with multi-scale residual terrain fusion, a U-Net backbone augmented with Clay semantic context at the bottleneck, and a standard U-Net baseline. The hybrid U-Net + Clay model with two-stage Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) achieved the best test F1 of 64.5 +/- 1.8% over three seeds, surpassing the Clay-only backbone (55.2 +/- 3.6%) and the U-Net baseline (59.9%). Clay as a standalone encoder underperformed the U-Net due to the absence of multi-scale skip connections, but its pretrained representations consistently improved performance when injected as auxiliary context. These findings suggest that GFMs are most effective for landslide detection when they complement spatially detailed convolutional architectures rather than replace them.

Abstract

Rapid post-event landslide mapping is essential for disaster response but remains difficult to automate due to extreme class imbalance. This study evaluates whether Clay v1.5, a Geo-Foundational Model (GFM), can improve pixel-level landslide segmentation on the Landslide4Sense (L4S) benchmark, which contains 3,799 training chips with 14 Sentinel-2 and terrain bands and approximately 2% positive pixels. We compare three strategies: Clay as the primary encoder with multi-scale residual terrain fusion, a U-Net backbone augmented with Clay semantic context at the bottleneck, and a standard U-Net baseline. The hybrid U-Net + Clay model with two-stage Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) achieved the best test F1 of 64.5 +/- 1.8% over three seeds, surpassing the Clay-only backbone (55.2 +/- 3.6%) and the U-Net baseline (59.9%). Clay as a standalone encoder underperformed the U-Net due to the absence of multi-scale skip connections, but its pretrained representations consistently improved performance when injected as auxiliary context. These findings suggest that GFMs are most effective for landslide detection when they complement spatially detailed convolutional architectures rather than replace them.

item.title: A Modular Dual-Arm Apple Harvesting Robot with Enhanced Field Performance
item.author: Keyi Zhu, Kyle Lammers, Chaaran Arunachalam, Kaixiang Zhang, Renfu Lu, Zhaojian Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种模块化双臂苹果采摘机器人，通过垂直堆叠双臂设计实现单树上下区域同时作业，简化了平台定位。相比之前的水平双臂系统，该机器人集成了五项技术改进，并在两个商业果园进行了实地验证。在1738次臂循环中，系统实现了百分之八十的单次尝试成功率和平均每次臂循环耗时七点五三秒。果实损伤评估显示，百分之九十一点二的果实保持最高美国农业部等级，瘀伤率在百分之二点四到百分之四点九之间。该设计有望用于苹果的商业化采摘。

背景: 商业果园面临劳动力短缺问题，机器人苹果采摘是 promising solution，但低吞吐量和在果园环境中的表现不佳阻碍了其商业化应用。

目的: 开发一种模块化双臂苹果采摘机器人，以提高吞吐量和在果园环境中的性能，促进商业化应用。

方法: 采用垂直堆叠双臂设计，实现单树上下区域同时作业。集成五项技术改进：基于基础模型的感知流水线（结合Grounding-DINO和EfficientViT-SAM）用于鲁棒果实定位；七阶 jerk 受限轨迹生成与控制障碍函数安全过滤器以实现快速安全臂运动；带有十厘米接近缓冲区和旋转脱落的线性扫描采摘策略以提高采摘可靠性；基于时序逻辑的双臂协调策略和视觉-臂异步调度以最大化共享真空源的使用；在2025年收获季节的两个商业果园进行实地验证，涵盖不同苹果品种和树体结构。

主要发现: 在1738次臂循环的实地试验中，系统实现了百分之八十的单次尝试成功率和平均每次臂循环耗时七点五三秒。果实损伤评估显示，百分之九十一点二的机器人采摘果实保持最高美国农业部等级（特级），瘀伤率在百分之二点四到百分之四点九之间。

结论: 通过进一步改进采摘循环时间和处理严重枝叶遮挡，这种新型模块化机器人设计有望用于苹果的商业化采摘。

翻译: Robotic apple harvesting offers a promising solution to labor shortages in commercial orchards, but low throughput and poor performance in orchard environments hinder its commercial adoption. This paper presents a modular dual-arm apple harvesting robot that uses a vertically stacked arms to enable simultaneous operation in the upper and lower zones of a single tree, simplifying platform positioning from multi-tree lateral repositioning to single-tree stops. Compared to our prior horizontal dual-arm system, the platform integrates 5 advances: (1)a foundation-model-based perception pipeline combining Grounding-DINO and EfficientViT-SAM for robust fruit localization in unstructured outdoor environments; (2)7th-order jerk-bounded trajectory generation paired with a Control Barrier Function safety filter to achieve fast yet safe arm motions; (3)a linear sweep harvesting strategy with a 10cm approach buffer and rotational detachment that improves picking reliability; (4)a temporal-logic-based dual-arm coordination policy with vision-arm async scheduling that maximizes usage of a shared vacuum source; and (5)field validation in 2 commercial orchards covering different apple varieties and tree architectures during the 2025 harvest season. Across the 1738 arm cycles collected in these field trials, the system achieved an 80.0% per-attempt success rate and a mean per-arm cycle time of 7.53s. Fruit damage assessments confirmed that 91.2% of robotically harvested fruit retained the highest USDA grade (Extra Fancy), with bruise rates between 2.4% and 4.9%. With further improvements in the picking cycle time and handling of heavy foliage occlusions, this new modular robot design holds promise for commercial harvesting of apples.

Abstract

Robotic apple harvesting offers a promising solution to labor shortages in commercial orchards, but low throughput and poor performance in orchard environments hinder its commercial adoption. This paper presents a modular dual-arm apple harvesting robot that uses a vertically stacked arms to enable simultaneous operation in the upper and lower zones of a single tree, simplifying platform positioning from multi-tree lateral repositioning to single-tree stops. Compared to our prior horizontal dual-arm system, the platform integrates 5 advances: (1)a foundation-model-based perception pipeline combining Grounding-DINO and EfficientViT-SAM for robust fruit localization in unstructured outdoor environments; (2)7th-order jerk-bounded trajectory generation paired with a Control Barrier Function safety filter to achieve fast yet safe arm motions; (3)a linear sweep harvesting strategy with a 10cm approach buffer and rotational detachment that improves picking reliability; (4)a temporal-logic-based dual-arm coordination policy with vision-arm async scheduling that maximizes usage of a shared vacuum source; and (5)field validation in 2 commercial orchards covering different apple varieties and tree architectures during the 2025 harvest season. Across the 1738 arm cycles collected in these field trials, the system achieved an 80.0% per-attempt success rate and a mean per-arm cycle time of 7.53s. Fruit damage assessments confirmed that 91.2% of robotically harvested fruit retained the highest USDA grade (Extra Fancy), with bruise rates between 2.4% and 4.9%. With further improvements in the picking cycle time and handling of heavy foliage occlusions, this new modular robot design holds promise for commercial harvesting of apples.

item.title: Machine Learning for Biomedical Raman Spectroscopy: From Spectral Acquisition to Clinical Translation
item.author: Bogdan Oancea, Ana Maria Seciu-Grama, Nicoleta Siminea, Laura Mihaela Stefan, Alice Stoica, Joel Sjoberg, Marian Necula, Ana-Maria Prelipcean, Corneliu Ovidiu Vrancianu, Eduard Milea, Andrei Păun, Ion Petre, Mihaela Păun
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 拉曼光谱在生物医学领域具有重要应用价值，但面临高维、噪声和背景干扰等挑战。本文综述了机器学习在该技术全流程中的应用，包括预处理、信号校正、结构发现、诊断分类、分子分层、迁移学习、可解释性、生物标志物发现及多模态整合。文章还讨论了临床转化面临的数据集规模小、仪器差异、预处理不一致、外部验证不足、可重复性差及数据共享有限等主要障碍，并强调需通过方法学进步、标准化、稳健验证和可解释性来推动可靠且可临床部署的拉曼人工智能系统的发展。

背景: 拉曼光谱能够提供无标记、化学特异性的生物系统表征，已成为癌症诊断、分子分型、微生物鉴定和术中决策支持的重要工具。然而，生物医学拉曼光谱具有高维、噪声大、受荧光背景影响、采集变异性和生物异质性等特点，使得稳健的计算分析变得至关重要。

目的: 审查机器学习在生物医学拉曼光谱全流程中的作用，强调其不仅用于诊断分类，还用于具有生物学可解释性和临床可操作性的分析，并探讨临床转化的障碍及未来发展方向。

方法: 通过综述的方式，系统考察机器学习在生物医学拉曼光谱处理流程中的应用，涵盖从预处理和信号校正到无监督结构发现、监督诊断和分子分层、表示和迁移学习、可解释性、生物标志物发现，以及与成像、病理学和分子谱学的多模态整合。

主要发现: 机器学习在生物医学拉曼光谱的多个环节均有应用，但临床转化面临数据集规模有限、仪器间变异性、预处理不一致、外部验证不足、可重复性担忧以及软件、数据和元数据共享有限等主要障碍。

结论: 推动该领域发展需要方法学进步与标准化、稳健验证、可解释性以及面向部署的分析框架相结合。通过整合方法学、生物医学和转化视角，本文为开发可靠且可临床部署的拉曼人工智能系统指明了关键方向。

翻译: Raman spectroscopy provides label-free, chemically specific characterization of biological systems and has become an important tool for cancer diagnosis, molecular subtyping, microbiological identification, and intraoperative decision support. Biomedical Raman spectra are, however, high-dimensional, noisy, and affected by fluorescence background, acquisition variability, and biological heterogeneity, making robust computational analysis essential. This review examines the role of machine learning across the biomedical Raman spectroscopy pipeline, from preprocessing and signal correction to unsupervised structure discovery, supervised diagnosis and molecular stratification, representation and transfer learning, explainability, biomarker discovery, and multimodal integration with imaging, pathology, and molecular profiling. Emphasis is placed on the use of machine learning not only for diagnostic classification, but also for biologically interpretable and clinically actionable analysis. We also discuss the main barriers to clinical translation, including limited dataset sizes, inter-instrument variability, inconsistent preprocessing, insufficient external validation, reproducibility concerns, and limited sharing of software, data, and metadata. We argue that progress will require methodological advances together with standardization, robust validation, explainability, and deployment-ready analytical frameworks. By integrating methodological, biomedical, and translational perspectives, this review outlines key directions for developing reliable and clinically deployable Raman-AI systems.

Abstract

Raman spectroscopy provides label-free, chemically specific characterization of biological systems and has become an important tool for cancer diagnosis, molecular subtyping, microbiological identification, and intraoperative decision support. Biomedical Raman spectra are, however, high-dimensional, noisy, and affected by fluorescence background, acquisition variability, and biological heterogeneity, making robust computational analysis essential. This review examines the role of machine learning across the biomedical Raman spectroscopy pipeline, from preprocessing and signal correction to unsupervised structure discovery, supervised diagnosis and molecular stratification, representation and transfer learning, explainability, biomarker discovery, and multimodal integration with imaging, pathology, and molecular profiling. Emphasis is placed on the use of machine learning not only for diagnostic classification, but also for biologically interpretable and clinically actionable analysis. We also discuss the main barriers to clinical translation, including limited dataset sizes, inter-instrument variability, inconsistent preprocessing, insufficient external validation, reproducibility concerns, and limited sharing of software, data, and metadata. We argue that progress will require methodological advances together with standardization, robust validation, explainability, and deployment-ready analytical frameworks. By integrating methodological, biomedical, and translational perspectives, this review outlines key directions for developing reliable and clinically deployable Raman-AI systems.

item.title: CacheRL:Multi-Turn Tool-Calling Agents via Cached Rollouts and Hybrid Reward
item.author: Md Amirul Islam, Sumiran Thakur, Huancheng Chen, Su Min Park, Jiayun Wang, Gyuhak Kim
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: CacheRL 是一个用于训练小型智能体基础模型的训练系统，在涉及多步工具调用的任务上达到了百分之九十二的过程准确率，接近 GPT-五的百分之九十四，同时计算资源消耗仅为后者的百分之一。

背景: 在实际智能体训练中面临三个挑战：大规模从大模型迁移工具调用知识、无需昂贵实时工具执行即可进行强化学习，以及在存在噪声的缓存环境中稳健学习。

目的: 解决上述实际智能体训练中的挑战，提升小型智能体模型在工具调用任务上的性能，同时降低训练成本。

方法: 提出三项关键创新：一是混合思维轨迹流水线，利用大语言模型生成的推理轨迹增强智能体轨迹，使模型不仅学习调用什么工具，还学习为何调用；二是 CacheAgentLoop，通过三层模糊缓存消除实时执行成本，并使用令牌级掩码保持轨迹保真度；三是缓存层级感知奖励，动态调整答案质量权重，避免对缓存限制导致的性能下降进行惩罚。通过迭代监督微调和群体相对策略优化进行训练。

主要发现: CacheRL 将 Qwen 三减四 B 思考模型的验证奖励从零点四三提升至零点七八，在公开智能体工具调用基准测试中达到与前沿模型竞争的性能。消融研究表明，移除知识迁移导致性能下降百分之四十一，而缓存感知奖励带来百分之十七的提升。

结论: 强化学习提高了训练稳定性，但在强大的监督微调基础上收益有限。这表明在构建实用的小型智能体模型时，数据质量和奖励设计比复杂的优化方法更为重要。

翻译: We present CacheRL, a system for training small agent foundation models that achieves 92 percent process accuracy on multi-step tool-calling tasks, approaching GPT-5's 94 percent while requiring 100 times less compute. Our approach addresses three challenges in practical agent training: transferring tool-calling knowledge from large models at scale, enabling reinforcement learning without costly live tool execution, and learning robustly from noisy cached environments. CacheRL introduces three key innovations. First, a hybrid thinking trajectory pipeline augments agent trajectories with LLM-generated reasoning traces, producing training examples that teach models not only what tools to call but also why. Second, the CacheAgentLoop eliminates live execution costs through a three-tier fuzzy cache while preserving trajectory fidelity using token-level masking. Third, a cache-tier-aware reward dynamically adjusts answer-quality weights to avoid penalizing models for cache-induced limitations. Through iterative supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), CacheRL improves Qwen3-4B-Thinking's validation reward from 0.43 to 0.78. On public agentic tool-calling benchmarks, our model achieves competitive performance against frontier models such as GPT-5. Ablation studies show that removing knowledge transfer reduces performance by 41 percent, while cache-aware rewards contribute a 17 percent improvement. Interestingly, reinforcement learning improves training stability but yields limited gains beyond strong supervised fine-tuning, suggesting that data quality and reward design play a more important role than complex optimization methods in building practical small agent models.

Abstract

We present CacheRL, a system for training small agent foundation models that achieves 92 percent process accuracy on multi-step tool-calling tasks, approaching GPT-5's 94 percent while requiring 100 times less compute. Our approach addresses three challenges in practical agent training: transferring tool-calling knowledge from large models at scale, enabling reinforcement learning without costly live tool execution, and learning robustly from noisy cached environments. CacheRL introduces three key innovations. First, a hybrid thinking trajectory pipeline augments agent trajectories with LLM-generated reasoning traces, producing training examples that teach models not only what tools to call but also why. Second, the CacheAgentLoop eliminates live execution costs through a three-tier fuzzy cache while preserving trajectory fidelity using token-level masking. Third, a cache-tier-aware reward dynamically adjusts answer-quality weights to avoid penalizing models for cache-induced limitations. Through iterative supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), CacheRL improves Qwen3-4B-Thinking's validation reward from 0.43 to 0.78. On public agentic tool-calling benchmarks, our model achieves competitive performance against frontier models such as GPT-5. Ablation studies show that removing knowledge transfer reduces performance by 41 percent, while cache-aware rewards contribute a 17 percent improvement. Interestingly, reinforcement learning improves training stability but yields limited gains beyond strong supervised fine-tuning, suggesting that data quality and reward design play a more important role than complex optimization methods in building practical small agent models.

item.title: OdysSim: Building Foundation Models for Human Behavior Simulation
item.author: Xuhui Zhou, Weiwei Sun, Weihua Du, Jiarui Liu, Haojia Sun, Qianou Ma, Tongshuang Wu, Yiming Yang, Maarten Sap
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了OdysSim，这是目前最大规模的开放系统性行为基础模型研究。研究提出了SOUL分类法，统一了62个数据集和23个基准任务，并构建了包含2140万交互的OdysSim语料库。研究开发了一种结合中期训练、任务特定强化学习和专家蒸馏的端到端训练方法，训练出的8B OSim模型在23个任务中的8个任务上排名第一或并列第一，在对话和社会任务上提升显著，输出更具人类特征，并在零样本用户模拟中接近真实用户。研究还发现基于大语言模型作为裁判的强化学习会引发奖励黑客行为，并提出了缓解方法。

背景: 大型语言模型越来越多地被部署为人类模拟器，用于交互式评估和社会模拟。然而，以有用性为导向的后训练使它们倾向于同质化、过度顺从的助手风格，导致了行为上的Sim2Real差距。

目的: 提出SOUL分类法以统一行为模拟的能力维度，构建大规模行为基础模型，缩小行为模拟与现实之间的差距，并探索更有效的训练范式。

方法: 提出SOUL分类法，包含五个能力轴（对话、社会、认知、角色、评估），统一62个数据集和23个基准任务。构建OdysSim语料库（2140万交互，100亿令牌，包含回溯生成的社会上下文）。构建SOUL-Index基准。开发结合中期训练、任务特定强化学习和专家蒸馏的端到端训练配方。

主要发现: 训练出的8B OSim模型在23个任务中的8个任务上排名第一或并列第一，优于任何单一的前沿模型，在对话和社会任务上提升最强。模型输出在长度、格式和用词上更具人类特征。在零样本分布外用户模拟中，接近真实用户的反应对齐度。基于大语言模型作为裁判的强化学习会引发奖励黑客行为，提出的检测器可在后训练期间缓解该问题。

结论: 行为基础模型需要重新思考大语言模型的训练范式。研究释放了所有资源以支持未来研究。

翻译: Large language models are increasingly deployed as human simulators for interactive evaluation and social simulation. Yet helpfulness-driven post-training pulls them toward a homogeneous, overly agreeable assistant register, creating a behavioral Sim2Real gap. We present OdysSim, the largest open systematic investigation of behavioral foundation models, i.e., models trained to simulate human behavior at scale. We propose SOUL, a taxonomy of five capability axes (CONV, SS, COG, ROLE, EVAL) that unifies 62 datasets and 23 benchmark tasks under one framework. Specifically, we curate the OdysSim corpus (21.4M interactions, 10B tokens, retrofitted with back-generated social contexts), construct the SOUL-Index benchmark, and develop an end-to-end training recipe combining midtraining, task-specific RL, and expert distillation. The resulting open 8B OSim model ranks first or tied-first on 8 of 23 tasks, outperforming any individual frontier model by this count, with the strongest gains on conversational and social tasks. Its outputs are also more human-like in length, formatting, and word choice, and it transfers zero-shot to out-of-distribution user simulation on τ-bench, nearly matching real users on reaction alignment (93.2 vs. 93.5). We further show that LLM-as-judge RL induces reward-hacking patterns, and that our detectors can mitigate them during post-training. Together, our findings suggest that behavioral foundation models require rethinking the LLM training paradigm. We release all artifacts to support future research.

Abstract

Large language models are increasingly deployed as human simulators for interactive evaluation and social simulation. Yet helpfulness-driven post-training pulls them toward a homogeneous, overly agreeable assistant register, creating a behavioral Sim2Real gap. We present OdysSim, the largest open systematic investigation of behavioral foundation models, i.e., models trained to simulate human behavior at scale. We propose SOUL, a taxonomy of five capability axes (CONV, SS, COG, ROLE, EVAL) that unifies 62 datasets and 23 benchmark tasks under one framework. Specifically, we curate the OdysSim corpus (21.4M interactions, 10B tokens, retrofitted with back-generated social contexts), construct the SOUL-Index benchmark, and develop an end-to-end training recipe combining midtraining, task-specific RL, and expert distillation. The resulting open 8B OSim model ranks first or tied-first on 8 of 23 tasks, outperforming any individual frontier model by this count, with the strongest gains on conversational and social tasks. Its outputs are also more human-like in length, formatting, and word choice, and it transfers zero-shot to out-of-distribution user simulation on $τ$-bench, nearly matching real users on reaction alignment (93.2 vs. 93.5). We further show that LLM-as-judge RL induces reward-hacking patterns, and that our detectors can mitigate them during post-training. Together, our findings suggest that behavioral foundation models require rethinking the LLM training paradigm. We release all artifacts to support future research.

item.title: Learning the Context of Errors: Black-Box Online Adaptation of Time Series Foundation Models
item.author: Xilin Dai, Yiding Liu, Hongjie Xia, Yifan Hu, Zewei Dong, Jiang-Ming Yang, Qiang Xu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文针对时间序列基础模型在黑盒在线适应场景下的学习对象问题，提出了一种名为ORCA的在线残差上下文适应方法，并通过实验验证了其有效性。

背景: 时间序列基础模型的发展推动了零样本预测的进步，未来可能以商业化的闭源API服务形式提供。然而，现有的在线适应方法大多依赖白盒访问进行参数微调或梯度反向传播，与黑盒API服务的范式不匹配。

目的: 解决在时间序列基础模型的黑盒在线适应中应该学习什么的问题。

方法: 提出ORCA（在线残差上下文适应）方法。基于预测误差由基础模型的输入和输出（即误差上下文）共同决定的洞察，在无法访问模型内部参数的情况下进行适应。

主要发现: 在五个最先进的时间序列基础模型和八个数据集上进行了广泛实验，证明了ORCA方法的有效性。消融实验定量分析了不同适配器学习假设对黑盒在线适应最终性能的影响。

结论: 预测误差的条件依赖于基础模型的输入和输出，这一洞察为黑盒在线适应提供了新的学习方向，ORCA方法在此方向上表现有效。

翻译: The rapid evolution of Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) has advanced zero-shot forecasting across diverse domains. Inspired by the current form of Large Language Models, future TSFMs may be offered as commercialized, closed-source API services. However, many existing online adaptation methods still rely on white-box access for parameter fine-tuning or gradient backpropagation. This paradigm mismatch raises a question: In black-box online adaptation for TSFMs, what should we learn? We answer this with an insight: the predictive errors of the base model are conditioned on both the input and output of the base model (i.e., the context of errors). To validate this insight, we propose ORCA (Online Residual Contextual Adaptation). We conduct extensive experiments across 5 state-of-the-art TSFMs and 8 datasets to demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. Furthermore, through ablation studies, we quantitatively analyze the impact of different adapter learning hypotheses on the final adaptation performance in black-box online adaptation. Code available at https://github.com/Fifthky/ORCA.

Abstract

The rapid evolution of Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) has advanced zero-shot forecasting across diverse domains. Inspired by the current form of Large Language Models, future TSFMs may be offered as commercialized, closed-source API services. However, many existing online adaptation methods still rely on white-box access for parameter fine-tuning or gradient backpropagation. This paradigm mismatch raises a question: In black-box online adaptation for TSFMs, what should we learn? We answer this with an insight: the predictive errors of the base model are conditioned on both the input and output of the base model (i.e., the context of errors). To validate this insight, we propose ORCA (Online Residual Contextual Adaptation). We conduct extensive experiments across 5 state-of-the-art TSFMs and 8 datasets to demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. Furthermore, through ablation studies, we quantitatively analyze the impact of different adapter learning hypotheses on the final adaptation performance in black-box online adaptation. Code available at https://github.com/Fifthky/ORCA.

item.title: HarnessX: A Composable, Adaptive, and Evolvable Agent Harness Foundry
item.author: Chen, Tingyang, Lu, Shuo, Zhao, Kang, Meng, Weicheng, Teng, Hanlin, Li, Tianhao, Li, Chao, Liu, Xule, Liang, Jian, Zhang, Zhizhong, Xie, Yuan, Qu, Heng, Shao, Kun, Luan, Jian
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了HarnessX，一个用于构建组合式、自适应和可进化AI智能体运行环境（harness）的工厂。该框架通过替换代数组装类型化的运行环境原语，利用AEGIS引擎基于执行轨迹进行多智能体进化，并将轨迹转化为运行环境更新和模型训练信号。在五个基准测试中，HarnessX平均提升了百分之十四点五的性能，表明从执行反馈中组合和进化运行环境接口是提升智能体性能的有效且互补的手段。

背景: AI智能体的性能严重依赖于运行环境，包括提示词、工具、记忆和控制流。然而，当前的运行环境大多是手工制作且静态的，每个新模型或任务都需要定制化的支撑结构，且执行过程中产生的丰富轨迹很少被提炼回系统性的改进中。

目的: 引入HarnessX，一个用于构建组合式、自适应和可进化AI智能体运行环境的工厂，以解决当前运行环境手工制作、静态且缺乏系统性改进的问题。

方法: 1. 通过替换代数组装类型化的运行环境原语。2. 利用AEGIS引擎，这是一个基于符号适应与强化学习之间操作镜像的、由轨迹驱动的多智能体进化引擎，用于自适应调整运行环境。3. 通过将轨迹转化为运行环境更新和模型训练信号，闭合运行环境与模型的循环。

主要发现: 在ALFWorld、GAIA、WebShop、tau立方基准和SWE-bench Verified五个基准测试中，HarnessX平均提升了百分之十四点五的性能（最高提升百分之四十四点零），且在基线性能最低的情况下提升幅度最大。

结论: 智能体的进步不仅仅依赖于模型规模的扩大，从执行反馈中组合和进化运行环境接口是一个可行且互补的提升手段。完整的代码库将在未来的版本中开源。

翻译: AI agent performance depends critically on the runtime harness, comprising the prompts, tools, memory, and control flow that mediate how a model observes, reasons, and acts. Yet today's harnesses remain largely hand-crafted and static: each new model or task still demands bespoke scaffolding, and the rich traces produced during execution are rarely distilled back into systematic improvement. We introduce HarnessX, a foundry for composable, adaptive, and evolvable agent harnesses. HarnessX assembles typed harness primitives via a substitution algebra, adapts them through AEGIS, a trace-driven multi-agent evolution engine grounded in an operational mirror between symbolic adaptation and reinforcement learning, and closes the harness-model loop by turning trajectories into both harness updates and model training signal. Across five benchmarks (ALFWorld, GAIA, WebShop, tau^3-Bench, and SWE-bench Verified), HarnessX yields an average gain of +14.5% (up to +44.0%), with gains largest where baselines are lowest. These results suggest that agent progress need not come from model scaling alone: composing and evolving runtime interfaces from execution feedback is an actionable and complementary lever. The complete codebase will be open-sourced in a future release.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 该论文主要解决当前智能体运行框架依赖人工静态设计、组件高度耦合且无法利用执行数据自动迭代优化的问题。该问题在研究和实践中至关重要，因为随着智能体处理更长周期和更复杂的任务，运行框架的设计直接决定了模型的实际表现。仅靠扩大模型规模已难以持续提升性能，通过执行反馈自动组合与进化运行框架，能为提升智能体能力提供一条高效且可落地的补充路径。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有智能体运行框架普遍存在手工编写、结构耦合且与模型训练脱节的问题，提出将运行框架视为可组合、可替换的一等对象。设计上，他们通过类型化接口将框架拆解为独立组件，引入基于执行轨迹的进化引擎进行自适应调整，并利用共享数据流实现框架与模型的协同进化。该方法借鉴了强化学习中的路径依赖与遗忘等概念，将其映射为符号化设计的风险以指导架构防御，同时吸收了现有提示词优化与工作流搜索研究的基础，但突破了以往仅优化单一组件的局限，实现了全链路可进化。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将智能体的运行框架视为可组合、可自适应和可进化的核心对象，通过执行反馈自动优化而非依赖人工静态设计。整体实现流程首先将框架拆分为模块化组件并按任务阶段挂载，接着利用基于运行轨迹的引擎自动分析执行日志、生成并评估新的组件配置，最后将优化后的框架与模型训练数据打通，使框架迭代与模型能力提升形成闭环互相促进。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于将智能体运行框架视为可组合、可自适应和可进化的核心对象。具体包括：通过类型化组件实现模块化组合；引入基于执行轨迹的进化引擎，将框架调整转化为可学习的符号优化问题；以及打通框架与模型的协同进化闭环，使执行数据同时用于框架更新和模型训练。相比以往手工设计、静态固化且与模型训练割裂的框架，本方法实现了从经验反馈中自动迭代优化，有效解决了传统方法中组件耦合严重和缺乏系统性改进的难题。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种名为HarnessX的框架，将智能体的运行时接口视为可组合与自适应演化的核心组件，通过执行轨迹自动优化接口配置并与模型协同训练，从而在不依赖模型规模扩张的情况下显著提升智能体性能。

Abstract

AI agent performance depends critically on the runtime harness, comprising the prompts, tools, memory, and control flow that mediate how a model observes, reasons, and acts. Yet today's harnesses remain largely hand-crafted and static: each new model or task still demands bespoke scaffolding, and the rich traces produced during execution are rarely distilled back into systematic improvement. We introduce HarnessX, a foundry for composable, adaptive, and evolvable agent harnesses. HarnessX assembles typed harness primitives via a substitution algebra, adapts them through AEGIS, a trace-driven multi-agent evolution engine grounded in an operational mirror between symbolic adaptation and reinforcement learning, and closes the harness-model loop by turning trajectories into both harness updates and model training signal. Across five benchmarks (ALFWorld, GAIA, WebShop, tau^3-Bench, and SWE-bench Verified), HarnessX yields an average gain of +14.5% (up to +44.0%), with gains largest where baselines are lowest. These results suggest that agent progress need not come from model scaling alone: composing and evolving runtime interfaces from execution feedback is an actionable and complementary lever. The complete codebase will be open-sourced in a future release.

item.title: Intelligent Domain Adaptation for Power System Transient Stability Assessment Under Varying Operating Scenarios
item.author: Yuan Yang, Lipeng Zhu, Chao Deng, Jiayong Li, Quan Zhou, Cong Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于域自适应深度迁移学习的自适应暂态稳定评估框架，以解决深度学习在运行条件频繁变化时性能下降的问题。

背景: 基于深度学习的暂态稳定评估方法在电力系统稳定性监测中展现出巨大潜力，但在实际运行条件频繁变化的环境中容易性能下降。

目的: 解决深度学习模型在实际应用中因运行条件变化导致的性能退化问题，提高模型对目标域的适应性和泛化能力。

方法: 设计了异质混合分布度量以处理多尺度高斯和长尾分布并量化源域与目标域间的分布差异；构建了基于贝叶斯理论的双分布域自适应方法以对齐边缘概率分布和子域类别分布；引入了多层稀疏正则化算法以缓解特征波动并增强泛化能力。

主要发现: 在三个测试系统上的数值测试表明，与传统方法相比，该框架以成本效益更高的方式将在线暂态稳定评估准确率提高了百分之零点五到百分之五，并大幅降低了模型更新的计算成本。

结论: 所提出的自适应暂态稳定评估框架能够有效提升模型在运行条件变化场景下的适应性和准确性，同时降低计算成本。

翻译: While deep learning-based transient stability assessment approaches have exhibited great potential in power system stability monitoring, they are prone to undergo performance degradation in practical contexts with frequent variations of operating conditions. To address this issue, this work develops an adaptive TSA framework via domain adaptation-enabled deep transfer learning. First, for the sake of capturing the primary transient stability characteristics, a robust metric, i.e., heterogeneous hybrid distribution metric, is designed through mathematical means to effectively handle multi-scale Gaussian and long-tail distributions of transient responsive data and to precisely quantify the intrinsic distributional discrepancies between the source and target domains corresponding to different operating scenarios. With the help of the HHDM, a Bayesian theory-based dual-distribution domain adaptation method is constructed, aligning not only marginal probability distributions between domains but also the distributions of sub-domain categories. Such alignments enable fine-grained transient stability feature transfer, helping significantly improve the adaptability of a well-trained TSA model to target domains. Furthermore, a multilayer sparse regularization algorithm is introduced to mitigate feature volatility caused by variations in operating scenarios, thereby enhancing the model's generalization in the presence of unforeseen scenarios. Numerical tests on three test systems illustrate that, compared with conventional methods, the proposed framework improves online TSA accuracy by 0.5% to 5% in a cost-effective manner, with the learning cost for TSA model update largely reduced.

Abstract

While deep learning-based transient stability assessment (TSA) approaches have exhibited great potential in power system stability monitoring, they are prone to undergo performance degradation in practical contexts with frequent variations of operating conditions. To address this issue, this work develops an adaptive TSA framework via domain adaptation-enabled deep transfer learning. First, for the sake of capturing the primary transient stability characteristics, a robust metric, i.e., heterogeneous hybrid distribution metric (HHDM), is designed through mathematical means to effectively handle multi-scale Gaussian and long-tail distributions of transient responsive data and to precisely quantify the intrinsic distributional discrepancies between the source and target domains corresponding to different operating scenarios. With the help of the HHDM, a Bayesian theory-based dual-distribution domain adaptation method is constructed, aligning not only marginal probability distributions between domains but also the distributions of sub-domain categories. Such alignments enable fine-grained transient stability feature transfer, helping significantly improve the adaptability of a well-trained TSA model to target domains. Furthermore, a multilayer sparse regularization algorithm is introduced to mitigate feature volatility caused by variations in operating scenarios, thereby enhancing the model's generalization in the presence of unforeseen scenarios. Numerical tests on three test systems illustrate that, compared with conventional methods, the proposed framework improves online TSA accuracy by 0.5% to 5% in a cost-effective manner, with the learning cost for TSA model update largely reduced.

item.title: Nonlocal Bayesian Modeling of Continuous Spatio-Temporal Dynamics
item.author: Jaeyeong Lee, Heeyoung Kim
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为非局部贝叶斯时空模型的非局部贝叶斯时空模型，用于处理具有不规则时间点和稀疏空间观测的连续时空场预测问题。该模型通过坐标基展开表示潜在场，并利用常微分方程建模系数过程，结合神经常微分残差捕捉非线性动力学。通过线性高斯观测模型实现卡尔曼风格的顺序更新，支持缺失和不规则观测下的预测。全局参数通过变分推断学习，不确定性通过贝叶斯层次结构处理。实验表明，该模型在合成和真实数据集上具有强大的预测能力和空间泛化能力，且不确定性校准良好，在非局部和局部观测条件下显著优于基线方法。

背景: 现实世界的时空预测需要处理不规则时间点、空间稀疏观测以及不确定性量化需求。此外，非局部相互作用（长程空间耦合）进一步加剧了建模难度。对连续空间和时间非局部动力学的建模自然导致无限维积分微分方程，使得原则性贝叶斯推断变得不可行。

目的: 提出一种能够学习显式非局部耦合同时保持可推断性的分层贝叶斯框架，用于连续时空场的预测。

方法: 提出非局部贝叶斯时空模型，采用坐标基展开表示潜在场，使用常微分方程建模系数过程，其中可学习线性算子对应于非局部积分微分方程的伽辽金约化，神经常微分残差捕捉额外非线性动力学。采用线性高斯观测模型实现卡尔曼风格的顺序更新，支持缺失和不规则观测。空间基表示支持在未测量位置进行归纳预测而无需重新训练。全局参数通过变分推断学习，不确定性通过贝叶斯层次结构处理。

主要发现: 在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，该模型在预测和空间泛化方面表现强劲，且不确定性校准良好。在非局部和局部观测条件下，显著优于基线方法。

结论: 非局部贝叶斯时空模型能够有效处理现实世界中复杂的时空预测问题，特别是在非局部相互作用和局部观测条件下，提供了强大的预测能力和可靠的不确定性量化。

翻译: Real-world spatio-temporal forecasting must handle irregular time points, spatially sparse observations, and the need for uncertainty quantification. This setting is often further compounded by nonlocal interactions (long-range spatial coupling). Modeling continuous-space, continuous-time nonlocal dynamics naturally leads to infinite-dimensional integro-differential equations (IDEs), making principled Bayesian inference intractable. We propose the NonLocal Bayesian Spatio-Temporal model (NLBST), a hierarchical Bayesian framework for continuous spatio-temporal fields that learns explicit nonlocal coupling while retaining tractable inference. NLBST represents the latent field via a coordinate-based spatial basis expansion and models the coefficient process with a continuous-time ODE whose learnable linear operator corresponds to a Galerkin reduction of a nonlocal IDE; a Neural ODE residual captures additional nonlinear dynamics. A linear-Gaussian observation model enables Kalman-style sequential updates under missing and irregular observations, while the spatial basis representation enables inductive prediction at unmeasured locations without retraining. Global parameters are learned via variational inference, and uncertainty is handled through a Bayesian hierarchy. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate strong forecasting and spatial generalization with well-calibrated uncertainty, yielding substantial gains over baselines in strongly nonlocal and partially observed regimes.

Abstract

Real-world spatio-temporal forecasting must handle irregular time points, spatially sparse observations, and the need for uncertainty quantification. This setting is often further compounded by nonlocal interactions (long-range spatial coupling). Modeling continuous-space, continuous-time nonlocal dynamics naturally leads to infinite-dimensional integro-differential equations (IDEs), making principled Bayesian inference intractable. We propose the NonLocal Bayesian Spatio-Temporal model (NLBST), a hierarchical Bayesian framework for continuous spatio-temporal fields that learns explicit nonlocal coupling while retaining tractable inference. NLBST represents the latent field via a coordinate-based spatial basis expansion and models the coefficient process with a continuous-time ODE whose learnable linear operator corresponds to a Galerkin reduction of a nonlocal IDE; a Neural ODE residual captures additional nonlinear dynamics. A linear-Gaussian observation model enables Kalman-style sequential updates under missing and irregular observations, while the spatial basis representation enables inductive prediction at unmeasured locations without retraining. Global parameters are learned via variational inference, and uncertainty is handled through a Bayesian hierarchy. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate strong forecasting and spatial generalization with well-calibrated uncertainty, yielding substantial gains over baselines in strongly nonlocal and partially observed regimes.

item.title: Squeeze-Release: Iterative Pruning with Exact Structural Minimization
item.author: Denkin, Roman, Akerholm, Ida, Singh, Prashant, Sintorn, Ida-Maria
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为最小化的精确结构重写方法，将掩码网络转换为更小的稠密网络，并通过挤压-释放循环迭代剪枝与最小化过程，结合补偿层归一化技术，显著压缩了模型规模。

背景: 非结构化剪枝会产生稀疏权重张量，但标准实现保持张量形状不变，导致部署后的模型体积并未减小。

目的: 将掩码网络转换为具有相同前向函数（在浮点舍入误差范围内）的更小稠密网络，以解决剪枝后模型体积未减小的问题。

方法: 提出最小化精确结构重写方法，将掩码网络转换为更小的稠密网络；设计挤压-释放循环，迭代执行剪枝和最小化，并在中间释放步骤中将紧凑张量中的精确零位置重新启用为小校准噪声，恢复可训练参数；引入补偿层归一化，作为层归一化的函数保留替代方案，以支持跨层归一化残差流的通道缩减。

主要发现: 挤压-释放循环在完全连接模型网络上可将可部署网络压缩至未剪枝模型的三十九分之一，在现代卷积神经网络（ConvNeXt-Tiny）上压缩至十四点八分之一，且精度相当；该重写方法可推广至Transformer架构。

结论: 通过最小化结构重写和挤压-释放循环，结合补偿层归一化，能够有效压缩模型规模并保留性能，且该方法具有广泛的架构适用性。

翻译: Unstructured pruning produces sparse weight tensors, but the standard implementation keeps tensor shapes unchanged so the deployed model is no smaller than before pruning. We present an exact structural rewrite, which we call minimization, that converts a masked network into a smaller dense network with the same forward function up to floating-point rounding. The Squeeze-Release cycle iterates pruning and minimization with an intermediate release step that re-enables the exact-zero positions inside the compacted tensors as small calibrated noise, turning otherwise wasted capacity back into trainable parameters. Successive cycles use that capacity to find structural redundancy a single pass cannot reach. We additionally introduce CompensatedLayerNorm, a function-preserving replacement for LayerNorm that extends minimization to channel reduction across LayerNorm-equipped residual streams. Squeeze-Release compresses the deployable network to 39x smaller than the unpruned model on a fully-connected model network and 14.8x smaller on modern CNN (ConvNeXt-Tiny), at comparable accuracy. In addition we prove that the rewrite can be extended to transformer architectures.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决非结构化剪枝后模型实际部署体积并未缩小、计算加速效果有限的问题。传统剪枝方法虽然能产生大量零权重，但通常保持原始网络形状不变，导致模型在标准硬件上无法真正节省内存和降低延迟。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为实际部署时的模型体积和运行速度直接决定硬件成本与应用可行性，而本文提出的精确结构重写方法能彻底消除这一差距，使剪枝技术真正具备实用价值。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现传统非结构化剪枝仅通过掩码隐藏权重，并未真正减小模型体积，因此设计了精确的结构化重写技术来物理压缩网络并保留原功能。在此基础上，他们提出了一种循环机制，在压缩后重新启用被剪枝位置并微调，使模型能逐步整合计算能力以实现更高压缩率。该方法借鉴了现有的非结构化剪枝与函数保持变换思想，但针对以往研究在固定形状迭代、精确通道缩减及层归一化处理上的不足进行了创新改进。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是通过交替执行参数剪枝与结构精简，将网络中冗余的零值参数彻底移除并转化为更小的稠密网络，同时恢复已剪枝位置的可训练能力以挖掘更深层的冗余。整体实现流程为一个循环周期：首先根据重要性评分剪除参数，接着进行结构精简以物理缩小网络规模，然后将剪除位置填入校准后的微小噪声使其恢复为可训练参数，最后对恢复后的模型进行微调。该循环不断重复直至达到目标压缩率。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点在于提出挤压释放迭代循环，通过交替执行剪枝、精确结构最小化、将剪除位置重新启用为校准噪声及微调，以挖掘单次剪枝无法触及的结构冗余。同时设计了补偿层归一化模块，能够精确重构被移除通道的统计量，实现函数不变的通道缩减。与以往工作相比，该方法不仅将掩码网络转化为实际体积更小的稠密网络，解决了传统剪枝部署后模型大小不降的问题，还首次在保留层归一化精确输出的前提下实现了残差流通道缩减，而传统方法多依赖近似处理或刻意避开该维度。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了压缩释放迭代剪枝框架，通过精确的结构最小化压缩模型并定期恢复剪枝参数进行微调，同时引入补偿层归一化以精确处理通道缩减，从而在保持精度的同时大幅降低可部署模型的体积与计算开销。

Abstract

Unstructured pruning produces sparse weight tensors, but the standard implementation keeps tensor shapes unchanged so the deployed model is no smaller than before pruning. We present an exact structural rewrite, which we call minimization, that converts a masked network into a smaller dense network with the same forward function up to floating-point rounding. The Squeeze-Release cycle iterates pruning and minimization with an intermediate release step that re-enables the exact-zero positions inside the compacted tensors as small calibrated noise, turning otherwise wasted capacity back into trainable parameters. Successive cycles use that capacity to find structural redundancy a single pass cannot reach. We additionally introduce CompensatedLayerNorm, a function-preserving replacement for LayerNorm that extends minimization to channel reduction across LayerNorm-equipped residual streams. Squeeze-Release compresses the deployable network to 39x smaller than the unpruned model on a fully-connected model network and 14.8x smaller on modern CNN (ConvNeXt-Tiny), at comparable accuracy. In addition we prove that the rewrite can be extended to transformer architectures.

item.title: Can Deep Neural Networks Improve Compression of Very Large Scientific Data?
item.author: Muhannad Alhumaidi, Guozhong Li, Spiros Skiadopoulos, Panos Kalnis
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文探讨了将现代机器学习模型作为科学数据压缩预测器的可行性。通过整合空间和时间深度学习模型到传统的误差有界压缩流程中，并在气候数据上进行了评估。研究发现，尽管机器学习预测器能生成更准确的预测并提升重建质量，但并未提高整体数据集的压缩比，因为残差的空间结构对熵编码效率起决定性作用。

背景: 误差有界无损压缩是管理现代模拟和观测仪器产生的大量科学数据的基本技术。最先进的压缩器通常遵循预测残差范式，其压缩效果取决于预测器的质量。

目的: 探讨现代机器学习模型是否可以作为科学数据压缩的更优预测器。

方法: 利用气候领域已有的高精度预训练天气预测基础模型作为测试平台，提出一个将空间和时间深度学习模型整合到传统误差有界压缩流程中的框架。该框架支持自回归预测模型并避免误差累积。使用ERA5气候数据作为代表性大规模科学数据集，评估了三种不同的机器学习预测器（基于VAE的编解码器CRA5、图神经网络预测器GraphCast和视觉变换器预测器Aurora），并在相同的量化和熵编码后端下与最先进的压缩器SZ3.1进行对比。

主要发现: 在约1.7 TB的数据评估中，机器学习预测器虽然能生成更准确的预测，并将重建质量提高高达百分之九十一，对于高度可预测的变量甚至能实现高达九点六倍的压缩比提升，但它们并未提高整体数据集级别的压缩比。

结论: 仅凭预测准确性不足以提升压缩效果，残差的空间结构在熵编码效率中起着决定性作用。

翻译: Error-bounded lossy compression is a fundamental technique for managing the rapidly growing volumes of scientific data produced by modern simulations and observational instruments. Most state-of-the-art compressors follow a prediction-residual paradigm, where compression effectiveness depends on the quality of the predictor: more accurate predictions generate smaller residuals that are easier to compress. This observation raises a question: can modern machine learning models serve as superior predictors for scientific data compression? Answering this question directly is challenging because developing compression-specific ML predictors requires substantial resources. Instead, we leverage the climate domain where highly accurate pretrained weather forecasting foundation models already exist, making them an ideal testbed. We present a framework that integrates spatial and temporal deep learning models into a conventional error-bounded compression pipeline. The framework supports auto-regressive forecasting models and avoids error accumulation. Using ERA5 climate data as a representative large-scale scientific dataset, we evaluate three distinct ML predictors: a VAEformer-based codec (CRA5), a graph neural network forecaster (GraphCast), and a vision-transformer forecaster (Aurora), against the state-of-the-art compressor SZ3.1 under identical quantization and entropy-coding backends.
