Despite generating increasingly photorealistic images, text-to-image (T2I) models still exhibit localized, subtle, and structurally complex failures. Diagnosing these failures requires instance-level feedback that answers where a defect occurs, what type it is, why it is defective, and its importance to overall image quality. While recent dense-feedback methods move beyond scalar supervision, their heatmap-centric representations still formulate diagnosis as pixel-field regression, making it difficult to localize variable-cardinality defects and bind semantic reasons to individual failures. To address this representation bottleneck, we propose Structured Defect Grounding (SDG), which casts T2I diagnosis as structured set prediction by modeling each defect as a (location, type, reason, importance) tuple. To make this formulation trainable and measurable, we introduce SDG-30K, a 30K-image dataset with box-grounded annotations across four modern T2I generators, together with a dedicated evaluation protocol, SDG-Eval. Building on this structured representation, we further present a diagnosis-to-alignment framework in which a Vision-Language Model (VLM) serves as the SDG detector, and BoxFlow-GRPO converts predicted defect sets into box-derived, importance-weighted spatial rewards for diffusion model alignment. Extensive experiments show that our SDG detector outperforms leading proprietary VLMs on structured defect grounding, while SDG-guided rewards consistently improve T2I alignment and support localized image refinement. These results establish SDG as a unified, instance-level interface for diagnosing, evaluating, and enhancing modern generative models.

item.title: MuJoCo-Drones-Gym: A GPU-Accelerated Multi-Drone Simulator for Control and Reinforcement Learning
item.author: Tayal, Manan
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了MuJoCo-Drones-Gym，一个基于MuJoCo物理引擎的开源多无人机环境，兼容Gymnasium，支持任意数量的Bitcraze Crazyflie 2.x微型四旋翼无人机，提供模块化API以选择物理模型、动作接口和观测空间，并通过PettingZoo ParallelEnv包装器实现多智能体强化学习。

背景: 机器人模拟器是现代空中机器人研究的核心，用于开发新的控制算法和训练强化学习策略。然而，现有的四旋翼学习环境通常在物理保真度、多智能体支持和现代深度强化学习管道所需的吞吐量之间面临权衡。

目的: 提出一个开源的、兼容Gymnasium的多无人机环境，以解决现有环境在物理保真度、多智能体支持和吞吐量之间的权衡问题。

方法: 基于MuJoCo物理引擎构建MuJoCo-Drones-Gym环境，支持任意数量的Bitcraze Crazyflie 2.x微型四旋翼无人机。提供模块化API，允许用户选择物理模型（刚体MuJoCo、显式Python动力学或地面效应、桨叶阻力和无人机间下洗流的子集）、动作接口（每电机转速、集体归一化推力、速度设定值或PID航点命令）和观测空间（运动学状态向量、RGB/深度/分割相机或邻域邻接信息）。使用PettingZoo ParallelEnv包装器实现多智能体强化学习，并设计了七种任务环境以展示接口的广泛性。

主要发现: MuJoCo-Drones-Gym通过利用MuJoCo改进的接触处理、渲染和并行化能力，展示了其在控制和学习示例中的有效性，这些示例与相关的gym-pybullet-drones项目相似。

结论: MuJoCo-Drones-Gym提供了一个灵活且高效的开源多无人机环境，适用于空中机器人研究和强化学习训练。

翻译: Robotic simulators are a cornerstone of modern research in aerial robotics, serving both as a vehicle for the development of new control algorithms and as the data source for training reinforcement learning (RL) policies. Yet, existing quadcopter learning environments often face a trade-off between physical fidelity, multi-agent support, and the throughput required by modern deep RL pipelines. In this paper, we present MuJoCo-Drones-Gym, an open-source Gymnasium-compatible multi-drone environment built on top of the MuJoCo physics engine. MuJoCo-Drones-Gym supports an arbitrary number of Bitcraze Crazyflie 2.x nano-quadcopters and exposes a modular API for selecting (i) the physics model (rigid-body MuJoCo, explicit Python dynamics, or any subset of ground effect, blade drag, and inter-drone downwash), (ii) the action interface (per-motor RPMs, collective normalized thrust, velocity setpoints, or PID waypoint commands), and (iii) the observation space (kinematic state vectors, RGB / depth / segmentation cameras, or neighbourhood adjacency information). A PettingZoo ParallelEnv wrapper enables drop-in multi-agent reinforcement learning, while a suite of seven task environments, hover, velocity tracking, multi-drone hover, waypoint navigation, formation flight, gate racing, and a generic multi-agent template, demonstrates the breadth of the interface. We describe the environment design, the underlying physics and quadcopter dynamics, and illustrate its use through control and learning examples that mirror those of the closely related gym-pybullet-drones project, while taking advantage of MuJoCo's improved contact handling, rendering, and parallelizability.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有无人机仿真环境在物理真实性、多机协同支持与大规模强化学习所需的高计算吞吐量之间难以兼顾的问题。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为高保真且高效的仿真平台是安全、低成本开发控制算法与训练智能体策略的核心基础，缺乏并行加速能力会严重阻碍现代多智能体强化学习算法的研发与验证。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有四旋翼仿真器在物理精度、多机支持与训练效率之间难以兼顾的痛点进行设计。该方法直接借鉴了广泛使用的gym-pybullet-drones项目，继承了其轻量级架构、空气动力学模型与控制器设计。在此基础上，作者引入了更先进的物理引擎与图形处理单元并行技术，并全面兼容最新的开源标准接口，从而在保持易用性的同时大幅提升了仿真速度与多智能体训练吞吐量。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是基于现代物理引擎构建一个高保真、支持多机协同且可图形处理器加速的无人机仿真平台，以同时满足控制算法测试与强化学习数据生成的需求。整体实现流程采用模块化架构，允许用户灵活配置物理模型、控制指令与观测数据格式，并通过标准强化学习接口与环境交互；底层依托并行计算技术实现海量环境的同步运行，同时内置风场扰动、动态障碍物及难度递增等可插拔组件，直接对接主流学习算法完成策略训练。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的核心创新是构建了一个基于现代物理引擎的无人机仿真平台，支持多种可选的空气动力学与接触模式，并内置了图形处理器批量加速技术，可单卡并行运行数千个训练环境。与早期工作相比，它突破了传统仿真器在物理精度、多机协同与训练速度之间的局限，采用更标准的接口设计，无需依赖重型渲染框架即可实现高效的多智能体强化学习与控制算法验证。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种基于MuJoCo物理引擎的开源多无人机仿真环境，通过引入图形处理器加速与模块化设计，在保持高物理保真度的同时显著提升了多智能体强化学习的训练效率与主流框架兼容性。

Abstract

Robotic simulators are a cornerstone of modern research in aerial robotics, serving both as a vehicle for the development of new control algorithms and as the data source for training reinforcement learning (RL) policies. Yet, existing quadcopter learning environments often face a trade-off between physical fidelity, multi-agent support, and the throughput required by modern deep RL pipelines. In this paper, we present MuJoCo-Drones-Gym, an open-source Gymnasium-compatible multi-drone environment built on top of the MuJoCo physics engine. MuJoCo-Drones-Gym supports an arbitrary number of Bitcraze Crazyflie 2.x nano-quadcopters and exposes a modular API for selecting (i)~the physics model (rigid-body MuJoCo, explicit Python dynamics, or any subset of ground effect, blade drag, and inter-drone downwash), (ii)~the action interface (per-motor RPMs, collective normalized thrust, velocity setpoints, or PID waypoint commands), and (iii)~the observation space (kinematic state vectors, RGB / depth / segmentation cameras, or neighbourhood adjacency information). A PettingZoo ParallelEnv wrapper enables drop-in multi-agent reinforcement learning, while a suite of seven task environments, hover, velocity tracking, multi-drone hover, waypoint navigation, formation flight, gate racing, and a generic multi-agent template, demonstrates the breadth of the interface. We describe the environment design, the underlying physics and quadcopter dynamics, and illustrate its use through control and learning examples that mirror those of the closely related gym-pybullet-drones project, while taking advantage of MuJoCo's improved contact handling, rendering, and parallelizability.

item.title: Robust-U1: Can MLLMs Self-Recover Corrupted Visual Content for Robust Understanding?
item.author: Tang, Jiaqi, Chen, Jianmin, Zhai, Youyang, Wei, Wei, Liu, Runtao, Zhao, Mengjie, Wu, Xiangyu, Xiao, Qingfa, Chen, Qifeng
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出Robust-U1框架，通过视觉自恢复能力增强多模态大语言模型在真实世界视觉损坏下的鲁棒性。

背景: 多模态大语言模型在视觉理解方面取得显著成功，但在真实世界视觉损坏下性能显著下降。现有鲁棒性增强方法存在局限性：黑盒特征对齐缺乏可解释性，白盒基于文本的推理无法恢复丢失的像素级细节。

目的: 探究多模态大语言模型能否自行恢复损坏的视觉内容。

方法: 提出Robust-U1框架，包含三个核心阶段：用于初始重建的监督微调、使用双重奖励（像素级结构相似性和语义级CLIP相似度）进行强化学习以对齐高视觉质量、以及联合考虑损坏输入和恢复图像的 multimodal 推理。

主要发现: Robust-U1在真实世界损坏基准上实现了最先进的鲁棒性，并在通用视觉问答基准的对抗性损坏下保持优越性能。分析证实高质量的视觉恢复直接增强了推理性能。

结论: 视觉自恢复是鲁棒视觉理解的关键机制。

翻译: 多模态大语言模型在视觉理解方面取得了显著成功，但在真实世界视觉损坏下性能显著下降。虽然现有的鲁棒性增强方法存在，但它们存在局限性：黑盒特征对齐缺乏可解释性，而白盒基于文本的推理无法恢复丢失的像素级细节。本研究探讨了一个根本性的研究问题：多模态大语言模型能否自行恢复损坏的视觉内容？为了解决这个问题，我们提出了Robust-U1，这是一种新颖的框架，为多模态大语言模型配备了显式的视觉自恢复能力以实现鲁棒理解。该方法包含三个核心阶段：用于初始重建的监督微调、使用双重奖励（像素级结构相似性和语义级CLIP相似度）进行强化学习以对齐高视觉质量，以及联合考虑损坏输入和恢复图像的多模态推理。大量实验表明，Robust-U1在真实世界损坏基准上实现了最先进的鲁棒性，并在通用视觉问答基准的对抗性损坏下保持优越性能。分析证实高质量的视觉恢复直接增强了推理性能，确立了自恢复作为鲁棒视觉理解的关键机制。源代码可在该网址获取。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决多模态大模型在面对真实世界图像损坏（如系统噪声、压缩失真或恶劣天气）时视觉理解性能大幅下降的问题，旨在赋予模型自主修复受损图像内容的能力。该问题在研究和应用中至关重要，因为现有方法要么缺乏可解释性，要么只能依赖文字描述而无法还原关键的像素级细节。通过让模型主动恢复丢失的视觉信息，不仅能直接提升其在复杂环境下的推理准确性，还能为实现更本质的图像鲁棒性提供一条全新的有效路径。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有方法要么缺乏可解释性，要么只能依赖文本描述而无法恢复丢失的像素细节，因此提出让模型自主恢复受损图像的核心思路。基于此，他们设计了包含监督微调、双奖励强化学习和多模态联合推理的三阶段框架，使模型能直接重建清晰图像并辅助理解。该方法借鉴了基础多模态生成模型、流匹配去噪技术、强化学习算法以及结构相似性和视觉语义一致性等成熟评估指标。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是让多模态大语言模型具备主动修复受损图像的能力，通过直接重建清晰画面来弥补信息丢失，从而提升模型在复杂环境下的视觉理解鲁棒性。整体流程分为三个阶段：首先通过监督微调让模型掌握基础的图像修复技能；接着利用结合像素结构相似度和语义一致性的双重奖励进行强化学习，进一步提升修复画面的质量；最后训练模型同时参考受损原图与修复后的清晰图进行联合推理，输出准确答案。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于首次赋予多模态大模型显式的视觉自恢复能力，通过三阶段训练流程实现受损图像的像素级重建与高质量对齐。与以往依赖隐式特征对齐或仅靠文本推理补偿的方法不同，本文直接让模型主动修复丢失的视觉细节，并联合原始受损图像与修复后的图像进行多模态推理。这种机制不仅提升了模型在真实与对抗性干扰下的理解鲁棒性，还增强了过程的透明度和可解释性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文首次提出一种新型框架，通过三阶段训练赋予多模态大语言模型自主修复受损图像的能力，并联合原始与修复后的图像进行推理，从而显著提升了模型在各类视觉干扰下的鲁棒理解性能。

Abstract

Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable success in visual understanding, yet their performance degrades significantly under real-world visual corruptions. While existing robustness enhancement approaches exist, they are limited: black-box feature alignment lacks interpretability, and white-box text-based reasoning cannot restore lost pixel-level details. This work investigates a fundamental research question: Can MLLMs recover corrupted visual content by themselves? To address this, we propose Robust-U1, a novel framework that equips MLLMs with explicit visual self-recovery capability for robust understanding. The approach comprises three core stages: supervised fine-tuning for initial reconstruction, reinforcement learning with dual rewards (pixel-level SSIM and semantic-level CLIP similarity) for aligning high visual quality, and multimodal reasoning that jointly considers both the corrupted input and the recovered image. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Robust-U1 achieves state-of-the-art robustness on the real-world corruption benchmark and maintains superior performance under adversarial corruptions on general VQA benchmarks. Analysis confirms that high-quality visual recovery directly enhances reasoning performance, establishing self-recovery as a critical mechanism for robust visual understanding. The source code is available at this https URL .

item.title: MaskAlign: Token-Subset Representation Alignment for Efficient Diffusion Training
item.author: Pang, Lianyu, Pan, Tianlin, Da, Cheng, Yu, Changqian, Yang, Huan, Gai, Kun, Guo, Song, Luo, Wenhan
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文针对扩散模型训练中使用预训练视觉模型进行表示对齐时存在的噪声输入与干净图像参考特征不匹配问题，提出了一种名为MaskAlign的令牌子集表示对齐方法。该方法通过在训练中对随机采样的令牌子集应用对齐，减少模型对完整令牌集的依赖，并引入轻量级预掩码令牌混合块以缓解信息损失。

背景: 使用预训练视觉模型进行表示对齐可加速扩散Transformer的训练，通过将对齐中间扩散特征与自监督视觉编码器提取的干净图像表示相结合，能够提升收敛速度和生成质量。

目的: 解决现有表示对齐方法中因噪声输入与干净图像参考特征不匹配而引入的非平凡约束问题，减少模型对完整干净图像令牌集的依赖，提高对齐行为在令牌子集扰动下的稳定性。

方法: 提出MaskAlign方法，在训练过程中对随机采样的令牌子集应用表示对齐；引入轻量级预掩码令牌混合块，在掩码前共享令牌间信息以缓解直接丢弃令牌导致的信息损失。

主要发现: 在完整令牌表示对齐下，具有大对齐梯度范数的令牌表现出稳定的空间偏好，表明对齐目标并非均匀影响所有令牌，且可能促使模型依赖完整的干净图像令牌集。

结论: MaskAlign通过令牌子集对齐和预掩码令牌混合机制，有效缓解了表示对齐中的信息不匹配问题，提升了模型在令牌扰动下的稳定性和对齐行为的鲁棒性。

翻译: Representation alignment with pretrained vision models has recently shown strong potential for accelerating diffusion transformer training. By aligning intermediate diffusion features with clean-image representations from self-supervised vision encoders, existing methods improve convergence and generation quality. However, such alignment also introduces a non-trivial constraint: diffusion models operate on noisy inputs whose usable information varies across timesteps, while the reference features are extracted from clean images. In this paper, we revisit this mismatch from a token-level perspective. We find that, under full-token representation alignment, tokens with large alignment-gradient norms exhibit a stable spatial preference, suggesting that the alignment objective does not affect all tokens uniformly and may encourage the model to rely on the complete set of clean-image tokens. To address this issue, we propose MaskAlign, a token-subset representation alignment method that applies alignment to randomly sampled token subsets during training. By exposing the model to different token subsets across iterations, MaskAlign reduces the dependence of representation alignment on the complete token set and encourages alignment behavior that is more stable under token-subset perturbations. To mitigate the information loss caused by directly dropping tokens, we further introduce a lightweight pre-mask token mixing block that shares information across tokens before masking.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决的是在扩散模型训练过程中，使用外部视觉模型进行特征对齐时，因模型输入含噪声而参考特征来自干净图像所导致的训练依赖捷径与收敛效率低下问题。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为大规模图像生成模型的训练成本极高，提升训练速度并保证生成质量是降低算力门槛、推动技术落地的关键。通过引入随机子集对齐策略，该方法能显著加快模型收敛并减少训练开销。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者通过层析发现全量标记对齐会使梯度集中在特定位置，导致模型依赖完整标记集并产生捷径。基于此，他们借鉴了防止共适应的随机特征丢弃策略，设计了随机掩码部分标记的方法，以打破梯度集中模式并提升对齐稳定性。为缓解直接丢弃标记的信息损失，又引入了轻量级的掩码前标记混合模块进行信息交互。该方法在现有表征对齐与标记掩码技术的基础上，创新地将随机掩码应用于构建对齐子集而非重建任务。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是在训练阶段随机遮蔽部分图像块令牌，仅对保留的令牌子集与干净图像特征进行对齐，从而打破全令牌对齐导致的空间依赖与捷径学习，促使模型获得更稳定的对齐信号。整体实现流程为：训练时先通过轻量级混合模块共享令牌信息，随后随机遮蔽部分图像块并保留全局类别令牌，仅对可见令牌执行特征对齐；推理阶段则取消遮蔽直接使用全部令牌。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种基于随机标记子集的特征对齐方法。与以往直接对所有图像块标记进行完整对齐的做法不同，该方法在训练时随机遮蔽部分标记，仅对保留的子集进行对齐，从而打破模型对完整标记集合的依赖和空间捷径。此外，论文还引入了一种轻量级的掩码前标记混合模块，在遮蔽前共享标记信息以减少直接丢弃带来的信息损失。相比之前的工作，这种方法使对齐信号在不同标记子集扰动下更加稳定，显著提升了训练收敛速度和生成质量。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种名为MaskAlign的随机令牌子集表征对齐方法，通过在训练时随机遮蔽部分图像块并结合轻量级信息混合模块，有效缓解了全令牌对齐带来的特征不匹配与捷径依赖问题，从而显著提升了扩散模型的训练收敛速度与生成质量。

Abstract

Representation alignment with pretrained vision models has recently shown strong potential for accelerating diffusion transformer training. By aligning intermediate diffusion features with clean-image representations from self-supervised vision encoders, existing methods improve convergence and generation quality. However, such alignment also introduces a non-trivial constraint: diffusion models operate on noisy inputs whose usable information varies across timesteps, while the reference features are extracted from clean images. In this paper, we revisit this mismatch from a token-level perspective. We find that, under full-token representation alignment, tokens with large alignment-gradient norms exhibit a stable spatial preference, suggesting that the alignment objective does not affect all tokens uniformly and may encourage the model to rely on the complete set of clean-image tokens. To address this issue, we propose MaskAlign, a token-subset representation alignment method that applies alignment to randomly sampled token subsets during training. By exposing the model to different token subsets across iterations, MaskAlign reduces the dependence of representation alignment on the complete token set and encourages alignment behavior that is more stable under token-subset perturbations. To mitigate the information loss caused by directly dropping tokens, we further introduce a lightweight pre-mask token mixing block that shares information across tokens before masking.

item.title: Visual Para-Thinker++: A Single-Policy Multi-Agent Framework for Visual Reasoning
item.author: Xu, Haoran, Wang, Hongyu, Gao, Yifei, Li, Jiaze, Tong, Zizhao, Zhang, Xiaofeng, Yuan, Xiaosong
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为Visual Para-Thinker++的单策略多智能体框架，通过共享多模态大语言模型策略实例化为主智能体、工作智能体和摘要智能体，以解决视觉推理中的早期感知承诺和幻觉问题。

背景: 视觉推理需要整合分布在区域、属性和关系中的证据，而单链推理容易导致早期感知承诺和幻觉。

目的: 提出一种新的多智能体框架，以提高视觉推理的准确性和减少幻觉。

方法: 采用单策略多智能体框架，其中共享的多模态大语言模型策略被实例化为主智能体、工作智能体和摘要智能体。主智能体负责任务分解，工作智能体在上下文隔离下并行推理，摘要智能体整合所有工作智能体的推理轨迹。通过多智能体能力注入和角色解耦多智能体优化进行训练，并使用原生推理引擎实现高效的智能体 rollout。

主要发现: 在多个视觉推理基准测试中，Visual Para-Thinker++ consistently 优于单轨迹和推理时并行基线方法，特别是在对幻觉敏感的视觉推理任务中表现突出。

结论: Visual Para-Thinker++ 框架能够有效提升视觉推理的性能，减少幻觉，为多智能体视觉推理提供了新的解决方案。

翻译: Visual reasoning requires integrating evidence distributed across regions, attributes, and relations, making single-chain reasoning prone to early perceptual commitment and hallucination. We propose Visual Para-Thinker++, a single-policy multi-agent framework in which one shared MLLM policy is instantiated as role-conditioned Main, Worker, and Summary Agents. The Main Agent decomposes the task with fixed allocation patterns; Worker Agents reason in parallel under context isolation; and the Summary Agent reconciles full Worker reasoning traces rather than majority-voting on final labels. The shared policy is trained by Multi-Agent Capability Injection and Role-Decoupled Multi-Agent Optimization, which assign role-specific rewards and advantages to corresponding token segments to reduce gradient conflict among collaborative roles. A native inference engine enables efficient multi-agent rollout through shared visual prefix and KV cache reuse. Across V*, CountBench, the RefCOCO family, and HallusionBench, Visual Para-Thinker++ consistently outperforms single-trajectory and inference-time parallel baselines, with especially strong gains on hallucination-sensitive visual reasoning.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决多模态大模型在视觉推理中因单条推理链容易过早锁定错误感知并导致幻觉的问题。该问题在研究中非常重要，因为视觉证据分散在图像的不同区域和关系中，传统的单链推理难以全面整合信息，导致模型在复杂视觉任务上的表现明显弱于文本任务。通过多角色协作机制，该方法能有效收集局部证据并整合全局信息，从而显著提升视觉推理的准确性与可靠性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者观察到视觉推理的证据分散在不同区域和属性中，单链推理容易陷入早期感知偏差和幻觉，因此放弃延长单条推理链的思路，转而设计多角色协作机制，将任务分解、局部证据收集、全局验证和结果整合分别分配给不同角色。在方法设计上，他们借鉴了现有并行推理和多智能体协作工作的启发，但摒弃了使用多个独立模型或仅靠提示词拼接的做法，而是将不同角色统一到一个共享模型中，通过角色标记和上下文隔离实现协作，并采用分角色奖励的强化学习来避免梯度冲突。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用单一共享模型策略构建多角色协作框架，通过分工并行推理避免单链推理的早期感知偏差。整体流程分为三步：首先由主控智能体将视觉任务按固定模式拆解为子任务；接着多个工作智能体在隔离环境下并行收集局部证据；最后由汇总智能体整合所有推理轨迹生成最终答案。训练时先通过监督微调让模型学会角色分工，再采用角色解耦的强化学习为不同角色的输出分配专属奖励，从而在统一权重下实现高效协作。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种单策略多智能体框架，即通过角色标识让同一个共享模型分别承担任务分解、并行推理与结果汇总职能。相比以往依赖单链推理或独立多模型的方法，该框架避免了早期感知偏差，并通过角色解耦的优化策略有效缓解了不同推理目标间的梯度冲突。此外，它采用汇总角色对完整推理过程进行证据融合而非简单的最终答案投票，在提升视觉推理准确性的同时大幅降低了计算开销。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了Visual Para-Thinker++框架，通过单一共享策略协同主、工和摘要三个角色代理进行视觉推理，并引入两阶段解耦优化方法有效缓解梯度冲突，从而在多项基准测试中显著提升了推理性能并降低了幻觉。

Abstract

Visual reasoning requires integrating evidence distributed across regions, attributes, and relations, making single-chain reasoning prone to early perceptual commitment and hallucination. We propose Visual Para-Thinker++, a single-policy multi-agent framework in which one shared MLLM policy is instantiated as role-conditioned Main, Worker, and Summary Agents. The Main Agent decomposes the task with fixed allocation patterns; Worker Agents reason in parallel under context isolation; and the Summary Agent reconciles full Worker reasoning traces rather than majority-voting on final labels. The shared policy is trained by Multi-Agent Capability Injection and Role-Decoupled Multi-Agent Optimization, which assign role-specific rewards and advantages to corresponding token segments to reduce gradient conflict among collaborative roles. A native inference engine enables efficient multi-agent rollout through shared visual prefix and KV cache reuse. Across V*, CountBench, the RefCOCO family, and HallusionBench, Visual Para-Thinker++ consistently outperforms single-trajectory and inference-time parallel baselines, with especially strong gains on hallucination-sensitive visual reasoning.

item.title: SG-OPD: Sign-Gated On-Policy Distillation via Sign-Consistency Gating and Phased Teacher Sampling
item.author: Xu, Haoran, Wang, Hongyu, Gao, Yifei, Li, Jiaze, Zhang, Xiaofeng, Yuan, Xiaosong
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为符号门控在线策略蒸馏的新方法，旨在解决现有在线策略蒸馏方法在实际应用中因轨迹对齐和教师偏好可靠性假设不成立而效果受限的问题。

背景: 在线策略蒸馏通过在自身轨迹上训练学生模型，并利用更强教师模型的密集逐令牌监督信号，通常能超越离线策略蒸馏和标准强化学习方法。

目的: 解决在线策略蒸馏在实际应用中因轨迹级对齐和教师令牌级可靠性假设频繁失效而导致的性能下降问题。

方法: 提出符号门控在线策略蒸馏方法，使用二元验证器作为教师信任信号，在两个互补粒度上发挥作用：在冷启动阶段混合经过验证器认可的教师 rollout，并通过符号一致性门控在教师与验证器方向一致时外推蒸馏更新，在方向不一致时插值更新。

主要发现: 在竞赛级数学推理基准测试中，该方法 consistently 优于标准在线策略蒸馏，在样本级别和问题级别分别平均提升了 1.98 和 7.50。

结论: 符号门控在线策略蒸馏通过引入验证器信任信号，有效克服了传统在线策略蒸馏的假设限制，显著提升了数学推理任务的性能。

翻译: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own trajectories with dense per-token supervision from a stronger teacher, and often outperforms off-policy distillation and standard reinforcement learning. However, we find that its effectiveness implicitly relies on two assumptions that frequently break in practice: trajectory-level alignment between the student and the teacher, and uniform token-level reliability of the teacher's preferences. We therefore propose Sign-Gated On-Policy Distillation (SG-OPD), which uses a binary verifier as a trust signal for the teacher at two complementary granularities: phased teacher sampling mixes in verifier-endorsed teacher rollouts at cold-start, and a sign-consistency gate extrapolates the distillation update on tokens where the teacher agrees with the verifier-correct direction and interpolates it where it disagrees. Experiments on competition-level mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that SG-OPD consistently outperforms standard OPD, with average gains of 1.98 and 7.50 at the per-sample and per-question levels, respectively.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决在线策略蒸馏方法在训练初期学生与教师轨迹对齐不足，以及教师逐词指导可靠性不一致的问题。该问题在研究中非常重要，因为在线策略蒸馏是压缩强大推理模型、降低计算成本的核心技术，但其训练不稳定会直接导致模型无法有效学习。解决这一问题能显著提升模型蒸馏的鲁棒性，使小模型更可靠地继承大模型的复杂推理能力。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者首先指出传统在线策略蒸馏方法在实际中常因训练初期学生与教师轨迹对齐度低，以及教师对每个词元的判断可靠性不一致而失效。针对这一问题，他们引入验证器作为信任信号，在轨迹层面借鉴混合策略优化思路设计了分阶段教师采样机制，在训练初期混合经过验证的教师数据以弥补对齐差距，随后逐渐过渡到纯学生数据；在词元层面设计了符号一致性门控，根据教师偏好与验证器正确方向是否一致，分别放大可信信号或抑制冲突信号。该方法的设计明确借鉴了混合策略优化中冷启动阶段混合专家数据的思路，并在已有外推机制的基础上进行了改进。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是利用二元验证器作为信任信号，在样本和词元两个粒度上解决传统在线蒸馏中轨迹对齐脆弱和教师偏好不可靠的问题。整体流程为：训练初期将少量经验证器确认正确的教师生成轨迹混合入学生数据中，并随训练推进逐渐降低其权重；同时针对学生生成的每个词元，判断教师偏好是否与验证器指出的正确方向一致，一致则放大蒸馏信号，冲突则减弱或屏蔽该词元的更新，最终结合两者完成模型参数更新。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种双粒度动态监督机制，利用验证结果作为教师模型的信任信号。在样本层面，训练初期会引入验证器认可的教师轨迹以弥补冷启动时的策略差距，随后逐渐过渡到完全基于学生自身的生成数据。在词元层面，通过判断教师偏好与验证器正确方向是否一致，分别对信任的词元进行强化放大，对冲突的词元进行抑制弱化。相比以往工作普遍采用全局固定放大系数或仅依赖单一信号的做法，该方法实现了细粒度的动态信号路由，有效解决了传统在线策略蒸馏中轨迹对齐脆弱和词元可靠性不均的缺陷。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种符号门控在线策略蒸馏方法，通过引入二元验证器作为信任信号，在轨迹层面采用分阶段教师采样解决冷启动对齐问题，在词元层面利用符号一致性门控机制区分并处理教师建议与验证结果一致或冲突的更新方向，从而有效提升了模型在数学推理任务上的训练效果。

Abstract

On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own trajectories with dense per-token supervision from a stronger teacher, and often outperforms off-policy distillation and standard reinforcement learning. However, we find that its effectiveness implicitly relies on two assumptions that frequently break in practice: trajectory-level alignment between the student and the teacher, and uniform token-level reliability of the teacher's preferences. We therefore propose Sign-Gated On-Policy Distillation (SG-OPD), which uses a binary verifier as a trust signal for the teacher at two complementary granularities: phased teacher sampling mixes in verifier-endorsed teacher rollouts at cold-start, and a sign-consistency gate extrapolates the distillation update on tokens where the teacher agrees with the verifier-correct direction and interpolates it where it disagrees. Experiments on competition-level mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that SG-OPD consistently outperforms standard OPD, with average gains of 1.98 and 7.50 at the per-sample and per-question levels, respectively.

item.title: WeaveBench: A Long-Horizon, Real-World Benchmark for Computer-Use Agents with Hybrid Interfaces
item.author: Li, Wanli, Zhou, Bowen, Yu, Yunyao, Xu, Zhou, Yang, Yifan, Li, Dongsheng, Shan, Caihua
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: WeaveBench是一个针对计算机使用代理的长期跨界面编排能力的基准测试，包含一百一十四个任务，覆盖八个真实工作领域。

背景: 现有基准测试通常将图形界面控制、命令行执行、代码编辑等接口能力分开评估，缺乏对长期跨界面编排能力的测试。

目的: 评估计算机使用代理在真实场景中结合图形界面观察与操作、命令行及代码操作进行长期跨界面任务编排的能力。

方法: 构建包含一百一十四个任务的基准测试，任务基于真实用户请求和可验证成果，要求代理在单一轨迹中结合图形界面与命令行代码操作。在部署的命令行代理运行时环境中使用真实Ubuntu桌面进行评估，并开发轨迹感知裁判检查交付物、文件、截图、日志和行动轨迹，以检测捷径行为。

主要发现: 在前沿模型与运行时配对中，最佳通过率仅为百分之四十一点二，表明基准测试远未饱和。轨迹感知裁判显示，仅基于结果的评分会严重高估代理性能。

结论: WeaveBench揭示了计算机使用代理评估中的关键差距，提供了一个有效的测试平台，用于衡量代理是否能在长期真实任务中有效编排图形界面、命令行和代码操作。

翻译: Computer-use agents (CUAs) increasingly operate in runtimes that combine visual desktop control, command-line execution, code editing, browsers, and external tools. Existing benchmarks, however, often evaluate these interfaces as separable capabilities, leaving long-horizon cross-interface orchestration under-tested. Thus, we introduce WeaveBench, a long-horizon hybrid-interface benchmark with 114 tasks across 8 real-world work domains, grounded in real user requests and publicly verifiable artifacts. Each task requires agents to combine GUI observations/actions with CLI/code operations within a single trajectory. We evaluate these tasks on a real Ubuntu desktop inside deployed CLI-agent runtimes, augmented with a minimal desktop-control plugin. We also propose a companion trajectory-aware judge that inspects deliverables, files, screenshots, logs, and action traces, while detecting shortcut behaviors such as fabricated visual evidence or hard-coded metrics. Across frontier model-runtime pairings, the best PassRate reaches only 41.2%, showing the benchmark remains far from saturated. The trajectory-aware judge further reveals that outcome-only grading substantially overestimates agent performance. Overall, WeaveBench exposes a critical gap in CUA evaluation and provides an effective testbed to measure whether agents can orchestrate GUI, CLI, and code operations across long-horizon real-world tasks.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有基准测试将图形界面、命令行和代码等接口能力割裂评估的问题，导致智能体在长周期真实任务中的跨界面协同能力缺乏有效检验。该问题在研究和现实中至关重要，因为实际生产工作流要求智能体必须交替使用图形界面观察与程序化修改来完成复杂任务。现有评估方式不仅无法真实反映智能体的实际工作效能，还容易因仅关注最终结果而高估性能，因此亟需此类基准测试来准确衡量智能体的跨界面编排能力。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有基准测试通常将图形界面与命令行能力割裂评估，无法检验智能体在真实工作流中跨界面协同的长期规划能力，因此设计了必须交替使用图形界面操作与命令行代码修改的混合任务。在方法构建上，他们借鉴了SWE-bench、WebArena和OSWorld等工作的真实场景任务采集模式，采用原型引导、资产打包、独立盲审和试点验证四阶段流程来构建任务。同时，为防范智能体走捷径或伪造结果

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是构建一个面向真实场景的长周期混合交互基准测试，专门评估智能体在单一任务中协同图形界面、命令行与代码编辑等多种通道的能力，并通过全程轨迹审计防止仅凭最终结果评分导致的作弊行为。整体实现流程首先从公开资料中收集并封装真实工作流任务，随后在部署了基础图形控制插件的真实操作系统环境中运行智能体。最后，通过一个独立的轨迹感知裁判模块主动抓取并交叉验证文件、截图、日志和操作记录，按多维度打分并严格拦截伪造证据，从而输出可靠的综合评分。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了首个面向长周期混合界面协同的计算机使用智能体基准测试。与以往仅评估单一图形界面或命令行能力、或允许单一通道完成任务的基准不同，该工作要求智能体在单次任务中必须交替使用图形界面观察与命令行代码操作，且两者在任务中不可互相替代。此外，论文引入了基于完整操作轨迹的自主评估机制，通过审查文件、截图与日志来检测捷径行为，从而更真实地衡量智能体在真实部署环境中的跨界面编排能力。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了WeaveBench基准测试，包含一百一十四个跨图形界面与命令行及代码操作的真实长程任务，并配套设计了轨迹感知评估器，以填补现有计算机使用智能体在混合界面协同编排能力评估上的空白。

Abstract

Computer-use agents (CUAs) increasingly operate in runtimes that combine visual desktop control, command-line execution, code editing, browsers, and external tools. Existing benchmarks, however, often evaluate these interfaces as separable capabilities, leaving long-horizon cross-interface orchestration under-tested. Thus, we introduce WeaveBench, a long-horizon hybrid-interface benchmark with 114 tasks across 8 real-world work domains, grounded in real user requests and publicly verifiable artifacts. Each task requires agents to combine GUI observations/actions with CLI/code operations within a single trajectory. We evaluate these tasks on a real Ubuntu desktop inside deployed CLI-agent runtimes, augmented with a minimal desktop-control plugin. We also propose a companion trajectory-aware judge that inspects deliverables, files, screenshots, logs, and action traces, while detecting shortcut behaviors such as fabricated visual evidence or hard-coded metrics. Across frontier model-runtime pairings, the best PassRate reaches only 41.2%, showing the benchmark remains far from saturated. The trajectory-aware judge further reveals that outcome-only grading substantially overestimates agent performance. Overall, WeaveBench exposes a critical gap in CUA evaluation and provides an effective testbed to measure whether agents can orchestrate GUI, CLI, and code operations across long-horizon real-world tasks.

item.title: Leveraging Morphology for Historical Script Metrological Analysis
item.author: Efstathiou, Malamatenia Vlachou, Baena, Raphaël, Stutzmann, Dominique, Aubry, Mathieu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种基于深度学习的古文字测量方法，通过从行级转录中学习字符原型，实现了可扩展、有意义且稳定的古文字测量。

背景: 手写文本识别的进步使得大规模转录历史文档成为可能，但在为古文字学（历史书体的研究）提供可解释的视觉测量方面仍存在局限。

目的: 旨在通过形态学书体分析，特别是从行级转录中学习字符原型的能力，定义可扩展、有意义且稳定的古文字测量指标。

方法: 利用基于变换器的检测架构和基于原型的行重建模块，学习字符原型及其出现、变形和定位。该方法仅需行级转录监督，显著优于可学习打字机基线，并能准确预测字符边界框。

主要发现: 该方法在巴黎国家图书馆编号为fr. 2813的十四世纪晚期手稿的160页上进行了验证。测量结果不仅区分了图形特征，还揭示了细微变化。研究表明该方法具有可扩展性，且训练数据需求极少，仅需单列文本即可计算测量值。

结论: 该架构为字符、双字符组合及图形单元间的空间提供了具有古文字学意义的自动测量。数据与代码已公开。

翻译: Advances in handwritten text recognition have enabled large-scale transcription of historical documents, but still provide limited access to interpretable visual measurements for paleography, the study of historical scripts. In this paper, our main insight is that morphological script analysis, in particular the capacity to learn character prototypes from line-level transcriptions, enables the definition of scalable, meaningful, and stable paleographic measurements. More precisely, we leverage a transformer-based detection architecture together with a prototype-based line reconstruction module to learn prototypical characters and their occurrence, deformation, and positioning. Our contributions are twofold. First, we introduce a deep architecture and learning methodology that enables efficient character modeling with only line-level transcription supervision, significantly improving over the Learnable Typewriter baseline and enabling accurate character bounding box prediction, unlocking its potential for paleographic measurements. Second, we introduce and demonstrate the paleographical relevance of automatic measurements enabled by our architecture for characters, bi-grams, and spaces between graphical units. For this demonstration, we extend the annotations of the codex Paris, BnF, fr. 2813, commissioned in the late fourteenth century by Charles V and copied by four hands, to 160 pages. We visualize our measurements over these pages, showing how they enable us not only to differentiate graphical profiles, but also to discover and analyze subtle variations. This case study outlines the scalability of our approach and its frugality in terms of required training data, since a single column of text is sufficient to compute our measurements on each of the 160 pages. Data and code are publicly available at: this https URL .

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决历史手写文献的自动测量与形态分析难以规模化、标准化的问题。传统古文字学研究高度依赖专家主观经验，缺乏客观可重复的量化指标。实现自动化的精确测量对于提升历史文献分析的可重复性、发现细微的书写差异以及大规模研究手稿特征具有重要意义。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者的核心思路是弥合古文字形态分析与计量分析之间的鸿沟，利用字符原型来定义稳定且可量化的古文字测量标准。在设计上，该方法借鉴了基于原型重建的字符生成模型以及基于检测的文本识别技术。针对现有原型方法无法准确调整字符宽高比且易受背景干扰的缺陷，作者将检测模型的边界框预测与原型变形重建相结合，并采用分阶段训练策略，从而在无需人工标注的情况下实现高精度的字符定位与形态测量。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是利用形态学分析中的字符原型学习，通过原型与具体字符实例的最优对齐来界定字符边界，从而将形态学分析与计量学分析相结合，实现可扩展且稳定的古文字测量。整体流程首先基于检测模型从文本行图像中预测字符边界框、类别和颜色信息，随后结合可学习的字符原型与预测的背景图，利用边界框对原型进行变形与空间排布以重建文本行。训练过程分为合成数据预训练、全数据集基础训练以及针对特定分析单元的微调三个阶段，最终通过精确的边界框输出计算字符比例、间距等计量指标。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于将字符形态学分析与计量学分析相结合，提出了一种基于检测架构与原型重建模块的统一方法，能够自动学习字符原型及其变形与定位。相比之前的可学习手写体模型，该方法首次利用预测的边界框精确调整字符宽高比，有效避免了背景噪声干扰和原型重复使用问题，同时大幅降低计算内存消耗。此外，它无需人工标注即可直接输出稳定且符合古文字学意义的测量数据，如字符比例、字距与词距，显著提升了古文字计量的客观性与可扩展性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种结合字符检测与原型重建的深度学习架构，通过字符原型对齐自动提取稳定且可扩展的古文字形态与度量特征，并通过历史手稿案例验证了该方法在细粒度古文字分析中的有效性。

Abstract

Advances in handwritten text recognition have enabled large-scale transcription of historical documents, but still provide limited access to interpretable visual measurements for paleography, the study of historical scripts. In this paper, our main insight is that morphological script analysis, in particular the capacity to learn character prototypes from line-level transcriptions, enables the definition of scalable, meaningful, and stable paleographic measurements. More precisely, we leverage a transformer-based detection architecture together with a prototype-based line reconstruction module to learn prototypical characters and their occurrence, deformation, and positioning. Our contributions are twofold. First, we introduce a deep architecture and learning methodology that enables efficient character modeling with only line-level transcription supervision, significantly improving over the Learnable Typewriter baseline and enabling accurate character bounding box prediction, unlocking its potential for paleographic measurements. Second, we introduce and demonstrate the paleographical relevance of automatic measurements enabled by our architecture for characters, bi-grams, and spaces between graphical units. For this demonstration, we extend the annotations of the codex Paris, BnF, fr. 2813, commissioned in the late fourteenth century by Charles V and copied by four hands, to 160 pages. We visualize our measurements over these pages, showing how they enable us not only to differentiate graphical profiles, but also to discover and analyze subtle variations. This case study outlines the scalability of our approach and its frugality in terms of required training data, since a single column of text is sufficient to compute our measurements on each of the 160 pages. Data and code are publicly available at: this https URL .

item.title: One Step Closer to Ground Truth: A Multi-Scale Residual-Aware Representation Learning Pipeline for Predicting Time Series Data
item.author: Amrijit Biswas, Mustafa Kamal, Robin Krambroeckers, M. M. Lutfe Elahi, Sifat Momen, Nabeel Mohammed, Shafin Rahman
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种两阶段、模型无关的框架，通过显式解耦预测和残差学习，解决了基于Transformer的时间序列预测模型中存在的系统性残差偏差问题。

背景: 近年来，基于Transformer的模型已成为时间序列预测的主要范式，利用自注意力机制捕捉长距离依赖关系。然而，这些单阶段预测架构由于结构差异、未建模的随机分量或多尺度时间表示不足，存在持续的系统性残差偏差。

目的: 解决单阶段架构中残差被视为不可约噪声的问题，通过自适应校正结构化误差模式，提升预测精度和鲁棒性。

方法: 引入一个两阶段框架，首先使用基础Transformer生成初始预测，然后通过专用的元校正器动态建模多变量通道上的结构化误差模式，保留跨变量依赖关系，并迭代细化基础Transformer的残差偏差。

主要发现: 在八个流行基准数据集上的评估表明，该方法在标准指标（均方误差、平均绝对误差）上取得了显著改进，实现了最先进的性能。

结论: 该框架通过假设空间扩展解决了单阶段架构的近似局限性，增强了对复杂时间动态的鲁棒性，提升了基于Transformer的预测模型的实际适用性。

翻译: 近年来，基于Transformer的模型已成为时间序列预测的主要范式，利用自注意力机制捕捉长距离依赖关系。然而，这些单阶段预测架构由于结构差异、未建模的随机分量或多尺度时间表示不足，存在持续的系统性残差偏差。当残差被视为不可约噪声时，这种局限性仍然存在，无法自适应校正结构化误差模式。为了解决这一局限性，我们引入了一种两阶段、模型无关的框架，显式地将预测和残差学习解耦为表示学习的不同阶段。基础Transformer首先生成初始预测。随后，专用的元校正器动态建模多变量通道上的结构化误差模式，保留跨变量依赖关系，并迭代细化基础Transformer的残差偏差。通过将这一流程形式化为假设空间扩展，我们的框架解决了单阶段架构固有的近似局限性，消除对限制性假设的依赖，并实现复杂误差动态的端到端学习。在八个流行基准数据集上使用既定协议进行评估，我们的方法在标准指标（均方误差、平均绝对误差）上取得了显著改进，实现了最先进的性能。结果表明，该框架能够减轻系统性偏差并增强对复杂时间动态的鲁棒性，推动了基于Transformer的预测模型的实际适用性。

Abstract

Transformer-based models have emerged as leading paradigms in time-series forecasting in recent years, employing self-attention mechanisms to capture long-range dependencies. Despite their success, these single-stage forecasting architectures exhibit persistent systematic residual biases arising from structural discrepancies, unmodeled stochastic components, or inadequate multi-scale temporal representations. This limitation persists when residuals are treated as irreducible noise, precluding adaptive correction of structured error patterns. To address this limitation, we introduce a two-stage, model-agnostic framework that explicitly decouples forecasting and residual learning into distinct stages of representation learning. A base transformer first generates the initial predictions. Subsequently, a dedicated meta-corrector dynamically models structured error patterns across multivariate channels, preserves cross-variable dependencies, and iteratively refines the residual bias of the base transformer. By formalizing this pipeline as a hypothesis space expansion, our framework addresses approximation limitations inherent in single-stage architectures, removes reliance on restrictive assumptions, and enables end-to-end learning of complex error dynamics. Evaluated on eight popular benchmark datasets using established protocols, our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance, with significant improvements in standard metrics (MSE, MAE). The results demonstrate the framework's ability to mitigate systematic biases and enhance robustness to complex temporal dynamics, advancing the practical applicability of transformer-based forecasting models.

item.title: N-GRPO: Embedding-Level Neighbor Mixing for Enhanced Policy Optimization
item.author: Zhu, Xukun, Yu, Hang, Di, Peng, Zhu, Linchao
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为N-GRPO的新颖探索策略，该策略集成在组相对策略优化框架中，旨在解决大语言模型在数学推理过程中生成多样化且有效解路径的问题。

背景: 大语言模型在数学推理上的成功很大程度上依赖于在 rollout 阶段生成多样且有效的解路径。然而，当前的 rollout 技术面临一个根本性的权衡：词元级采样通常产生仅在措辞上不同的冗余轨迹，而利用随机噪声的嵌入级方法经常破坏语义一致性。

目的: 解决当前 rollout 技术中词元级采样和嵌入级方法之间的权衡问题，通过引入新的探索策略来提升数学推理能力。

方法: 引入 N-GRPO 策略，该策略不依赖词元级采样或原生嵌入级噪声，而是利用语义邻居混合机制。该机制通过混合锚定词元及其最近语义邻居的嵌入来动态构建输入表示，从而在严格遵循局部语义流形的同时注入多样性。

主要发现: 在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen 不同规模的模型上的实验评估表明，N-GRPO 不仅在数学推理基准测试中相比强基线实现了持续改进，而且在分布外任务上也表现出强大的泛化能力。

结论: N-GRPO 策略能够有效解决数学推理中的探索问题，提升模型性能并增强泛化能力。

翻译: The success of Large Language Models in mathematical reasoning relies heavily on the generation of diverse and valid solution paths during the rollout phase. However, current rollout techniques face a fundamental trade-off: token-level sampling often yields redundant trajectories that differ only in rephrasing, while embedding-level methods utilizing random noise frequently disrupt semantic consistency. To resolve this, we introduce N-GRPO, a novel exploration strategy integrated into the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) framework. Rather than relying on token-level sampling or native embedding-level noise, our approach leverages Semantic Neighbor Mixing. This mechanism dynamically constructs input representations by mixing the embeddings of an anchor token and its nearest semantic neighbors, thereby injecting diversity while strictly adhering to the local semantic manifold. Experimental evaluations on the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models across different sizes show that N-GRPO not only achieves consistent improvements over strong baselines on math reasoning benchmarks but also exhibits robust generalization capabilities on out-of-distribution tasks.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决大语言模型在强化学习推理过程中，探索阶段难以兼顾轨迹多样性与语义一致性的问题。现有的词元级采样容易产生重复的改写路径，而直接注入随机噪声又会破坏语义连贯性。该问题之所以重要，是因为高质量的探索是强化学习提升模型复杂推理能力的关键，只有生成多样且有效的解题路径，模型才能在数学等复杂任务中取得突破。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有方法在探索阶段面临两难：词元级采样只能产生冗余的改写轨迹，而嵌入层随机噪声又会破坏语义连贯性。基于嵌入空间的结构特性，他们借鉴了连续空间探索的思路，但摒弃了直接添加噪声的做法，转而设计语义邻居混合机制。该机制以模型首选词元为中心，在空间中寻找语义相近的邻居进行加权混合，从而在保持局部语义一致的前提下注入多样性。最后，作者通过概率门控将该机制集成到群体相对策略优化框架中，实现了稳定且丰富的推理路径探索。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是在模型生成的嵌入层进行语义邻居混合，通过选取当前最可能生成的词作为锚点，并融合其语义相近的多个邻居词的向量表示，从而在保持语义连贯性的同时注入可控的多样性。整体实现流程为：在强化学习生成阶段，模型先确定当前最优词，检索其语义最接近的若干邻居词，利用当前步骤的预测概率对这些邻居词进行加权平均得到混合向量作为下一步输入；该混合过程以固定概率触发以兼顾稳定性，最终将生成的混合轨迹输入标准强化学习框架进行策略优化。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种语义邻居混合的嵌入级探索策略，并将其整合到策略优化框架中。与以往依赖离散词元采样（仅产生同义改写导致轨迹冗余）或直接注入随机噪声（易破坏语义连贯性）的方法不同，该方法通过选取与当前词元语义最接近的邻居进行加权混合，在生成过程中引入连续扰动。这种设计既保证了探索的多样性，又严格遵循了局部语义结构，从而有效避免了轨迹冗余和语义漂移问题。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种名为N-GRPO的新方法，通过在强化学习生成阶段引入基于语义邻居混合的嵌入级探索机制，有效提升了大语言模型在数学推理任务中的多样性与解题性能。

Abstract

The success of Large Language Models in mathematical reasoning relies heavily on the generation of diverse and valid solution paths during the rollout phase. However, current rollout techniques face a fundamental trade-off: token-level sampling often yields redundant trajectories that differ only in rephrasing, while embedding-level methods utilizing random noise frequently disrupt semantic consistency. To resolve this, we introduce N-GRPO, a novel exploration strategy integrated into the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) framework. Rather than relying on token-level sampling or native embedding-level noise, our approach leverages Semantic Neighbor Mixing. This mechanism dynamically constructs input representations by mixing the embeddings of an anchor token and its nearest semantic neighbors, thereby injecting diversity while strictly adhering to the local semantic manifold. Experimental evaluations on the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models across different sizes show that N-GRPO not only achieves consistent improvements over strong baselines on math reasoning benchmarks but also exhibits robust generalization capabilities on out-of-distribution tasks.

item.title: Flash-GMM: A Memory-Efficient Kernel for Scalable Soft Clustering
item.author: Bloch, Gal, Gera, Ariel, Orbach, Matan, Eytan, Ohad, Toledo, Assaf
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Flash-GMM 是一种用于在单个 GPU 上高效计算大规模数据高斯混合模型的融合 Triton 内核。

背景: 现有实现需要在全局责任矩阵中占用大量 GPU 内存，限制了训练数据集的大小。

目的: 消除对完整责任矩阵的内存需求，实现更高效的计算并支持更大规模的数据集训练。

方法: 通过融合 Triton 内核实现单次 GPU 传递计算，避免材料化完整责任矩阵。

主要发现: 相比现有实现实现二十倍加速，支持比之前可行大一百倍的数据集训练；在近似最近邻搜索中，软高斯混合模型聚类可替代 k 均值，利用责任分配边界向量，减少一点七倍距离计算或提升召回率。

结论: 该方法显著提升了计算效率和可扩展性，并作为开源项目发布。

翻译: We present Flash-GMM, a fused Triton kernel for efficient computation of Gaussian Mixture Models (GMMs) over large-scale data in a single GPU pass. By eliminating the need to materialize the full responsibility matrix in GPU memory, Flash-GMM achieves a 20x speedup over existing implementations and enables training on datasets more than 100x larger than previously feasible on one device. To demonstrate its impact, we integrate Flash-GMM into the IVF coarse quantizer for approximate nearest-neighbor (ANN) search. We show that soft GMM clustering is now a viable drop-in replacement for k-means, and that GMM responsibilities can be leveraged to assign border vectors to multiple clusters. Our approach reaches fixed recall targets with up to 1.7x fewer distance computations, or equivalently, yields +2--12 recall@10 at matched computational cost. We release the kernel as an open-source project.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决高斯混合模型在训练时因需要存储庞大的责任矩阵而导致的显存溢出与计算效率低下问题。该问题在研究和应用中至关重要，因为传统方法受限于显存容量无法处理海量数据，而突破这一瓶颈能使大规模软聚类成为可能，从而显著提升近似最近邻搜索等关键任务的构建速度与检索精度。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现传统方法受限于显存容量和带宽，无法存储庞大的责任矩阵，导致大规模训练不可行。为此，他们采用分块处理策略，将数据切分为小块在芯片内完成计算并累积统计量，避免将中间结果反复读写主存，从而大幅降低内存访问压力。该方法的设计直接借鉴了FlashAttention的输入输出感知分块思想，并将其成功适配到高斯混合模型的参数更新流程中。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是避免在显存中存储庞大的数据归属概率矩阵，而是采用分块处理策略，将计算和中间结果全部保留在芯片内部缓存中，从而大幅降低显存占用和读写带宽压力。整体流程首先将海量数据切分为小批次，逐批计算各数据点对所有聚类组件的归属概率并累加统计量，处理完所有批次后汇总全局统计量以更新模型参数，如此循环迭代直至收敛。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于设计了一种高效的计算内核，通过分块处理与片上缓存技术，彻底避免了在图形处理器中存储庞大的责任矩阵，使内存消耗不再随数据量增长。相比以往依赖完整矩阵存储的并行实现或速度缓慢的中央处理器方案，该方法大幅降低了显存读写压力，实现了约二十倍的性能提升，并支持在单卡上训练超大规模数据集。此外，该内核将软聚类机制引入近似最近邻搜索，利用边界向量的多簇

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种内存高效且优化数据读写的图形处理器计算模块，通过避免在显存中存储完整的概率分配矩阵，实现了对超大规模数据集的高效率高斯混合模型训练，并显著提升了近似最近邻搜索等实际应用的性能。

Abstract

We present \textbf{Flash-GMM}, a fused Triton kernel for efficient computation of Gaussian Mixture Models (GMMs) over large-scale data in a single GPU pass. By eliminating the need to materialize the full responsibility matrix in GPU memory, Flash-GMM achieves a \textbf{20$\times$} speedup over existing implementations and enables training on datasets more than \textbf{100$\times$} larger than previously feasible on one device. To demonstrate its impact, we integrate Flash-GMM into the IVF coarse quantizer for approximate nearest-neighbor (ANN) search. We show that soft GMM clustering is now a viable drop-in replacement for $k$-means, and that GMM responsibilities can be leveraged to assign border vectors to multiple clusters. Our approach reaches fixed recall targets with up to $1.7\times$ fewer distance computations, or equivalently, yields $+2$--$12$ recall@10 at matched computational cost. We release the kernel as an open-source project.

item.title: When to Align, When to Predict: A Phase Diagram for Multimodal Learning
item.author: Ilay Kamai, Hugues Van Assel, Aviv Regev, Hagai B. Perets, Randall Balestriero
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文针对多模态表示学习中跨模态对齐和跨模态预测两种主导范式，提出了一种统一的线性框架，系统性地解释了这两种方法何时成功、何时失败以及跨模态训练何时有效。

背景: 跨模态对齐和跨模态预测是多模态表示学习的主要范式，但缺乏对它们适用条件的系统性理解，导致实践者在面对异构数据和多层级组织时无法诊断标准方法为何表现不佳。

目的: 开发一个统一的线性框架，以解决何时使用跨模态对齐或跨模态预测的问题，并解释跨模态训练的有效性。

方法: 在具有结构化跨模态干扰相关性的尖峰信号加噪声模型下，推导两种目标的分离比率，构建相图将多模态问题划分为四种情况，并提出一种基于数据的过程，使用少量标记子样本在训练前定位数据集在相图中的位置。

主要发现: 跨模态对齐通过白化各模态工作，但在干扰跨视图强相关时失败；跨模态预测通过单侧白化编码可跨预测的内容，其恢复受源模态质量影响。相图将问题分为四种情况：两者皆适用、仅对齐适用、仅预测适用、两者皆不适用。实验在合成数据、立体视觉基准、图像-标题对和真实天体物理数据上验证了预测，包括跨模态训练有害的情况。

结论: 该框架使实践者能够在投入训练之前诊断其多模态问题并选择正确的目标。

翻译: Cross-modal alignment (CA) and cross-modal prediction (CP) are the dominant paradigms for multimodal representation learning, yet there is no systematic understanding of when each succeeds, when each fails, and when cross-modal training helps at all -- a gap that leaves practitioners, especially in scientific domains like biomedicine or astrophysics, with heterogeneous instruments and multiple levels of organization and measurement, unable to diagnose why standard methods underperform the best single modality. We develop a unified linear framework that addresses both questions. Under a spiked signal-plus-noise model with structured cross-modal nuisance correlation, we derive separation ratios for both objectives that expose complementary failure modes: alignment whitens each modality and fails when nuisance is strongly correlated across views; prediction encodes whatever is cross-predictable through a one-sided whitening, with recovery governed by source-modality quality. The resulting phase diagram partitions multimodal problems into four regimes: Both, CA only, CP only, and Neither. We present a data-driven procedure to locate real-world datasets in this diagram using a small labeled subsample, identifying the preferred objective and prediction direction before any cross-modal training. Experiments on synthetic data, stereo-vision benchmarks, image-caption pairs, and real astrophysical data validate the predictions in the nonlinear regime, including the Neither regime where cross-modal training is actively harmful. Our framework lets practitioners diagnose their multimodal problem and choose the right objective before committing to training. Code to reproduce the results is available at https://github.com/IlayMalinyak/mm_align_vs_pred.

Abstract

Cross-modal alignment (CA) and cross-modal prediction (CP) are the dominant paradigms for multimodal representation learning, yet there is no systematic understanding of when each succeeds, when each fails, and when cross-modal training helps at all -- a gap that leaves practitioners, especially in scientific domains like biomedicine or astrophysics, with heterogeneous instruments and multiple levels of organization and measurement, unable to diagnose why standard methods underperform the best single modality. We develop a unified linear framework that addresses both questions. Under a spiked signal-plus-noise model with structured cross-modal nuisance correlation, we derive separation ratios for both objectives that expose complementary failure modes: alignment whitens each modality and fails when nuisance is strongly correlated across views; prediction encodes whatever is cross-predictable through a one-sided whitening, with recovery governed by source-modality quality. The resulting phase diagram partitions multimodal problems into four regimes: Both, CA only, CP only, and Neither. We present a data-driven procedure to locate real-world datasets in this diagram using a small labeled subsample, identifying the preferred objective and prediction direction before any cross-modal training. Experiments on synthetic data, stereo-vision benchmarks, image-caption pairs, and real astrophysical data validate the predictions in the nonlinear regime, including the Neither regime where cross-modal training is actively harmful. Our framework lets practitioners diagnose their multimodal problem and choose the right objective before committing to training. Code to reproduce the results is available at https://github.com/IlayMalinyak/mm_align_vs_pred.

item.title: Risk Under Pressure: Compute-Aware Evaluation of Adversarial Robustness in Language Models
item.author: Ehghaghi, Malikeh, Ecsedi, Boglárka, Chechik, Marsha, Raffel, Colin
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于计算压力的计算感知评估框架，用于评估大型语言模型在对抗性攻击下的鲁棒性。

背景: 现有大型语言模型的对抗性鲁棒性评估通常在固定查询预算下报告攻击成功率，隐含地将所有攻击视为同等成本，但不同攻击策略的计算成本可能相差几个数量级。

目的: 确定攻击成本是否值得攻击者的收益，并更准确地衡量攻击模型所需的真实努力。

方法: 提出基于累积浮点运算次数的计算压力作为对抗性努力的代理，引入风险计算曲线，并推导两个总结攻击成功所需平均压力的指标。

主要发现: 对齐训练对计算空间鲁棒性有非单调影响；增加模型规模降低基于梯度的攻击效果但对基于模板的攻击影响有限；在替代模型上优化的基于梯度的攻击可转移到目标模型；同一模型内不同危害类别的计算成本差异可达五倍；安全对齐强化学习增加总体成本但使某些类别仍易受攻击。

结论: 释放计算感知风险评估和评估框架，以支持更准确的对抗性鲁棒性评估。

翻译: Adversarial robustness evaluations of large language models (LLMs) typically report attack success rate (ASR) under fixed query budgets, implicitly treating all attacks as equally costly. In practice, the computational expense of different attack strategies can vary by orders of magnitude. Consequently, ASR at a fixed budget can obscure the true effort required to jailbreak a model, thereby making it hard to determine whether an attack's cost justifies its payoff to the attacker. We propose a compute-aware evaluation framework based on computational pressure, measured in cumulative floating-point operations (FLOPs), as a proxy for adversarial effort. We introduce risk-compute curves, which map compute budgets to attack risk, and derive two metrics that summarize the average pressure required for a given attack to succeed. Across ten models spanning three families and four different stages in language model training and alignment, evaluated with three attack strategies (gradient-based, iterative refinement, and template-based) on two jailbreak robustness benchmarks, we find: (1) alignment training has non-monotonic effects on compute-space robustness; (2) scaling model size reduces gradient-based attack effectiveness but has limited impact on cheaper template-based attacks; (3) gradient-based attacks optimized on a surrogate model can transfer to a separate target model, providing a way to reduce attacker costs; (4) compute cost varies by up to approximately five times across harm categories within a single model; and (5) safety-aligned RL increases aggregate cost while leaving some categories disproportionately accessible. We release our framework to enable compute-aware risk assessment and evaluation.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决当前大语言模型安全评估中忽略攻击计算成本的问题，传统方法仅统计固定次数下的攻击成功率，无法反映攻破模型所需的真实算力投入。该问题在研究和现实中非常重要，因为攻击者的算力预算有限，只有准确衡量攻击代价，才能科学评估模型的真实安全风险，并帮助防御者制定符合实际威胁的防护策略。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现传统评估仅统计固定查询次数下的成功率，忽略了不同攻击策略的实际计算成本差异，无法真实反映攻破模型所需的努力。为此，他们借鉴了经典安全领域衡量“工作因子”的思路以及大模型缩放定律中常用的浮点运算量指标，设计了基于累计浮点运算量的计算压力评估框架。该方法将各类攻击步骤的成本统一折算为浮点运算量，并绘制风险与计算量的关系曲线，从而实现对攻击成本与模型脆弱性的量化对比。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是用累计浮点运算量来衡量攻击者的实际计算成本，从而更真实地反映模型在面临不同计算压力时的脆弱性，而非仅依赖固定的查询次数。整体流程是设定查询预算后，让攻击策略在目标模型上反复生成提示词并获取安全反馈，直到成功或预算耗尽。在此过程中精确累加每一步的运算量，最终绘制计算成本与攻击成功率的对应曲线，并提取关键指标进行量化对比。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种基于计算压力的评估框架，使用累计浮点运算量作为衡量攻击者实际投入成本的代理指标。相比以往仅关注固定查询次数下攻击成功率的传统方法，该框架通过绘制风险与计算量的关系曲线并提取核心摘要指标，能够更真实地反映攻破模型所需的实际计算代价。这使得不同攻击策略和模型之间的安全性比较更加统一且贴近现实攻击者的预算约束。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种基于累计浮点运算量的计算感知评估框架，通过绘制风险计算曲线并提取核心指标，实现了对大语言模型对抗攻击成本与成功风险之间关系的统一量化评估。

Abstract

Adversarial robustness evaluations of large language models (LLMs) typically report attack success rate (ASR) under fixed query budgets, implicitly treating all attacks as equally costly. In practice, the computational expense of different attack strategies can vary by orders of magnitude. Consequently, ASR at a fixed budget can obscure the true effort required to jailbreak a model, thereby making it hard to determine whether an attack's cost justifies its payoff to the attacker. We propose a compute-aware evaluation framework based on computational pressure, measured in cumulative floating-point operations (FLOPs), as a proxy for adversarial effort. We introduce risk-compute curves, which map compute budgets to attack risk, and derive two metrics that summarize the average pressure required for a given attack to succeed. Across ten models spanning three families and four different stages in language model training and alignment, evaluated with three attack strategies (gradient-based, iterative refinement, and template-based) on two jailbreak robustness benchmarks, we find: (1) alignment training has non-monotonic effects on compute-space robustness; (2) scaling model size reduces gradient-based attack effectiveness but has limited impact on cheaper template-based attacks; (3) gradient-based attacks optimized on a surrogate model can transfer to a separate target model, providing a way to reduce attacker costs; (4) compute cost varies by up to ${\approx}5{\times}$ across harm categories within a single model; and (5) safety-aligned RL increases aggregate cost while leaving some categories disproportionately accessible. We release our framework to enable compute-aware risk assessment and evaluation.

item.title: TreeSeeker: Tree-Structured Trial, Error, and Return in Deep Search
item.author: Shi, Zhuofan, Ma, Mingzhe, Wang, Lu, Yang, Fangkai, Zhao, Pu, Guan, Yiming, Huang, Youling, Zhang, Wei, Lin, Qingwei, Zhang, Dongmei, Rajmohan, Saravan
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为TreeSeeker的推理时框架，用于在深度搜索中实现受控的试错过程。该框架通过树状状态结构组织搜索，利用文本形式的上置信界信号来平衡利用、探索和剪枝，从而在多个可能的搜索方向中做出更优决策。

背景: 深度搜索要求智能体通过多步网络搜索、浏览、证据比较和综合来回答复杂问题。核心挑战在于当存在多个看似合理的搜索方向时，如何决定搜索策略。盲目跟随当前最优方向可能导致延续弱分支，而无纪律的探索则可能浪费预算在无关尝试上。

目的: 提出一种能够在深度搜索中进行受控试错的推理时框架，以解决在多个 plausible 方向中如何有效选择搜索路径的问题，避免贪婪策略或无序探索带来的负面影响。

方法: 提出TreeSeeker框架，将搜索组织为基于树状状态的分支与返回搜索。每个分支代表子目标的暂定方向。在每一轮中，框架读取所有子目标树，识别活跃目标，并利用文本形式的上置信界信号（包含价值、不确定性和风险）来选择是利用有前景的分支、探索不确定的替代方案，还是剪枝无效延续并返回早期分支点。同时使用TreeMem模块将证据、不确定性、冲突、进展和失败线索附加到相应分支上，以指导后续决策。

主要发现: 在XBench-DeepSearch、BrowseComp和BrowseComp-ZH基准上的实验表明，TreeSeeker consistently 强于开源基线模型。

结论: 显式的分支与返回控制机制能够补充更强的推理和工具执行能力，提升深度搜索性能。

翻译: Deep search requires agents to answer complex questions through multi-step web search, browsing, evidence comparison, and synthesis. A central challenge is deciding how to search when several directions look plausible but only some will later lead to reliable evidence. If an agent greedily follows the current best-looking direction, it may keep extending a weak continuation. If it explores without discipline, it may waste budget on disconnected trials. We propose TreeSeeker, an inference-time framework for controlled trial-and-error in deep search. TreeSeeker organizes search as branch-and-return search over tree-structured states, where each branch is a tentative direction for a sub-goal. At each round, TreeSearch reads all sub-goal trees, identifies active goals, and uses textual UCB signals of value, uncertainty, and risk to select among exploiting a promising branch, exploring an uncertain alternative, or pruning an unproductive continuation and returning to an earlier branch point. TreeMem supports this control loop by keeping evidence, uncertainty, conflicts, progress, and failure cues attached to the branches that produced them, so trial outcomes can guide later decisions. Experiments on XBench-DeepSearch, BrowseComp, and BrowseComp-ZH show that TreeSeeker consistently outperforms strong open-source baselines, suggesting that explicit branch-and-return control complements stronger reasoning and tool execution.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决深度搜索智能体在面临多个看似可行的搜索方向时，如何有效分配搜索预算并控制试错过程的问题。具体而言，它旨在避免智能体盲目坚持当前看似最优的路径而陷入低效延续，或无序探索而浪费资源。该问题在研究和现实中非常重要，因为复杂问答任务需要多步检索与证据综合，若缺乏科学的分支管理与回溯机制，智能体极易因预算耗尽或路径错误而无法生成准确答案，严重影响长程推理任务的效率与可靠性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对深度搜索中多方向探索易陷入低效路径或预算浪费的问题，设计了基于树状结构的分支与回溯机制。该方法借鉴了传统探索与利用权衡思想及树搜索算法，但将其从数值奖励扩展为基于文本语义的评估规则。通过引入价值、不确定性和风险三个信号，模型能在每个决策轮次中自主决定延续、探索或剪枝返回，从而实现对搜索过程的精细化控制。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将深度搜索组织为基于树状结构的分支与回溯过程，通过并行维护多个探索方向并依据价值、不确定性和风险进行受控试错，从而避免盲目延续单一路径。整体流程首先将复杂问题拆解为子目标并构建对应的搜索树，随后控制器读取所有分支的状态信息，综合评估后决定继续推进、尝试新方向或剪枝返回。执行选定操作后，记忆模块会更新对应分支的证据与失败线索，该循环不断迭代直至综合生成最终答案。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种推理时框架，将深度搜索组织为基于树结构的分支与返回过程。其核心包含决策控制器与记忆模块，前者通过文本评估规则综合考量价值、不确定性和风险来决定继续、探索或剪枝返回，后者将证据与失败线索绑定到具体分支以支持结构化对比。与以往依赖单一路径或扁平化上下文管理的工作不同，该方法避免了盲目跟随当前最优方向或无序探索的缺陷，能够在有限预算下通过显式的分支试错控制，更高效地分配搜索资源并快速从无效路径中恢复。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了TreeSeeker框架，通过树状分支结构和基于文本的UCB决策机制，结合分支局部记忆，实现了深度搜索中受控的试错与分支回溯过程。

Abstract

Deep search requires agents to answer complex questions through multi-step web search, browsing, evidence comparison, and synthesis. A central challenge is deciding how to search when several directions look plausible but only some will later lead to reliable evidence. If an agent greedily follows the current best-looking direction, it may keep extending a weak continuation. If it explores without discipline, it may waste budget on disconnected trials. We propose TreeSeeker, an inference-time framework for controlled trial-and-error in deep search. TreeSeeker organizes search as branch-and-return search over tree-structured states, where each branch is a tentative direction for a sub-goal. At each round, TreeSearch reads all sub-goal trees, identifies active goals, and uses textual UCB signals of value, uncertainty, and risk to select among exploiting a promising branch, exploring an uncertain alternative, or pruning an unproductive continuation and returning to an earlier branch point. TreeMem supports this control loop by keeping evidence, uncertainty, conflicts, progress, and failure cues attached to the branches that produced them, so trial outcomes can guide later decisions. Experiments on XBench-DeepSearch, BrowseComp, and BrowseComp-ZH show that TreeSeeker consistently outperforms strong open-source baselines, suggesting that explicit branch-and-return control complements stronger reasoning and tool execution.

item.title: Blind Dexterous Grasping via Real2Sim2Real Tactile Policy Learning
item.author: Shengcheng Luo, Xiyan Huang, Zhe Xu, Wanlin Li, Ziyuan Jiao, Chenxi Xiao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种用于灵巧手盲抓取的触觉-only框架，该框架可部署在物理多指机械手上。通过构建接触校准的数字孪生模拟器、使用布局感知触觉编码器增强稀疏触觉信号的表达能力，以及训练对象特定的强化学习专家并聚合其成功抓取轨迹到触觉条件扩散策略中，实现了在真实世界中的盲抓取。在配备分布式触觉传感器的LEAP手上的实验表明，该方法在未见过的物体上也能实现27%的抓取成功率，无需真实世界抓取演示或视觉输入。

背景: 使用灵巧手进行盲抓取是一项关键的操纵能力。然而，由于触觉仿真到现实的差距以及稀疏触觉信号表达能力的有限性，学习仅依赖触觉的策略在真实机器人上仍然具有挑战性。

目的: 提出一种可部署在物理多指机械手上的仅触觉盲抓取框架，以解决触觉仿真到现实的差距问题，并提高稀疏触觉信号在抓取任务中的表达能力和泛化能力。

方法: 1. 引入Real2Sim触觉校准流水线，构建能够复现真实触觉信号的接触校准数字孪生模拟器。2. 使用布局感知触觉编码器，通过自监督预训练结合传感器几何先验，提高稀疏触觉观测的表达能力。3. 在校准的模拟器中训练对象特定的强化学习专家，并将其成功抓取轨迹聚合到触觉条件扩散策略中，以提高对未见物体的泛化能力。

主要发现: 在配备分布式触觉传感器的LEAP手上进行的实验显示，所部署的策略在20个物体（包括10个已见和10个未见物体）上实现了27%的真实世界抓取成功率，且无需真实世界抓取演示或视觉输入。仿真消融实验表明，布局感知触觉预训练提高了抓取性能。传感级评估证实，Real2Sim校准增加了仿真与硬件之间触觉接触事件的一致性。

结论: 接触事件校准、几何感知触觉表示学习以及基于扩散的策略聚合为在真实灵巧机械手上实现仅触觉盲抓取提供了一条有效途径。

翻译: Blind grasping with a dexterous hand is a crucial manipulation capability. Nevertheless, learning such tactile-only policies for real robots remains challenging due to the tactile sim-to-real gap and the limited expressiveness of sparse tactile signals. To bridge this gap, we propose a framework for tactile-only blind grasping that is deployable on a physical multi-fingered robotic hand. Our approach combines three key components. First, we introduce a Real2Sim tactile calibration pipeline that constructs a contact-calibrated digital-twin simulator capable of reproducing real tactile signals. Second, we improve the expressiveness of sparse tactile observations using a layout-aware tactile encoder, which incorporates sensor-geometry priors through self-supervised pretraining. Third, to improve generalization to unseen objects, we train object-specific reinforcement-learning experts in the calibrated simulator and aggregate their successful grasp trajectories into a tactile-conditioned Diffusion Policy. We evaluate our method on a physical LEAP Hand equipped with distributed tactile sensing across 10 seen and 10 unseen objects. The deployed policy achieves a 27% real-world grasp success rate across all 20 objects, without real-world grasping demonstrations or visual input. Simulation ablations show that layout-aware tactile pretraining improves grasping performance, while sensing-level evaluations confirm that Real2Sim calibration increases the consistency of tactile contact events between simulation and hardware. Together, these results suggest that contact-event calibration, geometry-aware tactile representation learning, and diffusion-based policy aggregation provide an effective path toward tactile-only blind grasping on real dexterous robotic hands. Project page:Dex-Blind-Grasp.github.io.

Abstract

Blind grasping with a dexterous hand is a crucial manipulation capability. Nevertheless, learning such tactile-only policies for real robots remains challenging due to the tactile sim-to-real gap and the limited expressiveness of sparse tactile signals. To bridge this gap, we propose a framework for tactile-only blind grasping that is deployable on a physical multi-fingered robotic hand. Our approach combines three key components. First, we introduce a Real2Sim tactile calibration pipeline that constructs a contact-calibrated digital-twin simulator capable of reproducing real tactile signals. Second, we improve the expressiveness of sparse tactile observations using a layout-aware tactile encoder, which incorporates sensor-geometry priors through self-supervised pretraining. Third, to improve generalization to unseen objects, we train object-specific reinforcement-learning experts in the calibrated simulator and aggregate their successful grasp trajectories into a tactile-conditioned Diffusion Policy. We evaluate our method on a physical LEAP Hand equipped with distributed tactile sensing across 10 seen and 10 unseen objects. The deployed policy achieves a 27\% real-world grasp success rate across all 20 objects, without real-world grasping demonstrations or visual input. Simulation ablations show that layout-aware tactile pretraining improves grasping performance, while sensing-level evaluations confirm that Real2Sim calibration increases the consistency of tactile contact events between simulation and hardware. Together, these results suggest that contact-event calibration, geometry-aware tactile representation learning, and diffusion-based policy aggregation provide an effective path toward tactile-only blind grasping on real dexterous robotic hands. Project page:Dex-Blind-Grasp.github.io.

item.title: MultiToP: Learning to Patch Visual Tokens to Mitigate Hallucinations in Video Large Multimodal Models
item.author: Yuansheng Gao, Wenbin Xing, Jiahao Yuan, Kaiwen Zhou, Han Bao, Zonghui Wang, Wenzhi Chen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为MultiToP的多模态上下文感知视觉令牌修补框架，旨在通过语言生成前修正不可靠的视觉令牌来减轻视频大语言模型中的幻觉问题。

背景: 视频大语言模型在视频理解方面取得了显著进展，但仍容易产生幻觉，即生成的回答无法由输入视频忠实支持。

目的: 减轻视频大语言模型中的幻觉问题，通过修正不可靠的视觉令牌来提高生成回答的准确性。

方法: 提出MultiToP框架，包含一个轻量级的视觉令牌修补器，用于预测令牌级替换分布并选择性地将不可靠的视觉令牌替换为动态全局修补令牌。训练修补器时采用信息引导的秩校准方法，利用骨干网络导出的答案条件帧级信息线索指导令牌替换，并结合真实答案监督和稀疏性正则化，在不修改原始模型的情况下实现局部视觉证据修正。

主要发现: 在Vript-HAL数据集上，MultiToP有效减少了幻觉，推理开销可忽略不计，使Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct的F1分数比原始模型提高了百分之五十点六零。同时，MultiToP保持了通用的视频理解能力，在ActivityNet-QA数据集上使Video-LLaVA-7B的相对准确率提高了百分之十八点五八。

结论: MultiToP是一种有效的减轻视频大语言模型幻觉的方法，能够在不修改原始模型的情况下提升模型性能，同时保持通用视频理解能力。

翻译: Video Large Multimodal Models have achieved remarkable progress in video understanding, yet they remain prone to hallucinations, where generated responses are not faithfully supported by the input video. In this paper, we propose MultiToP, a multimodal-context-aware visual token patching framework that mitigates hallucinations by refining unreliable visual tokens before language generation. MultiToP introduces a lightweight Visual Token Patcher to predict token-level replacement distributions and selectively substitute unreliable visual tokens with a dynamic global patch token. To train the patcher effectively, we further propose information-guided rank calibration, which uses answer-conditioned frame-level information cues derived from the backbone to guide token replacement. Combined with ground-truth answer supervision and sparsity regularization, MultiToP enables localized visual evidence refinement without modifying the original model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MultiToP effectively reduces hallucinations on Vript-HAL with negligible inference overhead, improving the F1 scores of Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct by 50.60% over the vanilla model. Meanwhile, MultiToP preserves general video understanding ability, yielding an 18.58% relative accuracy gain on ActivityNet-QA for Video-LLaVA-7B.

Abstract

Video Large Multimodal Models have achieved remarkable progress in video understanding, yet they remain prone to hallucinations, where generated responses are not faithfully supported by the input video. In this paper, we propose MultiToP, a multimodal-context-aware visual token patching framework that mitigates hallucinations by refining unreliable visual tokens before language generation. MultiToP introduces a lightweight Visual Token Patcher to predict token-level replacement distributions and selectively substitute unreliable visual tokens with a dynamic global patch token. To train the patcher effectively, we further propose information-guided rank calibration, which uses answer-conditioned frame-level information cues derived from the backbone to guide token replacement. Combined with ground-truth answer supervision and sparsity regularization, MultiToP enables localized visual evidence refinement without modifying the original model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MultiToP effectively reduces hallucinations on Vript-HAL with negligible inference overhead, improving the F1 scores of Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct by 50.60% over the vanilla model. Meanwhile, MultiToP preserves general video understanding ability, yielding an 18.58% relative accuracy gain on ActivityNet-QA for Video-LLaVA-7B.

item.title: GraspLLM: Towards Zero-Shot Generalization on Text-Attributed Graphs with LLMs
item.author: Hengyi Feng, Zeang Sheng, Meiyi Qiang, Li Yang, Wentao Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: GraspLLM是一个结合图结构理解与大语言模型语义理解能力的框架，旨在提升跨数据集和跨任务的泛化能力。

背景: 文本属性图研究因在引用网络、电商平台、社交媒体和网页等现实场景中的广泛应用而受到关注。大语言模型在语义理解方面表现出色，已有多种尝试将其整合到文本属性图中。

目的: 解决现有方法在跨不同图和任务时泛化能力不足，以及捕捉可迁移图结构模式能力有限的问题。

方法: 使用冻结的通用嵌入模型将不同图的节点文本表示到统一的语义空间；在多个由子图诱导的邻接矩阵上进行感知子图的对比学习以提取数据集无关的结构信息；提出最优上下文子图，为每个目标节点提取最相关的子图，并通过对齐投影器将这些子图与大语言模型的词元空间对齐。

主要发现: 在涵盖不同领域的文本属性图基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，GraspLLM consistently 优于以往的基于大语言模型的文本属性图方法，特别是在零样本场景中，显示出强大的跨数据集和跨任务泛化能力。

结论: GraspLLM通过结合图结构理解与大语言模型语义理解，有效提升了跨数据集和跨任务的泛化性能。

翻译: Research on Text-Attributed Graphs (TAGs) has gained significant attention recently due to its broad applications across various real-world data scenarios, such as citation networks, e-commerce platforms, social media, and web pages. Inspired by the remarkable semantic understanding ability of Large Language Models (LLMs), there have been numerous attempts to integrate LLMs into TAGs. However, existing methods still struggle to generalize across diverse graphs and tasks, and their ability to capture transferable graph structural patterns remains limited. To address this, we introduce the GraspLLM, a framework that combines Graph structural comprehension with semantic understanding prowess of LLMs to enhance the cross-dataset and cross-task generalizability. Specifically, we represent node texts from different graphs in a unified semantic space with a frozen general embedding model, on top of which we perform motif-aware contrastive learning across multiple motif-induced adjacency matrices to extract dataset-agnostic structural information. Then, with our proposed optimal contextual subgraph, we extract the most contextually relevant subgraph for each target node and align these subgraphs to the token space of LLM via an alignment projector. Extensive experiments on TAG benchmark datasets spanning diverse domains reveal that GraspLLM consistently outperforms previous LLM-based methods for TAGs, especially in zero-shot scenarios, highlighting its strong generalizability across different datasets and tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/Heinz217/GraspLLM.

Abstract

Research on Text-Attributed Graphs (TAGs) has gained significant attention recently due to its broad applications across various real-world data scenarios, such as citation networks, e-commerce platforms, social media, and web pages. Inspired by the remarkable semantic understanding ability of Large Language Models (LLMs), there have been numerous attempts to integrate LLMs into TAGs. However, existing methods still struggle to generalize across diverse graphs and tasks, and their ability to capture transferable graph structural patterns remains limited. To address this, we introduce the GraspLLM, a framework that combines Graph structural comprehension with semantic understanding prowess of LLMs to enhance the cross-dataset and cross-task generalizability. Specifically, we represent node texts from different graphs in a unified semantic space with a frozen general embedding model, on top of which we perform motif-aware contrastive learning across multiple motif-induced adjacency matrices to extract dataset-agnostic structural information. Then, with our proposed optimal contextual subgraph, we extract the most contextually relevant subgraph for each target node and align these subgraphs to the token space of LLM via an alignment projector. Extensive experiments on TAG benchmark datasets spanning diverse domains reveal that GraspLLM consistently outperforms previous LLM-based methods for TAGs, especially in zero-shot scenarios, highlighting its strong generalizability across different datasets and tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/Heinz217/GraspLLM.

item.title: Frozen Multimodal Embeddings for AI-Assisted Interview Assessment of Personality and Cognitive Ability
item.author: Kuo-En Hung, Hung-Yue Suen, Shih-Ching Yeh, Hsiang-Wen Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文针对异步视频面试中的心理特质预测问题，提出了一种基于小样本表征学习的多模态建模方案，在ACM多媒体AVI挑战赛中取得了优于官方基线的性能。

背景: 在AI辅助面试评估中，由于标注数据集有限且每次回答包含高维度的视觉、听觉和语言信号，从异步视频面试中预测心理特质是一个具有挑战性的问题。

目的: 解决ACM多媒体AVI挑战赛2026中的两个任务：任务一预测基于自我报告的HEXACO人格特质，任务二对结构化异步视频面试回答中的认知能力水平进行分类。

方法: 将问题视为小样本表征学习任务，不使用大型预训练模型的微调，而是采用冻结的多模态编码器（包括用于视觉特征的CLIP、用于听觉特征和转录的Whisper，以及用于文本表示的RoBERTa、E5和DeBERTaV3），并连接低容量的下游模型。对于任务一，采用特定于特质的回归和晚期融合系统；对于任务二，采用多模态集成方法。

主要发现: 在任务一中，特定于特质的晚期融合系统实现了平均验证均方误差为0.2696，相比官方基线0.3334有显著提升，通过从全局模型到特定特质建模再到特定特质晚期融合的三步改进，实现了相对均方误差19.1%的降低。在任务二中，紧凑的主体属性基线准确率达到0.5781，多模态集成准确率达到0.5313，均高于官方基线0.4062，但结果可能反映了验证集中存在主体属性捷径而非稳健的认知能力推断。

结论: 基于异步视频面试的心理评估受益于特定于特质的多模态建模，但认知能力预测需要仔细控制数据集中的捷径问题。

翻译: Predicting psychological traits from asynchronous video interviews (AVIs) is a challenging problem in AI-assisted interview assessment because labeled datasets are limited while each response contains high-dimensional visual, acoustic, and verbal signals. This paper presents our solution for the ACM Multimedia AVI Challenge 2026, which evaluates two tasks: Track~1 predicts self-reported HEXACO personality traits from personality-related interview responses, and Track~2 classifies cognitive ability levels from structured AVI responses. We treat the problem as a small-sample representation learning task. Instead of fine-tuning large pretrained models, we use frozen multimodal encoders, including CLIP for visual features, Whisper for acoustic features and transcripts, and RoBERTa, E5, and DeBERTaV3 for textual representations, followed by low-capacity downstream models. For Track~1, our trait-specific regression and late-fusion system achieves an average validation MSE of 0.2696, improving over the official baseline of 0.3334. Ablation results show a three-step improvement from a global model (0.3189), to per-trait modeling (0.2871), to per-trait late fusion (0.2696), corresponding to a 19.1% relative MSE reduction over the official baseline. For Track~2, a compact subject-attribute baseline reaches 0.5781 accuracy, while our multimodal ensemble reaches 0.5313, both above the official baseline of 0.4062. We interpret this result as evidence of possible subject-attribute shortcuts in the validation split rather than robust cognitive inference from AVI content. Overall, our findings suggest that AVI-based psychological assessment benefits from trait-specific multimodal modeling, but cognitive ability prediction requires careful control of dataset shortcuts.

Abstract

Predicting psychological traits from asynchronous video interviews (AVIs) is a challenging problem in AI-assisted interview assessment because labeled datasets are limited while each response contains high-dimensional visual, acoustic, and verbal signals. This paper presents our solution for the ACM Multimedia AVI Challenge 2026, which evaluates two tasks: Track~1 predicts self-reported HEXACO personality traits from personality-related interview responses, and Track~2 classifies cognitive ability levels from structured AVI responses. We treat the problem as a small-sample representation learning task. Instead of fine-tuning large pretrained models, we use frozen multimodal encoders, including CLIP for visual features, Whisper for acoustic features and transcripts, and RoBERTa, E5, and DeBERTaV3 for textual representations, followed by low-capacity downstream models. For Track~1, our trait-specific regression and late-fusion system achieves an average validation MSE of 0.2696, improving over the official baseline of 0.3334. Ablation results show a three-step improvement from a global model (0.3189), to per-trait modeling (0.2871), to per-trait late fusion (0.2696), corresponding to a 19.1% relative MSE reduction over the official baseline. For Track~2, a compact subject-attribute baseline reaches 0.5781 accuracy, while our multimodal ensemble reaches 0.5313, both above the official baseline of 0.4062. We interpret this result as evidence of possible subject-attribute shortcuts in the validation split rather than robust cognitive inference from AVI content. Overall, our findings suggest that AVI-based psychological assessment benefits from trait-specific multimodal modeling, but cognitive ability prediction requires careful control of dataset shortcuts.

item.title: FORT-Searcher: Synthesizing Shortcut-Resistant Search Tasks for Training Deep Search Agents
item.author: Deng, Jia, Chen, Yimeng, Xiang, Xiaoqing, Zeng, Ziyang, Tang, Shuo, Zhao, Wayne Xin, Chang, Feng, Hao, Chuan, Wei, Yuan, Tao, Ran, Dai, Bryan, Wen, Ji-Rong
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 FORT 的框架，用于合成具有抗捷径能力的训练数据，以训练深度搜索代理。该框架通过控制实体选择、证据图构建、问题生成和对抗性优化过程中的捷径风险，解决了现有合成方法中结构复杂性无法保证实际搜索难度的问题。实验表明，FORT 生成的训练数据能诱导更长的预答案搜索路径并减少捷径模式，使用这些数据仅通过监督微调训练的 FORT-Searcher 在具有挑战性的深度搜索基准测试中取得了最佳性能。

背景: 训练深度搜索代理需要可验证的问题，其答案在通过搜索获取足够证据之前不可用。现有的合成方法通常通过丰富图结构来增加表观难度，但仅凭结构复杂性并不能保证实现搜索难度，因为预期的搜索过程可能通过更便宜的识别路径而崩溃。

目的: 形式化捷径意识难度框架，识别四种可操作的捷径风险（证据共覆盖、单线索选择性、暴露常量和先验知识绑定），并开发一种框架来合成抗捷径的训练数据，以解决现有方法中搜索难度无法保证的问题。

方法: 提出 FORT（抗捷径训练数据合成框架），通过控制实体选择、证据图构建、问题生成和对抗性优化过程中的捷径风险来构建抗捷径训练数据。使用轨迹签名（解决成本、答案命中时间和先验捷径率）来诊断捷径风险的实际影响。

主要发现: FORT 生成的训练数据相比现有的开源深度搜索数据集，能诱导更长的预答案搜索路径并减少捷径模式。仅通过监督微调训练 FORT-Searcher，在具有挑战性的深度搜索基准测试中取得了最佳整体性能。

结论: FORT 框架有效解决了深度搜索代理训练数据合成中的捷径问题，提升了模型的搜索能力和性能，相关资源将公开。

翻译: Training deep search agents requires verifiable questions whose answers remain unavailable until sufficient evidence has been acquired through search. Existing synthesis methods often increase apparent difficulty by enriching graph structures, but structural complexity alone does not guarantee realized search difficulty: the intended search process can collapse through a cheaper identifying route. We formalize this gap with a shortcut-aware difficulty framework and identify four actionable shortcut risks: evidence co-coverage, single-clue selectivity, exposed constants, and prior-knowledge binding. To diagnose their realized effects, we use trajectory signatures including solving cost, answer hit time, and prior-shortcut rate. Guided by this framework, we introduce FORT, a Framework of Shortcut-Resistant Training-Data Synthesis. FORT constructs shortcut-resistant training data by controlling shortcut risks across entity selection, evidence graph construction, question formulation, and adversarial refinement. Experiments show that FORT induces longer pre-answer search and fewer shortcut patterns than existing open-source deep search datasets. Using the resulting trajectories, we train FORT-Searcher with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) only, and it achieves the best overall performance among comparable-size open-source search agents on challenging deep search benchmarks. Relevant resources will be made available at this https URL .

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有深度搜索智能体训练数据合成方法中结构复杂但实际检索容易的问题，即智能体常通过捷径绕过预期的多步证据收集过程。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为若训练数据无法强制模型进行长程搜索与信息综合，将严重限制智能体在开放网络中持续发现证据和解决复杂问题的能力。消除这些捷径风险是提升智能体实际检索规划与推理性能的关键。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有合成方法仅通过增加图结构复杂度来提升难度，但智能体仍可能通过更便宜的捷径绕过预期搜索过程。为此，他们构建了捷径感知难度框架，识别出证据共覆盖、单线索选择性、暴露常量和先验知识绑定四类风险，并据此设计了全流程数据合成方法。该方法在实体筛选、证据图构建、问题生成和对抗优化等环节针对性规避上述风险。作者确实借鉴了现有工作，针对传统检索数据集和近期深度搜索合成方法中结构复杂不等于实际难的缺陷进行了改进。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是构建抗捷径的训练数据，确保智能体在搜索时必须按预定步骤逐步获取证据，而不是通过单一线索、已知信息或捷径直接得出答案。整体实现流程分为四个阶段：首先筛选冷门实体以减少模型依赖已有知识；接着从多源收集事实构建证据网络，避免线索重叠或结构单一；然后设计问题，隐去中间名称并将具体数值模糊化，迫使模型进行多步推理；最后利用强搜索代理对草稿问题进行对抗测试，自动修复存在捷径或表述不清的题目。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点在于提出了一种抗捷径的训练数据合成框架，并构建了基于捷径感知的难度评估体系。相比以往仅通过增加问题结构复杂度来提升难度的方法，该工作系统识别并控制了证据共覆盖、单线索选择性、暴露常量和先验知识绑定四类捷径风险。通过在全流程中主动压制这些风险并借助搜索轨迹特征进行验证，该方法生成的数据能迫使模型进行更长的真实搜索，从而在同等规模下取得了更优的搜索智能体训练效果。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种抗捷径训练数据合成框架，通过控制数据构建各环节的风险生成高质量训练数据，并仅使用监督微调训练出搜索智能体，在多个深度搜索基准测试中取得了开源同类模型的最佳性能。

Abstract

Training deep search agents requires verifiable questions whose answers remain unavailable until sufficient evidence has been acquired through search. Existing synthesis methods often increase apparent difficulty by enriching graph structures, but structural complexity alone does not guarantee realized search difficulty: the intended search process can collapse through a cheaper identifying route. We formalize this gap with a shortcut-aware difficulty framework and identify four actionable shortcut risks: evidence co-coverage, single-clue selectivity, exposed constants, and prior-knowledge binding. To diagnose their realized effects, we use trajectory signatures including solving cost, answer hit time, and prior-shortcut rate. Guided by this framework, we introduce FORT, a Framework of Shortcut-Resistant Training-Data Synthesis. FORT constructs shortcut-resistant training data by controlling shortcut risks across entity selection, evidence graph construction, question formulation, and adversarial refinement. Experiments show that FORT induces longer pre-answer search and fewer shortcut patterns than existing open-source deep search datasets. Using the resulting trajectories, we train FORT-Searcher with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) only, and it achieves the best overall performance among comparable-size open-source search agents on challenging deep search benchmarks. Relevant resources will be made available at this https URL .

item.title: DrivingAgent: Design and Scheduling Agents for Autonomous Driving Systems
item.author: Zhongyu Xia, Wenhao Chen, Yongtao Wang, Ming-Hsuan Yang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为DrivingAgent的新型智能体框架，旨在解决自动驾驶系统中基础模型集成带来的设计复杂性和实时调度挑战。该框架在系统设计和实时调度两个阶段分别实现了自动化模块开发和动态模块编排，并在nuScenes和Bench2Drive基准测试中展现了优越的速度与精度平衡。

背景: 许多自动驾驶系统正越来越多地采用基础模型以提升泛化能力并处理长尾场景。然而，这一趋势引入了两个关键挑战：一是设计和集成新模型的过程需要大量人工且耗时；二是缺乏智能的动态调度机制来满足严格的实时约束。现有的基于大型语言模型的智能体框架不适合自动驾驶，因为它们未能区分系统设计与实时调度的不同需求，将模块视为不透明的黑盒，且未针对连续运行进行设计。

目的: 解决自动驾驶系统设计和调度双重挑战，实现模块开发的自动化和实时调度的智能化，以克服现有框架在自动化程度、模块透明度和连续运行能力方面的不足。

方法: 提出DrivingAgent框架，包含两个阶段：在设计阶段，通过解析系统架构、生成代码以及利用超网络训练验证模块，实现模块开发的自动化；在调度阶段，采用通过强化学习训练的轻量级大型语言模型，结合集成长期存储和带时间戳短期上下文的结构化记忆，动态编排系统模块以满足实时需求。

主要发现: 在nuScenes和Bench2Drive基准测试中，DrivingAgent实现了优越的速度与精度平衡。

结论: DrivingAgent框架能够有效应对自动驾驶系统设计和调度中的挑战，通过自动化模块开发和动态实时调度，提升了系统的性能和效率。
