Our code is available at https://github.com/UConn-DSIS/TimeRouter.

item.title: Benchmarking Neural Speech Compression from a Rate-Distortion Perspective
item.author: Jun Xu, Zhengxue Cheng, Fengxi Zhang, Yuhan Liu, Li Song, Wenjun Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于熵约束的神经语音编解码器ECC，旨在优化低比特率下的语音压缩性能。

背景: 基于学习的语音压缩在低比特率下表现良好，但许多神经语音编解码器仍使用预设速率的离散符号描述量化潜在变量，或在符号生成后才应用熵编码。这种设计将表示学习与概率建模解耦，限制了其对学习到的语音潜在变量非均匀使用和时序依赖性的利用能力。

目的: 从率失真角度对神经语音压缩进行基准测试，并进一步研究用于低比特率语音压缩的熵约束编码。

方法: 提出ECC（熵约束编解码器），结合标量量化与学习到的熵模型。ECC整合了基于超先验的侧信息、通道级上下文建模、潜在残差预测和轻量级时序建模，以在训练期间估计潜在似然率并在推理期间进行算术编码。此外，引入熵跳过机制，利用解码器可用的尺度估计忽略高度可预测的残差符号，而无需传输额外的跳过掩码。

主要发现: ECC在低比特率下实现了有利的率失真权衡，在两个广泛使用的测试集上，ViSQOL和PESQ的平均BD-rate分别降低了百分之三十九点九和百分之七十六点三。消融和诊断研究进一步验证了熵建模的有效性。

结论: ECC通过结合标量量化与学习到的熵模型，并引入熵跳过机制，显著提升了低比特率语音压缩的效率，优于传统的和神经编解码器基线。

翻译: Learning-based speech compression has achieved promising low-bitrate performance, but many neural speech codecs still describe quantized latents with preset-rate discrete symbols or apply entropy coding only after symbol generation. Such designs decouple representation learning from probability modeling, limiting their ability to exploit the non-uniform usage and temporal dependencies of learned speech latents. In this paper, we benchmark neural speech compression from a rate--distortion perspective and further investigate entropy-constrained coding for low-bitrate speech compression. We first formulate a unified learning-based speech coding pipeline and provide a benchmark-style analysis of recent neural speech codecs, showing that explicit probability modeling remains underexplored in learned speech compression. We then propose ECC, an Entropy-Constrained Codec that combines scalar quantization with a learned entropy model. ECC integrates hyperprior-based side information, channel-wise context modeling, latent residual prediction, and lightweight temporal modeling to estimate latent likelihoods for rate estimation during training and arithmetic coding during inference. To further improve low-bitrate efficiency, ECC introduces entropy skip, which omits highly predictable residual symbols using decoder-available scale estimates without transmitting additional skip masks. Extensive experiments show that ECC achieves a favorable low-bitrate rate--distortion trade-off over conventional and neural codec baselines, reducing BD-rate by 39.9% on ViSQOL and 76.3% on PESQ on average over two widely-used test sets. Ablation and diagnostic studies further validate the effectiveness of entropy modeling. Project Page: https://avery-xu.github.io/ECC-demo/

Abstract

Learning-based speech compression has achieved promising low-bitrate performance, but many neural speech codecs still describe quantized latents with preset-rate discrete symbols or apply entropy coding only after symbol generation. Such designs decouple representation learning from probability modeling, limiting their ability to exploit the non-uniform usage and temporal dependencies of learned speech latents. In this paper, we benchmark neural speech compression from a rate--distortion perspective and further investigate entropy-constrained coding for low-bitrate speech compression. We first formulate a unified learning-based speech coding pipeline and provide a benchmark-style analysis of recent neural speech codecs, showing that explicit probability modeling remains underexplored in learned speech compression. We then propose ECC, an Entropy-Constrained Codec that combines scalar quantization with a learned entropy model. ECC integrates hyperprior-based side information, channel-wise context modeling, latent residual prediction, and lightweight temporal modeling to estimate latent likelihoods for rate estimation during training and arithmetic coding during inference. To further improve low-bitrate efficiency, ECC introduces entropy skip, which omits highly predictable residual symbols using decoder-available scale estimates without transmitting additional skip masks. Extensive experiments show that ECC achieves a favorable low-bitrate rate--distortion trade-off over conventional and neural codec baselines, reducing BD-rate by 39.9% on ViSQOL and 76.3% on PESQ on average over two widely-used test sets. Ablation and diagnostic studies further validate the effectiveness of entropy modeling. Project Page: https://avery-xu.github.io/ECC-demo/

item.title: Sparse probes and murky physics: a case study of interpretability challenges in a foundation model for continuum dynamics
item.author: Katherine Rosenfeld, Maike Sonnewald
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文探讨了生成式人工智能模拟器在科学领域的应用，特别是针对连续介质动力学的跨领域基础模型。通过机械可解释性方法，研究模型内部机制与已知物理规律的一致性，并分析模型成功或失败的原因。

背景: 生成式人工智能模拟器在已有强理论、基准测试和物理直觉的科学领域中被广泛使用。

目的: 评估和解释当基础模型能够重现已知的连续介质动力学时，其内部机制如何支持该行为，内部行为是否与已知物理一致，以及这与模型成功或失败的关系。

方法: 使用Polymathic的Walrus模型作为跨领域基础模型，通过机械可解释性方法，应用稀疏自编码器探测选定层，并利用涡度作为物理基准指标对超过两万种特征进行筛选。以剪切流为测试床，比较不同剪切流设置下的特征招募情况。

主要发现: 发现特征招募在不同设置下表现出分段一致性，但结构是间歇性的，无法清晰映射到标准物理分解。数值模拟与模拟器输出之间存在系统性差异，包括能量或结构过于弥散或过于集中的情况。这些差异与稀疏自编码器特征使用的变化有关。

结论: 研究提出了科学基础模型中的开放性问题，包括如何稳健地优先选择具有机制意义的特征，如何区分稳定结构与分析伪影，以及如何利用现有基准判断内部表示的差异是否具有真正信息价值。

翻译: Generative AI emulators are increasingly used in scientific domains where we already have strong theory, benchmarks, and physical intuition. This raises a central evaluation and interpretability question: when a foundation-style model can reproduce known continuum dynamics, what internal mechanism supports that behavior, is the internal behaviour consistent with known physics, and how does it relate to where the emulator succeeds or fails? We investigate a cross-domain foundation model for continuum dynamics, Walrus by Polymathic, using mechanistic interpretability guided by physical principles. We apply a sparse autoencoder to probe a selected layer, and address the practical challenge of triaging a large feature set using enstrophy as a physically grounded metric. As a deliberately simple testbed, we focus on shear flow and compare feature recruitment across multiple shear-flow setups. Across setups we find evidence of piecewise consistency, with subsets of features recurring in similar roles, but this structure is intermittent and does not map cleanly onto standard physical decompositions. In parallel, direct comparisons between numerical simulation and the emulator reveal systematic output-level discrepancies, including regimes where energy or structures become too diffuse or too localized. We connect parts of these discrepancies to changes in specific sparse autoencoder feature usage. Our work highlights open questions for scientific foundation models: how to robustly prioritize mechanistically meaningful features, how to separate stable structure from analysis artifacts, and how to use established benchmarks to decide when different internal representations are genuinely informative rather than merely effective.

Abstract

Generative AI emulators are increasingly used in scientific domains where we already have strong theory, benchmarks, and physical intuition. This raises a central evaluation and interpretability question: when a foundation-style model can reproduce known continuum dynamics, what internal mechanism supports that behavior, is the internal behaviour consistent with known physics, and how does it relate to where the emulator succeeds or fails? We investigate a cross-domain foundation model for continuum dynamics, Walrus by Polymathic, using mechanistic interpretability guided by physical principles. We apply a sparse autoencoder (SAE) to probe a selected layer, and address the practical challenge of triaging a large feature set (over 20,000) using enstrophy as a physically grounded metric. As a deliberately simple testbed, we focus on shear flow and compare feature recruitment across multiple shear-flow setups, i.e. parameter values in the numerical simulation. Across setups we find evidence of piecewise consistency, with subsets of features recurring in similar roles, but this structure is intermittent and does not map cleanly onto standard physical decompositions. In parallel, direct comparisons between numerical simulation and the emulator reveal systematic output-level discrepancies, including regimes where energy/structures become too diffuse or too localized. We connect parts of these discrepancies to changes in specific SAE feature usage. Our work highlights open questions for scientific foundation models: how to robustly prioritize mechanistically meaningful features, how to separate stable structure from analysis artifacts (including single-layer and SAE limitations), and how to use established benchmarks to decide when "different" internal representations are genuinely informative rather than merely effective.

item.title: SpAArSIST: Sparsified AASIST for Efficient and Reliable Anti-Spoofing
item.author: Anton Firc, Vojtěch Staněk, Zbyněk Lička, Kamil Malinka, Martin Perešíni
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为SpAArSIST的面向部署的AASIST图池化后端优化方案，通过替换学习池化和堆叠节点注意力机制为显式轻量级选择，显著降低了计算量和模型大小，同时提升了域外鲁棒性。

背景: AASIST是广泛用于基于自监督学习的反欺骗任务的图池化后端，但现有公开实现中存在冗余操作。

目的: 解决现有实现中的冗余操作问题，优化模型以支持更高效的部署。

方法: 将学习池化和堆叠节点注意力替换为显式轻量级选择，包括分离的训练和推理图池化比率、基于幅度的节点评分以及图节点的平均聚合。

主要发现: 最佳配置将后端计算量降低了百分之二十点七，模型大小减少了百分之四点一，同时将域外鲁棒性指标提升至百分之二点八二和零点零七八，并在ASVspoof5上保持竞争力。

结论: 提供了一种综合选择分数，用于总结准确性、校准和计算量，以支持平衡的面向部署的模型选择。

翻译: We present SpAArSIST, a deployment-oriented refinement of the widely used AASIST graph pooling backend for self-supervised learning based anti-spoofing. Motivated by redundant operations in public implementations, we replace learned pooling and stack-node attention with explicit, lightweight choices: separate train and inference graph pooling ratios, magnitude-based node scoring, and mean aggregation of graph nodes. The best overall configuration cuts backend compute by 20.7 percent and model size by 4.1 percent, while improving out-of-domain robustness on In-the-Wild to 2.82 percent EER and 0.078 minDCF, and remaining competitive on ASVspoof5. We further provide a composite selection score that summarizes accuracy, calibration, and compute to support balanced deployment-oriented model choice.

Abstract

We present SpAArSIST, a deployment-oriented refinement of the widely used AASIST graph pooling backend for self-supervised learning (SSL) based anti-spoofing. Motivated by redundant operations in public implementations, we replace learned pooling and stack-node attention with explicit, lightweight choices: separate train and inference graph pooling ratios $(k_{\mathrm{tr}},k_{\mathrm{inf}})$, magnitude-based node scoring, and mean aggregation of graph nodes. The best overall configuration (rank 1) cuts backend compute by 20.7% (195.045M $\rightarrow$ 154.706M MACs) and model size by 4.1% (611.8k $\rightarrow$ 586.4k params), while improving out-of-domain robustness on In-the-Wild to 2.82% EER and 0.078 minDCF (from 4.64% and 0.133) and remaining competitive on ASVspoof5. We further provide a composite selection score that summarizes accuracy, calibration, and compute to support balanced deployment-oriented model choice.

item.title: ICA Lens: Interpreting Language Models Without Training Another Dictionary
item.author: Liu, Sida, Han, Feijiang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于独立成分分析的实用工作流程ICALens，用于高效、稳定地分析大型语言模型表示中的可解释方向，结果表明该方法在稀疏探测和目标探针扰动任务中表现优异，可作为探索语言模型表示的有效初始工具。

背景: 在大型语言模型表示中寻找可解释方向对于理解和控制模型行为至关重要。稀疏自编码器已成为该目的的标准工具，但使用它们作为默认首选方法通常需要训练、存储和评估大型超完备字典，这一瓶颈限制了快速探索。

目的: 探讨在训练另一个神经字典之前，激活几何结构中已经可见多少可解释结构，并重新评估独立成分分析作为语言模型可解释性紧凑透镜的潜力。

方法: 提出ICALens，这是第一个用于大型语言模型表示的稳定、高效且可审计的独立成分分析实用工作流程。它结合了优化的GPU并行FastICA流水线、针对大型语言模型特定的稳定性配方以及更好的拟合诊断工具，实现了高效的逐层分析。

主要发现: 独立成分分析在大型语言模型可解释性方面被低估了，因为之前的使用往往依赖于在大型语言模型激活上表现脆弱的现成实现，并且缺乏检查和评估恢复方向的系统工具。ICALens在GPT-2 Small、Gemma 2 2B和Qwen 3.5 2B Base模型上高效恢复了紧凑且人类可解释的方向，无需逐层基于梯度的字典训练。在SAEBench上，ICA在稀疏探测方面与公开稀疏自编码器相当，在小到中等预算下在目标探针扰动任务中优于它们。

结论: 独立成分分析不应被视为弱基线，而应被视为探索语言模型表示的高效且互补的初始透镜。

翻译: 在大型语言模型表示中寻找可解释方向对于理解和控制模型行为至关重要。稀疏自编码器已成为此目的的标准工具，但将其作为默认首选透镜通常需要训练、存储和评估大型超完备字典。这一瓶颈限制了快速探索，并提出了一个根本性问题：在训练另一个神经字典之前，激活几何结构中已经可见多少可解释结构？我们的直觉很简单：许多可解释方向对标记具有选择性，这些方向应该看起来比随机方向更非高斯。因此，我们重新审视独立成分分析，这是一种寻找非高斯方向的经典方法，作为语言模型可解释性的紧凑透镜。我们发现独立成分分析在大型语言模型可解释性方面被低估了，因为之前的使用往往依赖于在大型语言模型激活上脆弱的现成实现，并且缺乏检查和评估恢复方向的系统工具。为了弥合这些差距，我们引入了ICALens，这是第一个用于大型语言模型表示的稳定、高效且可审计的独立成分分析实用工作流程。它结合了优化的GPU并行FastICA流水线、针对大型语言模型特定的稳定性配方以及更好的拟合诊断工具，实现了高效的逐层分析。在GPT-2 Small、Gemma 2 2B和Qwen 3.5 2B Base上，ICALens无需逐层基于梯度的字典训练即可高效恢复紧凑、人类可解释的方向。在SAEBench上，ICA在稀疏探测方面与公开稀疏自编码器相当，并在小至中等预算下在目标探针扰动任务中优于它们。这些结果表明，独立成分分析不应被视为弱基线，而应被视为探索语言模型表示的高效且互补的初始透镜。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决的是在大型语言模型中查找可解释特征方向时，传统稀疏自编码器训练成本过高且计算资源消耗巨大的问题。作者提出将独立成分分析作为轻量级替代工具，以更低成本快速提取模型内部结构。该问题在研究中非常重要，因为理解模型内部机制是保障人工智能安全、可控和可调试的基础，而降低分析门槛能让研究人员更高效地探索模型层级特征，推动可解释性研究的普及与深入。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者观察到现有稀疏自编码器训练成本过高，于是思考在训练新字典前，模型激活结构中是否已蕴含可解释信息。他们基于可解释方向通常具有选择性且偏离高斯分布的直觉，重新启用了经典的独立成分分析作为轻量级探索工具。针对传统算法在语言模型数据上容易失效的问题，作者借鉴了现有的快速独立成分分析算法，并设计了包含行归一化、稳健收敛判定和自适应重拟合的

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用独立成分分析直接寻找语言模型激活中高度非高斯的方向，因为许多可解释的特征方向具有选择性，其统计分布会偏离典型的高斯随机方向，从而无需训练昂贵的字典即可快速提取可解释结构。整体流程首先收集各层的激活数据并进行行归一化、去中心化和白化处理，随后在图形处理器上并行运行快速独立成分分析算法寻找非高斯方向。接着采用稳健的收敛接受规则与自适应降维重拟合机制，确保在部分方向难以收敛时仍能稳定输出结果，最终生成可用于人工检查、特征探测与干预实验的读写映射。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新在于提出了一套名为独立成分分析透镜的实用化工作流，使传统算法能够稳定高效地解析大语言模型的内部激活。相比以往直接套用现成实现导致收敛困难且缺乏系统评估的做法，该工作引入了针对模型数据特性的稳定性优化策略、自适应拟合机制以及配套的可视化工具与人工标注协议。这使得该方法无需训练庞大的特征字典即可快速提取具有解释性的方向，并在特征探测与干预实验中展现出与主流稀疏自编码器相当的性能，从而确立了其作为模型内部结构探索的高效前置工具的地位。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种实用的独立成分分析工作流程，通过优化算法使其能高效稳定地提取大语言模型的可解释特征方向，无需训练大型字典即可在特征探测与干预任务中达到与稀疏自编码器相媲美的效果。

Abstract

Finding interpretable directions in language-model representations is critical for understanding and controlling model behavior. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have become the standard tool for this purpose, but using them as the default first lens often requires training, storing, and evaluating large overcomplete dictionaries. This bottleneck limits rapid exploration and raises a fundamental question: how much interpretable structure is already visible from activation geometry before training another neural dictionary? Our intuition is simple: many interpretable directions are selective on tokens, and these directions should look less Gaussian than random directions. We therefore revisit independent component analysis (ICA), a classical method for finding non-Gaussian directions, as a compact lens for language-model interpretability. We find that ICA has been underestimated for LLM interpretability, because prior uses often relied on off-the-shelf ICA implementations that are brittle on LLM activations and lacked systematic tools for inspecting and evaluating the recovered directions. To bridge these gaps, we introduce ICALens, the first practical workflow for stable, efficient, and auditable ICA analysis of LLM representations. It combines an optimized GPU-parallel FastICA pipeline with LLM-specific stability recipes and better fitting diagnostics, enabling efficient and reliable layer-wise analysis. Across GPT-2 Small, Gemma 2 2B, and Qwen 3.5 2B Base, ICALens efficiently recovers compact, human-interpretable directions without per-layer gradient-based dictionary training. On SAEBench, ICA is competitive with public SAEs in sparse probing and outperforms them in targeted probe perturbation under small-to-medium budgets. These results suggest that ICA should not be viewed as a weak baseline, but as an efficient and complementary first lens for exploring language-model representations.

item.title: RCAP: Robust, Class-Aware, Probabilistic Dynamic Dataset Pruning
item.author: Atif Hassan, Swanand Khare, Jiaul H. Paik
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为RCAP的动态数据集剪枝算法，旨在通过周期性选择代表性数据子集来降低计算成本并减少信息损失。

背景: 现有的动态数据剪枝技术在保持最坏组准确率方面存在困难，尤其是在高剪枝率下，且在不同平衡程度的数据集上表现不佳。

目的: 解决现有方法在保持最坏组准确率方面的不足，特别是在高剪枝率下。

方法: 提出RCAP算法，采用闭式解估计每个类别的训练子集样本比例，并通过类别聚合损失在每个epoch自适应调整该比例。采用自适应采样策略，优先选择高损失样本填充各类别子集。

主要发现: 在六个不同数据集上，使用五种模型和三种训练范式进行评估，RCAP在所有剪枝率下均优于现有方法，实现更高的最坏组准确率。在仅使用百分之十数据的情况下，RCAP在类别不平衡数据集上的性能比全量数据训练提高超过百分之一点，并提供平均八点六九倍的加速。

结论: RCAP算法在降低计算成本的同时，有效提升了模型在最坏组上的准确率，尤其在类别不平衡数据集中表现优异。

翻译: Dynamic data pruning techniques aim to reduce computational cost while minimizing information loss by periodically selecting representative subsets of input data during model training. However, existing methods often struggle to maintain strong worst-group accuracy, particularly at high pruning rates, across balanced and imbalanced datasets. To address this challenge, we propose RCAP, a Robust, Class-Aware, Probabilistic dynamic dataset pruning algorithm for classification tasks. RCAP applies a closed-form solution to estimate the fraction of samples to be included in the training subset for each individual class. This fraction is adaptively adjusted in every epoch using class-wise aggregated loss. Thereafter, it employs an adaptive sampling strategy that prioritizes samples having high loss for populating the class-wise subsets. We evaluate RCAP on six diverse datasets ranging from class-balanced to highly imbalanced using five distinct models across three training paradigms: training from scratch, transfer learning, and fine-tuning. Our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art dataset pruning methods, achieving superior worst-group accuracy at all pruning rates. Remarkably, with only ten percent data, RCAP delivers greater than one percent improvement in performance on class-imbalanced datasets compared to full data training while providing an average eight point six nine times speedup. The code can be accessed at https://github.com/atif-hassan/RCAP-dynamic-dataset-pruning

Abstract

Dynamic data pruning techniques aim to reduce computational cost while minimizing information loss by periodically selecting representative subsets of input data during model training. However, existing methods often struggle to maintain strong worst-group accuracy, particularly at high pruning rates, across balanced and imbalanced datasets. To address this challenge, we propose RCAP, a Robust, Class-Aware, Probabilistic dynamic dataset pruning algorithm for classification tasks. RCAP applies a closed-form solution to estimate the fraction of samples to be included in the training subset for each individual class. This fraction is adaptively adjusted in every epoch using class-wise aggregated loss. Thereafter, it employs an adaptive sampling strategy that prioritizes samples having high loss for populating the class-wise subsets. We evaluate RCAP on six diverse datasets ranging from class-balanced to highly imbalanced using five distinct models across three training paradigms: training from scratch, transfer learning, and fine-tuning. Our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art dataset pruning methods, achieving superior worst-group accuracy at all pruning rates. Remarkably, with only $10\%$ data, RCAP delivers $>1\%$ improvement in performance on class-imbalanced datasets compared to full data training while providing an average $8.69\times$ speedup. The code can be accessed at https://github.com/atif-hassan/RCAP-dynamic-dataset-pruning

item.title: Fast Speech Foundation Model Distillation Using Interleaved Stacking
item.author: Eungbeom Kim, Kyogu Lee
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究探索了语音基础模型蒸馏的训练加速方法，提出了一种交错堆叠技术以在保持模型性能的同时提升训练效率。

背景: 将大型语音基础模型蒸馏为高效学生模型已成功应用于资源受限环境。虽然蒸馏降低了推理延迟，但需要额外的学生模型训练，且其训练效率尚未得到充分探索。

目的: 探索语音基础模型蒸馏的训练加速方法，以加快模型部署速度。

方法: 提出了一种名为交错堆叠的新方法。该方法在堆叠过程中始终保持层位置不变，通过逐步增加模型深度直至达到目标深度。

主要发现: 现有的堆叠方法虽然能提高训练速度，但会导致性能下降。提出的交错堆叠方法通过保持层位置不变，有效解决了性能下降问题，并在SUPERB基准测试中验证了其有效性。

结论: 交错堆叠方法在语音基础模型蒸馏中能有效平衡训练速度与模型性能，为资源受限环境下的模型部署提供了更高效的解决方案。

翻译: Distilling a large speech foundation model into an efficient student model has been successfully applied to low-resource environments. Although distillation reduces inference latency, it requires an additional student model training. However, the training efficiency of SFM distillation remains underexplored. In this work, we explore training acceleration of SFM distillation to speed up model deployment. We examine the potential of stacking, in which the model depth is progressively increased through training until the target model depth is reached. While existing stacking methods improve training speed, they suffer from performance degradation. To handle this limitation, we propose interleaved stacking, a novel stacking method that consistently preserves layer position throughout the stacking process. This property is particularly critical in SFMs, in which each layer encodes distinct layer-specific knowledge. We validate the effectiveness of the proposed method on SUPERB.

Abstract

Distilling a large speech foundation model (SFM) into an efficient student model has been successfully applied to low-resource environments. Although distillation reduces inference latency, it requires an additional student model training. However, the training efficiency of SFM distillation remains underexplored. In this work, we explore training acceleration of SFM distillation to speed up model deployment. We examine the potential of stacking, in which the model depth is progressively increased through training until the target model depth is reached. While existing stacking methods improve training speed, they suffer from performance degradation. To handle this limitation, we propose interleaved stacking, a novel stacking method that consistently preserves layer position throughout the stacking process. This property is particularly critical in SFMs, in which each layer encodes distinct layer-specific knowledge. We validate the effectiveness of the proposed method on SUPERB.

item.title: Blind Dexterous Grasping via Real2Sim2Real Tactile Policy Learning
item.author: Shengcheng Luo, Xiyan Huang, Zhe Xu, Wanlin Li, Ziyuan Jiao, Chenxi Xiao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种用于灵巧手的纯触觉盲抓取框架，该框架可部署在物理多指机械手上。通过构建接触校准的数字孪生模拟器、使用布局感知触觉编码器提升稀疏触觉信号的表达能力，以及训练对象特定的强化学习专家并聚合其成功抓取轨迹到触觉条件扩散策略中，实现了在真实硬件上的有效抓取。

背景: 使用灵巧手进行盲抓取是一项关键的操控能力。然而，由于触觉仿真到现实的差距以及稀疏触觉信号表达能力的有限性，为真实机器人学习仅依赖触觉的策略仍然具有挑战性。

目的: 缩小触觉仿真到现实的差距，实现可部署在物理多指机械手上的纯触觉盲抓取。

方法: 1. 引入Real2Sim触觉校准流程，构建能够复现真实触觉信号的接触校准数字孪生模拟器。2. 使用布局感知触觉编码器，通过自监督预训练结合传感器几何先验，提升稀疏触觉观测的表达性。3. 在校准的模拟器中训练对象特定的强化学习专家，并将成功的抓取轨迹聚合到触觉条件扩散策略中，以提高对未见物体的泛化能力。

主要发现: 在配备分布式触觉传感器的物理LEAP手上对10个已知和10个未知物体进行评估，部署的策略在没有真实世界抓取演示或视觉输入的情况下，实现了27%的真实世界抓取成功率。仿真消融实验表明，布局感知触觉预训练提高了抓取性能，而传感级评估证实Real2Sim校准增加了仿真与硬件之间触觉接触事件的一致性。

结论: 接触事件校准、几何感知触觉表示学习和基于扩散的策略聚合为在真实灵巧机械手上实现纯触觉盲抓取提供了一条有效途径。

翻译: Blind grasping with a dexterous hand is a crucial manipulation capability. Nevertheless, learning such tactile-only policies for real robots remains challenging due to the tactile sim-to-real gap and the limited expressiveness of sparse tactile signals. To bridge this gap, we propose a framework for tactile-only blind grasping that is deployable on a physical multi-fingered robotic hand. Our approach combines three key components. First, we introduce a Real2Sim tactile calibration pipeline that constructs a contact-calibrated digital-twin simulator capable of reproducing real tactile signals. Second, we improve the expressiveness of sparse tactile observations using a layout-aware tactile encoder, which incorporates sensor-geometry priors through self-supervised pretraining. Third, to improve generalization to unseen objects, we train object-specific reinforcement-learning experts in the calibrated simulator and aggregate their successful grasp trajectories into a tactile-conditioned Diffusion Policy. We evaluate our method on a physical LEAP Hand equipped with distributed tactile sensing across 10 seen and 10 unseen objects. The deployed policy achieves a 27% real-world grasp success rate across all 20 objects, without real-world grasping demonstrations or visual input. Simulation ablations show that layout-aware tactile pretraining improves grasping performance, while sensing-level evaluations confirm that Real2Sim calibration increases the consistency of tactile contact events between simulation and hardware. Together, these results suggest that contact-event calibration, geometry-aware tactile representation learning, and diffusion-based policy aggregation provide an effective path toward tactile-only blind grasping on real dexterous robotic hands. Project page:Dex-Blind-Grasp.github.io.

Abstract

Blind grasping with a dexterous hand is a crucial manipulation capability. Nevertheless, learning such tactile-only policies for real robots remains challenging due to the tactile sim-to-real gap and the limited expressiveness of sparse tactile signals. To bridge this gap, we propose a framework for tactile-only blind grasping that is deployable on a physical multi-fingered robotic hand. Our approach combines three key components. First, we introduce a Real2Sim tactile calibration pipeline that constructs a contact-calibrated digital-twin simulator capable of reproducing real tactile signals. Second, we improve the expressiveness of sparse tactile observations using a layout-aware tactile encoder, which incorporates sensor-geometry priors through self-supervised pretraining. Third, to improve generalization to unseen objects, we train object-specific reinforcement-learning experts in the calibrated simulator and aggregate their successful grasp trajectories into a tactile-conditioned Diffusion Policy. We evaluate our method on a physical LEAP Hand equipped with distributed tactile sensing across 10 seen and 10 unseen objects. The deployed policy achieves a 27\% real-world grasp success rate across all 20 objects, without real-world grasping demonstrations or visual input. Simulation ablations show that layout-aware tactile pretraining improves grasping performance, while sensing-level evaluations confirm that Real2Sim calibration increases the consistency of tactile contact events between simulation and hardware. Together, these results suggest that contact-event calibration, geometry-aware tactile representation learning, and diffusion-based policy aggregation provide an effective path toward tactile-only blind grasping on real dexterous robotic hands. Project page:Dex-Blind-Grasp.github.io.

item.title: Battery detection of XRay images using transfer learning
item.author: Nermeen Abou Baker, David Rohrschneider, Uwe Handmann
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究证明了迁移学习在预测图像中是否包含电池、定位电池以及识别三种锂离子电池（方形、软包和圆柱形）方面的潜力。

背景: 在许多应用中，检测和分类电池的需求急剧增加。

目的: 预测图像中是否包含电池，确定其位置，并识别三种类型的锂离子电池。

方法: 采用迁移学习方法，首先使用预训练的YOLOv5m在大规模数据集上训练以检测电子设备，然后利用这些训练好的权重来检测和分类电池。

主要发现: 电池检测的精度达到百分之九十四，比预训练的YOLOv5m权重高出百分之五，推理时间为二十二毫秒。

结论: 迁移学习在电池检测和分类任务中表现出色，具有实际应用潜力。

翻译: The need for detecting and sorting batteries is drastically increasing for many applications. This study proves the potential of transfer learning in predicting whether the image contains a battery or not, the location and identifying three types of batteries, namely: prismatic, pouch, and cylindrical Lithium-Ion Batteries (LIB). Particularly, it focuses on the transfer learning method in two applications: Training a large-scale dataset to detect electronic devices using a pre-trained YOLOv5m, then using these latter trained weights to detect and classify the batteries. The precision of battery detection achieves 94%, which outperforms the pretrained YOLOv5m weights with 5%, in 22 ms inference time.

Abstract

The need for detecting and sorting batteries is drastically increasing for many applications. This study proves the potential of transfer learning in predicting whether the image contains a battery or not, the location and identifying three types of batteries, namely: prismatic, pouch, and cylindrical Lithium-Ion Batteries (LIB). Particularly, it focuses on the transfer learning method in two applications: Training a large-scale dataset to detect electronic devices using a pre-trained YOLOv5m, then using these latter trained weights to detect and classify the batteries. The precision of battery detection achieves 94%, which outperforms the pretrained YOLOv5m weights with 5%, in 22 ms inference time.

item.title: Lius: Translation Model Based Instructional Lingustic Using Continual Instruction Tuning In Kupang Malay
item.author: Lopo, Joanito Agili, Sari, Yunita, Herwanto, Guntur Budi
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种针对低资源语言古邦马来语的大语言模型微调方法，通过设计基于双语词典显式词汇和语义特征的指令集，并引入持续指令微调范式，显著提升了翻译性能，减少了对大规模平行数据的依赖。

背景: 大语言模型在翻译任务中展现出新的潜力，但在处理低资源语言时性能往往会下降。

目的: 解决大语言模型在处理低资源语言时性能下降的问题，特别是针对古邦马来语进行微调。

方法: 设计一组指令，利用双语词典中的显式词汇和语义特征，并引入持续指令微调训练范式，实现基于指令的迭代训练。

主要发现: 提出的模型在多项评估指标上比标准指令微调模型高出四点至六点，并超越神经机器翻译和多语言大语言模型模型十点至十三点。

结论: 该方法展示了在低资源语言翻译中减轻对大规模平行数据依赖的潜力。

翻译: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer new potential for translation tasks but often experience performance degradation when handling low-resource languages. To address this limitation, we propose an approach for fine-tuning LLMs on a low-resource language, Kupang Malay. Our approach involves designing a set of instructions by leveraging explicit lexical and semantic features from a bilingual dictionary, and introducing Continual Instruction Tuning (CIT), a training paradigm that enables iterative instruction-based training. Experimental results demonstrate that our model, named Lius, yields notable improvements over standard instruction-tuned models by outperforming 4-6 points, and surpassing both Neural Machine Translation (NMT) and Multilingual LLM models by 10-13 points on several evaluation metrics. These findings highlight the potential of our approach to mitigate the reliance on large-scale parallel data in low-resource language translation.
