结论: Q-Fold能够有效保留关键视觉证据和广泛的时间覆盖，同时更好地维持短片段内的局部时间连续性，为长视频理解提供了一种有效的解决方案。

翻译: Long-video understanding remains challenging for multimodal large language models, because temporally extended videos often contain thousands of frames and are therefore expensive to process exhaustively. Existing methods usually construct compact visual inputs from long videos under a limited visual budget. However, most of them still follow a frame-centric paradigm and apply similar representations to retained content regardless of its importance. This makes it difficult to preserve both high-fidelity visual evidence and broad temporal coverage. To address this issue, we propose Q-Fold, a training-free input construction framework for long-video understanding. Instead of treating isolated frames as the basic modeling unit, Q-Fold operates on contiguous temporal segments and constructs a heterogeneous Focus--Context representation under query guidance. Query-relevant segments are preserved as high-fidelity Focus Frames, while less relevant segments are folded into chronology-preserving contextual layouts. In this way, Q-Fold preserves critical visual evidence and broad temporal coverage, while better maintaining local temporal continuity within short segments. Experiments on four long-video benchmarks with multiple Video-MLLMs show that Q-Fold consistently improves performance without increasing the input budget. Notably, it achieves gains of up to 9.1 percentage points on an ultra-long video benchmark. Code will be made publicly available.

Abstract

Long-video understanding remains challenging for multimodal large language models, because temporally extended videos often contain thousands of frames and are therefore expensive to process exhaustively. Existing methods usually construct compact visual inputs from long videos under a limited visual budget. However, most of them still follow a frame-centric paradigm and apply similar representations to retained content regardless of its importance. This makes it difficult to preserve both high-fidelity visual evidence and broad temporal coverage. To address this issue, we propose Q-Fold, a training-free input construction framework for long-video understanding. Instead of treating isolated frames as the basic modeling unit, Q-Fold operates on contiguous temporal segments and constructs a heterogeneous Focus--Context representation under query guidance. Query-relevant segments are preserved as high-fidelity Focus Frames, while less relevant segments are folded into chronology-preserving contextual layouts. In this way, Q-Fold preserves critical visual evidence and broad temporal coverage, while better maintaining local temporal continuity within short segments. Experiments on four long-video benchmarks with multiple Video-MLLMs show that Q-Fold consistently improves performance without increasing the input budget. Notably, it achieves gains of up to 9.1 percentage points on an ultra-long video benchmark. Code will be made publicly available.

item.title: Time-Conditioned and Multi-Time Survival Prediction from 2D PET/CT Projections in Lung Cancer
item.author: Ashish Chauhan, Sambit Tarai, Elin Lundström, Johan Öfverstedt, Håkan Ahlström, Joel Kullberg
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究通过开发两种互补的时间建模方法（ATCS和MTS），利用治疗前的PET/CT图像预测非小细胞肺癌患者的总生存期，发现这些方法优于基线模型，且不同的时间离散化和输入特征设计对预测性能有显著影响。

背景: 基于PET/CT的生存期准确预测可支持肿瘤学中的个性化治疗和随访策略，但时间建模对基于影像的生存预测的影响尚未得到充分探索。

目的: 调查不同的时间建模方法如何影响生存预测，通过开发Attention-guided Time-Conditioned Survival (ATCS)和Multi-Time Survival (MTS)两种互补方法，并与基线Time-Conditioned Survival (TCS)模型进行比较。

方法: 回顾性分析了848名非小细胞肺癌患者的治疗前PET/CT图像（556名用于模型开发，292名用于测试）。使用5折交叉验证训练模型，并在测试集上评估0.5至5年每6个月时间点的时变曲线下面积（AUC）。

主要发现: ATCS和MTS的平均AUC分别为0.794和0.793，优于基线TCS模型的0.767。ATCS在较早时间点（0.5-3年）表现更好，MTS在较晚时间点（3.5-5年）表现更好。结合肿瘤特异性与组织级PET/CT特征优于单一输入。更细的时间离散化改善了短期预测，而较粗的时间间隔提供了更稳定的长期估计。

结论: 时间建模和输入设计影响基于PET/CT的生存预测。所提出的方法能够从治疗前影像进行特定时间的生存期估计，可能支持改进的风险分层和临床决策。

翻译: Accurate prediction of overall survival (OS) from positron emission tomography/computed tomography (PET/CT) can support personalized treatment and follow-up strategies in oncology. However, the impact of temporal modeling on imaging-based survival prediction remains insufficiently explored. We investigate how different temporal formulations influence survival prediction by developing two complementary approaches: Attention-guided Time-Conditioned Survival (ATCS) and Multi-Time Survival (MTS). We retrospectively analyzed pre-treatment PET/CT images from 848 patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), including 556 for model development and 292 for held-out testing. A previously proposed Time-Conditioned Survival (TCS) model was used as a baseline. Models were trained using 5-fold cross-validation and evaluated on the test set using time-dependent area under the curve (AUC) at 6-month intervals from 0.5 to 5 years. Both ATCS and MTS outperformed the baseline TCS model, achieving mean AUCs of 0.794 and 0.793, respectively, compared to 0.767. ATCS performed better at earlier time points (0.5-3 years), whereas MTS performed better at later intervals (3.5-5 years). Combining tumor-specific and tissue-wise PET/CT features improved performance over either input alone. Finer temporal discretization improved short-term prediction, while coarser intervals provided more stable long-term estimates. These findings demonstrate that temporal modeling and input design influence PET/CT-based survival prediction. The proposed approaches enable time-specific survival estimation from pre-treatment imaging and may support improved risk stratification and clinical decision-making.

Abstract

Accurate prediction of overall survival (OS) from positron emission tomography/computed tomography (PET/CT) can support personalized treatment and follow-up strategies in oncology. However, the impact of temporal modeling on imaging-based survival prediction remains insufficiently explored. We investigate how different temporal formulations influence survival prediction by developing two complementary approaches: Attention-guided Time-Conditioned Survival (ATCS) and Multi-Time Survival (MTS). We retrospectively analyzed pre-treatment PET/CT images from 848 patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), including 556 for model development and 292 for held-out testing. A previously proposed Time-Conditioned Survival (TCS) model was used as a baseline. Models were trained using 5-fold cross-validation and evaluated on the test set using time-dependent area under the curve (AUC) at 6-month intervals from 0.5 to 5 years. Both ATCS and MTS outperformed the baseline TCS model, achieving mean AUCs of 0.794 and 0.793, respectively, compared to 0.767. ATCS performed better at earlier time points (0.5-3 years), whereas MTS performed better at later intervals (3.5-5 years). Combining tumor-specific and tissue-wise PET/CT features improved performance over either input alone. Finer temporal discretization improved short-term prediction, while coarser intervals provided more stable long-term estimates. These findings demonstrate that temporal modeling and input design influence PET/CT-based survival prediction. The proposed approaches enable time-specific survival estimation from pre-treatment imaging and may support improved risk stratification and clinical decision-making.

item.title: Agentic Environment Engineering for Large Language Models: A Survey of Environment Modeling, Synthesis, Evaluation, and Application
item.author: Li, Jiachun, Jin, Zhuoran, Men, Tianyi, Hao, Yupu, Zhu, Kejian, Wang, Lingshuai, Huang, Dongqi, Wang, Longxiang, Hua, Shengjia, Wang, Lu, Gao, Jinshan, Yuan, Hongbang, Xu, Ruilin, Liu, Kang, Zhao, Jun
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文系统研究了基于大语言模型智能体的环境工程生命周期，涵盖建模、合成、评估与应用。

背景: 环境作为大语言模型智能体的交互系统，在推动模型能力持续演进中起关键作用，但现有工作缺乏系统分类与深入分析。

目的: 系统梳理当前智能体环境研究，从环境工程生命周期视角提供全面分析。

方法: 从八个属性和八个领域介绍代表性环境，分析其发展路径与核心能力；介绍符号合成与神经合成两种自动化环境合成范式及其评估方法；从智能体与环境协同演进视角讨论环境应用。

主要发现: 智能体在动态环境中的演进路径包括以记忆为中心的经验演进、以编排为中心的工作流演进、以轨迹为中心的离线演进和以探索为中心的在线演进；环境演进范式包括神经驱动、难度驱动和规模驱动三种。

结论: 讨论了未来有前景的方向，包括环境即服务、多智能体环境和神经符号环境。

翻译: Environments serve as interactive systems for large language model (LLM) based agents across diverse scenarios and play a crucial role in driving the continual evolution of model capabilities. Despite this importance, existing work lacks a systematic categorization and deep analysis. This paper systematically studies current researches on agentic environments from the perspective of the environment engineering lifecycle, covering their modeling, synthesis, evaluation and application. Specifically, the paper first introduces representative environments from the perspectives of eight attributes and eight domains, providing detailed analyses of their development paths and highlighting their core capabilities. Second, for automated environment synthesis, two paradigms are introduced, such as symbolic synthesis and neural synthesis. This paper also shows different environment evaluation methods in each paradigm. Thirdly, the corresponding environment applications from the perspective of agent-environment co-evolution are discussed. In specific, the paper characterizes the primary pathways for agent evolution in dynamic environments from four complementary perspectives: memory-centric experience evolution, orchestration-centric workflow evolution, trajectory-centric offline evolution, and exploration-centric online evolution. And three paradigms of environment evolution are identified, namely neural-driven, difficulty-driven, and scaling-driven approaches. At last, several promising future directions are discussed, including Environment-as-a-Service, Multi-agent Environments, and Neural-Symbolic Environments.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决当前大语言模型智能体环境缺乏系统分类与深度分析的问题，旨在全面梳理环境建模、合成、评估及应用的全生命周期。该问题在研究与现实中至关重要，因为环境是智能体交互与能力进化的核心载体，而真实世界交互存在成本高、风险大且难以复现等局限。系统构建与评估模拟环境不仅能安全高效地生成训练数据，还能推动智能体在复杂任务中持续优化与泛化。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对当前智能体环境研究缺乏系统梳理的现状，从环境工程的生命周期出发，设计了涵盖建模、合成、评估与应用的整体分析框架。该思路借鉴了人类通过环境交互积累经验的发展规律，并广泛归纳了现有文献中基于符号规则与神经网络的各类环境构建方法及评估标准。通过围绕三个核心研究问题展开论述，作者将分散的现有工作整合为统一的分类体系，以揭示智能体与环境协同演化的内在机制。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 提供的文本是一篇综述论文的节选，主要系统梳理了智能体环境工程的多个研究方向，并未聚焦于单一具体方法。文中未明确指定所问的“这个方法”具体指代何种技术，也未详细阐述其核心思想与整体实现流程。因此回答为unknown。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 本文的关键创新在于首次从环境工程生命周期的完整视角，系统性地梳理了智能体环境的建模、自动化合成、质量评估与应用。相比以往缺乏系统分类与深度分析的研究，本文构建了基于多项属性与八大领域的分类框架，并深入揭示了智能体与环境协同进化的闭环机制与未来发展趋势。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文系统梳理了大语言模型智能体环境工程的全生命周期，全面总结了环境建模、自动化合成、质量评估及在智能体与环境协同进化中的应用现状，并指出了未来的研究方向。

Abstract

Environments serve as interactive systems for large language model (LLM) based agents across diverse scenarios and play a crucial role in driving the continual evolution of model capabilities. Despite this importance, existing work lacks a systematic categorization and deep analysis. This paper systematically studies current researches on agentic environments from the perspective of the environment engineering lifecycle, covering their modeling, synthesis, evaluation and application. Specifically, the paper first introduces representative environments from the perspectives of eight attributes and eight domains, providing detailed analyses of their development paths and highlighting their core capabilities. Second, for automated environment synthesis, two paradigms are introduced, such as symbolic synthesis and neural synthesis. This paper also shows different environment evaluation methods in each paradigm. Thirdly, the corresponding environment applications from the perspective of agent-environment co-evolution are discussed. In specific, the paper characterizes the primary pathways for agent evolution in dynamic environments from four complementary perspectives: memory-centric experience evolution, orchestration-centric workflow evolution, trajectory-centric offline evolution, and exploration-centric online evolution. And three paradigms of environment evolution are identified, namely neural-driven, difficulty-driven, and scaling-driven approaches. At last, several promising future directions are discussed, including Environment-as-a-Service, Multi-agent Environments, and Neural-Symbolic Environments.

item.title: InternVideo3: Agentify Foundation Models with Multimodal Contextual Reasoning
item.author: Ziang Yan, Sheng Xia, Jiashuo Yu, Yue Wu, Tianxiang Jiang, Songze Li, Kanghui Tian, Yicheng Xu, Yinan He, Kai Chen, Limin Wang, Yu Qiao, Yi Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了InternVideo3框架，该框架通过多模态上下文推理增强了开放多模态模型在长视频理解任务中的能力。

背景: 基础模型的发展正转向涉及多步推理和工具使用的代理行为，但开源工作主要集中在文本主导的设置中，长期多模态任务，特别是需要持续时间理解和迭代交互的视频任务，尚未得到充分探索。

目的: 旨在填补长期多模态任务的空白，特别是针对需要持续时间理解和迭代交互的视频任务。

方法: 提出了多模态上下文推理框架，将理解视为在共享且不断演变的上下文中的闭环过程，包含观察、指令、推理、工具动作和记忆。引入了多模态多头潜在注意力机制，这是一种保留令牌的重新参数化方法，在压缩键值缓存状态的同时保留完整的令牌流。训练过程包括继续预训练、短到长监督微调、基于规则的强化学习和在线策略蒸馏。

主要发现: InternVideo3在Video-MME、MLVU和EgoSchema等基准测试中表现出色。通过检索工具实例化为视频代理，展示了稳健的证据 grounding 行为。

结论: 高效的上下文处理和闭环推理对于将开放多模态模型适应于长期视觉 grounding 代理行为至关重要。

翻译: Recent progress in foundation models has shifted toward agentic behavior involving multi-step reasoning and tool use. However, open-source efforts largely focus on text-dominant settings, leaving long-horizon multimodal tasks underexplored. This gap is evident in video tasks requiring sustained temporal understanding and iterative interaction. We present InternVideo3, a framework enhancing these capabilities via Multimodal Contextual Reasoning (MCR). MCR treats understanding as a closed-loop process over a shared, evolving context containing observations, instructions, reasoning, tool actions, and memory. This frames long-video understanding as evidence accumulation and verification. To ensure efficiency, we introduce Multimodal Multi-head Latent Attention (M^2LA), a token-preserving reparameterization compressing KV-cache states while retaining the full token stream. Our staged training includes continued pretraining, short-to-long supervised fine-tuning, rule-based reinforcement learning, and on-policy distillation. Experiments show InternVideo3 achieves strong performance on benchmarks like Video-MME, MLVU, and EgoSchema. We further instantiate the model as a video agent with retrieval tools, demonstrating robust evidence-grounded behavior. Our results suggest that efficient context handling and closed-loop reasoning are vital for adapting open multimodal models toward long-horizon visually grounded agency.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有开源多模态模型在长视频理解与多步推理任务中能力不足的问题，特别是缺乏持续的时间感知、证据收集以及与外部工具或记忆的迭代交互能力。该问题在现实中非常重要，因为许多实际应用场景无法通过单次问答完成，必须依赖动态更新上下文和逐步验证结论。在研究层面，这类任务为探索多模态智能体的长期规划、状态追踪和闭环感知决策提供了关键的测试平台。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有模型多采用单次问答模式处理短视频或纯文本任务，难以应对需要持续观察、工具调用和自我修正的长视频场景。为此，他们将长视频理解设计为闭环过程，把视觉观察、推理步骤、工具反馈和记忆统一整合到一个随时间演变的共享上下

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将长视频理解视为一个闭环的递归过程，而非单次问答。它把视觉观察、任务指令、中间推理、工具操作、外部反馈和记忆全部整合到一个不断演进的共享上下文中，使模型能够持续积累证据、修正判断并验证结论。整体实现流程首先基于用户查询和初始视频片段启动多步交互循环，模型在每一步观察当前画面、进行推理并调用工具或获取反馈，随后将新信息更新到共享上下文中。为保证长程交互的效率，该方法采用了一种能压缩缓存但不丢失信息的注意力机制，并配合分阶段训练策略来逐步强化模型的长期推理能力。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的核心创新在于提出了一种多模态上下文推理框架，将视频观察、工具调用、反馈和记忆统一在一个不断演化的共享上下文中，实现闭环推理。同时，设计了一种高效的注意力机制，在保留完整视觉信息的前提下压缩缓存状态，解决了长视频处理的内存瓶颈。与以往仅依赖单次问答或文本主导的代理模型不同，该方法强调对长视频进行持续的时序理解、证据积累与自我修正，使模型能够像智能体一样逐步推理并动态更新认知状态。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种名为InternVideo3的框架，通过构建统一的上下文推理机制、设计高效的长上下文注意力模块以及开发分阶段训练流程，成功将多模态基础模型转化为具备长视频理解与递归推理能力的智能体，并在多项长视频推理基准上取得了显著性能提升。

Abstract

Recent progress in foundation models has shifted toward agentic behavior involving multi-step reasoning and tool use. However, open-source efforts largely focus on text-dominant settings, leaving long-horizon multimodal tasks underexplored. This gap is evident in video tasks requiring sustained temporal understanding and iterative interaction. We present InternVideo3, a framework enhancing these capabilities via Multimodal Contextual Reasoning (MCR). MCR treats understanding as a closed-loop process over a shared, evolving context containing observations, instructions, reasoning, tool actions, and memory. This frames long-video understanding as evidence accumulation and verification. To ensure efficiency, we introduce Multimodal Multi-head Latent Attention (M^2LA), a token-preserving reparameterization compressing KV-cache states while retaining the full token stream. Our staged training includes continued pretraining, short-to-long supervised fine-tuning, rule-based reinforcement learning, and on-policy distillation. Experiments show InternVideo3 achieves strong performance on benchmarks like Video-MME, MLVU, and EgoSchema. We further instantiate the model as a video agent with retrieval tools, demonstrating robust evidence-grounded behavior. Our results suggest that efficient context handling and closed-loop reasoning are vital for adapting open multimodal models toward long-horizon visually grounded agency.

item.title: Implicit Neural Representations of Individual Behavior
item.author: Andrew Kang, Priya Narasimhan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究探讨了从无标签的多策略行为数据中学习策略表示的问题。提出了一种名为行为隐式神经表示的自监督生成模型，将隐式神经表示从视觉领域适配到行为领域。该模型将策略表示为状态到动作的函数，并通过 episode 级别的潜在变量调制该函数，从而在无需监督的情况下推断策略身份。该模型能够自然适应不同长度的 episode 和不同的采样粒度。研究还定义了策略层面的分布外偏移，并在合成数据、MuJoCo 演示数据以及真实世界的数据集（如国际象棋、F1 赛车、机器人学和 Seek-Avoid 数据集）上进行了评估。结果表明，行为隐式神经表示在最具挑战性的连续状态动作设置中 consistently 提高了策略可识别性，特别是在长 episode、多策略和分布外偏移使得边缘捷径失效的情况下。

背景: 在机器人玩耍、演示、游戏、赛车等数据集中，存在混合的异质行为且缺乏标注的情况。每个 episode 由固定策略生成，但策略标签不可用。

目的: 从无标签的多策略行为数据中学习策略表示，推断策略身份。

方法: 提出行为隐式神经表示，这是一种自监督生成模型。它不将坐标映射到 RGB 值，而是将策略表示为状态到后续动作的函数。通过 FiLM 层使用 episode 级别的潜在变量调制该函数，生成策略的先验分布。由于隐式神经表示将每个数据点视为潜在函数的样本，因此能够自然适应可变长度的 episode 和不同的采样粒度。

主要发现: 在合成高斯随机场数据、带有受控分布外划分的 MuJoCo 演示数据以及真实世界的国际象棋、F1 赛车、机器人学和 Seek-Avoid 数据集上进行了评估。行为隐式神经表示在最具挑战性的连续状态动作设置中 consistently 提高了策略可识别性，特别是在长 episode、更多策略和分布外偏移使得边缘捷径失效的情况下。当策略身份可以通过符号重复或低维动作统计恢复时，摊销历史编码器仍然具有竞争力。

结论: 行为隐式神经表示在复杂的行为数据设置中能有效提高策略可识别性，并发布了代码和检查点。

翻译: We study policy representation learning from unlabeled multi-policy behavioral data. Each episode is generated by a fixed policy, but policy labels are unavailable. This setting appears in robotics play, demonstrations, games, racing, and other datasets where heterogeneous behaviors are mixed without annotations. We introduce Behavioral INR, a self-supervised generative model that adapts implicit neural representations from vision to behavior. Instead of mapping coordinates to RGB values, Behavioral INR represents a policy as a state-action function mapping states to subsequent actions. An episode-level latent modulates this function through FiLM layers, yielding a generative prior over policies and allowing policy identity to be inferred without supervision. Because INRs treat each datapoint as samples from an underlying function, the same model naturally accommodates variable episode lengths and different sampling granularities, as in vision INRs with different image resolutions. We also define policy-level out-of-distribution shifts along state-distribution and action-distribution axes, which arise when policies overlap in states or actions but are not captured by standard behavioral OOD settings based only on new agents or environments. We evaluate on synthetic Gaussian random field data, MuJoCo demonstrations with controlled OOD splits, and real-world chess, Formula 1 racing, robotics, and Seek-Avoid datasets. Behavioral INR most consistently improves policy identifiability in the hardest continuous state-action settings, especially when longer episodes, more policies, and OOD splits reduce the usefulness of marginal shortcuts; amortized history encoders remain competitive when policy identity can be recovered from symbolic repetition or low-dimensional action statistics. We release code and checkpoints.

Abstract

We study policy representation learning from unlabeled multi-policy behavioral data. Each episode is generated by a fixed policy, but policy labels are unavailable. This setting appears in robotics play, demonstrations, games, racing, and other datasets where heterogeneous behaviors are mixed without annotations. We introduce \emph{Behavioral INR}, a self-supervised generative model that adapts implicit neural representations (INRs) from vision to behavior. Instead of mapping coordinates to RGB values, Behavioral INR represents a policy as a state-action function mapping states to subsequent actions. An episode-level latent modulates this function through FiLM layers, yielding a generative prior over policies and allowing policy identity to be inferred without supervision. Because INRs treat each datapoint as samples from an underlying function, the same model naturally accommodates variable episode lengths and different sampling granularities, as in vision INRs with different image resolutions. We also define policy-level out-of-distribution (OOD) shifts along state-distribution and action-distribution axes, which arise when policies overlap in states or actions but are not captured by standard behavioral OOD settings based only on new agents or environments. We evaluate on synthetic Gaussian random field data, MuJoCo demonstrations with controlled OOD splits, and real-world chess, Formula 1 racing, robotics, and Seek-Avoid datasets. Behavioral INR most consistently improves policy identifiability in the hardest continuous state-action settings, especially when longer episodes, more policies, and OOD splits reduce the usefulness of marginal shortcuts; amortized history encoders remain competitive when policy identity can be recovered from symbolic repetition or low-dimensional action statistics. We release code and checkpoints.

item.title: Adaptive Multi-Resolution Procedural Knowledge Compression for Large Language Models
item.author: Wang, Changyue, Su, Weihang, Ai, Qingyao, Tang, Yichen, Qiao, Runzhong, Li, Xuancheng, Zhang, Min, Liu, Yiqun
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为SKIM的自适应多分辨率软令牌压缩框架，用于对大型语言模型中的程序性技能进行压缩，旨在解决因技能文本过长导致的预填充成本和延迟增加问题。

背景: 大型语言模型广泛用于处理复杂任务，可重用的自然语言技能成为注入程序性知识的流行范式。由于热门技能常被重复调用，将其完整文本放入上下文会显著增加预填充成本和延迟。现有的文本压缩技术主要针对文档中的事实性知识，而非程序性知识，因此不足以有效压缩技能。

目的: 开发一种有效的技能压缩方法，该方法应能保留工作流和工具协议之间的逻辑依赖关系，支持对频繁更新的社区技能进行轻量级离线压缩，并适应不同技能复杂度的变化。

方法: 提出SKIM（SKIll coMpression）框架，这是一种自适应多分辨率软令牌压缩方法。根据每个技能的复杂度，SKIM创建不同数量的软令牌，以在提高大型语言模型推理效率的同时保持技能使用的有效性。

主要发现: 实验表明，SKIM能够将技能压缩至原始令牌长度的百分之三十到六十，同时在保持任务性能方面优于现有的压缩方法。

结论: SKIM框架通过自适应压缩策略，有效解决了程序性技能压缩中的效率与效果平衡问题，为大型语言模型应用中的技能管理提供了新的解决方案。

翻译: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used to tackle complex tasks with autonomous workflows. Recently, reusable natural language skills have emerged as a popular paradigm to inject procedural knowledge into LLM applications. Since popular skills are often invoked repeatedly, placing their full text in every context significantly increases prefill cost and latency. While text compression techniques have the potential to solve this problem, most existing methods are designed to compress factual knowledge in documents instead of procedural knowledge, making them insufficient for skill compression. In this paper, we argue that an effective skill compression method should: 1) preserve logical dependencies among workflows and tool protocols, 2) enable lightweight, offline compression for frequently updated community skills, and 3) be adaptable to varying complexities across skills. To address this, we present SKIM (SKIll coMpression), an adaptive multi-resolution soft token compression framework for procedural skills. Depending on the complexity of each skill, SKIM creates different numbers of soft tokens that not only improve the efficiency of LLM inference, but also preserve the effectiveness of skill usage. Experiments indicate that SKIM compresses skills to 30 to 60 percent of their original token length while preserving task performance better than existing compression this http URL have released our code at this https URL .

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决大语言模型在调用可复用技能时，因完整加载技能文本而导致计算成本高和推理延迟大的问题。现有压缩方法多针对事实性文档，无法有效保留技能中的逻辑依赖关系，且缺乏轻量级和自适应能力。该问题在现实中非常重要，因为随着智能体生态的普及，频繁调用技能会产生巨大的冗余开销，高效压缩技能能在保证执行准确性的同时显著降低部署成本并提升系统响应速度。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对程序性技能压缩需保留逻辑依赖、支持轻量级离线更新以及适应不同复杂度这三大挑战进行设计。该方法借鉴了双模型软令牌压缩架构，采用专用压缩模块与投影模块结合的结构，并引入渐进式三阶段训练以强化可执行逻辑的保留。同时，通过离线自我评估机制自动匹配最优压缩分辨率，从而在降低推理成本的同时保持技能执行效果。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将大语言模型的可复用程序化技能离线压缩为连续的软词元，并支持同一技能对应多种压缩精度，以便在实际使用时自动选择最轻量且能保证执行效果的精度。整体流程分为离线准备与在线推理：首先通过三阶段渐进式训练让压缩模型学习保留技能的逻辑依赖，并离线测试确定每种技能的最佳压缩精度；部署时直接加载预生成的软词元与参数适配模块，将其拼接至用户查询前输入模型，从而实现低延迟、高效率的技能调用。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种自适应多分辨率软词元压缩框架，专门用于压缩大语言模型中的程序性技能知识。它通过渐进式训练和离线评估机制，能够根据技能复杂度自动生成不同压缩程度的连续表示，并自动选择最优分辨率。与以往主要压缩事实性文档或依赖在线梯度优化的方法不同，该框架专注于保留技能执行所需的逻辑依赖关系，支持轻量级离线压缩，无需频繁重新训练，从而在大幅降低计算成本的同时保持了技能调用的有效性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种自适应多分辨率的软词元压缩框架，专为保留程序化技能的可执行逻辑而设计，通过渐进式训练与离线自适应选择机制，在将技能文本压缩至原长度三至六成的同时，有效保障了大语言模型的任务性能与推理效率。

Abstract

Large language models (LLMs) are widely used to tackle complex tasks with autonomous workflows. Recently, reusable natural language skills have emerged as a popular paradigm to inject procedural knowledge into LLM applications. Since popular skills are often invoked repeatedly, placing their full text in every context significantly increases prefill cost and latency. While text compression techniques have the potential to solve this problem, most existing methods are designed to compress factual knowledge in documents instead of procedural knowledge, making them insufficient for skill compression. In this paper, we argue that an effective skill compression method should: 1) preserve logical dependencies among workflows and tool protocols, 2) enable lightweight, offline compression for frequently updated community skills, and 3) be adaptable to varying complexities across skills. To address this, we present SKIM (SKIll coMpression), an adaptive multi-resolution soft token compression framework for procedural skills. Depending on the complexity of each skill, SKIM creates different numbers of soft tokens that not only improve the efficiency of LLM inference, but also preserve the effectiveness of skill usage. Experiments indicate that SKIM compresses skills to 30 to 60 percent of their original token length while preserving task performance better than existing compression this http URL have released our code at this https URL .

item.title: Adapting Prithvi-EO for Fallow Detection for Food-Water Nexus: ViT-Adapter Necks and Parameter-Efficient Backbone tuning of Geospatial Foundation Model
item.author: Sk Muhammad Asif, Orhun Aydin
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文评估了结合参数高效微调方案和不同颈部设计的休耕地检测管线，通过轻量级空间先验融合和选择性解冻主干网络，使模型能更有效地捕捉局部休耕地模式，性能优于依赖重塑单步长特征的方法。

背景: 理解休耕地的空间分布对于优化食物水关联至关重要，因为休耕在作物轮作和节水方面发挥作用。休耕地在美国农业部农田数据层中属于低精度类别。地理空间基础模型在计算机视觉任务中显示出强大的可迁移性，但其视觉变换器主干网络产生的特征处于单一空间尺度，不适合对象检测头所需的多尺度特征。现有方法通过缩放单步长令牌合成多尺度金字塔，牺牲了空间异质性，而完整主干网络微调对于地理空间基础模型来说计算成本过高。

目的: 评估一种休耕地检测管线，该管线结合两种参数高效微调方案和三种颈部设计，以解决现有方法在空间异质性保留和计算成本方面的问题，并提高休耕地检测的准确性。

方法: 评估了结合低秩适应和混合参数高效微调方案的休耕地检测管线，并测试了伪多尺度、轻量级视觉变换器适配器和完整视觉变换器适配器三种颈部设计。

主要发现: 最佳配置为使用轻量级视觉变换器适配器和单阶段头的低秩适应方案，在结合特定损失函数时达到较高的平均精度。该配置比无适配器的基于锚点的方法提高了百分之六点四二，最佳配置比基线无适配器基于锚点的方法提高了百分之二十五点七零。

结论: 轻量级空间先验融合和选择性主干网络解冻使模型能够更有效地捕捉局部休耕地模式，其性能优于依赖重塑单步长视觉变换器令牌的方法。

翻译: Understanding spatial distribution of fallow land is important for optimizing the food-water nexus, given fallowing's role in crop rotation and water conservation. Fallow is a low accuracy class in USDA Cropland Data Layer. Geospatial foundation model has shown strong transferability across computer vision tasks. However, its Vision Transformer backbone produces features at a single spatial scale that are ill-suited for the multi-scale features required by object detection heads. Existing approaches synthesise multi-scale pyramids through scaling of single stride tokens, sacrificing spatial heterogeneity, and full backbone fine-tuning is computationally prohibitive for GFMs. We evaluate a fallow detection pipeline combining two parameter-efficient fine tuning schemes: Low-Rank Adaptation and a hybrid PEFT, with three neck designs: pseudo multi-scale, Lite ViT-Adapter, and Full ViT-Adapter. Our best configuration, Lite ViT-Adapter with a one-stage head, achieves a high mAP with the Diou loss, suggesting the effectiveness of center-aware localization for irregular fallow field detection. ViT-Adapter free one-stage detection under LoRA improves the adapter-free anchor-based approach by 6.42%, and the best configuration improves baseline adapter-free anchor-based approach by 25.70%. These results demonstrate that lightweight spatial prior fusion and selective backbone unfreezing enable the model to capture local fallow patterns more effectively, outperforming approaches that rely on reshaped single-stride ViT tokens.

Abstract

Understanding spatial distribution of fallow land is important for optimizing the food-water (FW) nexus, given fallowing's role in crop rotation and water conservation. Fallow is a low accuracy class in USDA Cropland Data Layer (CDL). Geospatial foundation model (GFM), Prithvi-EO has shown strong transferability across computer vision tasks. However, its Vision Transformer (ViT) backbone produces features at a single spatial scale that are ill-suited for the multi-scale features required by object detection heads. Existing approaches synthesise multi-scale pyramids through scaling of single stride tokens, sacrificing spatial heterogeneity, and full backbone fine-tuning is computationally prohibitive for GFMs. We evaluate a fallow detection pipeline combining two parameter-efficient fine tuning (PEFT) schemes: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and a hybrid PEFT, with three neck designs: pseudo multi-scale, Lite ViT-Adapter, and Full ViT-Adapter. Our best configuration, Lite ViT-Adapter with a one-stage head, achieves a mAP@50 of 0.9479 with the Diou loss, suggesting the effectiveness of center-aware localization for irregular fallow field detection. ViT-Adapter free one-stage detection under LoRA improves the adapter-free anchor-based approach by 6.42%, and the best configuration improves baseline adapter-free anchor-based approach by 25.70%. These results demonstrate that lightweight spatial prior fusion and selective backbone unfreezing enable Prithvi-EO to capture local fallow patterns more effectively, outperforming approaches that rely on reshaped single-stride ViT tokens.

item.title: m6A-FORM: A Foundation Model for Decoding N6-methyladenosine Biology
item.author: Tinghe Zhang, Sumin Jo, Shou-Jiang Gao, Yufei Huang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: m6A-FORM是一种基于Transformer的RNA甲基化基础模型，利用MeRIP-seq峰作为先验信息，在约2200万条人类MeRIP-seq研究衍生的序列上进行预训练，并在高精度单核苷酸m6A注释上进行微调。该模型在m6A位点预测方面达到最先进水平，显著提升了PR-AUC并加快了推理速度。此外，该模型还适用于预测m6A相关调控因子的结合位点，并在24种人类组织的67个数据集中识别出19631个组织保守位点，这些位点具有独特的定位、聚类、甲基化、表达、RBP相互作用和衰变相关特征。

背景: N6-甲基腺苷（m6A）是真核生物mRNA中最丰富的内部修饰。然而，大多数现有预测器使用基于腺苷中心的公式，计算效率低下且容易产生假阳性。

目的: 开发一种更高效、准确的RNA甲基化预测模型，以克服现有方法的局限性。

方法: 提出m6A-FORM，一种基于Transformer的基础模型，使用MeRIP-seq峰作为甲基化富集先验，并在约2200万条人类MeRIP-seq研究衍生的序列上进行预训练。随后，使用m6A-Atlas v2.0和GLORI的高置信度单核苷酸m6A注释进行微调。

主要发现: m6A-FORM-sites在m6A位点预测方面达到最先进水平，PR-AUC为0.635，ROC-AUC为0.988，PR-AUC比现有方法至少提高0.14，同时推理速度显著提高。该模型还成功预测了19种m6A相关调控因子的结合位点，并识别出与mRNA降解相关的YTHDF2结合的m6A位点。在24种人类组织的67个数据集中，识别出19631个组织保守位点，这些位点具有独特的定位、聚类、甲基化、表达、RBP相互作用和衰变相关特征。

结论: m6A-FORM是一种高效、准确的RNA甲基化预测工具，适用于多种m6A相关功能的研究，并在大规模数据集中揭示了组织保守位点的特征。

翻译: N6-methyladenosine (m6A) is the most abundant internal modification in eukaryotic mRNA. However, most existing predictors use adenosine-centered formulations that are computationally inefficient and prone to false positives. Here we present m6A-FORM, a transformer-based foundation model for RNA methylation that uses MeRIP-seq peaks as methylation-enriched priors and is pretrained on approximately 22 million peak-derived sequences from 143 human MeRIP-seq studies. After fine-tuning with high-confidence single-nucleotide m6A annotations from m6A-Atlas v2.0 and GLORI, m6A-FORM-sites achieves state-of-the-art m6A site prediction performance, with a PR-AUC of 0.635 and ROC-AUC of 0.988, improving PR-AUC by at least 0.14 over existing methods while enabling substantially faster inference. Task-specific adaptation further supports prediction of binding sites for 19 m6A-associated regulators and identification of YTHDF2-bound m6A sites associated with mRNA degradation. Applying m6A-FORM across 67 datasets from 24 human tissues identifies 19,631 tissue-conserved sites with distinct localization, clustering, methylation, expression, RBP-interaction, and decay-associated signatures.

Abstract

N6-methyladenosine (m6A) is the most abundant internal modification in eukaryotic mRNA. However, most existing predictors use adenosine-centered formulations that are computationally inefficient and prone to false positives. Here we present m6A-FORM, a transformer-based foundation model for RNA methylation that uses MeRIP-seq peaks as methylation-enriched priors and is pretrained on approximately 22 million peak-derived sequences from 143 human MeRIP-seq studies. After fine-tuning with high-confidence single-nucleotide m6A annotations from m6A-Atlas v2.0 and GLORI, m6A-FORM-sites achieves state-of-the-art m6A site prediction performance, with a PR-AUC of 0.635 and ROC-AUC of 0.988, improving PR-AUC by at least 0.14 over existing methods while enabling substantially faster inference. Task-specific adaptation further supports prediction of binding sites for 19 m6A-associated regulators and identification of YTHDF2-bound m6A sites associated with mRNA degradation. Applying m6A-FORM across 67 datasets from 24 human tissues identifies 19,631 tissue-conserved sites with distinct localization, clustering, methylation, expression, RBP-interaction, and decay-associated signatures.

item.title: DrivingAgent: Design and Scheduling Agents for Autonomous Driving Systems
item.author: Zhongyu Xia, Wenhao Chen, Yongtao Wang, Ming-Hsuan Yang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为DrivingAgent的新型智能体框架，旨在解决自动驾驶系统中基础模型引入带来的设计复杂性和实时调度挑战。该框架在系统设计中通过解释架构、生成代码和超网络训练验证来自动化模块开发；在调度阶段，利用强化学习训练的轻量级大语言模型动态编排系统模块，并结合结构化记忆实现实时操作。实验表明，该框架在nuScenes和Bench2Drive基准测试中实现了更优的速度与精度权衡。

背景: 许多自动驾驶系统正越来越多地采用基础模型以提升泛化能力并处理长尾场景。然而，这一趋势带来了两个关键挑战：一是设计和集成新模型的过程需要大量人工且耗时；二是缺乏智能的动态调度机制来满足严格的实时约束。现有的基于大语言模型的智能体框架不适合自动驾驶，因为它们未能区分系统设计和实时调度的不同需求，将模块视为不透明的黑盒，且未设计用于连续运行。

目的: 解决自动驾驶系统设计中手动集成新模型的繁琐问题以及实时调度机制的缺失，提出一个能够自动化模块开发并动态调度系统模块的智能体框架。

方法: 提出DrivingAgent框架，包含两个阶段：在设计阶段，通过解释系统架构、生成代码和使用超网络训练验证模块来自动化模块开发；在调度阶段，使用通过强化学习训练的轻量级大语言模型动态编排系统模块，并借助集成长期存储和带时间戳短期上下文的结构化记忆支持实时操作。

主要发现: DrivingAgent框架在nuScenes和Bench2Drive基准测试中实现了更优的速度与精度权衡。

结论: DrivingAgent框架能够有效解决自动驾驶系统设计和调度中的关键挑战，通过自动化模块开发和动态实时调度，提升了系统的性能和效率。

翻译: Many autonomous driving systems are increasingly incorporating foundation models to improve generalization and handle long-tail scenarios. However, this trend introduces two key challenges: (i) the manual and labor-intensive process of designing and integrating new models, and (ii) the lack of intelligent, dynamic scheduling mechanisms to meet strict real-time constraints. While Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents offer a promising avenue for automation, existing frameworks are ill-suited for autonomous driving. Specifically, they fail to distinguish between the fundamentally different requirements of system design and real-time scheduling, treat modules as opaque black boxes, and are not designed for continuous operation. To address these limitations, we propose DrivingAgent, a novel agent framework tailored to the dual challenges of autonomous driving system design and scheduling. In the design phase, DrivingAgent automates module development by interpreting system architecture, generating code, and validating modules via super-network training. In the scheduling phase, it employs a lightweight LLM trained with reinforcement learning to dynamically orchestrate system modules in real time, supported by a structured memory that integrates long-term storage with timestamped short-term context. Experimental results demonstrate that DrivingAgent achieves a superior speed--accuracy trade-off on both the nuScenes and Bench2Drive benchmarks.

Abstract

Many autonomous driving systems are increasingly incorporating foundation models to improve generalization and handle long-tail scenarios. However, this trend introduces two key challenges: (i) the manual and labor-intensive process of designing and integrating new models, and (ii) the lack of intelligent, dynamic scheduling mechanisms to meet strict real-time constraints. While Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents offer a promising avenue for automation, existing frameworks are ill-suited for autonomous driving. Specifically, they fail to distinguish between the fundamentally different requirements of system design and real-time scheduling, treat modules as opaque black boxes, and are not designed for continuous operation. To address these limitations, we propose DrivingAgent, a novel agent framework tailored to the dual challenges of autonomous driving system design and scheduling. In the design phase, DrivingAgent automates module development by interpreting system architecture, generating code, and validating modules via super-network training. In the scheduling phase, it employs a lightweight LLM trained with reinforcement learning to dynamically orchestrate system modules in real time, supported by a structured memory that integrates long-term storage with timestamped short-term context. Experimental results demonstrate that DrivingAgent achieves a superior speed--accuracy trade-off on both the nuScenes and Bench2Drive benchmarks.

item.title: DiffCold: A Diffusion-based Generative Model for Cold-Start Item Recommendation
item.author: Kangning Zhang, Yingjie Qin, Weinan Zhang, Yong Yu, Jianghao Lin
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于扩散的生成模型DiffCold，旨在解决冷启动物品推荐中的跷跷板困境。该模型通过条件扩散技术将冷物品与热物品的表示统一，利用检索增强聚合器和基于模拟的表示对齐模块，有效保留了热物品的行为流形结构并实现了分布一致性。实验表明，DiffCold在多个基准测试中均优于现有最先进方法，成功解决了跷跷板困境。

背景: 在现实世界的推荐系统中，由于缺乏交互历史，冷启动物品推荐一直是一个持续存在的挑战。虽然先前的模型尝试使用物品内容特征来弥合这一差距，但它们普遍存在跷跷板困境：提升冷物品性能必然导致热物品性能下降，反之亦然。

目的: 解决冷启动物品推荐中的跷跷板困境，统一热物品和冷物品的表示，同时保持热物品的行为流形结构并实现分布一致性。

方法: 提出DiffCold，一种基于扩散的生成模型。该模型利用条件扩散从内容重建热物品嵌入，保留底层流形结构。具体设计包括：检索增强聚合器，使用语义相似的热物品初始化生成以绕过低效噪声；以及基于模拟的表示对齐模块，通过对比学习强制生成嵌入与真实嵌入之间的分布一致性。

主要发现: DiffCold成功解决了跷跷板困境，在三个基准测试中一致优于最先进的方法，在所有指标上均表现出色。

结论: DiffCold通过统一热物品和冷物品的表示，有效解决了冷启动推荐中的跷跷板困境，为推荐系统提供了更优的解决方案。

翻译: Cold-start item recommendation remains a persistent challenge in real-world systems due to the absence of interaction histories. While prior models attempt to bridge this gap using item content features, they universally suffer from the seesaw dilemma: enhancing performance for cold items inevitably degrades performance for warm items, and vice versa. We identify that this dilemma stems from a fundamental distributional disparity: warm item embeddings occupy a complex behavioral manifold shaped by rich interaction signals, whereas cold item embeddings are constrained to a semantic manifold derived solely from auxiliary content. Existing methods often force a rigid mapping between these inconsistent spaces, causing the model to sacrifice the precision of warm representations to accommodate cold ones. To address this, we propose DiffCold, a diffusion-based generative model that unifies warm and cold representations. Unlike GANs or VAEs, DiffCold leverages conditional diffusion to reconstruct warm item embeddings from content, preserving the underlying manifold structure without degradation. We further tailor this paradigm with two specific designs: a Retrieval-enhanced Aggregator that initializes generation using semantically similar warm items to bypass inefficient noise, and a Simulation-based Representation Alignment module that enforces distribution consistency between generated and real embeddings via contrastive learning. Experiments on three benchmarks confirm that DiffCold resolves the seesaw dilemma, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art methods across all metrics.

Abstract

Cold-start item recommendation remains a persistent challenge in real-world systems due to the absence of interaction histories. While prior models attempt to bridge this gap using item content features, they universally suffer from the \textbf{seesaw dilemma}: enhancing performance for cold items inevitably degrades performance for warm items, and vice versa. We identify that this dilemma stems from a fundamental \textbf{distributional disparity}: warm item embeddings occupy a complex ``behavioral manifold" shaped by rich interaction signals, whereas cold item embeddings are constrained to a ``semantic manifold" derived solely from auxiliary content. Existing methods often force a rigid mapping between these inconsistent spaces, causing the model to sacrifice the precision of warm representations to accommodate cold ones. To address this, we propose \textbf{DiffCold}, a diffusion-based generative model that unifies warm and cold representations. Unlike GANs or VAEs, DiffCold leverages conditional diffusion to reconstruct warm item embeddings from content, preserving the underlying manifold structure without degradation. We further tailor this paradigm with two specific designs: a \textbf{Retrieval-enhanced Aggregator} that initializes generation using semantically similar warm items to bypass inefficient noise, and a \textbf{Simulation-based Representation Alignment} module that enforces distribution consistency between generated and real embeddings via contrastive learning. Experiments on three benchmarks confirm that DiffCold resolves the seesaw dilemma, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art methods across all metrics.

item.title: Damage-TriageFormer: A Foundation-Model Framework for Typology-Based Building Damage Assessment from Mono-Temporal Imagery
item.author: Yiming Xiao, Yu-Hsuan Ho, Sanjay Thasma, Junwei Ma, Ali Mostafavi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出Damage-TriageFormer模型，用于灾后建筑损伤评估。该模型基于单张灾后影像和建筑轮廓，输出损伤类型而非严重程度等级。研究构建了包含五个损伤类型的基准数据集DamageTriage-Bench，并展示了模型在验证集和测试集上的性能，特别是在未受损建筑和完全结构倒塌类别上表现优异。

背景: 灾后建筑损伤评估对资源优先分配和恢复至关重要。现有自动化方法通常将损伤简化为单一严重程度等级，或需要配对的前后事件影像，而后者对于新兴灾害往往不可用。

目的: 开发一种无需配对影像、基于单张灾后影像的建筑损伤评估方法，以支持针对性的应急响应和资源分配。

方法: 提出Damage-TriageFormer模型，扩展DINOv3 ViT-L主干网络，引入简单特征金字塔用于更高分辨率的实例池化，采用两阶段门控损伤头，并加入辅助严重程度回归目标。构建DamageTriage-Bench基准数据集，涵盖飓风迈克尔、飓风海伦和洛杉矶野火事件，包含区分屋顶损伤与结构损伤及局部与完全程度的五个类型。

主要发现: 模型在验证集上宏观F1得分为0.624，在分层测试集上为0.619。在未受损建筑和完全结构倒塌类别上分别达到0.91和0.84的类别F1得分。总屋顶损伤类别因样本有限和标签边界模糊而较难识别。

结论: 单张灾后影像支持可行的建筑损伤类型识别，无需事件前参考影像即可实现有针对性的应急响应和资源分配。

翻译: Decision-relevant building damage assessment is critical for prioritizing resources and recovery after a disaster, yet most automated methods either flatten damage into a single severity scale (no damage, minor, major, destroyed) or require paired pre- and post-event imagery that is often unavailable for emerging hazards. This paper presents Damage-TriageFormer, a single-image, post-event, footprint-conditioned model that produces a damage typology rather than a severity scale. We contribute: (1) DamageTriage-Bench, a new benchmark built from NOAA Emergency Response Imagery across Hurricane Michael (2018), Hurricane Helene (2024), and the 2025 Los Angeles wildfire complex, with five typology classes that distinguish roof damage from structural damage and, within each, partial from total extent; and (2) Damage-TriageFormer, which extends a DINOv3 ViT-L backbone with a Simple Feature Pyramid for higher-resolution instance pooling, a two-stage gated damage head, and an auxiliary severity-regression objective. Our model achieves macro F1 of 0.624 on validation and 0.619 on a held-out stratified test set, performing strongest where operational triage needs it most, with per-class F1 of 0.91 and 0.84 on undamaged buildings and total structural collapse, respectively. While the rare Total Roof Damage class remains difficult due to its limited examples and an inherently ambiguous label boundary, our results show that single-image post-event imagery can support actionable building damage typing, enabling targeted emergency response and resource allocation without a pre-event reference.

Abstract

Decision-relevant building damage assessment is critical for prioritizing resources and recovery after a disaster, yet most automated methods either flatten damage into a single severity scale (no damage, minor, major, destroyed) or require paired pre- and post-event imagery that is often unavailable for emerging hazards. This paper presents Damage-TriageFormer, a single-image, post-event, footprint-conditioned model that produces a damage typology rather than a severity scale. We contribute: (1) DamageTriage-Bench, a new benchmark built from NOAA Emergency Response Imagery across Hurricane Michael (2018), Hurricane Helene (2024), and the 2025 Los Angeles wildfire complex, with five typology classes that distinguish roof damage from structural damage and, within each, partial from total extent; and (2) Damage-TriageFormer, which extends a DINOv3 ViT-L backbone with a Simple Feature Pyramid for higher-resolution instance pooling, a two-stage gated damage head, and an auxiliary severity-regression objective. Our model achieves macro F1 of 0.624 on validation and 0.619 on a held-out stratified test set, performing strongest where operational triage needs it most, with per-class F1 of 0.91 and 0.84 on undamaged buildings and total structural collapse, respectively. While the rare Total Roof Damage class remains difficult due to its limited examples and an inherently ambiguous label boundary, our results show that single-image post-event imagery can support actionable building damage typing, enabling targeted emergency response and resource allocation without a pre-event reference.

item.title: Bridging Day and Night: Unsupervised Cross-Domain Re-Identification with Synergistic Prompt and Prototype Learning
item.author: Jiyang Xu, Rui Liu, Hang Dai
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种无监督的跨域昼夜行人重识别框架，通过结合提示学习和基于原型的表示学习，在无手动标注的情况下实现跨域身份关联。

背景: 跨域昼夜重识别面临昼夜场景间显著的视觉外观差异挑战。现有全监督方法严重依赖耗时且泛化能力有限的人工标注。

目的: 研究无监督昼夜重识别问题，提出一种无需手动标签即可关联跨域身份的新框架。

方法: 采用渐进式两阶段训练策略。第一阶段利用视觉语言模型无标注生成实例特定文本提示，并通过实例级对齐机制将视觉特征与文本提示嵌入统一语义空间，利用实例感知动态偏差适应对齐无标注昼夜图像与可学习提示。第二阶段构建域特定原型记忆库，引入域内身份关联模块增强特征判别力，以及跨域原型匹配模块可靠识别正负原型对以建立稳健的跨域身份对应关系。

主要发现: 在公共基准上的广泛实验验证了方法的有效性。在无监督设置下，该框架达到的Rank-1准确率与最先进全监督方法相当。

结论: 所提出的框架在无监督条件下能有效解决昼夜跨域重识别问题，性能媲美全监督方法。

翻译: Cross-domain day-night re-identification (ReID) is fundamentally challenged by the substantial visual appearance discrepancies between daytime and nighttime scenes. Existing fully supervised methods rely heavily on labor-intensive annotations, which are costly and exhibit limited generalization across domains. In this work, we investigate unsupervised day-night ReID and propose a novel framework that synergistically combines prompt learning and prototype-based representation learning to associate identities across domains without requiring manual labels. Our approach follows a progressive two-stage training strategy. In the first stage, we exploit the vision-language model to generate instance-specific textual prompts in an annotation-free manner. We employ an instance-level alignment mechanism to embed visual features and textual prompts into a unified semantic space, aligning unlabeled day/night images with learnable prompts via instance-aware dynamic-bias adaptation. In the second stage, we construct domain-specific prototype memory banks and introduce two complementary modules: i) an intra-domain identity association module to enhance feature discriminability within each domain, and ii) a cross-domain prototype matching module to reliably identify positive and negative prototype pairs, thereby establishing robust identity correspondences across day and night. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our method. Under the unsupervised setting, our framework attains Rank-1 accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art fully supervised methods.

Abstract

Cross-domain day-night re-identification (ReID) is fundamentally challenged by the substantial visual appearance discrepancies between daytime and nighttime scenes. Existing fully supervised methods rely heavily on labor-intensive annotations, which are costly and exhibit limited generalization across domains. In this work, we investigate unsupervised day-night ReID and propose a novel framework that synergistically combines prompt learning and prototype-based representation learning to associate identities across domains without requiring manual labels. Our approach follows a progressive two-stage training strategy. In the first stage, we exploit the vision-language model to generate instance-specific textual prompts in an annotation-free manner. We employ an instance-level alignment mechanism to embed visual features and textual prompts into a unified semantic space, aligning unlabeled day/night images with learnable prompts via instance-aware dynamic-bias adaptation. In the second stage, we construct domain-specific prototype memory banks and introduce two complementary modules: i) an intra-domain identity association module to enhance feature discriminability within each domain, and ii) a cross-domain prototype matching module to reliably identify positive and negative prototype pairs, thereby establishing robust identity correspondences across day and night. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our method. Under the unsupervised setting, our framework attains Rank-1 accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art fully supervised methods.

item.title: CCKS: Consensus-based Communication and Knowledge Sharing
item.author: Jinyuan Zu, Xiaowei Lv, Yongcai Wang, Deying Li, Yunjun Han, Wenping Chen, Fengyi Zhang, Naiqi Wu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于共识的通信与知识共享框架，旨在解决去中心化训练与执行中行动建议方法过度依赖教师指导的问题，通过引入共识模型和对比学习机制，提升了多智能体协作的效率、学习速度和整体性能。

背景: 在合作式多智能体强化学习的去中心化训练与执行中，基于行动建议的知识共享有助于实现可解释且可扩展的智能体协作。然而，现有的行动建议方法往往过度遵循教师的指导，缺乏对师生兼容性的评估，导致建议过多、稳定性次优及性能下降。

目的: 克服现有行动建议方法过度依赖教师指导、缺乏兼容性评估所导致的稳定性差和性能下降问题，使智能体能够更智能地遵循教师指令，平衡探索与从经验丰富的教师处学习。

方法: 提出基于共识的通信与知识共享框架，该框架允许智能体基于共识衍生的约束采纳建议。核心在于共识模型的构建，通过在训练阶段利用对比学习基于智能体的局部观察构建共识模型。在动作选择阶段，智能体根据共识和共享知识对动作进行评分和选择。该方案设计为即插即用模块，可与现有去中心化训练与执行算法无缝集成。

主要发现: 在谷歌研究足球环境和复杂的星际争霸二多智能体挑战中的实验表明，与现有去中心化训练与执行基线相比，集成该框架显著提高了协作效率、学习速度和整体性能。

结论: 该框架通过共识机制有效解决了行动建议中的过度依赖问题，提升了多智能体系统的协作能力和学习表现，且具有良好的通用性和即插即用特性。

翻译: In Decentralized Training and Decentralized Execution for cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning, action-advising-based knowledge sharing promotes interpretable and scalable cooperation among agents. However, current action advising approaches often adhere too much to the teacher's guidance without evaluating teacher-student compatibility, which causes excessive advising, suboptimal stability, and degraded performance. To overcome these challenges, this paper presents a Consensus-based Communication and Knowledge Sharing framework, which allows agents to adopt recommendations based on consensus-derived constraints and to follow the teacher's instructions more smartly. This mechanism enables agents to balance exploration and learning from experienced teachers, improving overall performance. The key is the consensus model construction, for which we propose to employ contrastive learning to construct consensus models based on local observations in the agents' training phase. In action selection, agents score and choose actions based on consensus and shared knowledge. Designed as a plug-and-play solution, it integrates seamlessly with existing algorithms. Experiments conducted in the Google Research Football environment and the complex StarCraft II Multi-Agent Challenge demonstrate that the integration significantly improves cooperation efficiency, learning speed, and overall performance compared with current baselines. The code is available at a specific GitHub repository.

Abstract

In Decentralized Training and Decentralized Execution (DTDE) for cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), action-advising-based knowledge sharing promotes interpretable and scalable cooperation among agents. However, current action advising approaches often adhere too much to the teacher's guidance without evaluating teacher-student compatibility, which causes excessive advising, suboptimal stability, and degraded performance. To overcome these challenges, this paper presents a Consensus-based Communication and Knowledge Sharing (CCKS) framework, which allows agents to adopt recommendations based on consensus-derived constraints and to follow the teacher's instructions more smartly. This mechanism enables agents to balance exploration and learning from experienced teachers, improving overall performance. The key is the consensus model construction, for which we propose to employ contrastive learning to construct consensus models based on local observations in the agents' training phase. In action selection, agents score and choose actions based on consensus and shared knowledge. Designed as a plug-and-play solution, CCKS integrates seamlessly with existing DTDE algorithms. Experiments conducted in the Google Research Football environment and the complex StarCraft II Multi-Agent Challenge demonstrate that the integration with CCKS significantly improves cooperation efficiency, learning speed, and overall performance compared with current DTDE baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/yuanxpy/CCKS.

item.title: Claw-SWE-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating OpenClaw-style Agent Harnesses on Coding Tasks
item.author: Zheng, Mengyu, Han, Kai, Li, Boxun, Xu, Haiyang, Tian, Yuchuan, He, Wei, Zhou, Hang, Guo, Jianyuan, Hu, Hailin, Ma, Lin, Xu, Chao, Dai, Guohao, Xia, Lixue, Wei, Yunchao, Wang, Yunhe, Wang, Yu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了Claw-SWE-Bench，一个多语言的SWE-bench风格基准测试和适配器协议，旨在公平比较不同异构智能体工具集在代码生成任务上的表现。该基准测试包含350个跨8种语言和43个仓库的GitHub问题修复实例，并发布了轻量版用于快速验证。实验表明，适配器设计对智能体执行代码任务至关重要，模型选择和工具集选择对性能影响显著，且系统间API成本差异较大。

背景: 通用智能体如OpenClaw正日益被用作自主工具使用者，但在SWE-bench基准测试中，由于通用智能体本身不满足评分所需的清洁Docker工作区、补丁和预测合同要求，其编码能力难以准确衡量。

目的: 引入Claw-SWE-Bench基准测试和适配器协议，使异构智能体工具集在固定提示、运行预算、工作区合同、补丁提取程序和评估器等公平设置下具有可比性，并提供可复现的比较基准。

方法: 构建包含350个实例的全量基准测试，涵盖8种语言和43个仓库，数据源自SWE-bench-Multilingual和SWE-bench-Verified-Mini并经未来提交清理。同时发布包含80个实例的轻量版基准测试，通过成本感知和排名感知的程序从17个校准列中筛选。使用适配器协议连接智能体与基准测试，评估不同模型和工具集组合的性能及成本。

主要发现: 在完整基准测试上，OpenClaw使用最小直接差异适配器时Pass@1得分仅为百分之十九点一，而使用完整适配器时得分达到百分之七十三点四，表明适配器设计对有效执行代码任务至关重要。在模型和工具集的交叉测试中，模型选择导致Pass@1变化百分之二十九点四，工具集选择导致变化百分之二十七点四。此外，准确度相似的系统在总API成本上可能存在显著差异。

结论: Claw-SWE-Bench将工具集和成本核算视为SWE风格代码智能体评估的一等公民维度，提供了完整基准测试和低成本参考集，以支持可复现的比较。

翻译: General-purpose agents such as OpenClaw are increasingly used as autonomous tool users, but their coding ability is difficult to measure under SWE-bench: a generic agent does not by itself satisfy the clean Docker workspace, patch, and prediction contract required for scoring. We introduce Claw-SWE-Bench, a multilingual SWE-bench-style benchmark and adapter protocol that makes heterogeneous agent harnesses, or claws, comparable under fair settings including a fixed prompt, runtime budget, workspace contract, patch extraction procedure, and evaluator. The full benchmark contains 350 GitHub issue-resolution instances across 8 languages and 43 repositories, drawn from SWE-bench-Multilingual and SWE-bench-Verified-Mini after future-commit cleanup. We also release Claw-SWE-Bench Lite for faster validation, which is an 80-instance subset selected by a cost-aware, rank-aware procedure over 17 calibration columns. On the full benchmark, OpenClaw with a minimal direct-diff adapter scores only 19.1% Pass@1, whereas the full adapter reaches 73.4% with the same GLM 5.1 backbone, showing that adapter design is essential for enabling OpenClaw-style harnesses to perform coding tasks effectively. Across an OpenClaw × nine-model sweep and a five-claw × two-model sweep, model choice changes Pass@1 by 29.4 pp and harness choice by 27.4 pp under fixed models; systems with similar accuracy can differ substantially in total API cost. Claw-SWE-Bench therefore treats harness and cost accounting as first-class axes of SWE-style coding-agent evaluation, providing both a full benchmark and a low-cost reference set for reproducible comparison. The data is available at this https URL and this https URL .

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有代码能力评测基准将大语言模型、智能体框架与任务实例混杂的问题，导致无法公平评估智能体框架本身的编码能力。明确隔离并标准化评测框架，能够避免将运行成本或探索时间误认为能力优势，从而为研究者和开发者提供可复现、可横向对比的评估标准，助力高效且低成本的智能体系统迭代与选型。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有评测将模型、智能体框架和任务混杂，无法公平比较不同框架的编码能力，且通用智能体无法直接适配标准评测接口。为此，他们设计了适配协议与标准化执行流程，将智能体框架作为独立变量进行控制，并统一了提示词、运行环境、补丁提取和成本核算标准。该方法直接借鉴了标准代码评测基准的契约与容器机制，同时参考了现有单一框架评测的局限性，通过解耦评估栈实现了可复现的横向对比。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将智能体框架作为独立的实验变量，通过标准化接口协议将通用智能体与代码修复评测标准对接，从而在固定任务、运行预算和评分规则下公平比较不同框架的编码能力与资源消耗。整体实现流程首先构建包含多语言真实代码修复任务的基准数据集，接着要求不同智能体框架实现统一的调用接口以接入系统。随后由中央调度器在隔离的容器环境中统一执行任务，严格限制运行时间与并发数量，并从实际文件修改中自动提取代码补丁。最后通过官方验证程序检查补丁有效性，并同步记录解决率与总成本以供综合对比。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一套标准化的评测协议与基准，将智能体框架作为可控的实验变量进行独立评估。相比以往将大语言模型、智能体框架和任务捆绑评测的做法，该工作通过统一的适配器协议解耦了异构智能体与评测流程，并首次将接口调用成本与运行耗时作为核心指标与一次通过率并列报告。此外，论文还发布了一个低成本精简子集，便于快速验证与回归测试。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一套标准化的代码智能体基准测试框架与适配器协议，通过统一任务集、运行预算和评分标准，首次将通用智能体框架作为独立变量，公平评估其在真实代码修复任务中的解决能力与运行成本，并配套发布了完整数据集与轻量级验证子集。

Abstract

General-purpose agents such as OpenClaw are increasingly used as autonomous tool users, but their coding ability is difficult to measure under SWE-bench: a generic agent does not by itself satisfy the clean Docker workspace, patch, and prediction contract required for scoring. We introduce Claw-SWE-Bench, a multilingual SWE-bench-style benchmark and adapter protocol that makes heterogeneous agent harnesses, or claws, comparable under fair settings including a fixed prompt, runtime budget, workspace contract, patch extraction procedure, and evaluator. The full benchmark contains 350 GitHub issue-resolution instances across 8 languages and 43 repositories, drawn from SWE-bench-Multilingual and SWE-bench-Verified-Mini after future-commit cleanup. We also release Claw-SWE-Bench Lite for faster validation, which is an 80-instance subset selected by a cost-aware, rank-aware procedure over 17 calibration columns. On the full benchmark, OpenClaw with a minimal direct-diff adapter scores only $19.1\%$ Pass@1, whereas the full adapter reaches $73.4\%$ with the same GLM 5.1 backbone, showing that adapter design is essential for enabling OpenClaw-style harnesses to perform coding tasks effectively. Across an OpenClaw $\times$ nine-model sweep and a five-claw $\times$ two-model sweep, model choice changes Pass@1 by $29.4$ pp and harness choice by $27.4$ pp under fixed models; systems with similar accuracy can differ substantially in total API cost. Claw-SWE-Bench therefore treats harness and cost accounting as first-class axes of SWE-style coding-agent evaluation, providing both a full benchmark and a low-cost reference set for reproducible comparison. The data is available at this https URL and this https URL .

item.title: Atlas H&E-TME: Scalable AI-Based Tissue Profiling at Expert Pathologist-Level Accuracy
item.author: Kai Standvoss, Miriam Hägele, Rosemarie Krupar, Julika Ribbat-Idel, Jennifer Altschüler, Gerrit Erdmann, Hans Pinckaers, Evelyn Ramberger, Madleen Drinkwitz, Ádám Nárai, Alexander Möllers, Katja Lingelbach, Sebastian Kons, Lukas Hönig, Recepcan Adigüzel, Joana Baião, Alberto Megina Gonzalo, Marius Teodorescu, Marie-Lisa Eich, Paolo Chetta, Shakil Merchant, Verena Aumiller, Simon Schallenberg, Andrew Norgan, Klaus-Robert Müller, Lukas Ruff, Maximilian Alber, Frederick Klauschen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了基于Atlas病理基础模型的AI系统Atlas H&E-TME，该系统能够对多种癌症类型的苏木精和伊红染色全切片图像进行细胞级分辨率的定量分析，预测组织质量、区域和细胞类型标签，并生成超过四千五百个定量读数。

背景: 苏木精和伊红染色是组织病理学的基石，但对苏木精和伊红全切片图像进行可扩展的定量分析仍是计算病理学中的核心挑战。验证此类系统面临的主要困难在于仅依赖苏木精和伊红标准答案固有的形态学模糊性，以及依赖免疫组化等更丰富参考信息的可扩展性有限。

目的: 开发并验证一种能够克服形态学模糊性并实现大规模可扩展性的AI系统，以将苏木精和伊红切片转化为对肿瘤及其微环境的可扩展定量窗口，为转化和临床研究中的下一代基于组织的生物标志物奠定基础。

方法: 提出了一种结合生物学深度与技术形态学广度的双重验证框架。在深度方面，设计了免疫组化指导的多病理学家共识协议，以提高评分者间的一致性并建立分子层面的参考标准。在广度方面，在涵盖八种癌症类型及其常见转移部位的一千五百多例病例、超过二十万条高置信度苏木精和伊红病理学家注释上对系统进行了基准测试，这些病例来自二十五个以上来源和八个以上扫描仪模型。

主要发现: 在免疫组化指导的共识标准下，Atlas H&E-TME的性能匹配或超过了仅使用苏木精和伊红进行工作的病理学家，并在广泛的形态学和技术范围内表现出一致且稳健的泛化能力。

结论: Atlas H&E-TME成功将病理学中最普遍的数据即苏木精和伊红切片转化为对肿瘤及其微环境的可扩展定量窗口，为转化和临床研究中的下一代基于组织的生物标志物奠定了基础。

翻译: Hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) staining is the cornerstone of histopathology, yet scalable, quantitative analysis of H&E whole-slide images (WSIs) remains a central challenge in computational pathology. We present Atlas H&E-TME, an AI-based system built on the Atlas family of pathology foundation models that predicts tissue quality, tissue region, and cell type labels across multiple cancer types, yielding over 4,500 quantitative readouts per slide at cell-level resolution. A key challenge to validating such systems is overcoming morphological ambiguity inherent to H&E-only ground truth and the limited scalability of more informed references drawing on modalities such as immunohistochemistry (IHC). We address this with a dual validation framework combining biologically grounded depth with technical and morphological breadth. For depth, we propose an IHC-informed multi-pathologist consensus protocol that substantially improves inter-rater agreement over conventional H&E-only annotation. This yields a molecularly grounded reference against which we compare Atlas H&E-TME and pathologists working from H&E alone. For breadth, we benchmark Atlas H&E-TME on over 200,000 high-confidence H&E-only pathologist annotations across 1,500+ cases spanning eight cancer types and their most common metastatic sites, with subtypes covering >90% of clinical cases per cancer type, drawn from 25+ sources and 8+ scanner models. Benchmarked against the IHC-informed consensus, Atlas H&E-TME matches or exceeds pathologist H&E-only performance and generalizes consistently and robustly across this broad morphological and technical scope. In doing so, Atlas H&E-TME turns the H&E slide -- the most ubiquitous data in pathology -- into a scalable, quantitative window into the tumor and its microenvironment, laying a foundation for the next generation of tissue-based biomarkers in translational and clinical research.

Abstract

Hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) staining is the cornerstone of histopathology, yet scalable, quantitative analysis of H&E whole-slide images (WSIs) remains a central challenge in computational pathology. We present Atlas H&E-TME, an AI-based system built on the Atlas family of pathology foundation models that predicts tissue quality, tissue region, and cell type labels across multiple cancer types, yielding over 4,500 quantitative readouts per slide at cell-level resolution. A key challenge to validating such systems is overcoming morphological ambiguity inherent to H&E-only ground truth and the limited scalability of more informed references drawing on modalities such as immunohistochemistry (IHC). We address this with a dual validation framework combining biologically grounded depth with technical and morphological breadth. For depth, we propose an IHC-informed multi-pathologist consensus protocol that substantially improves inter-rater agreement over conventional H&E-only annotation. This yields a molecularly grounded reference against which we compare Atlas H&E-TME and pathologists working from H&E alone. For breadth, we benchmark Atlas H&E-TME on over 200,000 high-confidence H&E-only pathologist annotations across 1,500+ cases spanning eight cancer types and their most common metastatic sites, with subtypes covering >90% of clinical cases per cancer type, drawn from 25+ sources and 8+ scanner models. Benchmarked against the IHC-informed consensus, Atlas H&E-TME matches or exceeds pathologist H&E-only performance and generalizes consistently and robustly across this broad morphological and technical scope. In doing so, Atlas H&E-TME turns the H&E slide -- the most ubiquitous data in pathology -- into a scalable, quantitative window into the tumor and its microenvironment, laying a foundation for the next generation of tissue-based biomarkers in translational and clinical research.

item.title: Latent World Recovery for Multimodal Learning with Missing Modalities
item.author: Hui Wang, Tianyu Ren, Joseph Butler, Christopher Baker, Karen Rafferty, Simon McDade
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了在缺失模态情况下的多模态学习问题，提出了一种名为潜在世界恢复的框架，该框架通过在共享潜在空间中对齐特定模态的嵌入，并仅融合实际可用的模态嵌入来构建统一表示，从而在部分观测下实现鲁棒的多模态预测。

背景: 在生物科学应用中，异质模态在需要做出决策时往往只有部分可用。

目的: 解决在缺失模态情况下的多模态学习问题，避免显式重建缺失模态带来的误差传播，实现鲁棒的多模态预测。

方法: 提出潜在世界恢复框架，包含两个关键思想：一是将不同模态的特定模态嵌入对齐到共享潜在空间中；二是仅融合在训练和推理时实际可用的模态嵌入来构建统一表示。该方法将每个模态视为对底层潜在状态的局部感知，直接从观测到的模态进行可用性感知的表示学习。

主要发现: 在真实世界的不完整多组学基准测试上评估该框架，证明其在癌症表型分类和生存预测等下游任务中是一种有效的方法。

结论: 该框架通过基于邻居的潜在对齐和可用性感知的模态融合，能够在部分观测下实现鲁棒的多模态预测，同时避免显式重建缺失模态带来的误差传播。

翻译: We study multimodal learning under missing modalities, with particular motivation from bioscience applications in which heterogeneous modalities are often only partially available when decisions need to be made. We propose Latent World Recovery, a framework built on two key ideas: modality-specific embeddings from different modalities are aligned in a shared latent space, and a unified representation is constructed by fusing only the embeddings of the modalities that are actually available at both training and inference time. Rather than imputing missing modalities or requiring a fixed modality set, LWR treats each modality as a partial perception of an underlying latent state and performs availability-aware representation learning directly from the observed modalities. This combination of neighbor-based latent alignment and availability-aware modality fusion enables robust multimodal prediction under partial observation, while avoiding error propagation from explicit reconstruction of missing modalities. We evaluate the proposed framework on real-world incomplete multi-omics benchmarks and demonstrate that it provides an effective approach to downstream tasks such as cancer phenotype classification and survival prediction.

Abstract

We study multimodal learning under missing modalities, with particular motivation from bioscience applications in which heterogeneous modalities are often only partially available when decisions need to be made. We propose Latent World Recovery (LWR), a framework built on two key ideas: (i) modality-specific embeddings from different modalities are aligned in a shared latent space, and (ii) a unified representation is constructed by fusing only the embeddings of the modalities that are actually available at both training and inference time. Rather than imputing missing modalities or requiring a fixed modality set, LWR treats each modality as a partial perception of an underlying latent state and performs availability-aware representation learning directly from the observed modalities. This combination of neighbor-based latent alignment and availability-aware modality fusion enables robust multimodal prediction under partial observation, while avoiding error propagation from explicit reconstruction of missing modalities. We evaluate the proposed framework on real-world incomplete multi-omics benchmarks and demonstrate that it provides an effective approach to downstream tasks such as cancer phenotype classification and survival prediction.

item.title: On Subquadratic Architectures: From Applications to Principles
item.author: Anamaria-Roberta Hartl, Levente Zólyomi, David Stap, Pieter-Jan Hoedt, Niklas Schmidinger, Lukas Hauzenberger, Sebastian Böck, Günter Klambauer, Sepp Hochreiter
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文比较了三种次二次复杂度架构（xLSTM、Mamba-2 和 Gated DeltaNet）在复杂依赖任务上的表现，发现 xLSTM 整体性能最强，并通过统一公式和机制分析解释其优势源于更灵活稳定的记忆修正、状态追踪和累积能力。

背景: Transformer 主导现代序列建模，但其二次注意力机制带来高昂的计算成本。次二次复杂度架构提供了可扩展的替代方案，但尚不清楚哪些设计能产生最有效的序列模型。

目的: 比较三种领先的次二次复杂度架构（xLSTM、Mamba-2 和 Gated DeltaNet）在复杂依赖任务上的有效性，并解释 xLSTM 性能优势的原因。

方法: 在代码模型预训练、从大语言模型蒸馏代码模型以及时序基础模型预训练等复杂依赖任务上评估三种模型；提出统一公式分析架构机制，重点关注状态追踪和记忆动态；在受控的合成长度泛化任务上验证发现。

主要发现: xLSTM 在所有设置中提供最强的整体性能；其优势源于门控机制带来的更灵活和稳定的记忆修正能力；xLSTM 在复杂任务上的增益源于稳健的状态追踪和累积能力。

结论: xLSTM 凭借其稳健的状态追踪和累积能力，在复杂依赖任务上表现出显著优势，优于其他次二次复杂度架构。

翻译: Transformers dominate modern sequence modeling, but their quadratic attention incurs substantial computational cost. Subquadratic architectures offer a scalable alternative. However, it remains unclear which designs yield the most effective sequence models. We compare three leading approaches: xLSTM, Mamba-2, and Gated DeltaNet. We evaluate these models on tasks with complex dependencies: (1) code-model pre-training, (2) distillation of code models from large language models, and (3) pre-training of time-series foundation models. Across these settings, xLSTM delivers the strongest overall performance. To explain xLSTM's advantage, we present a unified formulation and analyze the underlying architectural mechanisms, focusing on state tracking and memory dynamics. Our results show that xLSTM enables more flexible and stable memory correction via its gating scheme. We corroborate these findings on controlled synthetic length-generalization tasks. Overall, our findings indicate that xLSTM's gains on complex tasks stem from robust state tracking and accumulation.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决在替代传统注意力模型的多种次二次复杂度架构中，究竟哪种设计在复杂依赖任务上表现最优，并揭示其背后的机制原因。该问题在研究和现实中非常重要，因为传统注意力模型的计算成本过高，而次二次复杂度架构是提升模型扩展性的关键替代方案。明确最优架构及其原理，有助于研究人员更高效地设计面向代码和时间序列等复杂数据的基础模型，从而在降低算力消耗的同时保持强大的序列建模能力。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者通过观察现有架构在复杂任务上表现差异不明显，提出将三种主流架构统一到一个分析框架中进行对比。他们借鉴了现有状态空间模型与线性注意力机制的数学表述，抽象出状态写入、遗忘、覆盖和读取的核心操作，从而设计出该统一框架。该方法直接建立在多项已有研究的基础之上，并在此基础上验证了状态追踪与累积能力对性能的影响。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是通过统一框架对比分析不同次二次复杂度序列模型在复杂任务中的表现，并揭示其底层状态追踪与记忆更新机制的差异。整体实现流程首先在三类复杂数据场景中进行实证性能对比，随后构建统一框架将各架构映射到状态写入、遗忘与读取的共性层面，最后通过受控的合成长度泛化任务验证状态追踪与累积能力对模型优势的决定性作用。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于首次将xLSTM、Mamba-2和门控DeltaNet三种主流次二次复杂度架构在代码预训练、代码蒸馏和时间序列预训练等复杂依赖任务上进行了直接对比，并提出了统一的形式化框架来解析它们的底层状态管理机制。相比以往仅在标准语言模型或常识推理基准上比较的工作，本文聚焦于具有长程结构化依赖的复杂数据，揭示了不同架构在状态追踪与累积能力上的本质差异。此外，论文通过受控的合成任务验证了xLSTM凭借更灵活稳定的记忆修正机制在复杂任务中表现更优的假设，填补了该领域的系统性对比与理论分析空白。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文首次系统对比了三种次二次架构在复杂任务上的表现，提出统一理论框架揭示其差异，并验证了xLSTM凭借更稳健的状态追踪与累积能力取得性能优势。

Abstract

Transformers dominate modern sequence modeling, but their quadratic attention incurs substantial computational cost. Subquadratic architectures offer a scalable alternative. However, it remains unclear which designs yield the most effective sequence models. We compare three leading approaches: xLSTM, Mamba-2, and Gated DeltaNet. We evaluate these models on tasks with complex dependencies: (1) code-model pre-training, (2) distillation of code models from large language models, and (3) pre-training of time-series foundation models. Across these settings, xLSTM delivers the strongest overall performance. To explain xLSTM's advantage, we present a unified formulation and analyze the underlying architectural mechanisms, focusing on state tracking and memory dynamics. Our results show that xLSTM enables more flexible and stable memory correction via its gating scheme. We corroborate these findings on controlled synthetic length-generalization tasks. Overall, our findings indicate that xLSTM's gains on complex tasks stem from robust state tracking and accumulation.

item.title: Breaking Entropy Bounds: Accelerating RL Training via MTP with Rejection Sampling
item.author: Li, Yucheng, Jiang, Huiqiang, Xu, Yang, Yang, Jianxin, Zhang, Yi, Cao, Yizhong, Shen, Yuhao, Zhou, Fan, Men, Rui, Zhang, Jianwei, Yang, An, Yu, Bowen, Zheng, Bo, Huang, Fei, Lin, Junyang, Liu, Dayiheng, Zhou, Jingren
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文系统研究了大语言模型后训练中的多令牌预测技术，提出了一种端到端损失函数和概率拒绝采样方法，显著提升了接受率和推理吞吐量，实现了异步强化学习训练中的端到端加速。

背景: 强化学习在现代大语言模型中已成为关键组成部分，但 rollout 阶段仍是强化学习训练流水线中的关键瓶颈。多令牌预测通过推测解码提供加速 rollouts 的自然解决方案，但在强化学习训练期间，多令牌预测的接受率显著下降，导致加速性能有限。

目的: 解决多令牌预测在强化学习训练中的瓶颈问题，提供将多令牌预测集成到大规模强化学习流水线的实用方法。

方法: 提出一种端到端 TV 损失函数，直接优化多步拒绝采样的接受率；采用概率拒绝采样替代贪婪草稿采样以减轻熵扰动的干扰；测试了各种在线多令牌预测训练策略，并验证了预强化学习多令牌预测训练结合端到端 TV 损失和拒绝采样的有效性。

主要发现: 多令牌预测的接受率受模型熵波动的根本限制，与强化学习阶段熵的增加呈明显的负线性关系；概率拒绝采样比贪婪草稿采样更能缓解熵带来的干扰；传统的多令牌预测训练目标（交叉熵或 KL）在此类设置下次优；端到端 TV 损失使接受率提高约百分之十，接受率最高可达百分之九十五，推理吞吐量最高增加百分之二十五；预强化学习多令牌预测训练结合端到端 TV 损失和拒绝采样在整个强化学习过程中实现一致的接受率和加速效果，无需昂贵的在线多令牌预测更新。

结论: 所提方法在 Qwen 系列模型的异步强化学习训练中实现了最高一点八倍的端到端加速，验证了该方法的有效性。

翻译: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a key component in modern large language models, yet the rollout stage remains the key bottleneck in RL training pipelines. Although Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) offers a natural solution to accelerate rollouts through speculative decoding, many studies have observed that MTP acceptance rates degrade significantly during RL training, leading to limited speedup performance. To address this bottleneck, we present Bebop, a systematic study of MTP in LLM post-training, and offer practical recipes to integrate MTP into large-scale RL pipelines. First, we reveal that the MTP acceptance rate is fundamentally bounded by the fluctuation of model entropy, which demonstrates a clear negative linear relationship with the rise of entropy in the RL stage. Second, we show that probabilistic rejection sampling largely alleviates the disturbance introduced by entropy in RL compared to greedy draft sampling. We further identify that the conventional MTP training objectives (cross-entropy or KL) are suboptimal in such settings, and therefore we propose a novel end-to-end TV loss that directly optimizes multi-step rejection sampling acceptance rate, yielding ~10% acceptance rate improvements, achieving up to 95% acceptance rates and up to 25% extra inference throughput gains across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and agentic tasks. Third, we test various online MTP training strategies during RL and show that pre-RL MTP training with e2e TV loss and rejection sampling achieves a consistent acceptance rate and speedup throughout the entire RL, eliminating the need for costly online MTP updating. We provide extensive experiments and analysis that validate our findings. Experimental results show our method achieves up to 1.8x end-to-end acceleration in async RL training of Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6, and Qwen3.7 models.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决大语言模型强化学习训练中推理生成阶段速度过慢的问题，特别是针对多令牌预测技术在训练过程中因模型不确定性波动导致预测接受率大幅下降的瓶颈。该问题在研究和现实中非常重要，因为强化学习训练的计算成本极高且严重依赖推理阶段，突破这一瓶颈能显著降低训练开销与时间，从而加速大模型的迭代优化与高效部署。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者首先通过实验发现直接应用多词元预测会导致接受率下降，并理论分析指出这主要受模型熵值波动的制约。基于此，他们放弃传统的贪婪采样，改用概率拒绝采样以降低对熵值变化的敏感度，并针对该机制设计了端到端的总变差损失函数来直接优化多步接受率。该方法借鉴了现有的投机解码与多词元预测技术，同时参考了前期尝试在强化学习过程中在线训练预测模块的改进方案，但通过前置训练和损失函数创新避免了高昂的在线更新开销。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是利用概率拒绝采样替代贪婪采样，以缓解强化学习过程中模型不确定性波动对多词元预测接受率的负面影响，并通过端到端的总变差损失函数在训练前直接优化多步接受率。整体流程为：在强化学习开始前，使用新损失函数对多词元预测模块进行轻量级预训练；随后在强化学习的推理生成阶段，直接调用该预训练模块配合拒绝采样进行加速，全程无需在线更新预测模块，从而实现稳定高效的训练加速。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于揭示了强化学习训练中多词元预测接受率下降的根本原因是目标模型的熵波动，并证明概率拒绝采样能有效缓解这一问题。论文还提出了一种全新的端到端总变差损失函数，直接优化多步接受率，替代了传统的交叉熵或散度目标。与以往依赖昂贵在线联合训练的方法不同，该方案仅需在训练前进行轻量级预训练，即可在整个强化学习过程中保持稳定的加速效果，大幅降低了计算开销。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种结合概率拒绝采样与端到端总变差损失的新方法，有效克服了强化学习训练中模型不确定性波动对多词元预测接受率的限制，无需在线更新即可实现稳定的推理加速。

Abstract

Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a key component in modern large language models, yet the rollout stage remains the key bottleneck in RL training pipelines. Although Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) offers a natural solution to accelerate rollouts through speculative decoding, many studies have observed that MTP acceptance rates degrade significantly during RL training, leading to limited speedup performance. To address this bottleneck, we present Bebop, a systematic study of MTP in LLM post-training, and offer practical recipes to integrate MTP into large-scale RL pipelines. First, we reveal that the MTP acceptance rate is fundamentally bounded by the fluctuation of model entropy, which demonstrates a clear negative linear relationship with the rise of entropy in the RL stage. Second, we show that probabilistic rejection sampling largely alleviates the disturbance introduced by entropy in RL compared to greedy draft sampling. We further identify that the conventional MTP training objectives (cross-entropy or KL) are suboptimal in such settings, and therefore we propose a novel end-to-end TV loss that directly optimizes multi-step rejection sampling acceptance rate, yielding ~10% acceptance rate improvements, achieving up to 95% acceptance rates and up to 25% extra inference throughput gains across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and agentic tasks. Third, we test various online MTP training strategies during RL and show that pre-RL MTP training with e2e TV loss and rejection sampling achieves a consistent acceptance rate and speedup throughout the entire RL, eliminating the need for costly online MTP updating. We provide extensive experiments and analysis that validate our findings. Experimental results show our method achieves up to 1.8x end-to-end acceleration in async RL training of Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6, and Qwen3.7 models.

item.title: Verifiable Environments Are LEGO Bricks: Recursive Composition for Reasoning Generalization
item.author: Xiang, Hao, Tang, Qiaoyu, Yu, Le, Lu, Yaojie, Han, Xianpei, He, Ben, Sun, Le, Yu, Bowen, Wang, Peng, Lin, Hongyu, Liu, Dayiheng
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为RACES的框架，通过将可验证环境视为可组合的构建块并递归组装，以增强大型语言模型的推理能力。

背景: 强化学习在可验证环境中被证明能有效提升大型语言模型的推理能力，但现有手动或个体构建方法存在线性扩展限制，阻碍了推理泛化的可扩展性。

目的: 解决现有环境构建方法扩展性不足的问题，实现推理泛化的可扩展性。

方法: 提出RACES框架，将可验证环境视为可组合的构建块，当输出类型与输入类型匹配时自动融合为新环境，并定义了顺序、并行、排序和选择等组合算子，使用少量基础环境递归生成大量复合环境。

主要发现: 在复合环境上进行强化学习训练能持续提升推理泛化能力；在六个未见过的基准测试中，RACES使DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B平均提升3.1分，Qwen3-14B从58.8提升至61.1；仅用50个基础环境即可达到与300个个体环境训练相当的性能，显著提高了环境利用效率。

结论: RACES框架通过递归自动组合环境，有效提升了大型语言模型的推理泛化能力，并在环境利用效率方面表现出显著优势。

翻译: Reinforcement Learning (RL) with verifiable environments has emerged as a powerful approach for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). While prior research demonstrates that scaling environment quantity improves RL performance, existing manual or individual construction methods suffer from linear scaling limits, thereby hindering scalable reasoning generalization. This paper introduces RACES (Recursive Automated Composition for Environment Scaling), a framework that conceptualizes verifiable environments as composable building blocks that can be recursively assembled. The key insight is that when the codomain (output type) of one environment matches the domain (input type) of another, they can be automatically fused into a new verifiable environment, enabling recursive composition. RACES is implemented with 300 individual environments and defines a set of composition operators (SEQUENTIAL, PARALLEL, SORT, and SELECT) that induce diverse reasoning patterns. Extensive experiments show that RL training on these composite environments consistently enhances reasoning generalization. Specifically, RACES improves DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B by an average of 3.1 points (from 48.2 to 51.3) and boosts Qwen3-14B performance from 58.8 to 61.1 on six benchmarks, which are unseen during the construction of training environments. Moreover, RACES achieves performance comparable to training on 300 individual environments using only 50 base environments, demonstrating significant efficiency in environment utilization.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有验证环境构建方法扩展性差、难以通过增加环境数量有效提升大语言模型推理泛化能力的问题。该问题在研究中非常重要，因为传统方法只能线性增加环境，导致训练数据多样性不足且成本高昂。通过递归组合基础环境，该方法能以极小的成本生成海量多样化的推理任务，显著提升模型在未见任务上的泛化性能，为高效训练推理模型提供了新路径。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现传统手动构建验证环境的方式扩展性有限，因此受数学变换组合的封闭性质及现有问题组合研究的启发，将环境视为可拼接的积木。他们设计了基于输入输出类型匹配的自动融合机制，通过递归组合有限的基础环境来生成海量且多样的训练任务。该方法借鉴了现有问题组合工作的思路，但克服了以往仅在问题层面浅层组合的局限，实现了程序级的深度递归扩展。
